v5569.title: 想ひ出坂
v5569.originalDescription:
A landscape with a nostalgic atmosphere. A woman is always standing on a slope behind the scenery.
...  This is the mysterious dream that comes every night. The hero returns to his home town as a practice student and recognized the girl of his dreams in Tamiya Maika. While still wondering about this connection, he gets to know that the teacher was killed in the arts classroom. He sets on the investigation to find out the truth behind the incident.
v5569.description:
梦……梦是会发生各种不可思议之事的世界。
然而，主人公所做的梦，总是同一个。
那是某处令人怀念的风景……
在爬完某条坡道的地方，有一位女性伫立在那里的梦。
开始做这个梦，是从为了考取教师资格证而回到老家的时候起。
主人公作为教育实习生，要在自己曾就读的学园度过两周，没想到原本是男女共学的学园竟然变成了女校。
然后，在这所学园里，主人公遇到了与梦中女性长得一模一样的少女“田宫 舞华”。
为什么她会在梦里……怀揣着这个谜团，波澜万丈的学园生活开始了。
在习惯了学园和学生们，觉得待得相当舒适后的某一天，
发生了动摇整个学园的大事件……
梦……事件……谜……。被卷入黑色漩涡的主人公的命运是……。

Momoko-chan for Me R Gaiden ~Yubiwa ni Kometa Omoi~
v6208.originalDescription: Main character is a doctor who finally decides to propose to his assistant nurse Momoko. He buys a ring, but it disappears. He gets upset, but starts to think that maybe it's a sign not to get bonded with just one person.
v6208.description:
故事从主人公——年轻的镇上医生高橋恭司买下一枚戒指开始拉开帷幕。
那枚戒指，是订婚戒指。
送出的对象，是身为恋人的新手护士小笠原桃子(小笠原ももこ)。
从交往开始算起已经1年，恭司终于下定决心向她求婚了。
“她会收下吗，桃子酱……”
然而何等不幸，他在买下戒指的当天就把它弄丢了。
消沉的恭司……但他以此为契机，开始重新思考结婚究竟是怎么一回事。
“一直爱着一个女性，是怎样一回事？”
“选择人生的伴侣、一生的搭档，又是怎样一回事？”
在这样的他身边，除了桃子以外，还有与各种女性们的相遇在等待着他。
贯彻与恋人桃子的爱也好，选择与其他女性的关系也好。
一切，都取决于你的判断。
然后最后，在你身边微笑着的是谁？
那是作为恋人？还是……作为新娘？
通过“结婚”这一现实主题描绘的，等身大的男女恋爱故事。
连同寄托于戒指的思念一起，送到你的心中。

v6516.originalDescription: Main character moves to a rural area after poverty life in the city. One day he bumps into a cheeky girl who looks for some person. The next day this girl waits for him at his house together with another girl who claims to be protagonist's marriage partner. In such way a quiet life turns into vigorous one in co-habitation with two girls.
v6516.description:
主人公吉田孝弘离开了调职到地方的父母，独自一人享受着贫穷的独居生活的学生。然而，他的生活以某一天为界，发生了翻天覆地的变化。

“请问您知道吉田孝弘先生的家在哪里吗……？”

上学途中，他被一个看起来十分懂礼貌、散发着清纯气息的女孩突然搭话。听到自己的名字吓了一跳的孝弘，当场说了句不知道敷衍了过去。

那天放学后，他撞上了一个突然从拐角冲出来、看起来十分嚣张的女孩。虽然两人发生了口角，但对方却说“总之你给我小心点。我赶时间”，单方面把他当成坏人后逃跑了。

到了晚上。他应答了对讲机，发现那里站着早上遇到的女孩。自称“南城千鹤(南城ちづる)”的女孩说，她从小作为我的未婚妻被抚养长大，这次是为了嫁给我才离开了老家。

第二天。他一边为千鹤的事烦恼一边回到家，却发现那里又有一张见过的面孔。房间里，昨天撞到的那个嚣张的女孩“雾村阳子(霧村陽子)”擅自闯了进来。

就这样，男人一个人的平静生活宣告结束，与两位不请自来的美少女之间，吵吵闹闹的忙碌日子拉开了帷幕。

v6831.description:
御厨 潤一郎（みくりや じゅんいちろう），22岁。
他在那年春天入职的公司里，度过了忙碌的每一天。
某天夜里，从老家寄来的包裹里，和信件、食物一起，
装着他小时候最喜欢的玩具手机。
潤一郎出于怀念，仔细端详着这个玩具手机。
就在这时，突然手中的玩具手机发出了尖锐的电子音，响彻了整个
房间。明明没有装电池……
潤一郎战战兢兢地把它贴到耳边。从里面隐约传来的，
是完全无法想象属于这个世上的女人的声音。

　我绝对，会去成为你的新娘的……』

v7804.title: 姦染5 ～The Daybreak～
v7804.originalDescription:
Four years ago, Makoto Nakazawa lost family, friends, and even memory of the events during the outbreak of the Unknown virus epidemic in the Tohoku region of Japan.
Now adopted by a female friend of his deceased father, he lives in the Shibuya district of Tokyo, struggling to rebuild a new life in a new land. However he doesn't suspect what Fate has for him when he accepts to go to a little (and not entirely fictional) island in the Inland Sea of Japan as correspondent for the newspaper club of his school, because that island is about to become one of the starting points of the second outbreak of the epidemic he barely survived once...
v7804.description:
灾难，波及到整个日本。

200X年。
被卷进东北发生的病毒灾害的中泽诚(なかざわ まこと)，在失去了家人和朋友之后，也丧失了当天的记忆。
度过了数年的设施生活后，他被自卫队军人的父亲的部下，灾害时曾救过自己的日向夏都(ひゅうが なつ)领养，转移到东京的涉谷居住。
“已经没有了失去重要的人的现实感”
他一边隐隐地介意着此，一边和夏都同居，过着平静的学园生活。

灾难4年后的8月。、
从属于新闻部的诚，和准备进行运动部的集训取材的朋友出渊，上级生南彩月(みなみ さつき)一起在濑渡内
海的大神岛上住宿。
同时关系不错的下级生越智茜梨(おち あかり)以及啦啦队部的部员也一起同行了。
在诚对茜梨隐藏的秘密的感情悄悄膨胀的时候——

——“那个”灾害，再次悄悄降临。

在观光地附近的赌场“Testament”里，作为头号荷官兼调酒师工作的黑泽瞳（くろさわ・ひとみ）。有一天，在回家时驾驶的汽车差点撞到一名男性。幸好避免了接触，但男性失去了意识倒在路边。瞳照顾了他，但男性明显是一副“倒地不起”的打扮，无法置之不理，于是将男性带回了家。男性醒了过来，但发现他完全没有记忆。也没有能证明男性身份的东西。
无奈之下，瞳允许了他同居。给他取了“健太”这个名字，同居生活开始了。

平时，瞳即使与他人接触，也总有一种退避一步的感觉。然而不知为何，唯独对健太很少表现出这种态度。不久后，健太在“Testament”的日常生活中，逐渐察觉到了瞳隐藏的心情……

Kansen Ball Buster is split into two different scenarios titled "The Other Aspect" and "The Chronicle Teller."

"The Other Aspect" features Senoo Kazumi who is currently living alone and job hunting in Tokyo. One day his sister Tsugumi comes to visit him to make sure that he is still alive, since he has not spoken to his family in a while. On the same day, the virus known as Unknown LV4 breaks out causing panic and mayhem across the city. 初音顺利地击破了一个又一个怪人。

而＜格雷纳达＞的干部怪人达姆德(ダムド)，
其作战屡屡被普利兹姆雷克妨碍，
在组织内沦为了笑柄，自尊被撕得粉碎。
就在这时，＜格雷纳达＞的疯狂科学家布雷恩博士，
向他提出了一个主意：对普利兹姆雷克施加洗脑催眠来进行复仇。

纯洁、正直，且蕴藏着无比坚强意志的那颗心。
为了将那颗心按他们的意愿改写，使其蜕变成只要被要求，哪怕在大街上也会脱下衣服张开双腿的淫乱雌性奴隶，他们开始行动了。

在接连不断的洗脑催眠下，普利兹姆雷克被压制住了正义之心，
被打入了耻辱与快乐的地狱……！

她究竟能否将那颗正义之心坚持到最后，
又或者，会如＜格雷纳达＞所愿被彻底洗脑呢——

Aku no Onna Kanbu 2 "Kisama nado ni Kyouiku Sarete Tamaru ka!"
v15127.originalDescription:
Ex-delinquent Tobimura Eigo has his first day of receiving his new job as teacher ruined by the rampage of a mysterious group of evil woman executives. To make it worse, his next job at Otoki school is stolen by some random guy introduced himself as God of Education's descendant. Devastated, he goes to the schoolyard just to get involved in the flashy battle between those hateful evil woman executives and the superhero named Bakken Loader.

After twists and turns, he ends up as spy impersonating that God of Education guy who was supposed to join the evil organization behind the school on the same day. Together with the superhero Bakken Loader and the divine beast of God of Education, he decides to use his new power to overthrow the evil mastermind which takes root in this school by "Educating" those woman executives.
v15127.description:
飞村英吾是个前不良少年的新手教师。
他满怀热情地想着“应该会有能理解差生心情的教书匠才对！”从而当上了教师，但或许是过去的所作所为招致了灾祸，赴任地迟迟没有着落，处于待业状态。
好不容易定下来的赴任地，也被突然出现的自称“ブラックメルヘン”的谜之集团给破坏了。
就在他快要放弃当老师的时候，收到了来自地方上的巨型学校——私立大户岐学园的邀请。
当然，英吾二话不说就决定赴任。
然而，等他真的去了学园，不知为何赴任的事却没了下文？
这背后依然有谜之集团ブラックメルヘン的影子。
据说这所学园里有着能颠覆世界的“宝物”，ブラックメルヘン为了得到它而占领了学园，表面上作为教师在里面工作。
两次工作的事都被搞得不了了之，怒火中烧的英吾心想“哪怕就一拳也要揍飞他们！”，于是向ブラックメルヘン发起了挑战。
就在这时，一位被称为“吉备桃花(バッケンローダー)”的少女出现了，她比英吾更早向ブラックメルヘン发起了战斗。
被卷入吉备桃花与ブラックメルヘン激烈战斗中的英吾，偶然夺走了敌方干部的能力！
接着，目睹了事情始末的吉备桃花向他请求道：“希望你伪装成敌方干部潜入ブラックメルヘン，协助我。”
这显然是个危险的任务，但作为教师，绝不能原谅利用学园的ブラックメルヘン！
说实话，就是想把那些耍了我的家伙们彻底打垮！！话说回来我只是想要工作！！
出于这些想法，他决定协助吉备桃花。
就这样，为了打垮邪恶组织，英吾作为邪恶组织干部兼教师的生涯开始了！

aliases: 聖騎士セルシア ～悪辣たる姫君～
The Uncoming of Holy Knight Celsia
v17949.originalDescription:
Celsia, Aishu and Fiorun had toppled the demon overlord who threatened to conquer their world. Peace returned, but only briefly.

A messenger came to Forestoire, Celsia's homeland, to beg the heroines' assistance in a nearby village.
They embarked to help, and came face to face with Luquus, the daughter of the toppled demon.
She vowed revenge for what they'd done to her father......! 

A visual novel of epic depravity, where myriad creatures destroy the yielded loins of a holy knight and her party!
v17949.description:
手握众神赐予的“圣刻”，圣骑士塞尔西亚(セルシア)和她的同伴们挑战讨伐魔王戈尔扎伊尔(ゴルザイル)。
激战之后，虽然塞尔西亚的哥哥塞尼亚(セニア)牺牲了，但魔王被封印，这个世界迎来了和平。
然而，短暂的和平时光转瞬即逝，塞尔西亚收到了紧急的传令。
那是正在走向复兴的邻近城镇阿尔托(アルト)发来的救援请求。
城镇遭到了一个名叫奥尔奥加(オルオガ)的兽人首领率领的盗贼团的袭击。
塞尔西亚与战士艾修(アイッシュ)、僧侣菲奥尔恩(フィオルン)立刻带领数十名骑士团员前往阿尔托，
成功反杀了袭来的魔族，击退了奥尔奥加。
城镇的居民伴随着欢呼迎接骑士团，并举办了简朴的宴席作为款待。
就在宴会气氛达到最高潮时，撕裂丝绸般的尖叫声响彻阿尔托城镇。
赶到现场的塞尔西亚等人看到的是，骑士团员袭击城镇少女的异常光景。
团员像失去理智般双眼充血，发出不似人类的疯狂叫声后，身体变为了异形的存在。
此时突然出现的，是魔族少女露库斯(ルキュス)。她的真实身份竟然是，魔王戈尔扎伊尔的女儿。
露库斯在城镇中布下了改变人体的结界，正逐渐将人类变成魔族。
面对找不到破局之策的塞尔西亚等人，露库斯提出了一个提议。
那就是，只要服从露库斯的指示，就会削弱结界的力量。
怀揣着身为圣骑士的骄傲，塞尔西亚舍弃了武器，接受了露库斯的要求。
就这样，魔王之女露库斯名为复仇的奸计开始了……

v18650.title: 姦染 Clipping Chronicle
v18650.originalDescription: Set a few days before the initial outbreak of the Kansen Virus in the Tohoku region of Japan. Shibue Akira, Suda, Ashina Rui, and Kiyohara Riri are on their way to the Summer training camp facility where they are training for the sport's nationals hosted in Autumn. The Summer training camp will also be hosting participants from other schools located in the Tohoku region. On the way there, they see an abandoned car which is only one of the mysterious events leading up to the survival of their lives from the people infected with the Kansen Virus.
v18650.description:
就读于画馆仙北学园的渋江央，参加了所属游泳部与田径部的夏季联合合宿。

与游泳部部长兼学生会长的芦名累，以及隶属田径部的青梅竹马清原梨里，

还有须田等同为社团活动的伙伴和参加合宿的同伴们，央与他们度过了既严酷又快乐的时光。

对憧憬之人的思念，在青梅竹马与好友的恋情中摇摆不定的心，与朋友畅谈的对未来那模糊的不安与梦想。

在夏日里流逝的，平凡的青春时光。

那本该○地鲜明却又平稳地流逝，作为难以忘怀的回忆留存下来。

另一方面——

在无人知晓处繁殖蔓延的，使一切陷入○○狂气的恶疫。\
逐渐被夺去理性、变得凶暴的感染者们。

呼唤终结的灾厄之影成群结队，将他们包围，企图蹂躏一切。

v19042.originalDescription:
A "netorase" play—where a husband lends his wife to another man.
It had been about a year since Kenji, the husband, had lent his beloved wife, Marina, to a former adult film actor.

Over time, Kenji began to feel an even stronger desire: he wanted to see Marina willingly cheat on him, driven by her own desires.

Then, one day, Marina received a message from her ex-boyfriend—the first contact in over a decade. He wanted to rekindle their relationship, with marriage as the goal.
Marina, of course, turned him down. But when Kenji heard about it, he confessed the darker, more forbidden desire he’d been harboring:
"I want you to get back together with your ex."

This was different from before. This time, it would all be Marina’s choice—a relationship she entered willingly.
As her ex continued to pursue her, determined to win her back, Marina found herself at a crossroads. What would she do—?

被打算复合的前男友不断逼迫的满里奈，究竟会——

v29242.originalDescription: In a world where humans and different magical races coexist, interactions between them bring both benefits and an increase in heinous crimes by the magical beings. The story follows a feared operative known as the Demon Slayer Princess and her succubus partner, Elmia, as they team up to solve crimes, engaging in deadly battles to uphold law and order.
v29242.description:
世界各地通往异界的大门开启已有数百年。
与非人种族——『魔族』的交流在为世界带来改变与恩惠的同时，也导致了涉及魔族的凶恶犯罪不断增加。
隶属于犯罪组织的魔族们、从异国流入的魔族们，以及与他们勾结的人类暗中活跃，不知不觉间这个国家的首都·东京也露出了犯罪都市的面目。
曾被称为世界最安全国家的面貌已荡然无存。
然而，为了给被黑暗笼罩的这个国家点亮光明，为了让无辜的人们能多享受哪怕一点点的和平，有人在水面下防范着危机。
——万里无云的澄澈夜空，满月照耀着霓虹闪烁的超高层建筑群。
在距离市中心稍远的东京湾上，一艘巨大的游轮内正举办着盛大的派对。
身穿西装和礼服的男男女女们在交谈中谈笑风生。
但这并非普通的社交派对，那里正在进行的，竟是年轻女性的人口贩卖拍卖——
在那里，犯罪组织主办的下流宴会正不为人知地举行着。
参加这场宴席的，两位身穿美丽礼服的年轻少女互相看向对方。
刹那间，伴随着窗户破碎的声音，烟雾与闪光支配了整个会场。
接着，从外面、从里面的门闯入的是……究竟刚才一直潜伏在哪里。身穿特殊作战服的男男女女，以及魔族战斗员们。
他们是扫荡危害社会的人魔的存在——
隶属于政府麾下特务谍报机关『神槌』，由拥有高洁精神的人类与善良魔族集结而成的被选中的人们。
参与这场强袭作战的，包括从礼服迅速换装、同样身穿特殊作战服的御厨美命和埃尔米亚·舒蒂贝尔(エルミア・シュティーベル)，特别是美命，以『魔灭姬』的异名令人敬畏。
与刚才截然不同，会场内化作了与优雅相去甚远、沾满鲜血与暴力的阿鼻叫唤地狱。
参加黑暗派对的人中，大多数在投降后被无力化，然而，其中也有将姿态变回本来面目进行抵抗的恶德魔族，以及命令护卫佣兵进行抵抗的人类。
但是，曾与无数犯罪组织对决、穿梭于生死线间的美命等人毫不犹豫地迎击，不断重复着歼灭与拘束，将敌人镇压。
美命用爱剑『风切』一刺，刺穿了勉强保住意识、倒在地上伺机反击的魔族的脖子。
被雇为佣兵的半兽人魔族从口中吐出鲜血与丑陋的浊音后，便不再动弹了。
在交战中，敌方魔族拿出神秘的糖果含在口中咬碎的刹那，突然间，以臂力为首的身体动作被激活了。
如果稍有松懈，就算是身经百战的美命等人，也免不了受个一两处伤吧。
凝视着满月，美命脑海中忽然闪过那个在自己心中留下深深创伤、实体不明的巨大犯罪组织的存在。
——就这样，涉及魔族的犯罪在美命和埃尔米亚等人的活跃下，被防患于未然。
但是，这终究不过是解决了一个事件而已，美命等人与恶德人魔之间的战斗没有尽头。
——而那场战斗，即将迎来新的局面。

v48766.originalDescription:
――Yatou Akari, an ordinary school girl attending an all-girls' school. Her grades are decent, engaging in club activities, and has a lot of friends. Perhaps because she has reached a certain age, in her room, on a spur of the moment, she masturbates. After climaxing with pleasure, she tirelessly opens her eyes and finds――

v48766.description:
――女学生「夜藤 朱莉（やとう あかり）」
她是个在女学院上学的极其普通的少女。
学习还算过得去，也努力参加社团活动，和朋友闲聊时聊得热火朝天。
这样的她或许也到了年纪，偶尔会在自己房间里进行自慰行为。
顺随快感迎来高潮，在慵懒中睁开眼睛，那里是――

既不是在床上也不是在自己房间，更不是在学院的宿舍内，而是坚硬的石板地上，一个没有见过的昏暗之处。

就在朱莉心想这是不是做梦，不由得快要发出声音的那一刹那。
映入眼帘的，是一个比她先发出声音的陌生人。

“啊啊啊啊啊！？什么！？为什么！？等一下。……诶？我？这是我的失误吗？”

嘴里这样叫喊着，明显惊慌失措的女性。
光滑的褐色肌肤和尖尖的长耳。看到她那似乎是只穿着内衣的模样，朱莉纯粹地觉得很美，同时也觉得这一定是在做梦。

竟然会出现小说或漫画里的人物，我，不，我的梦还真是够宅向的啊，她这么想着。

也许是高潮的余韵还未完全消退，身体非常慵懒。
想着干脆就这样睡到晚饭时间吧，于是再次闭上了眼睛。

然而。

“不不不！这怎么可能！为什么？偏偏是人类？而且，看起来明显很贫弱是个粪杂鱼不是吗！”

即使闭上眼睛也能听到的，明显的谩骂。
自己确实是人类，但身材并没有贫弱到那种地步。
胸部也比一般人要大，又不是胖。

明明是在做梦，为什么非得要挨骂呢？
加上身体的慵懒，没有力气回嘴的朱莉叹着气，想着这么失礼的梦怎么还不快点醒来。

但是，对朱莉的谩骂并没有停止，夹杂着一些听不懂的单词，那个女人的谩骂还在继续。

终于忍耐到了极限，为了反击那些谩骂，朱莉强行撑起慵懒的身体。

“啊，真是的！到底是怎么回事……啊？”

……这里本该是梦。
但是，一切都莫名地真实而生动。

撑在地上的手掌所感受到的，冰凉的石板路触感。
是灰尘还是霉菌，总之是种陈旧的气味。
在梦里，能体会到如此真实的感觉吗？
因为这种感觉，不由得声音变得微弱，尾音也变得模糊，焦躁和疑问，甚至是不安顿时袭来。

“这是什么？”“怎么回事？”“这里是哪里？”
“怎么回去？”“眼前的精灵是真的吗？”
“诶？我刚才在自己房间里自慰了对吧？”
“等一下，什么？去了之后，就到了别的地方？”

简直就是恐慌。
高潮的余韵瞬间烟消云散，伴随着血液抽离的感觉和脑内被疑问句填满的，无可救药的焦躁感。

仿佛要踩碎混乱中朱莉的脑袋一般，谩骂的声音变成了格外大的一声叹息，毫无感情地宣告道。

“哈……。要你来当这个世界的魔王。如果不想死……如果想回原来的世界，就乖乖服从吧，粪杂鱼的人类！”

“哈？哈啊啊啊啊！？”

――朱莉究竟能否回到现代世界。又或者成为异世界的魔王呢。

Time passed, and they reunite at the promised spot. Along with an uninvited darkness.

他们在某处设施里像兄弟姐妹一样长大，但那个堪称他们老家的设施被关闭了，他们各自分道扬镳——

——约定好总有一天，要在这里再次相聚。

然后，10年的岁月流逝，他们如约在约定的地方重逢了。

与不请自来的“黑暗”一同。

v490.originalDescription: One month ’till Christmas Day. Students at Shigure High School are excited about it. Toru is also looking forward to it. But there is one thing that worries him: a girl who appears in his dreams. One night, the girl in his dream asks him, “Do you want to change your memories?” He recalls his childhood – he had lost his parents, and had decided to live with his younger sister. “Shall I change your memories?” Her mysterious offer turns into reality…
v490.description:
选择的过去、希冀的现在——以及延续的未来。

离「X’mas」约还有一个月。在万里无云的蓝天下，「時雨学園」的学生也因为临近的节日而浮躁不已。「徹」也不例外，他怀着符合这个年纪的男生的期待。
彼此很熟悉的唯一的家人「青梅竹马们」和「妹妹」。有孽缘的「化学教師」和憧憬的「学生会长」，打工处的「店长」。
但是，最近每晚都会做的「奇怪的梦」微微减淡了徹这淡淡的期待。

那个有些奇怪的梦带来的是与「神秘少女」的邂逅。
但是快乐的日子还是在迅速地流逝。即将要到X’mas的时候……梦中的少女微笑着说道。
『要不要……改变回忆？』
听到这句话的时候，徹想到的是往昔的童年……为了不输给失去了重要的父母的沉痛的悲伤而和唯一的妹妹一起宣誓的那一天。

『我来……改变你的回忆吧？』

对徹来说，少女所言的神秘的话语不知不觉化为了既是非现实，但又确实存在的现实……

v562.description:
「通往幸福前方的故事」

春。

因身为世界级美术家的父亲去世，变得天涯孤独的主人公草薙直哉，决定寄宿在挚友夏目圭的家中。

在那里，等待着的是与直哉就读学园的班主任夏目蓝，以及圭的妹妹、身为女演员的夏目雫的交流。

然后，随着新学期的到来，很久以前转学的青梅竹马御樱禀，再次出现在直哉面前。

在随风飞舞的樱花花瓣彼端，那宛如早已约定好的重逢一般——。

当时光的刻痕重叠思念，感情的奔流化作形体之时，在那里遇见的光景是？

故事前方的幸福。

那前方的故事的形态——。

樱之诗，是停下脚步的人与在那前方继续前行的人们的故事。

ーWhat comes after happiness?

It is springtime, and Naoya Kusanagi has just been orphaned by the death of his father (the world-famous painter). He moves in with his best friend Kei’s family, where he grows closer to his homeroom teacher Ai and to Kei’s younger sister, the actress Shizuku Natsume.
As the new semester arrives, his childhood friend Rin Misakura, who had transferred to a different school long ago, returns to his life as well.

A gust stirs up a swirl of sakura petals—with a promised reunion in its wake.

Feelings grow fonder to time’s constant drumbeat, and the torrent of emotion begins to take shape—but where will it lead?

Sakura no Uta is a story of those whose paths stop short—and of those who walk on.

露出悠闲睡脸的健太的内裤，被四只手臂慢慢地拉了下去。
咯咯的笑声，仿佛被夜幕吞噬般洒落——

v18806.title: 夏之锁
v18806.description: 暑假开始了，升学后的日常毫无变化，主人公感到日子灰暗无聊，决定亲自改变这个灰色的世界。一次偶然与误会，让两个原本不会有深入交往的人纠缠在一起。
v18806.originalDescription:
It's the beginning of summer. I moved up a class but nothing changed. This year is the same as last and the next, nothing will ever change. A dreary every day life. If only I knew why I'm so depressed. My relentlessly boring life won't reveal the cause or name of this feeling. Therefore, I will change this bleak world by myself. 

I will now carry out what I've always imagined. My plan is perfect. Now I just have to choose a girl to entrap in my scheme. Anyone will do, as long as she's not boring. For example, the girl walking in front of me with the long black hair. I don't desire a brightly shining summer. What I crave are days filled with a girl's screams and despair.

v38402.title: 薔薇姫綺譚
v38402.originalDescription:
A colossal underground cavern, never once glimpsed by human eyes, and a manor built within it. A young girl, raised in this world untouched by light, lived peacefully with her beloved father and their servant. As time flowed gently by, the girl — Claritte — grew into a beautiful woman, and it seemed the days of tranquility might continue forever.

But then, Claritte's father, Clemens, was struck down by a mysterious illness, shattering the peace of the manor in the darkness. Claritte bravely retreated to her father's study in search of a cure for his strange affliction. There, she discovered a mysterious book and learned of the existence of a unique rose, said to heal any illness. The rose was said to exist only in the manor's deepest reaches, but to arrive there, one must undergo several "trials". Furthermore, the book warned that even if she were to attempt the trials, should Claritte prove unable to endure them, the path to the rose would be closed, and Clemens would meet his end at the culmination of his sickness.

One day, as Claritte dwelled on thoughts of her ailing father, the servant, Ludoana, informed her that the condition of Clemens was worsening. To the girl, resolved to save her father, the mysterious book revealed the path leading to the trials. Seeking the rose, Claritte cast herself into the darkness of the trials.
v38402.description:
巨大的地下洞窟，从未被人类之眼瞥见，以及其中建造的一座宅邸。一个在这个未受光线触及的世界中长大的年轻女孩，与她深爱的父亲和他们的仆人平静地生活着。随着时间静静流逝，女孩——克拉丽特——长成了一位美丽的女性，似乎宁静的日子会永远持续下去。

然而，克拉丽特的父亲，Clemens，被一种神秘的疾病击倒，打破了黑暗中宅邸的宁静。克拉丽特勇敢地退到父亲的书房，寻找治疗他奇怪病痛的方法。在那里，她发现了一本神秘的书，并得知了一种独特玫瑰的存在，据说能治愈任何疾病。据说这种玫瑰只存在于宅邸的最深处，但要到达那里，必须经历几场“试炼”。此外，书中警告说，即使她尝试试炼，如果克拉丽特无法忍受它们，通往玫瑰的道路就会关闭，Clemens 将在疾病达到顶点时迎来他的终结。

有一天，当克拉丽特正沉浸在对生病父亲的思念中时，仆人，卢多安娜，告诉她 Clemens 的病情正在恶化。对于决心拯救父亲的女孩，神秘的书揭示了通往试炼的道路。寻求玫瑰，克拉丽特将自己投入了试炼的黑暗之中。

v48262.title: Lilac
v48262.originalDescription:
Adaptation of the stage play series by Project Ricoro.

Lilac Academy.

A joint magic school established by Lilac, the Legendary Magus, who wished for a world where humans and mages could come together, hand in hand, in peace and harmony.

One day, in a rural village in the east, an admission letter arrives at the home of a sick mother and her child, Emil.

Having been treated badly by a mage in the past, Emil hates mages. However, upon learning that graduating from the academy would net a generous monetary reward, Emil resolves to enroll. The reason? Family comes before any grudge.

After getting lost on the way to the academy, Emil meets Henri, who happens to be around the same age. The two hit it off, but that all falls apart once Emil realizes that Henri is actually a mage.

Disgusted at this revelation, Emil tries to leave, but Henri insists on showing the way to the academy and forcibly casts a spell.

However, the spell fails, and Emil is sent flying to an unfamiliar place. Thus begins Emil's turbulent academy life.
v48262.description:
大巫师莱拉克为了人类与魔族的和平共处，携手同行，创立了这所混合魔法学校『莱拉克学院』。
某一天，一封入学通知书寄给了居住在东部偏远村庄里，与母亲相依为命的Emil家中。
由于过去遭受着巫师的恶劣对待，Emil非常讨厌巫师。
但得知从学院毕业后就能获得国家颁发的奖金后，为了生病的母亲，Emil决定入学。
前往学院路上迷路的Emil，遇到了年龄相仿的Henri。
两人意气相投，一见如故。但当Emil得知Henri是巫师时，这份友谊戛然而止。
正当Emil决定离开时，Henri坚持要送对方去学院，并强行施展了魔法。
然而，Henri的魔法失败了，
Emil被传送到了一个完全陌生的地方。
于是，Emil波澜万丈的学院生活，就此拉开了序幕。

v49056.title: 丽露娅与夏夏的纯白谎言
v49056.original: リルヤとナツカの純白な嘘
aliases: 丽露娅与夏夏的纯白谎言
リルヤとナツカの純白な嘘
Lilja to Natsuka no Junpaku na Uso
Riruya to Natsuka no Junpakuna Uso
v49056.originalDescription:
The world is illuminated by your light, and the flowers you hold give it color.
 
There's a rumor spreading quietly across the internet: "An anonymous painter will paint anything you request."
 
They do not want money or fame. Capricious and eccentric, the painter only accepts requests that pique their interest. Those lucky enough to meet this mysterious criteria will be chosen to meet with Lilja—a beautiful girl with long, fairy-like silver hair and eyes that shine like gemstones. Even though she is blind and wheelchair-bound, this does not hinder her genius.
 
"From this day forward, I'm going to become your new eyes and legs!"
 
Natsuka is her energetic live-in assistant. She acts as Lilja's eyes and legs, using her instinct and intuition to find the inspiration and information beyond what's necessary that Lilja seeks.
 
"I don’t know for sure, but I can feel it!"
 
Her words resound within Lilja and become the "light" that illuminates her world. The blue of reminiscence, the green of monsters, the red of martyrdom...
 
"My little dove has brought me an olive leaf! It's now my turn to take care of the rest."
 
The results far exceed the clients' wildest dreams.
 
"The world seen through your eyes is much more beautiful than the world I used to see."
 
Tortured by their pasts, two girls walk into a new future in this story of loss and rebirth.
v49056.description:
世界因你的光芒变得与众不同，
你手捧的鲜花让世界更加缤纷多彩。
 
一则消息传闻在网络上悄悄流传。
 
有一位充满谜团的天才画家，只为甲方描绘美妙的作品。
然而她随性、偏执，不为权力与金钱所左右，选择的标准充满谜团，只接受自己中意的委托。
 
出现在甲方面前的，是一位拥有一头银色长发与宛若宝石的眼瞳，
好似冬天妖精一般的美少女画家——丽露娅，以及住在丽露娅家中的，精神饱满的助手夏夏。
 
然而，少女画家坐在轮椅上，眼中没有光芒。
 
“没关系。我会成为丽露娅小姐崭新的双眼与双腿！”
 
夏夏为了甲方与丽露娅奔波，依靠本能与直觉讲述丽露娅所需求的灵感源泉
——撕开黑暗，重新照耀世界的“光芒”。
 
“虽然有点摸不着头脑，但我的感觉就是这样子！”
“我的白鸽，将橄榄叶带到身边。之后——就是我的工作了”
 
追忆之蓝，异形之绿，殉教之红——丽露娅用夏夏带来的“光芒”，
描绘出超乎甲方想象的作品。
 
“在你眼中呈现的世界，比我看到的更加美丽”
 
这是一篇讲述带着旧时伤痛的少女们，为了全新未来迈出脚步的，失去与重生的故事。

v52778.title: KANADE
v52778.originalDescription:
In the near future, a sudden and unexplained proliferation of plants has left much of human civilization drowning in greenery.
Yuuto is a boy living in a once-thriving city that's now largely reclaimed by nature.
One day, a girl named Kanade appears on his doorstep.
The two had been exchanging letters after Kanade found one of Yuuto's carrier pigeons injured and nursed it back to health.
Kanade then reveals her biggest secrets, too important to write in a letter:
The fact that she's half alien, half human, and that she's on a mission to save the world with her song.
She sings before the bewildered Yuuto, demonstrating her power to pacify the plants.

"I have to sing the greatest love song and save the world in my mother's place.
Yuuto-san, would you please fall in love with me?"

After the disappearance of her mother,
Kanade was left clueless as to how to save the world, or why she had to fall in love in order to do so.
Everything seemed shrouded in mystery.
Still, Kanade's earnest wish stirs something within Yuuto,
who is always ready to lend a helping hand to those in need, and he decides to take a chance on her.
Warmly watched over by those around them, the two tentatively begin their exploration of love.
What neither of them realize is that a spark of affection has already budded between them...

This is the tale of a wondrous future where the encounter between a boy and girl brings a miracle to the world.
v52778.description:
未来的地球，由于植物失控泛滥， “自然”试图将“文明”摧毁殆尽。
名为悠登的少年生活在被绿色淹没的城市废墟一角。
一天，一位名叫奏的少女登门造访。
此前他们是通过悠登的信鸽交流的笔友。
奏对悠登亲口坦白了一条在信中难以启齿的秘密。
其实她是地球人与外星人的混血，通过歌声拯救世界。
她向困惑不已的悠登展示了她的歌声，抑制了植物的生长。

“我必须代替妈妈高唱最为动听的情歌，将世界拯救。
所以悠登，你可以与我坠入爱河吗？”

母亲不辞而别，奏孑然一身。
她对于用歌声拯救世界的具体方法， 乃至以恋爱作为前提条件的缘由，都一概不知。
一切都是那么虚无缥缈，使得他们不明就里。
尽管如此，悠登依然回应了奏的赤诚之心，决定与奏恋爱。
在周围众人温暖目光的守望下， 他们并肩携手，成为了情侣。
彼此都未曾察觉那悄然萌发的真情。

坠入爱河，放声高歌，拯救世界。
这是一个由少年与少女的邂逅所诞生的美妙奇迹， 一则略带奇幻的未来童话――

v68402.title: 激论激议激辩学生会
v68402.original: ディスディスディスカッション
aliases: ディスディスディスカッション
v68402.originalDescription:
"And THAT'S why nobody likes you!"

Kohnodai Academy prides itself on the self-governance and autonomy of its students.

One day, the charismatic student council president, Sakurai Risa, causes a whirlwind of controversy by proposing a change to the dress code: She wants to make uniforms a personal choice.

Meanwhile...
Vice president Hiyama Ryo just wants to admire his senpai in her uniform...
Secretary Hasumi Ai secretly harbors feelings for Hiyama...
Sakakibara Tsubasa is determined to protect a certain secret at all costs...
Kashino Chinatsu wants to confirm the suspicions she has about her boyfriend...
Then there is Komatsu Shoko, the hard-working auditing committee chair...
And many more!

When a room full of quirky, overly opinionated students assemble, logic and raw emotion go head to head!

But the real disaster begins when it’s time to pick the class activities for the Cultural Festival. Welcome to the “Content Restriction Meeting”—where the worst, most unwanted assignments must be distributed. As class reps fight to defend their agendas, ridiculous excuses, wild loopholes, and mental gymnastics fly back and forth in an absolute storm!

Just how will this meeting end!? And will Hiyama finally find love?

And so, the curtain rises on this sophistry-filled coming-of-age ensemble drama.
v68402.description:
故事发生在以鼓励学生自主自律为宗旨的学校·鸿之台高校。

怀揣不同立场与思绪的众多学生，将会在无数时而有理有据时而胡搅蛮缠的议论中，渐渐表达出各自的心声与思念。

过程中种种话语与感情交错相汇，幽默同时也不乏光彩。敬请期待将如何呈现一幕好戏吧！

——你之所以没有桃花运，不就是因为总把这种话挂嘴边吗！

故事发生在以“自主自律”为宗旨的学校·鸿之台高校。

某一天，广受追捧的学生会长·樱井梨沙提出「校服自由化」之倡议，引发席卷全校的大论战！

渴求欣赏学姐校服身影的副会长兼主角·桧山亮，

暗中爱慕前者的学生会书记·莲见爱，

千方百计死守某个秘密的男生·榊原翼，

盼望知晓男朋友秘密的女生·樫野千夏，

此外更有勤勤勉勉的老黄牛——监查委员长·小松祥子等诸多角色，

特立独行的各路人马，将会怀揣各自的论据与感情，在学生总会上激烈碰撞！

后续围绕文化祭发表项目，各怀鬼胎的各班代表更是不惜相互攻讦以求自保！

由于被迫承接了一份强压下来的苦差事，在这场「内限会（内容规限会议）」上，

各方竟将东拉西扯地互相推诿……？！

那么这场会议最终将如何落实呢？！

以及，桧山的恋情将会何去何从呢？

青春群像荒诞轻喜剧——《激论激议激辩学生会》，即将在此拉开帷幕！

v16570.originalDescription:
In the far future, the world’s population had grown to an unsustainable amount. The country descended into chaos and the government built a special protection area with high walls as the final paradise: Utopia. Ryouta comes from a noble family and was promised a life in peace, but he hides a certain ambition in his heart. It is a secret which cannot be told to anyone.

A certain tragic event in Ryouta’s past caused his life to ‘end’ and that something happened in his previous school prior to his transfer. Utopia is not quite the paradise that is envisioned, with different castes occupying different areas of the city. The lowest tiers in this city of over 200,000 are about to fall into ‘dystopia’.
v16570.description:
那是，一个时代远超现代的未来的故事。
以居住在特别保护区域的人们为中心的故事。

世界人口膨胀，人们破坏了自给自足的平衡。
在治安恶化、国家逐渐崩溃之中，政府筑起高墙，诞生了成为最后乐园的区域“乌托邦”。

在被承诺和平的世界里，主人公·曾我作为名门望族的一员，将某种野心深藏胸中。
怀揣着对谁都无法诉说的秘密——

v17331.originalDescription:
News arrives from a remote corner of the kingdom: “Strange monsters, unlike anything we’ve ever seen, rule the roost there.” 
Frena, a skilled hunter sent to investigate, never returns. 
At first, the kingdom remains optimistic, but as the monsters—led by a witch—draw closer to the capital, the queen’s daughter and leader of the royal knight order, Cecil, sets out to deal with them. 

However, the news that reaches the queen isn’t of victory—it’s of Frena and Cecil, now futanari, driven mad with pleasure and disgraced for everyone to see!..
v17331.description:
■故事
从王国的一个偏远乡村
传来了“潜伏着前所未见的可疑怪物”的消息。
前往调查的干练猎人芙蕾娜(フレナ)也一去不返。
王国起初虽然乐观，但由于怪物及其统领的魔女正逼近王都，身为女王之女兼王国姬骑士团长的塞西尔(セシル)前往讨伐。
然而，带给女王的并非胜利的消息，而是暴露扶他之身、疯狂高潮的芙蕾娜与塞西尔的痴态……！

■登场角色
【为扶他而苦恼的高傲姬骑士】
●塞西尔
女王之女，王国的姬骑士团长。
不愧是继承了女王的力量，其实力也很高，但过度自信等处处显露出年轻的一面。
接到“前往调查可疑怪物的骑士没有回来”的报告后，亲自出面调查与讨伐，却被魔女抓住了……？
平时会说出“你的父母是从我母亲大人那里领工资的”等天然且直言不讳的话。
其实是扶他。

【隐藏扶他之身的干练猎人】
●芙蕾娜
居住在王国边缘偏远乡村的干练猎人。
惯用右手。
平时靠排除靠近村庄的外敌来维持生计。
憧憬慢生活而来到乡下，对此并不后悔，但现在想想，城市的便利也不错。
然后是令人震惊的事实，她是扶他。

【受扶他折磨的慈爱女王】
●阿纳斯塔西娅(アナスタシア)
王国的女王。
拥有慈爱之心，深受国民支持。
而且其战斗力也是王国最强。
但对异端者和外敌却严厉到苛刻的地步，也有无情的一面。

v18077.description:
関東邪法街——
曾经被称为“架上市”的関東地方的一个核心都市，在数年前一夜之间与混沌魔力盘旋的〈深淵〉连接，化为了超常现象跋扈的魔界都市。
针对身份不明的不死之身“魔女”们的出现，政府将该都市圈从外部隔离封锁，作为遗弃地区从国土上抹除。
一度化为鬼城的旧架上市，逃入了犯罪者、非法滞留的外国人、在俗世无法生存的多重债务人等并在此定居，进而以此为食的黑帮、非法商贩、风俗女郎等也流入其中。
在历经数年成为约有15万人非正式存在的治外法权都市的“邪法街”中，当某名男子与一名“魔女”相遇时，故事拉开帷幕。
在一切法律都无法触及的邪恶且危险的都市中，
一名男子与“魔女”们的残酷命运开始转动。
v18077.originalDescription:
Kantou, Pandemonium—

Once known as Kajou City, a central metropolis of the Kantou region. A few years ago, it was connected to the "Abyss," an alternate dimension where primal magic energy swirls, turning the place into a demonic city full of supernatural phenomena.

Upon the emergence of unidentifiable immortal "Witches," the government quarantined the metropolitan area and erased it from the national map, leaving it to ruin. 

After a while, the ghost town soon became a haven for criminals, illegal immigrants, and people with multiple debts who could not survive in the outside world. In addition, yakuza, black market merchants, and prostitutes also came to the city to take advantage of the situation.

The plot begins with a chance encounter between a man and a "Witch" in this free city of Pandemonium, whose unofficial population has grown to around 150,000.

In this wicked and lawless metropolis, the cruel fates of one man and the "Witches" begin to unfold.

One day, after a successful business deal, Takeshi and Keiichi decide to have a small drinking party together. Keiichi, who can't handle his alcohol, gets drunk, and Takeshi takes him home. At Keiichi's home, they are greeted by Keiichi's wife, Kuzuki Yukina, who was once Takeshi's subordinate, and Keiichi's sister, Kuzuki Mako. 现在是敬一妻子的葛木由季菜，以及敬一的妹妹葛木真子。
剛志盯上了久未见后变得妩媚的由季菜，以及知性、开朗又可爱的真子。
直到最近还在做性伴侣的女人跟着丈夫调职走了，这或许正好合适。
“在不被敬一察觉的情况下，我想用这双手尽情侵犯两人，看看她们在快乐中痛苦扭动的样子。”
扭曲的情念在心中生根。
剛志思考着让两人堕落的计划，想象着由季菜和真子喘息的面庞，独自浮现出扭曲的笑容──。

v19192.originalDescription:
When I came to, I found myself in an unfamiliar room.

I was taking advantage of my summer break to go on a ten day vacation with my best friend. We were enjoying the sights of Okinawa on the bus from the airport when—

And that's the last thing I remember.

Is this the hotel? Did I fall asleep on the bus...?

The door wouldn't open and what we thought were windows were actually just screens displaying images of the outside. When we searched the room for some clue as to where we were, we found yet another screen displaying a single, mercilessly cold sentence:

"You have been selected to participate in a behavioral analysis experiment."

We have to choose and complete a task presented on the screen as instructed if we ever want to see the light of day again.

If we play our cards right, we can get out in ten days—ten choices.

Our options are extremely limited—

Either my best friend has to physically harm me,
or I have to debase my best friend sexually.

At the mercy of these inhumanly cruel choices, the two of us decide to—
v19192.description:
醒来时，身处一个没有印象的房间。
和挚友两人，利用暑假进行为期10天的冲绳旅行。
从机场乘坐接送巴士，两人一起享受冲绳的风景——之后就没有记忆了。
这里是酒店？在巴士里睡着了吗……？
但是房间的门打不开，以为是窗户的东西是播放风景的液晶显示器。
在谜一样的密室中，为了寻求信息而显示的显示器上出现的是，无机质且无慈悲的文章。
“你们被选作行动分析的实验对象”
为了从这个房间出去，必须从每天提示的多个课题中选择1个，并达成。
至少10天，10次选择。
选项有2个。
被残酷而严酷的选择所真正对待的两人所抵达的结局是——

v37172.originalDescription:

v359.description:
那是一个弥漫着战败预兆的阴暗氛围的时代。小说家“健次”收到了一封寄件人不明的电报，上面写着“有个人想介绍给您认识”。
他造访了一座群山环绕的小村庄，那里有一位名叫“彩江”的妇人。他跟随着彩江的指引，踏入了她带他前往的洋馆。

被摘下的花朵环绕着进行自慰行为的少女。将健次脱下扔在一旁的鞋子摆好又再次弄乱的女仆。面对这异样的光景，彩江说道。
“求求您！请救救那些女孩吧！”
洋馆的名字叫“悲愿华”，是为了将患上奇人病的患者从村子里隔离出去而建造的疗养院。
“哪怕只是她们所剩不多的时间，我也希望能让她们过得宽裕一些。”
面对在脚边哭泣着恳求的彩江，健次无法拒绝——。为了平息逐渐加剧的发作而进行的性行为，不断升级到了无法控制的地步。

Rinjoku no Shiro Kairai no Ou
凛辱之城 傀儡之王
v1061.originalDescription: There is a kingdom where the king takes good care of people. Seemingly, it looks peaceful. However, there is a castle owned by evils floating above them. They are connected with each other through a gate and they can come and go freely. The ones who go through the gate usually carry weapons, so a terrible battle often takes place. The main character is a soldier. He joins a battle against evils and enters the castle. But there is no one inside, just the devil appears. He finally kills the devil and happily comes back to his troop. However, other soldiers see him and say, "Oh, the devil! We'll kill you!!" He doesn't know what is going on, but he defeats them and runs away.... A while later, a girl appears in front of him and says, "You are the devil now. Attack people and rape girls to keep on living." He has been transformed into the devil....
v1061.description:
王的统治深得民众信赖，街道繁华的『米德加尔德王国』。
一眼看去十分和平的王国。然而，大陆的上空漂浮着一座被称为『阿斯加德』的魔王城。
阿斯加德高不可及，非人手所能触及，但大陆与阿斯加德之间由被称为『比弗罗斯特』的门连接着，使得双方能够相互往来。虽说是往来，但无论是天空之人还是地上之人，穿过门的皆是手持武器之辈。血洗血的凄惨战斗已经重演了无数次。
主人公是在『米德加尔德』立下无数功绩，深受君主与民众绝对信赖的剑士。
那一天终于迎来了进攻魔王城的壮行会。主人公与身为未婚妻的公主立下誓言后踏上了旅途。
历经无数次魔物的强袭，主人公终于潜入的『阿斯加德』城内却异常安静。
在那里的王座上现身的魔王也被轻易地打倒了。
随后，出现在欣喜的主人公面前的，是一同历经激战走到这里的同伴士兵们。
但是，面对满心欢喜奔去的主人公，他们却举起剑脱口而出：
“你终于出现了，魔王！！为了米德加尔德的和平，受死吧！！”
主人公在震惊与困惑中陷入混乱，但面对他们真刀真枪的夺命攻势，若不抵抗便会有性命之虞，便当场将他们击退了。
这一切结束后，一名少女现身了。
接着，她将镜中映出的、已变成刚才被打倒的魔王模样的主人公展示给他看，并说道：
“从今往后，你将成为魔王，靠袭击人类、侵犯女人活下去吧。”
……不侵犯就会被杀的主人公，对应当守护的民众的凌辱就此开始。

v2633.originalDescription:
Somewhere on the Darkside of the Moon, Second Lieutenant Fernandez and his all-female pilot squad are fighting for their lives against overwhelming forces. The XEN-TRIX mobile suit is technologically superior, but even cutting edge technology doesn't count for too much if you are outnumbered twenty to one.
Inevitably, a well placed shot inflicts critical damage, and Fernandez falls into a dark oblivion of wild memories...
v2633.description:
22世纪初头，第三次世界大战爆发了。
美国、加拿大、南美、欧洲诸国，以及亚洲各国——
一瞬间蔓延至全世界的地狱业火终于平息后，
出现在人们面前的是被分割为“北”“南”两大势力的“世界”……
故事仿佛为了躲避两大势力飞溅的火星，在群星的彼方开始。
是的。在被永恒的“黑暗”锁住的漆黑尽头，月球的背面——
主人公（用户）在脑内接连有新发现，是前途无量的科学家。
但是，骄傲自大之余，反复进行非人道的实验，被学会放逐了。
一转，走上跌落人生的主人公，如雪崩般身败名裂，
结果染指了非法合成毒品的制造，沦为被关在监狱牢狱中的身躯。

但是，为恶化的战况而苦恼的军部为了打破战况开发新兵器，
将主人公监禁在月背的极秘设施中。
那里有从世界各地收集来的受验体在等待他的到来。
被称为“素体”的年轻少女们，被监禁在这月背。

最初感到困惑的他，知道了在这个设施中展开的淫靡丑恶的行为，
逐渐开始贪恋少女们。以“实验”之名——
就这样，借着兵器开发之名的凌辱剧将被展开，但是……
狡猾的军队的真正目的，在别处。

v3372.originalDescription: Kouji was surprised when a beautiful girl appeared one day and said that she would be his maid. Yuria is part of the famous maid servant group called “Noblesse Oblige” (N.O.) which caters to the wealthy and famous. His grandmother had told him that wanted him to be the most loved in the world, but he never expected to have a maid servant. Not only that but shortly after, another girl showed up, as well as his childhood friend Ayana. What is going on here?
v3372.description:
哎呀，吓了一跳。你问被什么吓了一跳？
是突然到来的漂亮姐姐，说出“作为女仆来侍奉我”这种事。
那是当然，我也是男人嘛？被漂亮姐姐侍奉也不会觉得不爽，也飘飘然了就是。

而且，这位姐姐……据说是属于那个“高贵的责任感”的超有名女仆·从者吧。
在当今这个时代，雇佣在那里注册的女仆，感觉就是取得了社会性成功的证明，已经成了一种身份象征了哦？
实际上，世界上的名人大多都有很酷的女仆侍奉着呢。
就在不久前，还有N．O．的女仆用一杯红茶阻止了战争……这样的传闻，现在不知道那个名字的家伙完全会被当成门外汉对待。

虽然有些自夸，我这个人，“冴木 煌司（さえき こうじ）”，确实遵守奶奶的嘱咐，以成为“被全世界的人所爱的男人”为目标。
在达成那个目标的时候，超弩级的女仆侍立在我的身旁，在某种意义上可以说是必然的吧。
但是，我实在不觉得现在的自己已经把男人味打磨到了能够使唤女仆·从者的程度。
听说是和奶奶有缘的人的委托，但到底是谁也不太清楚啊——

叫“天川 遊莉亜”小姐对吧，没记错的话。
那个人到底……是抱着什么打算来我这种地方的？
柊由香里(柊ゆかり)也极其怀疑……总觉得今后，好像会有一场大波澜啊。

开头，主人公的青梅竹马、如同姐姐一般的内海绫香(うつみ　あやか)倒下了。她天生体弱多病，如果不在这4个月内接受大手术，寿命就所剩无几。然而，手术费用极其庞大，绫香的父母，更不用说主人公，根本不可能筹措得到。

面对拼命恳求“请借钱给我”的主人公，宅邸的女主人六华提出的条件是，像“猎犬”一样在街上游荡，寻找美女，并将她们带回宅邸。仿佛是对惊愕的主人公追加打击一般，少女命令他将抓来的美女们当作“种马”并“让她们怀孕”……

Several hundred years ago heroes finally defeated the source of evil
Nowadays grand battle starts to be forgotten until demon king slaughters hero descendant and turns him into his servant. The devil infiltrates the city taking revenge on the citizen girls. However, the order of Empire protectors is still strong. Will devil have his revenge or fall in the battle with the knights?
v3956.description:
数百年前。从古代持续至今的暗与光的战斗最终打上了休止符。
黑暗眷属在赌上了性命的英雄们的活跃下被驱逐。

时光流逝，如今——战斗的记忆已经被忘却。
勇者们的活跃只被铭刻于石碑上。
充满沉溺于和平，
陶醉于病态的快乐中的人类心中的强欲、暴食、傲慢、嫉妒、愤怒、怠惰、
以及死亡。
在颓废的生活中，没有一个人察觉到正在逼近的黑暗眷属的复活的征兆。

当黑暗眷属再次显示出其恐怖的姿态的时候，
看见黑暗眷属派来的尖兵的人们陷入了惊愕。
因为眼前的是身穿魔族的装束的过去的英雄……
身穿魔族装束的勇者的双手栖息着作为加入『魔道』的证据的邪恶魔物。

心里怀着秘密的意图，不停地在城市中杀人放火，残忍地吃掉女童，
干尽了一切坏事并不停地提升武功，虽然接近魔族中枢是他的真正目的，
但和曾经的自己抱着同样的志向的守护帝都的圣女们阻拦在了他的面前。

掳走王女作为魔王复活的祭品。一点点被“魔素”侵蚀的颓废的心。
击败、玩弄、凌辱、玷污圣女们，极尽一切极恶之事。
在心灵即将就要彻底失控的如今，“勇者”所作出的决定是……！？

他究竟能不能达成复仇！？

v4287.originalDescription:
In a peaceful kingdom, the country is governed by the five royal sisters who are also mystical songstress.

The gentle oldest sister - the diva of the earth, the second sister who is also the leader of the knights - the diva of the fire, the third sister - the diva of the light, the fourth sister - the diva of the water, and the fifth and youngest sister - the innocent diva of the wind.

From generation to generation the divas sing the song of peace, leading the nation against the power of the devil. But a man resurrected from the grave. And along with him, the shadow of many demons appear at the peaceful kingdom.

Against the hord of demons, the diva of light serving as a guardian of the kingdom sings, and all demons disappear in an instant. The revived man who saw that demonstration of power gets startled.

"If I get that power... i can dominate everything!"

And beside the man, the figure of a succubus arises. And so the man who is the revived demon king began to move in order to dominate and rape them all.
v4287.description:
在神圣歌姬们的庇佑下，享受着和平与繁荣的奥拉特里昂王国。
歌姬是五姐妹。
用慈爱包容王国的是长女，大地之歌姬奥斯蒂娜(オスティナ)。
在飞龙骑士团担任团长，绝不容许外敌入侵的是次女，炎之歌姬拉图卡(ラトゥカ)。
自由自在享受恋爱，作为和平象征的四女，水之歌姬贾尼斯(ジャニス)。
性格天真烂漫，作为国民与歌姬之间桥梁的五女，风之歌姬米莉尔(ミリル)。
然后……
用光芒照亮那个王国的是三女，光之歌姬菲涅(フィーネ)。
历代的光之歌姬们歌唱和平之歌，与守护兽一同引导国民走向安宁。
此时，一个男人从墓地中复活了。
随着那个男人的复活，平稳的王国悄然笼罩上阴影。
怪物的出现。
在复活的男人眼前，歌姬的子民与怪物展开了战斗。
填满地平线的怪物群。
人类的军队虽然奋力奋战，却敌不过怪物群，魔物的军队终于逼近了王都。
就在人们快要被邪恶的怪物群吞噬之时，光之歌姬唱起了歌。
歌姬们召唤出的守护兽，在大地奔驰，在天空飞翔。
瞬间消灭的怪物群。
亲眼目睹那番光景的男人惊愕不已，然后心想。
如果能得到那股力量……。
那个男人，名为雷加托(レガート)。
过去被光之歌姬封印的男人。
雷加托行动了起来。

Yuri had been enduring relentless sexual bullying from two classmates, Higashifushimi Sumire and Nomaguchi Akira. The torment had driven her to attempt suicide.
Furious at the severity of the bullying, Kouka reported it to their homeroom teacher, Nogata Kaede. But the response was dismissive:
"Student issues should be resolved among students."
Worse, Kouka himself became a target of suspicion.
"Isn’t Tokorozawa Kouka the one bullying her?"
The student council president, Saginomiya Ayame, accused him, and Kouka was unfairly suspended.
With neither the teachers nor the student council on his side, Kouka felt cornered. But instead of giving up, he decided to fight back.

"There is no salvation."

Burdened by the deep-set scars of an unspeakable violation, Shirasaka Mio sought sanctuary in her online interactions with a stranger named Yuka. As if emerging from the heavy fog of her trauma, Mio set forth a proposition – uprooting her family's life to Yuka's town in search of a deeper, more meaningful healing. Embracing this pursuit with unwavering support, her family acquiesced, a beacon of a brighter future gleaming for Mio, her brother Taichi, and their youngest sibling, Mei.

Yet, within this promising refuge, unsettling undertones began to surface. Lured by Yuka's urging, Mio found herself entwined with the "Fraternity Club," an enigma veiled in the guise of an off-campus collective. Meanwhile, Taichi found his heart subtly stirred by a chance encounter with his classmate, Megumi. The discovery that Megumi, too, was ensnared within the bizarre club, tugged at the threads of Taichi's tranquility.

　　从前，有一个古老的城市名叫音羽。
　　音羽，诗一般的名字，恰到好处地描绘了ef的整个故事内涵。

　　曾经发生过一场强烈的地震，一对对恋人被迫分离。
　　……
　　……
　　即使记忆会随着时间的流逝而被冲淡，唯一不变的是那曾经的感觉。
　　历尽艰辛，你和我再次相遇，为什么……为什么你会把我的名字忘却？！
　　没关系……
　　让我们……重新开始吧……
　　只要……只要你我有缘。
　　相识，相恋。心中只有对你的那份感觉。
　　天意弄人，你我牵着的双手，放开在圣诞节的那天。
　　时过境迁，沧海桑田！我日夜等待的你终于出现在我的面前。
　　可是……你是谁？……
　　脑海中竟想不起你的容颜！
　　强忍住的泪水模糊了双眼,
　　再也无法回到那个被遗忘的夏天！
　　……
　　美丽的童话，曾经发生在天使降临的那年。

v99.title: 水夏
v99.originalDescription:
Suika is a collection of mysterious love stories that occurred one summer in the silent and remote village of Tokiwa.

Chapter 1

Kazama Akira recently came back to Tokiwa village with his mother. On his trip to the village shrine he was reunited with his old childhood friend, Minase Itsuki. Their reunion brought back all kinds of memories from the times when they were still playing with each other and generally had a good time together. As their past and present interweaves, what will fate bring to them ... ?

Chapter 2

Shirakawa Sayaka comes from a painter's family. Her father is an infamous eccentric painter and all the villagers think that he has a rather odd personality. By extension, his bad reputation has also passed on to innocent Sayaka so she is having a hard time making new friends. Sayaka's one and only enjoyment is to paint with her childhood friend Kamishiro Souji, the only person that she can trust. Her rebellious feelings towards her father, her longing for her deceased mother, and her love towards Souji will all be painted on a blank canvas along with the blooming sunflowers this summer.

Chapter 3

Masaki Yoshikazu is starting to feel a little awkward with his girlfriend, Kyouya Touko, and that awkwardness has something to do with his little sister, Masaki Akane. This awkwardness has become a dark spot in his heart which just keeps growing bigger and bigger. The relationship between Yoshikazu, Touko and Akane is heading in an unexpected direction.

Chapter 4

Inaba Hiroshi had to leave his home as a child and live in an orphanage due to his family-related problems. When he heard that his father became seriously ill, he came back to Tokiwa village on the night of Tanabata (Star Festival). During that night, Hiroshi met a mysterious girl that is holding a black stuffed cat-like toy. The strange girl wearing black clothes and a black hat doesn't remember her own name but none of that will stop Hiroshi from spending more time with the girl and her stuffed cat, Archimedes. Hiroshi's special summer like none other in Tokiwa has just begun.
v99.description:
爱情与离别的痛苦……因为拥有了人心而无法继续胜任死神工作的少女，
舍弃了自己的心，由此开始的故事。
被舍弃的“半身”，为了让本体找回爱人的心，向她展示了各种各样的人类的爱的姿态。
注视着3对少男少女各自的爱情故事，从与对任何人都很温柔的少年的接触中，逐渐敞开心扉的死神少女的交流与恋爱。

v264.originalDescription: The game is centered around the protagonist, Asakura Jun'ichi, who lives on a fictional japanese island named Hatsunejima peacefully attending the local Kazami Academy. His childhood friend and cousin, Yoshino Sakura, returns to the island Hatsunejima after moving to America several years ago. v264.description:
一年中“永不枯萎的樱花”盛开绽放的初音岛。
尽管有人在研究这种不可思议的樱花，但一般人依然过着极其平凡的生活。
就算樱花永不枯萎很稀奇，生活也不会改变。

在位于这样一个平凡世界中心的风见学园，有着能凭空变出日式点心，以及能让人看到他人梦境的力量……
有一位少年，使用着这两种离平凡甚远、离非凡也甚远的童话般的力量。

钟爱日式点心的学园偶像，
嘴上啰嗦却爱撒娇的妹妹，
迷迷糊糊天然呆的学姐，
在梦中现身的吵闹青梅竹马，
天生活力充沛被称为“小狗”的学妹。

当他与她们在临近毕业的“学园”相遇时，一段稍微有些令人心痒难耐恰到好处的恋爱故事就此开始。

v318.title: Infantaria
v318.originalDescription:
As the scars of the 'Dragon War' continue to plague the lands since ancient times, the isolated 'Hiver' kingdom is trapped in an unnaturally long 'Winter'. 

Because of the kingdoms natural environment and isolated location, 'Hiver' has been able to maintain peace for a long time. 

Princess Sofia, the heir to the throne, I's worried about her inexperience and wishes to go to the outside world to get to know more about her people's way of living, while concealing her royal heritage.

The protagonist, a Knight of Imperial Guard, petitions the king for the princess sake and his majesty graciously permits Sofia to go to the "Canary Kindergarten" as a teacher under the protagonist's protection.
v318.description:
作为据说兴起于遥远古代的“龙战争”的爪痕，伊维尔王国被非自然的漫长“冬天”所封闭。
即便处于这样的自然环境中，伊维尔王国依然维持着长久的和平。 

　该国的王女索菲亚公主，对于身为王位继承人的自己过于不谙世事而感到不安。于是，为了了解民众的生活，她强烈希望能隐藏身份前往外界。 

　身为近卫骑士的主人公得知了公主强烈的想法，便向国王直诉了此事。
幸运的是获得了国王的许可，索菲亚得以作为“金丝雀幼儿园”的保育员，在城下生活。 
　主人公也为了护卫公主且不暴露其身份，作为同一所幼儿园的代理园长被派遣过去。 

　索菲亚公主与主人公青梅竹马的保育员迈谢拉·克里斯汀(マイシェラ＝クリスティン)、以及充满谜团的同事蕾玛＝斯坦尼斯瓦夫(レマ＝スタニスワフ)交流，并从可爱的园童们那里学到了自然的笑容与爱。 
　然后，在作为保育员的自觉逐渐觉醒的某一天，她察觉到了对在背后支持着自己的主人公那份淡淡的恋慕之心……。 

　根据每位女主角的不同，从完全不同的角度描绘的故事。 

　血的宿命与超越它的爱情——。

v1286.original: eden* They were only two, on the planet.

Eden* They Were Only Two, On The Planet
v1286.description:
走向即将毁灭的乐园的，最后的爱情故事。

近未来。火星附近突然出现的“毁灭之星”。受其影响，地球即将迎来毁灭。
地球统一政府提倡人类向宇宙逃亡的计划。然后，为了使那个看似不可能实现的逃亡计划成为可能，通过基因操作，创造出了拥有高智商与不老长寿肉体的超人类“菲利克斯”。
其中一名菲利克斯——“诗音(シオン)”。仅仅为了拯救人类这一目的，她被囚禁在建于孤岛上的洋馆中长达100年之久。渴望自由的诗音，以及将她关在鸟笼里的地球统一政府军士兵——“榛名亮”。
两人相遇而开始的，地球上最后的爱情故事——
v1286.originalDescription:
In the distant future, a gigantic energy mass called the "Star of Destruction" suddenly appears near Mars. Its presence causes abnormal weather and tectonic plate shifts on Earth. As resources become scarce and populations have nowhere to go, conflicts erupt worldwide. This, however, is merely an omen of things to come.

Only a hundred years remain for humanity. They plan to evacuate the planet to evade its doom. Two projects are drafted to meet that end.

First is the establishment of Earth's Unified Government, which will allow the project to be implemented. Evacuating Earth becomes a top priority, and the order of "sacrificing the few to save the many" is implemented. Authoritarian rule controls the masses. Armed force oversees states and non-governmental organizations that oppose the new world order. The overwhelming military power maintains order regarding race, religion, food, energy, etc.

The second is the "Felix Project," which will serve as the foundation for the exodus plan. With only 100 years left, humanity needs to build a spaceship to leave the planet and acquire the technology to survive in the vacuum of space for a long time. They decided to create "Felix," genetically modified people with extraordinary intelligence and longevity. These "superhumans" will be able to complete the seemingly impossible project.

99 years pass.
A lone female Felix, Sion, has served her role as the central figure in the Earth Evacuation Project. With her job completed, Sion wishes to spend her remaining time quietly on the abandoned Earth. A young man, Ryo Haruna, from the unified military, is deployed to her side to protect and keep her in check.

Their meeting sets the story in motion.
The final love story on Earth.

v2436.originalDescription:
A joint project of Circus and Princess Soft.

It's spring break, and while most students go back home, at Kyodai school, Makoto Kusanagi and four other boys and girls and one teacher remain in the dormitory. In front of them, Asuka, a transfer student with a mysterious atmosphere appears. Asuka handed over an  old book to Kusanagi, saying, "I want you to read this and perform this play". Without knowing that the play would lead them to a mysterious fate, the hero took on the stage script.
v2436.description:
既是所有开端亦是终结的故事，现在，交到了我的手中……

春假开始的3月。
其他学生全都回乡了，无人的校舍，无人的宿舍。

包括主人公・草薙誠在内的4名少年少女＋1名教师，
以及春天即将入学的姐妹小雪，因为各自的情况留在了宿舍。

在和煦的春日，在不知如何打发无聊的他们面前出现的，神秘的转校生明日香。
明日香递给主人公一本没有作者名字的破旧古书。

“希望你能把这本书，排成戏剧……”

主人公接下了将明日香带来的书改编成舞台剧本的工作。
却不知道那出戏剧，将会把他们引向不可思议的命运……

v4189.originalDescription: This is the fandisc to the ef series. It consists of three parts: After and another stories for the ef cast, a sd chara side-scrolling action game and a Blu-ray animation movie. The after story takes place in the January following the end of the game, with the returning of Renji and Shuuichi. In the another stories, there are three additional routes for Yuuko, Nagi and Mizuki (Renji’s cousin). Yuuko’s route does not include any H-scenes.
v4189.description:
【后日谈】

《ef - the latter tale.》结束后的1月上旬。

童话的后日谈。

广野纮(広野紘)与宫村宫子(宮村みやこ)、景与京介。各对情侣度过了艰难的时期，在平静生活的音羽，新的成员到来了。

决心留在新藤千寻(新藤千尋)身边的麻生莲治(麻生蓮治)，以及被羽山瑞希(羽山ミズキ)和火村说服后决定回老家露面的久濑修一(久瀬修一)。

随着两人的到来，新的人际关系与新的幸福的一天开始了。

【另一个故事】

本篇中未被“选择”的另一个故事。

以用户的要求为基础，收录了未遭遇事故而幸福生活的“雨宫优子路线”、

v6700.originalDescription:
The protagonist, Sanada Yukinari, has returned to his hometown in Kanagawa Prefecture, Kamakura City, for the first time in seven years, and is greeted by his older cousin, Narumi Sakura (complete with maid outfit). He wanted to live in peace, but his life at the academy placed on the coastlands becomes bustling and brilliant while surrounded by a lineup of members with booming personalities like Amano Hotaru, the sharp tongued, half-Japanese beauty, and Alice Kamishiro, the lazy witch who loves modern-science and mail-orders.

Eventually, Yukinari is coaxed into joining the action committee for the academy's traditional beauty contest by his close friend. He interacts with the heroines participating in this contest who are cute but each have an idiosyncrasy or two. Fun events (with their own difficulties) pop up again and again. Your story with "her" about smiles, peace, passion, and love, all while borrowing the power of a witch, is about to begin!
v6700.description:
minori正统第5作　
minori's 5th debut about "Wonder"

『すぴぱら STORY ＃01 - Spring Has Come！』、5月18日発売です。

樱花盛开的春天，4月，回到7年未归的故乡神奈川县镰仓市的主人公，真田幸成和作为亲戚的姐姐的鸣海樱（女仆装）相遇了。想要平静地生活的主人公，在沿海的校园的生活却被毒舌的混血美少女天野萤和最喜欢现代科学和网购的懒散魔女神代爱丽丝等充满个性的成员给包围，生活变得热热闹闹华华丽丽的了。就这样，主人公被损友挑拨着担当了学园传统活动--学园小姐的实行委员。并与虽然可爱但却有着各式各样怪癖的学园小姐参加者们交流，然后发生了各种各样的有趣事件（麻烦事）。借助着魔女的力量的同时，现在，你和“她”的，笑脸和和平和热情和爱的故事，开始了。

aliases: 夏色天空下的珀爾修斯
The Brave Under The Summer Sky.
v10597.description:
【故事】

7月的某一天。
行驶在山道上的巴士车厢内。

遠野 森羅(とおの しんら)与他的妹妹・远野恋(遠野 恋)正不悦地交谈着。

“别又多管闲事啊”
“啊”

兄妹拥有将他人的“痛楚”转移到自己身上的力量。
幼年时失去亲人，因为那股力量而一直被他人利用的兄妹。
他们辗转于亲戚家中，但无论身在何处，拥有力量的事都会被周围人知晓，
结果，他们不断失去容身之所。

面对妹妹“这次可要小心点”这句带着危险气息的话语，
森罗敷衍地回了一句“我知道了”。

“你到底有没有在听？”

无法治愈“痛楚”，只能转移到自己身上的无用力量。
但是，森罗认为那股力量一定有着某种意义。

换乘巴士抵达的地方，是远房亲戚居住的天領村(てんりょうむら)。
这是一个三面环山、向日葵盛开的山村。

被初次见面的远房亲戚少女・皆川 翠(みなかわ すい)迎接，
被带往从第二天起将要就读的学园。

在人口过疏化日益严重的村子里，似乎会有多个年级在同一个班级上课。
与读者家少女・菱田菖蒲(菱田 あやめ)，以及浮现出天使般微笑的
泽渡透香(沢渡 透香)的相遇。

在村里的顾问翠的父亲推荐下，遠野兄妹将在村里神社的社务所生活。
由于有一阵子没人管理，也是期待他们能提供年轻的劳动力——同时，
这大概也是为了将外人隔离并进行观察的措施吧。

但是，对于一接触人就会转移“痛楚”的兄妹来说，这反而是件方便的事。


风铃、向日葵花田、有望楼的高地。
夏日山村里流淌的平稳时光。

在这种情况下，他得知了并排坐在桌前的少女们，各自都怀抱着“痛楚”。

远房亲戚少女・翠，腿部受了伤。
读书家少女・菖蒲，有着因交通事故导致双亲死亡的心灵创伤。
亲生妹妹恋，则怀抱着对他人的不信任，以及对哥哥森罗的依赖。

特别是，浮现出天使般微笑的名为透香的少女，对森罗来说是异质的存在。
仅仅是触碰，就会传来猛烈的“痛楚”，有漆黑的某种东西流入。


将各自的“痛楚”怀揣于心。
由爱与牺牲纺出的羁绊故事，宣告了它的开端——。
v10597.originalDescription:
Shinra and his younger sister Ren have the ability to transfer ‘pain’ on to themselves by touching someone. Ever since they were young, they have been used by their foster parents for this ability. Tired of constantly moving from place to place, they decided to leave together to the rural mountain village of Tenryou-mura with the intention of not using their powers again. Even though they can temporarily lessen pain by taking it from someone, they are unable to cure whatever is causing the pain. However, his mother had told him that his ability is a gift for someone special in his life.

Their distant relative Sui greeted them and showed them around the school, where they met the bookworm Ayame and Touka, who had an angelic smile. They are the only students at the school and this suited the siblings just fine since they wanted to avoid contact with people as much as possible. Gradually, he learned about the ‘pain’ that each girl had. Sui had an injured leg, while Ayame suffered from her parent’s deaths in a traffic accident. His own sister Ren didn’t trust anyone, relying only on him. However, Touka’s pain is on a totally different scale – just touching her had pain shooting through his body. This is the beginning of a tale of love and sacrifice.

v12562.title: 无尽的平安夜
aliases: はじまりは、ここにする。
v12562.originalDescription:
Winter─ A time of year where people feel the need to run around every waking moment with a deluge of feelings in their hearts. The scenery in a new development near the urban center, Megumi City, only made that sentiment more prominent. Then, on Christmas Eve─

An utterly unremarkable young man runs into a mysterious girl while out on an errand. It is when he realizes this girl he has no memory of ever meeting is, for some reason, familiar to him that their story begins... 

─One wishes to protect the fun times they share. 
─Another has something to gain. 
─The last is determined to accomplish their goal. 

Each of their fates interleave into a tale.
v12562.description:
每个人虽然都怀抱着各种各样的思绪，却仿佛被催促着“必须匆匆度过”一般，某年的岁末。

在距离都市不远的卫星城・恵美市（めぐみし），这样的光景也大行其道。



以“平安夜”之名而为人所知的那一天。

极其平凡的青年・直人（なおと）在办事的途中，遇到了一位不可思议的少女。



当没有相遇记忆的那位少女，不知为何被意识为“熟人”时，他们的故事拉开了帷幕―。



―有的人，是为了守护快乐度过的‘时间’。
―另外，有的人，是无意识地想要得到‘什么’。
―然后，有的人，是为了实现重要的‘目的’。



各自的命运，交织成了故事。

v15637.title: 永不落幕的前奏诗
aliases: それよりのぷろろーぐ
v15637.description:
从懂事起，就能读懂他人感情的少年・宫坂终(宮坂終)。
尤其是在人多的地方——比如满员电车里，会有大量感情涌入。
那只有痛苦。

某天，终在乘坐的同一节车厢里发现了一个少女。
“咦？”
她的感情没有流过来。
“只要把意识集中在她身上，其他乘客的感情应该就不会流进来了……”
然而，依然什么也感觉不到。

多次擦肩而过的不可思议的少女。
不知何时起，终变得只注视着她。

但是，明明是同一所学校的学生，却连名字都不知道。
“她到底……”
然后，变得想要了解她的心——

某个夏日，少女没有走向教室，而是登上了通往天台的楼梯。
“怎么了？”
终追了上去。来到天台后，少女用冰冷的目光注视着这边。
“那个……”
正要向少女搭话的那一刻，仿佛要遮断般的话语被说了出来。
“我的心里有一堵墙。你是无法跨越的”——
少女，察觉到了终的能力。

能读懂感情的少年，与心里有墙的少女。
两人的一个夏天的回忆，就从这里开始了——
v15637.originalDescription:
Shuu is able to read the feelings of others. However, it only brings him pain, especially in places with many people, like a full train. One day, he noticed that he was not able to feel the emotions of a girl on the train, even when he focused his ability on her. Before he knew it, he was completely fixated on her and wanted to know more about her heart although he didn’t even know her name. He only knew that she was a student at his school.

One summer day, the girl went to the school’s roof instead of the classroom. He curiously followed her and when he reached the top, he was greeted by her cold gaze.

“There is a wall surrounding my heart. You cannot pass through it.”

For some reason, the girl knows his "power". 

A boy who can read people's feelings. A girl who has sealed her heart/feelings with a wall. 
The story of these two, starts at that summer ~

v21523.title: 青鸟

developers.name: パープルソフトウェア

v21523.description:
11月、冬。
于某处山腰上，坐落着一间女子全日制住宿天主学校・雾原学园。
在禁止男生出入的校园内，有着唯一的特例——身为学生神父的主人公・白鸟律。
 
被这种奇迹之力眷顾的他也成为了恶魔们的目标，
因此自出生后从未踏出过学园一步。
而他也将学园里的少女们当作“天使”来交往。
 
在他的过去、曾背负了杀害一名少女的罪孽，
因此自那时起，便立下了以她人幸福为第一的誓言。
 
然而随着一名少女的登场，本次物语的序幕至此拉开。
那便是旅行过100年的吸血鬼少女、玛丽・哈卡。
 
同时，随着她潜入学园的还有那来自电话里的娓娓恶魔之音。
 
“奇迹”之力真的能够让人幸福吗？
于这个世界诞生的价值又在何处？
 
由那些零碎的祈祷所编织而成的、诠释着生命的物语——
v21523.originalDescription:
November, the start of winter.

Kirihara Academy for Girls, a missionary boarding school located in the remote Japanese mountains. It's here we find our protagonist, Shiratori Ritsu, the sole male allowed on campus and the school priest.

He has the power to bring bliss to those he touches, and that ability is enhanced if the contact is sexual in nature. Never once has he set foot outside the academy grounds, which protect him from demons lusting after him. But the girls of this academy come to him, believing he's their guardian angel, and he obliges.

For he is burdened by the death of a girl, which strengthened his resolve to make others happy.

This constant mix of the holy and the sinful has him just barely holding onto his sanity. And the sudden arrival of a new girl raises the curtain on a whole new story. For she is the one hundred year old vampire, Mary Harker.

However, her infiltration of the academy brings with it another surprise... Namely, a phone call from the devil.

Can these powers of his truly bring joy to people's hearts? For what reason was he born?

This is a tale of life, woven into prayer.

v51923.originalDescription:
"Welcome, ghost of humans, to lunar base 13, the "Garden"."

2199 A.D.
Progress in sciences has finally allowed androids to observe the soul of humans, also known as "Ghost."

Resolving the ghosts' sorrows and regrets, this role is given to these kindhearted androids.

The protagonist, Da'at, a recently activated android, wakes up in the lunar base "Garden" and takes up their duty.

This story is about a kindhearted android as they form a connection with the Ghosts. A tale following the sound of a bell secretly signaling the end of the world.
v51923.description:
『欢迎各位人类的幽灵，来到月面基地13“庭园”』

公元2199年。
科学的进步终于让仿生人观测到了人类的灵魂＝“幽灵”。

被赋予消除幽灵的后悔与留恋、拯救灵魂之职责的
心地善良的仿生人们。

处于仿生人智力教育课程中的主人公・达识(ダアト)，
在月面基地“庭园”中醒来，并将从事这份工作。

这个故事，
是心地善良的仿生人与有苦衷的幽灵们的接触，以及。
追寻悄然开始的毁灭世界之钟声的故事。

v62721.title: マガルミナ

developers.name: パープルソフトウェア

v62721.description:
4月，春。
位于地方的宁静港口小镇。

主人公・福留大和为了开始在日本独自生活而来到了日本。
除了是混血儿之外，他乍看之下是个平凡的青年，但——

“走错路”
“被别人认错”
“送来的快递包裹，也会送成别人的东西”
“我的人生，总之总是伴随着‘错误’”

刚到达街上，
某国的公主就从天而降。
因为公寓的双重契约而和女间谍同居。
被迫去上与预定不同的学园，
还被可疑的三下辣妹同学给盯上了。

“……我想不引人注目地安静生活啊”

虽然他这么抱怨着。
但对热闹且充满谎言的新生活，也感到了兴奋。

那是，由谎言与错误交织而成的，愉快的“欺骗之爱”的故事。
v62721.originalDescription:
April, spring.  
A quiet port town in the countryside.

The protagonist, Fukutome Yamato, came to Japan to begin living on his own.  
He was a seemingly ordinary young man, apart from being half-Japanese –  

"I get lost."  
"I'm mistaken for someone else."  
"Even the packages delivered to me are for someone else."  
"My life is, in short, plagued by 'mistakes'."

No sooner had he arrived in town than a princess from some country fell from the sky.  
Due to a double contract for an apartment, he ends up cohabiting with a female spy.  
He's made to attend a different school than planned, and catches the attention of a suspicious, low-level gal classmate.

"I want to live quietly without drawing attention."

He grumbles, but he's also excited about this bustling, deception-filled new life.

This is a cheerful tale of "deceptive love" spun from lies and mistakes.

v195.original: 処女はお姉さまに恋してる

Otoboku: Maidens Are Falling For Me
The Maidens are Falling in Love with me
v195.originalDescription:
One day, the heir to the prosperous Kaburagi Corporation, a soft-spoken yet cultured young man, received a visit from his family lawyer. He came to pass on the final wish of the boy's late grandfather: that he attend an all-girls school!

With his childhood friend Mariya - a talented fashionista - to help him with the "transition," Mizuho enrolls in his new school. It's not long before a series of strange misunderstandings leads to him being elected the school's "Elder Sister," the idol of the entire student body!

It's one wild event after another at this all-girls charm school! Can Mizuho make it through the year with his identity - and his dignity - intact?
v195.description:
梅雨的间隙，略显内敛的阳光穿过樱花树列，温柔地照耀着湿润的石板路。昨夜被雨水打湿的樱花嫩叶闪烁着晶莹的水滴，透过鲜艳的绿色摇曳着。在通往校舍的短暂樱花树列间，少女们清脆的笑声与轻快的脚步声如弹跳般回荡着。那幅光景，是如此清纯、美丽而清爽。

可是……为什么非得是我去上学不可啊？！

镝木财阀的少爷，文武双全、天赋异禀却有些胆小的男孩子。某天，顾问律师造访了这样的瑞穗。

“这是不久前过世的祖父大人的遗嘱”

说着递过来的，竟是女子学院的入学指南。突如其来如暴风雨般降临的，大小姐学院的大骚动！！瑞穗到底会变成什么样呢……？！

终末少女幻想爱丽丝马蒂克 Windows7对应版
v492.originalDescription:
In 2022, the world is afflicted with a mysterious phenomenon. Adjoining multi-dimension world assimilates and becomes another space, dimension assimilation phenomenon called "Petulation". Humans can't approach these areas and their number keeps increasing...

One day, Kuroudo receives summons from the government to help the related scientific investigation at Shin Shinonome Academy located on the newly reclaimed land in Tokyo bay.

He has no idea what is going on. But the world gets closer to the destruction little by little. All he has is his skill of swordplay and one sword.

There he meets others, whom just like him are destined to fight for the future of mankind...
v492.description:
世界正悄然迎来终末。

公元2022年。世界正被一种不明原因致死的疾病侵蚀。

这种被称为"散花蚀"的时空融合现象，导致相邻多重次元世界相互融合并异界化。

污染区域顽固地拒绝人类靠近，其范围正在持续扩大......就在这样的某天。

在九州乡间过着普通学生生活的"丸目藏人"，突然因文部科学省颁发的征召令，

被带往东京湾新填海造地建成的新东云学园都市。他完全不知道自己肩负着怎样的使命，这一切又意味着什么。

然而世界正以分秒必争之势走向灭亡。少年手中紧握的，唯有自幼苦练的剑术与一柄长刀。

就在那里，藏人邂逅了试图斩开各自命运的少女们──

在这无处可逃的苍蓝天幕之下──

此刻，少年少女们为未来而战的"终末幻想"物语正悄然拉开帷幕......

莎玛娜莎玛娜～月与心与太阳的魔法～
v540.originalDescription: In a town preserved by the Sun God, where humans and fairies coexist people are preparing for a festival, praying for rich harvest. Under the peaceful sun the whole town is getting excited. The preparation is finished and all people need to do is to wait for the day of the festival to arrive. Mildin, born as a son of the moon who left this town before because of what he had done, now returns on the day of the festival. His friends welcome him home, but it is not everyone who is happy to see him return...
v540.description:
『唯有舍弃当下才能获得的明天』
那是在充满魔法与壮阔的世界中谱写的凄美爱情故事———。
　受太阳神庇佑，与众多妖精们共同存续至今的城镇。位于王国边境的玛古兰，今年也在为祈愿丰收的大祭做准备。外出打工的年轻人们也唯独在这个时节回到镇上，在温和的阳光下，小镇逐渐被喧嚣所包围。街角也摆放了孩子们亲手制作的妖精里乌·尼斯的稻草人，万事俱备，只待当日到来。
　作为拥有高魔术适性的“月之子”降生于世的主人公米尔丁，因自己引发的某起事件，在幼年时便离开了故乡玛古兰。此后被迫在王都生活的米尔丁，却出乎意料地在时隔数年后踏上了故乡的土地。故乡的海风令人怀念，街景一如往昔，朋友们无比温柔地迎接了他。然而，身为月之子的他回乡，并非所有人都乐见其成——。

v541.originalDescription:
This contains omake content from Caramel Box's other visual novels and some minigames. It contains:

- Sub episodes of Otome wa Boku ni Koishiteru
  Yarukibako contains four additional sub-episodes and a special sub-episode of Otome wa Boku ni Koishiteru.

- One novel of Shamana Shamana ~Tsuki to Kokoro to Taiyou no Mahou~
  This is a Ravi Roth's story entitled Little Knights. This episode is contained in the Shamana Shamana - DVD Edition.

- Visual novel Getsuyoutei Nite -At Moondance Diner-
  The setting of this story is the same as Blue, though they are unconnected.

- Caramelic Bout
  Caramelic Bout is a collectible card game on PC. This system was updated to version 2.1 in Fukkoku-ban.

- Splendid Reversi

v541.description:

v542.originalDescription:
The protagonist, having lost his family because of the faulty A.I. of a machine, makes his living as a professional player of a game called CQ shot.

Suddenly your friend requests you to be a bodyguard for a strange girl who is getting stalked. The protagonist doubt whether or not there actually is a stalker but since the girl seems very afraid, he takes on the job and she starts living with him.
v542.description:
自从家人在A.I误动作引发的事件中丧生以来，对那类事物抱有排斥感的主人公，作为名为QC Shot的竞技职业选手维持着生计。
另一方面，在学生生活中，多亏了青梅竹马的柚子、损友虎太郎以及龙平，虽然算不上受人欢迎，但也过着不好不坏、还算过得去的生活。
就在这时，柚子拜托他去给她的朋友千冬当保镖。似乎她最近感觉到了疑似跟踪狂的男人的视线，对此感到非常害怕，但主人公对那个跟踪狂却抱有一种疑问。
与此同时，一个麻烦人物突然降临到了主人公身边。
她的名字叫蕾波儿(リップル)。因为偶然的原因与主人公共同生活的她究竟是什么人……？
而盯上千冬的男人的目的又是……？

v543.originalDescription:
There is a school in town. The story of seven mysteries is told among students from generation to generation. Ren is an ordinary student except for the fact that he has a mysterious childhood friend.

Triggered by meeting with a witch, he gets to know a little bit about the mysteries. Ellen, Kazusa, Hana, Miu, and the other girls. The story of seven mysteries and romances starts now...
v543.description:
被稻继魂神社守护着的古町八阿多。
在其中心矗立的学园里，自古以来在学生之间流传着七件不可思议的事件。

被会说话的小狐们称为主人的八千古岛莲(八千古島蓮)，除了与创造出小狐们的妖之少女是青梅竹马之外，只是个毫无特别之处的矮小男学生。
但是以与从遥远国度降临的魔女相遇为契机，他将稍微触及到八阿多的不可思议。

患有恐高症的魔女艾琳(エリン)、
被当作神明供奉的狐妖月砂、
义妹华、
青梅竹马的姐姐深雨、
以及这个夏天新相遇的女孩子们――。

在梅雨早早放晴的太阳下，在暑假临近的八阿多学园，七件不可思议与七段恋爱的故事现在开始……

v544.description:
诸位，久等了。
那家伙又回来了！！！
这次也要大干一场！
「处女是爱上姐姐」「脆弱蓝晶的世界终焉」
「终末少女幻想Alice Magic」「交替七恋天气雨」的甜蜜爱情后日谈。
全新的卡牌战斗爆发！？
历代女主角们展开激烈交锋的卡牌游戏，
以及粉丝特典盘原创剧本，内容超豪华、丰富多彩！
■交替七恋天气雨
【故事】
・文子篇「恋萤」
以完美无缺的委员长·文子为女主角，以莲、鲇乃(鮎乃)、文子三人的旧时回忆为起因的，有点不可思议的故事。
以「低语的妖精」威斯帕大人为契机的幼年时期的事件是……？
■处女是爱上姐姐
【故事】
●严岛贵子(厳島貴子)篇 Appendix−X「然后，立于彼处之人的肖像」
毕业后贵子与瑞穗(瑞穂)的甜蜜同居生活与校园生活。
然而，就在此时发现的紫苑的婚事让瑞穗和贵子感到困惑。
两人为了拯救紫苑而四处奔走，然而……？
●十条紫苑篇 Appendix−XI「以恋与爱为主题的变奏曲」
如愿结婚成为夫妻的瑞穗和紫苑。
在大学里与比自己高一年级的贵子一起度过大学生活的两人周围发生的诸多前途多难的恋爱骚动。
重要的人们的思念去向与瑞穗的命运是？？
【角色介绍】
●松下桃子　（CV：北都南）
与瑞穗同龄，翔阳大学的1年级学姐。
学生会副会长。
说关西腔的元气少女，但在意自己幼小的外表。
与学生会会长黑泽隼人是好朋友兼吵架搭档，但开始产生了变化。
收录于『干劲箱2』的十条紫苑篇中登场。
■终末少女幻想Alice Magic
【故事】
●小夜音篇 After episode I「南十字星、漏刻之台」
如愿结婚并与甜蜜的藏人的新婚旅行目的地澳大利亚，小夜音遇到了一位自称小英的少女。
不知为何怨恨小夜音、执拗地跟踪小英。
其中有着与小夜音过去相关的因缘。
在遥远异国他乡，两位少女的命运交错……。
●冬芽/伊织篇 After episode II「梦幻剧·圣恋之重荷」
与冬芽、伊织三人开始奇妙夫妻生活(？)的藏人面前，突然出现的江户时代花魁幽灵八岛。
围绕着古怪的闯入者及其心上人展开的，有点令人感伤的奇幻爱情故事？
【角色介绍】
●蔡小英　（CV：青山由香里）
被香港三合会系黑帮（犯罪组织）培养为杀手的少女。
拥有汉族人特有的细长锐利的眼睛。
在澳大利亚逗留以进行偷渡引路和毒品贩卖期间，发现了来新婚旅行的小夜音。
使用的枪械是澳大利亚军队流出的格洛克18c。
●八岛　（CV：北都南）
江户时代，被称为游廓之花的太夫职花魁……的幽灵。
生前试图与乡下的武士一起私奔时被斩杀，两人就这样跳入河中，但遗体被冲入大海而下落不明。
受到造物主的影响，魄活化到了拥有连伊织等人都能看见的强大灵力（普通人无法看见）的程度。
收录于『干劲箱2』的冬芽/伊织篇中登场。
■脆弱蓝晶的世界终焉
【故事】
●Coffin -Ripple篇-、-向日葵篇-
枣收到了凪的委托，希望她调查追踪某个男人。
感受到周围不安气氛的枣，决定对那个男人进行调查，但不久枣发现与那个男人之间有着奇妙的因缘……。
再次被卷入疑难案件的枣和Ripple，以及向日葵等人的前方等待着的命运是……？
从Ripple和向日葵两个视角描绘震撼塞德娜的事件的紧张悬疑！
【角色介绍】
●酒井由香　（CV：木原泉）
与枣同班的女生。
柚子的朋友，同属网球部。
事件后开始上学的向日葵照顾有加，但同时也灌输了不少多余的知识。
在遭遇爆炸事件时看到了犯人的脸，因此被盯上了性命。
收录于『干劲箱2』的-向日葵篇-中登场。
■深红のチョコレート
非常甜蜜又略带苦涩的校园青春爱情喜剧！
【故事】
继承了妖魔一种·人虎血脉的主人公森崎春也，与异母妹妹花凛两人一起生活，同时与青梅竹马风祭鸟子和同班同学冢原耀一起过着热闹而平稳的学生生活。
然而某个秋日，继承了吸血鬼血脉的雾生红雪转学过来后，他的日常开始发生变化。
「表情不错呢。和看中时一样……你有成为我之物的资格」
突然亲吻春也的红雪。
开始面对自己心意的花凛·夕月。
迟迟不被当真而焦急的鸟子。
被卷入众人恋爱纠葛的春也。
被美少女们围绕是幸运还是不幸！？
森崎春也的命运究竟如何！
【角色介绍】
●森崎春也
人虎父亲与人类母亲之间诞生的青年。
父亲因工作离家后，由担任教育负责人的夕月抚养长大。
大约三年前开始，与分开生活的异母妹妹花凛一起生活。
性格随性但温柔，这既是被人趁虚而入的弱点也是优点。
●雾生红雪　（CV：由良香）
拥有雪般肌肤、红瞳的少女。
吸血鬼双亲之间诞生的第一阶位特殊因子保持者。
不擅长晒太阳，有经常吐血等弱点。
讲道理且固执，傲慢不逊，很了解自己的美貌，也知道那可以成为武器。
因体弱和身世原因导致升级延迟，其实比大家都年长。
小时候看中了被带到夜会上的春也，与春也的父亲签订了「将来迎娶令郎」的契约，但春也想不起来。
●夕月　（CV：松永雪希）
小时候被森崎家收养的少女。
接受英才教育，被赋予春也的教育负责人兼女仆的角色。
离家大约一年，却不知为何和红雪一起回到了家。
因为某些原因与春也在同一个房间起居。
始终冷静，不会惊讶或慌张，态度淡然。
精通所有家务，还拥有其他多种多样的技能。
唯独没有驾照。
●森崎花凛　（CV：文月香奈）
春也的妹妹。
与春也母亲不同。
不把春也当哥哥而是当同居人对待。
讨厌孩子气的自己，努力表现得成熟，但仍然残留着爱撒娇的部分。
最讨厌打雷和可怕的东西。
强烈继承了人虎的特质，长出了虎耳，所以用帽子遮住。
●风祭鸟子　（CV：木原泉）
春也的青梅竹马。
外表温吞但爱说话，每次失言都拼命找借口的没用孩子。
在父母经营的餐厅里和春也一起打工，觉得春也是「被自己雇用的」。
对权力低头，所以在红雪面前抬不起头，对夕月则单方面地感到尊敬。
●冢原耀　（CV：乃岛架菜）
春也的同班同学。
认识相当久了，但春也对他并不太了解。
飘飘然，举止间处处显出轻浮，但基本上是个能体贴周到的人。
■きゃらスタ！？
简单易玩的新经典！
「きゃらスタ！？」是卡牌游戏新手也能轻松享受且富有深度的对战型卡牌游戏！
组合角色卡和程序卡，组建属于你自己的特殊卡组！

v963.originalDescription:
The player takes the role of Itsukaichi Keiji, a teenager that lives by himself in the town of Tokieda, with his closest living relative being his granduncle, an author and researcher of the paranormal. Our protagonist has the peculiar ability to recognize supernatural beings with ease as well as the ability to see ghosts and other entities not visible to normal humans. Due to a complicated set of circumstances, Keiji has a strong hatred for ghosts and phantoms (also known as youkai), blaming them for the problems in his life.

Keiji's life has taken a bit of a downturn since the death of his parents, and is generally seen as a loner that makes little effort to interact with others. His life suddenly changes direction when a kage-onna by the name of Mikage appears in his house one day, claiming that she is bound to him and that she will be keeping him company.

Mikage's appearance is only the beginning, as our protagonist crosses paths with eight heroines in total as he discovers love, learns why things are the way they are and grows to accept his reality.
v963.description:
“早上好”
早晨。叫醒我的，既不是母亲，也不是妹妹，既不是青梅竹马，也不是天使，更不是来自异世界的使者——
而是影女。
听她所说，似乎是会出现在单身男人家中，宛如不请自来的妻子般照顾人的妖怪。
……不，这纯属多管闲事啊。
是的——我已经对妖怪感到厌烦了。正因为勉强能看见，才会发生那种事的……
而且，事情并没有就此结束。
在我那阵混乱还未平息之时，连疫病神都跑出来了。
……偏偏是疫病神啊。
我明明只想过普通的生活而已……
看来我注定无法逃离这些家伙的命运。
——哎呀呀。

v3790.originalDescription: Other than not being interested in any girls under 80cm bust size, Masayuki is pretty much your standard oppai-loving student. However, due to a traffic accident, he gained the ability to use astral projection (the mind leaving the body) and now can see the spiritual world which is full of ghosts and youkai. One day while he’s enjoying this world, his body was possessed by someone else! When he returns to his body, he receives criticism all around and has been branded as a pervert. What happened when he was gone!?
v3790.description:
但是，因为自行车事故而变得能够灵魂出窍了！
以幽体得知了幽世（カクリヨ：被认为是存在于这个世界与那个世界之间的缝隙中的世界）的存在，开始往来于现世之间。
幽世里充满了至今为止看不见的幽灵和妖怪们。
在那里结识了幽灵少女美世子，以及同样灵魂出窍并自称来自另一个城镇的空美，尽情享受着从未见过也从未听过的幽世世界。
更甚的是，饲养的猫铃美也灵魂出窍变成了猫耳少女！？
幽世生活变得更加喧闹了！
另一方面，在现世中，青梅竹马的美遥不知为何开始欺负（？）转学来的少女·由希。
因为庇护了由希，和美遥的关系也变得复杂起来……
就在这样的某一天，灵魂出窍时灵魂不在的政幸的身体被占据了！
被周围人指责，对毫无记忆的“变态”烙印感到困惑的政幸。
到底发生了什么！？

v3861.originalDescription: Occuring some years after the original game, this follows a new crossdressing boy and the lady-like girls who surround him at Seio Girl’s Academy. Chihaya is a boy with beautiful silver hair who was teased in class due to his looks and ends up transferring into a girl’s school run by his relatives. There he meets a girl named Kaoruko who tells him to be totally honest no matter what happens. They soon become close friends and are both nominated to become the next Elder!
v3861.description:
因为祖先拥有北欧血统，而拥有一头美丽银发的少年，妃宫千早。但他的容貌成为了好奇的焦点，并且因为其伶俐而无法与人亲近、拒绝他人，最终变得不愿上学。看不下去千早这样的母亲，下达了最后通牒，命令他转学去另一所学校……但是，那里是由亲属经营的大小姐女学院！！

和身为女仆又是青梅竹马的史一起被强行送进的学院女生宿舍……在那里，千早与名叫薰子的少女迎来了命运般的相遇。

对任何事都直来直往正面相迎的【薰子】
以及愤世嫉俗、仿佛从高处俯视事物的【千早】

彼此相互影响，虽然相互对立，千早和薰子却因奇妙的友情而结合在一起。就在这时，两人被捧为了Elder候选人……！！

究竟，他能否平安无事地度过学园生活！？而新的相遇又将如何改变千早呢？

v4316.originalDescription: Main character's parents divorce, so he has to move to a rural school. After the initial week he gets disenchanted with the school and his classmates. One day he notices a shadow in the school building. Protagonist decides to investigate it and finds a girl sitting alone in a classroom dyed in the red sunset. She does not notice protagonist and leaves the classroom. The next morning he learns that girl is a local mentally ill weirdo Chihaya who is of school age, but does not attend school. He starts to get interested in this girl.
v4316.description:
主人公因搬家前的交通事故断绝了打篮球的道路，现在无论做什么都提不起干劲，在这个乡下小镇也没有交朋友，只是单纯地度过每一天。

某天，主人公救下了被少年们欺负的少女，但那名少女即使被救下也无法好好说话，立刻就明白了她是残障人士。

起初主人公也疏远她，但不知为何开始在意起她，渐渐地开始见面，并且随着日子一天天过去，逐渐被她的纯真所吸引……。

主人公和她将会走向何方呢……。

Main character is one of its students joining in the treasure hunt accompanied by classmate girls.
v5249.description:
东京的奥地有一所白天是普通学园的「宝盛学园」。然而一到夜晚，学园就会变成迷宫。据说那座迷宫中沉睡着自太古以来就能实现任何愿望的『究极的宝物』。
因此，各方为了追求那『究极的宝物』的各色学生聚集到学园，探索着迷宫。主人公也是为了追求『究极的宝物』而转入学园的学生之一。
主人公究竟能否与女主角们一起找到『究极的宝物』呢？

v6183.title: 白い蛇の夜
v6183.originalDescription: Main character is an ordinary student, but with pervert nature. He finally decides to confess to a girl, but she is attacked by some evil spirit. Protagonist jumps ahead of her and dies. But his soul can not come up with the fact that he's going to die a virgin, so the soul rushes back to fight for control of the body. As a result, protagonist controls his body only during daytime. At night evil spirit dominates with the aim to hurt the dearest persons to main character.
v6183.description:
说起那样的“恋”，她正在追踪某种“气味”……那是只有像恋这样拥有特殊能力的人才能察觉到的“气味”。潜伏于世间暗处、附身于人的“妖”。恋的家系是代代退治这种妖的“退魔师”家系。

“那是…………什么？”
快要跟丢恋的诚一，好不容易追踪到的地方所看到的是……在烈焰飞舞的战斗中，被幻影般的巨大白蛇袭击的恋的身影。诚一不由得挺身而出推开了恋。恋得救了。
但作为代价，妖企图附身到诚一的身体上。

——事情看似就这样平安无事地解决了，但妖并没有被完全从诚一体内驱逐出去。
诚一的身体变成了白天由诚一、夜晚由妖的存在“志金(shigane)”支配的状态。
然后，志金为了恢复力量，以诚一的性命为盾牌，开始向诚一珍视的女性们伸出毒牙……

诚一究竟会……而她们的命运又会是……。

v6663.title: 雨芳恋歌　センセイ。わたし、もうオトナだよ…………
v6663.original: 雨芳恋歌　センセイ。わたし、もうオトナだよ…………
aliases: 雨芳恋歌　センセイ。わたし、もうオトナだよ…………

developers.name: キャラメルBOX ミルク味

v6663.originalDescription:
After moving to the city and becoming a schoolteacher, the protagonist’s private school shut down due to the ongoing economic downturn.  

Stuck without a job and unsure what to do next, he received a call from his father back in the countryside:  
"We’re short on teachers because of maternity leave. Come back and help out."  

The protagonist had no real desire to return to the rural town, but worn down by the emptiness of his current situation, he decided to take up the offer on a whim.  

However, upon arriving home, his father bluntly told him,  
"Your old room’s gone. I’ve arranged a place for you at the Toyohira Inn. Go there."  
And just like that, he were sent packing.  

Reluctantly, the protagonist headed to the inn, where two women were waiting for him…
v6663.description:
因《处女爱上姐姐 2位艾露达》等作品而闻名、制作王道系ADV的キャラメルBox，其榨干白浊的实用品牌——キャラメルBox ミルク味诞生了！
由实力派制作人员表现出讲究色情的本作，是3名男女在乡下小镇展开淫靡关系的不道德故事。
肉感丰富且色情的上色与姿势，诱发背德感的情境与表情。
主人公随波逐流，与青梅竹马的学生以及住宿处的年轻女将，这两名女性沉溺于情事之中，加深了爱情与肉体关系……


虽然去到都市当教师，但由于当时的不景气，工作地点的私立学校因合并而废校，主人公失去了工作。
正当走投无路时，乡下的父亲发来招募临时教师的联络说：“因为产假老师不够。回来帮忙吧。”

虽然没有回乡下的打算，但或许是出于自己现在的状况，以及对都市生活突然感到空虚，他决定接受邀请回乡。
但是回到老家后，父亲却对他说“你的房间已经没了。我已经在丰平屋订好房间了，你去那里吧”，把他赶了出去。

在不情不愿前往的民宿里，有两名女性正等待着主人公……

She performs various household chores and tries to get liked by protagonist. Where will this strange cohabitation lead?
v7294.description:
突然，作为不请自来的妻子而来的青梅竹马。
她做着各种家务，试图讨主人公的欢心，但是……

主人公是临近3月毕业的大学生。只剩下毕业论文和补课，工作也已内定。就在这时，以商店街的抽奖为契机，父母将要离家大约两周。
得知此事的、仰慕主人公为“哥哥”的附近青梅竹马，为了在父母不在家期间照顾他，成为了不请自来的妻子，住进家里做着各种家务，试图讨主人公的欢心，但是……

尽是失败的笨拙的不请自来的妻子们。究竟，奇妙的同居生活去向如何！？

v10958.original: 木洩れ陽のノスタルジーカ -Raggio di sole nostalgico-
aliases: 木洩れ陽のノスタルジーカ -Raggio di sole nostalgico-
Komorebi no Nostalgica -Raggio di sole nostalgico-
v10958.originalDescription: In the distant future, humans live together with AI and history had been forgotten. Youta enjoyed his quiet life even though he was often manipulated by his genius programmer (but also extreme troublemaker) imouto Akira. One day while accompanying Akira, he came upon a hidden room. With the help of some old friends, they managed to open the door. Inside they found a pretty android girl in a deep sleep. Her body and her heart was broken. Akira decided right there that she wanted to fix her and her words fired up everyone’s curiosity, just like when they were kids. Thus begins their heart-warming days with the android girl Cinema.
v10958.description:
遥远——历史已失落的遥远未来。与拥有智慧的机械共存的世界。
人们即便如此，依然迈着缓慢的步伐前行。
岛津翔太虽然被身为程序天才却是超大型问题儿童的义妹·岛津朗折腾得团团转，但也过着还算平稳快乐的日子。
在这样的某一天，他陪同岛津朗前往休息日的学园，发现了一间隐藏的房间。
翔太借助仿佛被吸引般聚集而来的昔日好友们的力量，打开了那扇门。
——那里，有着一具可爱的仿生人少女的身影。
但是，她因为漫长漫长的沉睡，心也，身体也，快要坏掉了。
“我，想治好这孩子！”
岛津朗的这一句话，点燃了大家沉睡的好奇心。
仿佛回到了孩提时代般的六个伙伴。
于是，与机械构造的少女·希音玛(しねま)之间温暖人心的日子开始了——。

v14760.title: セミラミスの天秤
v14760.originalDescription:
Ever since he hit his head, Reiji can sometimes hear things which he shouldn’t be able to hear. The doctor told him that such cases of acousma would gradually fade with time, but he felt rather restless about it. One day, he met Ami, the transfer student who had held all the boys in the class captive on her first day. He wasn’t excited like his friends, but rather worried about her after looking at her slightly vacant eyes.

That night, he met her by chance on the way back home from the convenience store. She told him while smiling that he was qualified to become a magician, and he felt a shiver through his body. He realized that he couldn’t defy Ami, who called herself a ‘devil’. It was as if she could read his thoughts. Afterwards in the classroom, he would hear her whispers, by which she would reveal the true feelings and intentions of his fellow classmates. He felt that the classroom had become a ‘kind prison’ full of lies and façades. Will he be able to escape from Ami’s ‘prison’?
v14760.description:
“——能听见幻听”
也许是撞到头的影响，时不时会夹杂着杂音，听到本不该听到的声音。
虽然医生说“轻伤，迟早会好的”，但总觉得心神不宁——在这样的日子里，“她”出现了。
神尾爱生(神尾愛生)。转校第一天就让班上所有男生为之倾倒的美少女。
但是，只有玲儿对兴奋不已的朋友们视若无睹，在意着她那微微空洞的眼眸。
夜晚，从便利店回家的途中，玲儿与爱生相遇。
“是叫速水同学吧——你有成为魔术士的资格呢”
听到与妖艳的微笑完全不符的那句话，玲儿不可思议地感觉到身体开始颤抖。
就这样被硬闯进独居的公寓，不知为何落得被赖着住下的下场的玲儿。
但是，面对自称“恶魔”的爱生，不知为何却无法违抗。总之她能言善辩，而且心就像被看透了一样被她读了出来。
“——那孩子，是个骗子呢”
爱生的这种“力量”也毫不留情地施展到了同学们身上。
仅仅是和爱生共同行动，朋友们的恣意就像写在薄纸背面的文字一样被揭露出来。
难道说，爱生真的是恶魔吗——甚至涌起了这样的心情，但并非发生了什么超常的事情。
她只是轻声低语。仅此而已，玲儿的周围就建立起与至今为止完全不同的人际关系——
那简直就像是，用谎言粉饰而成的 温柔牢狱 一样。
玲儿能从爱生那样的“牢狱”中逃脱出来吗……？

某天被爱生邀请大家一起玩手游的过程中，和同班同学阳子变得亲近起来……

v18145.original: 機関幕末異聞 ラストキャバリエ
aliases: 機関幕末異聞 ラストキャバリエ
机关幕末异闻 最后的骑士
v18145.originalDescription:
During the Bunkyuu Era, the Tokugawa shogunate that had remained in power for three centuries was being pressured by both foreign countries to open its borders and feudal lords who aspired to restore Imperial rule, and was on the verge of collapse due to internal and external scheming.

The political strife shifted from Edo to Kyoto, with heroes and conspirators alike attracted to the Imperial capital. At that time, a new squad called Shinsengumi was formed on the orders of the Military Commissioner Matsudaira Katamori to maintain peace and order. Only women known as "shouki", who can harness power of mystical stones known as "kishouseki", were eligible to become its members. 

Okita Soujirou was working as an instructor at the Shieikan dojo in western Edo. Without any relatives, he considered the dojo master Kondou Isa and her sworn sister Hijikata Sei, who both saved his life when he was young, to be his family. When women of the dojo were called to help in forming the Shinsengumi, they asked Soujirou to disguise himself as a woman and join them. Now known as Okita Soushi, Soujirou held only one goal in him mind - to protect Isa and Sei, even if he couldn't hold the same power as a real "shouki".
v18145.description:
——工业革命也流入日本，完成了近代化的与如今不同的世界。

文久三年。
守护了三百年幕藩体制的德川幕府，在迫使其开国的诸外国、以朝廷复权为目标的公卿，以及外样藩的谋划下，正被逼入内忧外患、体制崩溃的境地。
政争的舞台从江户转向京都，杰出人物与汉奸，所有的阴谋都被吸引至帝都。

在那时，被任命为京都守护职的松平容保公，
组建了瘴姬——仅由接受过鬼瘴石洗礼的女性构成的治安维持组织“新选组”。

鬼瘴石在吸收了相性契合的人类后，会增强其膂力与反射神经，赋予其如鬼神般的战斗力。
但不知是何种天意的恶作剧，这种适应性只在女性身上显现。

在多摩的偏僻乡村，担任剑术道场试卫馆塾头的俊英冲田惣次郎，是个天涯孤独之身。
他将道场主近藤伊佐，以及将自己从困境中拯救出来的伊佐的义兄弟土方岁，尊为家人与主君，
某时，他听闻了幕府招募以京都守护为职的“瘴姬”的通告。

惣次郎立刻被伊佐叫去，被告知两人要前往京都一事。

既然作为瘴姬降生，立身出世便是正道——惣次郎也理解这一点。
但是，惣次郎还没能向两人报恩或还清借款。这让他心存遗憾。

然而，接下来从伊佐那里听到的话语，让惣次郎吃了一惊。

“你那天赋的剑术，现在不正是为了我们派上用场的时候吗？”

伊佐告诉惣次郎也要前往京都侍奉——如此说道。

v21979.originalDescription:
Hisoka was an orphan who was raised by Yukitaka, the present head of the worldwide Jinsei Corporation, with the help of his right-hand man Daisuke. He was adopted for the sole purpose of working both publicly and secretly for his daughter Orihime, who was next in line to inherit the business. That’s why he did not hesitate when he was asked by Yukitaka to attend the same school as her and serve as her bodyguard in secret.

The only problem was that her school was the refined Saint Ceral Girls’ Academy, which was closed to boys. He didn’t know it at the time, but it would be a major turning point in his life.
v21979.description:
“希望你保护就读于这所学院的，我的‘女儿’”

尽星集团是一家业务横跨全球的企业集团。
作为其创始人家族的女儿出生的风早织女——暗中护卫她的人身安全。

这就是下达给主人公·结城密的职务。

密在成为孤儿时，是被现任当家风早幸敬保护的孩子。
他被托付给其心腹结城大辅，作为其养子被抚养长大。
为了有朝一日能为织女，在暗处与明处效力——他就是为此而生的存在。

所以，他早已做好了觉悟。

只是问题在于，接下来要前往的圣瑟拉尔女子学院
是一所禁止男性入内的千金小姐学校……

——然而，密并不知道。

那将成为改变他人生的巨大转机……

v27161.originalDescription: It's autumn, and main character is busy staging a play for culture festival. He tries to find important things in everyday life and build memories with important people.
v27161.description:
季节是秋天。
现在，我脑海中想的是我们乐队的事。
要怎样才能将学园祭的舞台变成属于我们的。
但是，
我感觉到了与平时稍微有些不同的什么。
感觉像是缺少了平时一直存在的什么。
那是，在不知不觉间，却又确实地，
改写着我们的日常……




『秋风的情歌』 是，
发生在日常中的，重要的日常。
以那样的日常为主题的，恋爱冒险游戏。
请你化身为主人公･羽山誠人 (はやままこと)
与亲友、损友、女孩子们一起度过学生生活。
从中你一定能够找到，对于你而言的
“重要的日常”……

v29032.title: プリンセスクライシス
v29032.original: プリンセスクライシス
aliases: プリンセスクライシス
v29032.originalDescription:
Humans, fairies, dwarfs, and beastmen. Laurencia is a remote island where the four races live happily without conflict.

That peace was brought about after the four tribes united to challenge the "Demon King", who once came from the mainland and ruled the island with fear and despair. They were able to defeat and seal him in after a having won a fierce and painful battle. Several hundred years have passed since then. The threat of the Demon King has been forgotten in the prosperity supported by advanced magic technology.

One day, an earthquake occurs that shakes the entire island. The epicenter of the earthquake is the dungeon called "Zvinga" where the Demon King was sealed. The four tribes fear that this might be a sign of the resurrection of the Demon King. The protagonist, Bernard, a descendant of the mage who created the ward, is ordered to investigate it.
v29032.description:
——人类、妖精、小人、兽人——
四个种族无争无斗、幸福生活的边境岛屿劳伦西亚。
这份和平，是四个种族团结一致，向曾经从大陆而来、用恐怖与绝望支配岛屿的魔王发起挑战，
在激战之后勉强获胜并将其封印才换来的。
此后数百年。
在高级魔法技术支撑的繁荣之中，魔王的威胁早已被彻底遗忘，
然而某天，发生了震动全岛的地震。
震源是封印魔王的地下城“茨温加”，
四个种族担忧这可能是魔王复活的预兆，
便命令制造了结界的魔导师子孙、主人公贝尔纳尔前去调查。
前往调查的贝尔纳尔，被即将苏醒的魔王搭话道“若协助我复活，便让你返老还童”——
他接受了那甜美的诱惑。
于是贝尔纳尔成为了魔王的麾下，
为了将再次被送来坚固封印魔王的公主们引入陷阱，他开始了暗中活跃……

●莉莉安·鲁瓦耶（CV：天知遥）
人类之国阿尔萨斯的大公主。
操使由魔王之角制成的魔剑达因斯莱夫。
虽出身于旁系贵族，但在学院里是文武双全如出一辙的顶尖模范生。
不仅剑技与魔力出众，还多才多艺，却绝不因此骄傲，兼具深思熟虑与温和，是一位具备堪称公主中的公主之气度与高洁精神的少女。
“既然成为了大公主，就必须做好随时握剑的觉悟。”

●塞莱斯缇雅·华兹华斯（CV：绫音真子）
妖精之国弗雷斯特尔的大公主。
操使魔弓费尔诺特。
妖精族是魔法才能优秀的种族，其中身为王家直系公主的塞莱斯缇雅拥有极高的魔力，但也正因有实力而带有自信家气质，偶尔会“毫无恶意地戳中别人的弱点”。
好胜心强，但对物理疼痛很弱。
“没关系，你以为我是谁？”

●艾丽泽·海因策尔(エリーゼ・ハインツェル)（CV：天野诗）
小人之国克莱因施密特的大公主。
操使魔锤妙尔尼尔。
小人族虽然身材矮小，但肉体极其强健，力量也很优秀，身为公主的艾丽泽更是拥有堪称怪力的力量。
性格直爽不拘小节，比起思考复杂的事情烦恼，更喜欢活动身体。
在战斗方面，喜欢与强敌堂堂正正地交锋，厌恶从背后偷袭或算计对方的卑鄙行为。
所谓油耗很差的身体，是个相当的大胃王。
“哪个都行。总之，把那家伙也打飞就行了，对吧？”

●菲奥蕾·德·桑克蒂斯(フィオレ・デ・サンクティス)（CV：花泽樱）
兽人之国的里雅斯特的大公主。
操使魔枪冈格尼尔。
是宿有狼之特征的兽人，拥有很高的身体能力，但性格略显内向且温柔，甚至可能被看作软弱，属于安静的类型。
与其他三人相比，对自己作为大公主的立场也缺乏自信，不太认为自己配得上那个地位。
兽人族尊崇抑制内在兽性、像人一样有文化地行动，因此菲奥蕾也倾向于忌讳争斗与战斗本身，但保护同伴的意识非常强。
“诶……我，没有自信……”

●保拉(パウラ)（CV：枫花）
魔王分配给贝尔纳尔作为辅助角色的人型魔力生命体。
毫无战斗能力。
外表是散发着冷酷神秘氛围的美女，但内在却有着某种难以捉摸的不可思议的性格，对主人贝尔纳尔也会轻描淡写地说些毒舌或玩笑话。
“请放心。这种程度的玩笑我还是懂的。”

●贝尔纳尔·杜兰
本作的主人公。
氛围不太起眼的中年男人。
建造了茨温加的结界术师末裔，现任管理人。
凭借祖先的功绩获得了学院的教授职位，但在长久的和平时代中地位下降，实质上几乎被当作闲职对待。
本人也早已没有扭转这种境遇的气力，半以放弃的心境接受着每天人生消化比赛模式的日子。
……但是，某天前往茨温加调查时，听到了本该被封印的魔王的声音，命运由此发生了巨大改变。
“也就是说……让我背叛人类成为魔王的同伴？”
