v5690.originalDescription:
The player takes on the role of Naoki Serizawa, the protagonist of Yubikiri no Kioku. Naoki used to live at Chinatsu's home but is now living alone. Naoki is a second year student at the private Tourin high school. Chinatsu Amakawa is also a second year student at the private Tohrin high school and is a classmate of Naoki's. As Chinatsu is concerned about Naoki at all times, she commutes to school with him and is always around him during school hours. Kasumi Nagumo is a runaway girl who suddenly arrived at the doorsteps of Naoki's place and is forcibly living with him at the moment. Orihime Hoshitsuki is the new math teacher for Naoki's class at Tourin high school. Lisa Caycy Foster is an American girl who has gone to Japan to study abroad temporarily. Lisa works part-time at a restaurant called Fuuruuyan and is where he meets Naoki. Lisa's reason for studying in Japan is because of her interest in Japanese history and culture. Shiina Kodou is a first year student at Tourin high school. She is very outgoing and loves gossips.

(edited from Wikipedia)
v5690.description:
神奈川县藤川市——
　　在黄金周结束的时分，暖春的气息一如既往地造访了位于神奈川县藤川市的藤林高等学校。享受着从教室的窗户撒进来的温暖的阳光进行小憩，芹泽直树一直都祈望着这种生活。
　　「一切都没有改变，永远都不会改变，这样温暖而又幸福的日子能继续的话就够了——」
　　这样平静的生活直到直树升到高中2年级的时候都未曾改变。
　　「千夏我，是直树的妻子！！」
　　直树一直觉得，只要能和总是说出这种令人害羞的发言的青梅竹马兼同班同学——天川千夏，以及其他朋友们继续过着这样平凡但却快乐的生活就足够了。
　　——然而，这个平凡的愿望却突然——
　　——被降临的迷之少女彻底摧毁了——
　　迷之少女——南云霞，忽然出现在了直树面前，以及，突然开始的，与霞一起的秘密同居生活。
　　「想赶我出去的话，随你的便，我失去的只不过是卧眠之塌，而你失去的，则是将来。这会是个很有趣的交易呢。
　　困惑的直树，被彻底打乱的日常生活。被道破的记忆矛盾。直树有勇气松开那已勾紧的小指吗？
　　本作的舞台将转移到当地的支线，在芦鹿电沿线的林钟寺与芦鹿岛周边展开。距离林钟寺站不远的公立高中，是主人公所在的高中。教学水平处于中等程度，名字的由来是相邻不远的市区「藤川」与「林钟寺」的首个汉字所组合起来，故被命名为藤林高级中学。附近的学生都简称其为「藤高」。另外还有一所名为「风流庵」的餐厅，是全面体现「和风」的餐厅，店内的布局能使人感到安心。所属企业经营着著名的连锁餐馆「罗萨克」，是以树立新的品牌为目标而开设的实验性店铺。

v5883.originalDescription:
"The Science itself may prove cynical. However, one mustn't forget that there is a scientific element in all things. The important truth is this: I am the master of my fate, I am the captain of my soul."

Science Adventure Series #3     "Robotics;Notes Elite"    Divergence: 1.048596.

In the near future, the PhoneDroid--a device which features augmented reality--has risen in popularity in Tanegashima.
On that island, Central Tanegashima High's "Robot Research Club" is about to have their club disbanded.
Despite their predicament, Kaito Yashio, one of only two members in the Robot Club, couldn't care less and would rather play a robot fighting game.
His counterpart, the reckless club leader Akiho Senomiya, ignores Kaito as she strives to keep the club from being disbanded by completing their giant robot.

One day, for some odd reason, Kaito finds an A.R. (augmented reality) annotation titled "Kimijima Report."
It contains details about a plot involving the entire world written by a man named Ko Kimijima.
v5883.description:
1975年的『IBN5100制成』1991年的『海湾战争』2000年的『千年虫问题』2009年的『新世代的疯狂事件、涉谷毁灭』 2010年的『某个划时代的发明』
下一个世界线的大分歧是在2019年的种子岛。
舞台是中央种子岛高中即将被废部的机器人研究部。
Robotic;Notes的故事发生在世界线变动率『1.048596』的世界线上。
也就是处在Steins；Gate世界线延长线上2019年的种子岛。
这时手握关键的是『JAXA』。
“拯救世界的不是英雄——而是死宅。”

v7483.originalDescription:
During the sixteenth century, Japan is experiencing civil war. Even worse, monsters attack the Shimizu castle, where Seishiro Tachibana, a low ranking samurai warrior, serves. After barely escaping from one of these fiends, he hears that the princess of the castle, Natsu, has had a curse placed upon her. She is to become a sacrifice for reviving other monsters. Seishiro sets out on a journey to find a way to remove the princess's curse. During his trek, he encounters girls who help him find clues. He'll meet up with Shion, Rindou, and Kikumo. They learn that the ultimate monster, "Azami," is looting the entire country, in search for sacrifices to revive his fiendish clan.

The powerful daimyo "Tobusa" rises against the monsters to end the sacrifices causing all this turmoil.

Natsu has only two months to live. With the help of his comrades, will Seishiro be able to remove the curse and save her?
v7483.description:
在古老的世代，存在着应被忌讳的妖物。
妖，持金色的尾巴，以从其身涌出的火焰屠杀山野，
以毒毁灭鸟兽，
将一切吞噬，
欲聚集力量以叠加更深的罪孽。
在战栗颤抖的人们之中，挺身而立的年轻人终于讨伐了妖物，即便化为粉碎的残片却依然未灭。
四散的残片，有的释放毒气，有的蕴含力量，化作雾气消散，各自散落于深山之中。
经过漫长岁月，化作往昔传说，因人的记忆依凭，此妖终被遗忘。

v7849.title: 尸体派对 影之书
v7849.original: コープスパーティー ブックオブシャドウズ
aliases: コープスパーティー ブックオブシャドウズ
v7849.originalDescription:
Before, during, and after the events of Corpse Party—in the canon universe, as well as in several alternate timelines—the students of Kisaragi Academy, Byakudan Senior High, Paulownia High, and Musashigawa Middle School had far more experiences within the cursed halls of Heavenly Host Elementary than the stories typically recount. How would events have unfolded, for example, in a universe where each student went into the Sachiko Ever After ritual with an unconscious awareness of everything that was going to happen to them? What might’ve occurred to Mayu if she’d never interacted with the ghostly children in the school infirmary? What might’ve occurred to Yuka if she’d been caught during the harrowing chase in the second wing? What might’ve occurred to Seiko if Naomi had gotten to the bathroom just a bit earlier?

On the other side of the coin, how did Naho actually get into Heavenly Host, and whom did she come with? What was Tohko’s relationship with Kizami, and how did that result in a lost tooth? And what connection did Ms. Yui have to the cursed elementary school prior to ever taking part in the Sachiko Ever After ritual?

Most crucially, what happened to the survivors of the previous incident after their escape? How did the loss of their friends affect them? And what does all of this have to do with the mysterious tome known as the “Book of Shadows”…?
v7849.description:
本作汇集了从前作《尸体派对 血色覆盖 重复恐惧》（以下简称BR）派生出的各种故事，并将其整合为一部作品。无论是BR的前传与后传，还是在BR中登场的刻命裕也所就读的白檀高中的插曲等，各自虽为单发故事，却是以BR为中心相互关联的卫星插曲集形式的作品。

　系统方面，与前作“玩家自由操作角色”的风格不同，本作将成为玩家以主人公视角推进故事的探索型文字冒险游戏。此外，还搭载了玩家自己移动画面以获取提示等新系统。

　配音阵容延续自前作，并有2名新角色登场。此外，前作中广受好评的采用仿真头麦克风进行双声道录音的音源大幅增加。成为了一部能让人品味到更浓厚恐怖风味的作品。

v9032.title: 魔法のパレット
v9032.originalDescription:
Jan lost his parents in a fire when he was a child. He now tries to become a painter and travels the land as his father did. He has two purposes in his journey: to polish his skills as a painter and to find the witch with a stone called "A Drop of the Moon," which appeared in his father's painting. Unfortunately, the painting was lost in the fire, but it remains in Jan's memory. No one believes in the existence of witches, but Jan's father believed it up until his death. Jan believes his father, and he finally arrives at the famous "witch-town" of Evenburg.

Will Jan be able to finally meet the witch? This adventurous story takes place in the beautiful, medieval European-like town of Evenburg. The goal of the player (Jan) is to find the gem called "A Drop of the Moon." Throughout the quest, the player will meet many cute witches and experience exciting events with them! This title features a new "Attribute System," which appoints every witch a specific guardian gemstone. This system randomly decides which events will occur according to the personalities of the characters. For instance, if your character doesn't share matching attributes with the heroine, your character will never share the night with her! Play hard! Get the gem! Get your favorite girl!!
v9032.description: 主人公让（ジャン）在幼年时因火灾失去了双亲。在那场火灾中，一幅描绘着名为《怀抱光的魔女》、胸前怀有美丽宝石「月之滴」的魔女的画作被烧毁了。然而，那幅画从未从让的心中消失过。他相信那幅画中所描绘的魔女的存在，立志成为和父亲一样的画家，继续着旅程。让相信父亲的话语，以及他画下的《怀抱光的魔女》这幅画中所蕴含的心意。而现在，他来到了有着魔女之城之称的埃本堡。

v10231.original: コープスパーティー -THE ANTHOLOGY- サチコの恋愛遊戯♥Hysteric Birthday 2U
aliases: コープスパーティー -THE ANTHOLOGY- サチコの恋愛遊戯♥Hysteric Birthday 2U
Corpse Party -The Anthology- Sachiko no Ren'ai Yuugi ♥ Hysteric Birthday 2U
Corpse Party: Sweet Sachiko's Hysteric Birthday Bash
尸体派对 文选集 幸子的恋爱游戏 竭斯底里生日2U
v10231.originalDescription:
Sachiko Shinozaki, tragically murdered at age 7; such a sweet girl, taken away at such a young and tender age! Sure, she may have reacted by becoming a bloodthirsty, vengeful spirit responsible for the deaths of countless other children, as well as their erasures from history, but everyone knows that in her heart of hearts, she's just an ordinary, innocent little 7-year-old... right?

Well, no. Because you see, today is her birthday! She'll be turning... 7 again, naturally. But in celebration, she's decided to grant all her victims 24 hours of amnesty from their suffering by gathering them all together for a...hysteric? birthday bash. (What makes it “hysteric,” again?) There will be party games, entertainment, adventure, and most of all, romance!

Why romance? Well, that's simple. Sachiko has only one thing she truly wants for her birthday, and that's to see all the students she's killed (and re-killed, and re-re-killed) put on a romantic comedy show for her amusement. Whether it be a movie, a play, or just some off-the-cuff party hijinks, Sachiko had better see her ships come to pass... or else!

Join Sachiko and the lovable cast of damned souls from previous Corpse Party games—along with a few new faces—as they take the very concept of genre and toss it aside. Prepare to experience terror, discomfort, joviality, and confusion in equal measure as Heavenly Host Elementary plays less-than-heavenly host to cooking contests, co-ed mixers, interpretive stage drama, traditional party games, and Lovecraftian horrors alike. Because you know what they say: Hell hath no fury like a 7-year-old girl bored...
v10231.description:
今天是筱崎幸子(サチコ)的生日。因诅咒而支配力减弱的天神小学。
因筱崎幸子的力量而命运被重置的哲志等人，被聚集在天神小学的礼堂里。虽然记忆处于模糊的状态，但哲志等人对平安重逢感到高兴。
这时筱崎幸子出现，突然宣布要举办文化祭。众人感到困惑。
而文化祭的主题是……

“恋爱喜剧”!? 在天神小学搞“恋爱喜剧”？？？

来开始吧，筱崎幸子的恋爱游戏。
竭斯底里生日开始了开始了～

v14018.description:
2009年11月6日。
　涩谷区发生M7.8的局部地震。
　涩谷站周边的市区陷入毁灭状态，最终死亡人数达到3851人。

　然后，2015年。

　故事从复兴后的涩谷开始——
v14018.originalDescription: It's been six years since a massive earthquake leveled the city of Shibuya. Now, in October 2015, while researching a number of recent murders, Takuru Miyashiro realizes a horrible truth. These murders are the return of a series of killings that plunged Shibuya into terror six years ago. And at the same time, people called gigalomaniacs, with the powers to make their delusions real, are beginning to awaken.

v17101.title: 匿名代码
v17101.originalDescription:
"The fact that you've arrived here―rather, to this save point―at this moment in your life is nothing short of a miracle. It delights me to no end. Step through the stage's curtain; rip off the mask of the wizard who pulls the strings. Close the loop. Hack into God."

——February 6, 2036 - Time, 15:28:15

Every computer on Earth overflowed past the maximum limit of the 4,294,967,295 seconds granted within the Digital Standard Clock that had been ticking away since 1900, leading to the worst-case scenario: all Defense-Attack Systems throughout the world majorly malfunctioning. Military satellites roared like Hammers of God as they showered instant devastation upon the world's major cities. New York, London, Shanghai, Moscow, and Shinjuku. This large-scale disaster came to be known as "Sad Morning."  Was this simply judgment being handed down onto mankind? If so, then who could that judge be? Or instead, could this merely be the preface to a far greater calamity...? 

The curtains to the story of Anonymous;Code rise during an unsettling series of events set in Nakano, Tokyo - Year 2037.
v17101.description:
故事舞台为2037年的东京・中野。主角高冈步论与好友弓川十字搭档从事着黑客工作，在这片自2036年2月6日的世界级巨大灾害“哀伤之晨”中幸存之地生活。

在这样的日子里，某天出于一些琐碎细故，步论脱口跟大家宣告说他约好了要与人“私奔”，但其实根本只是信口胡说。没想到，原本预期不会有人出现的步论，却在会合地点邂逅了一位神秘少女“桃”。

随后，神秘的袭击者紧追着桃现身。

正当步论与桃上演着绝地大逃亡之际，他取得了一个神秘的应用程式“存档＆读档”，获得能像电玩游戏那样将特定时刻存档重新来过的能力，两人也因此逃出了生天。然而，这一切却只不过是连串事件的开端……

神秘的天才黑客“Cicada3301”与其抛出的各式无解“任务”；
“垓机关”唤醒了本已冻结的地球模拟器；
以及私下谋划策动的梵蒂冈“513圣务室”派出的刺客阵。

在与桃的邂逅之后，步论被卷入了各方错纵的阴谋与企图之中，挺身而出面对撼动整个世界的大事件。

发挥黑客之力与“存档＆读档”等一切之后，方能在彼端看见的真相是？

“黑进”无限分歧的现实世界，“读档”找出拯救世界的结局吧！

这是一段改写未来的“黑客”们的故事。

シュタインズ・ゲート ゼロ
v17102.originalDescription:
"This is the story of the 'future' that could not be saved." 

December, 2010 - Beta Worldline:

At the end of his journey through countless worldlines filled with untold sorrows and hardship, the protagonist, Okabe Rintarou, sinks into despair and abandons all efforts of saving "her".

As his friends grow concerned for his well-being, Okabe immerses himself in the lifestyle of a serious student in a desperate attempt to push past his guilt and grief.
 
He attends a college seminar for extra credit while still struggling with trauma, where he comes across two scientists who belonged to the same school and research team as "her".

After he publicly defends their work against skepticism during a presentation, Okabe is invited to be a test subject for a research project titled "Amadeus"— an experimental AI which uses digitized memories as artificial intelligence avatars, one containing none other than "her" memories. 

But little did he know that the project would soon draw him back into that very world of dark conspiracies he had strived to avoid.

The story is inspired by the "Epigraph Trilogy" light novels and other various drama CDs.
v17102.description:
——这是未能拯救的「未来」的故事。
2010年11月 β世界线——

主人公·冈部伦太郎(岡部倫太郎)在跨越了无数苦难与悲哀的尽头，

放弃了拯救「她」的世界线。

陷入失意谷底的冈部伦太郎。

担心着他的伙伴们。

未能获救的「她」后来怎样了？

迎来新角色所描绘的「0」的故事。

没错，「她」如今也依然在那里——

v19552.title: 色紙
v19552.originalDescription: Main character is an occult enthusiast. He finds three types of bills in his old warehouse - red, blue and green. In an attempt to defend school from a mysterious beast he learns that these bills can summon shikigami. Each of spirits appears in the form of a girl and demands a part of protagonist as payment. Body fluid also suffices, so his sex life becomes much more diverse.
v19552.description:
今宵，让我们来谈谈那些非人之物吧……

　身为超自然狂热者的主人公・白河 秀吾，在自家的旧仓库中，发现了赤・青・緑这三种颜色的符咒。那分别是装订成册的各10张。产生兴趣的秀吾，沉迷于那些符咒的研究之中。
　就在这样的某一天，秀吾的周围开始发生不可解的事件。得知用那些符咒可以召唤式神的秀吾，用召唤出的式神的力量，退治了成为不可思议事件原因的物怪。在这两个故事中诞生的人类与式神的羁绊、相遇与离别被凄美地描绘出来，催人泪下的故事在根底流淌，为故事增色。

v19953.title: カオスチャイルド らぶchu☆chu!!
v19953.original: カオスチャイルド らぶchu☆chu!!
aliases: カオスチャイルド らぶchu☆chu!!
v19953.originalDescription:
“On that day... at that very moment... I... quit this goddamn game!”

Chaos;Child Love Chu☆Chu!! is set in Shibuya, Tokyo, and takes place after Chaos;Child's true ending.

Bizarre events referred to as the "Return of the New Generation of Madness" take place, but their interest is quite debatable for the protagonist Miyashiro Takuru, the president of Hekiho Academy's Newspaper Club; instead, after failing to find a real scoop, he focuses on "real-life activities" and goes on to spend time with the rest of the cast.

In Chaos;Child Love Chu☆Chu!! the story is affected by player choices: by regularly using the "Yes/No Trigger" system—in which they fill in "yes/no" questionnaires in the in-game magazine Cool Cat Press—the story branches depending on the player's answers. Of course, the Delusion Trigger system is still present and also provides a way to branch the story.
v19953.description:
“那一天……就在那一刻……我……不玩这个该死的游戏了！”

Chaos;Child 爱的亲亲的故事舞台设定在东京涩谷，时间线在Chaos;Child的真结局之后。

被称为“新世代狂气的回归”的离奇事件发生了，但对于主人公、Hekiho Academy新闻部的部长宫代拓留(Miyashiro Takuru)来说，这些事件的吸引力实在值得商榷；相反，在未能找到真正的独家新闻后，他将重心转向了“现实生活活动”，并开始与剩下的角色们共度时光。

在Chaos;Child 爱的亲亲中，故事会受到玩家选择的影响：通过定期使用“Yes/No Trigger”系统——在游戏内杂志Cool Cat Press中填写“是/否”问卷——故事会根据玩家的回答产生分支。当然，Delusion Trigger系统依然存在，同样也提供了让故事产生分支的途径。

v21281.title: ROBOTICS;NOTES DaSH
aliases: ロボティクス・ノーツ DaSH
v21281.originalDescription:
2020. World line variation rate: 1.048596.

While consumer-use robots receiving the benefits of a networked society are becoming more widespread, the robot rebellion incident in February showed the vulnerability of that sort of information society. While it was a global crisis through the network, it was prevented by high school students of Tanegashima island, where the battle took place.

Half a year later. Tanegashima is flooded with people as it prepares for its summer festival. One of the high school students that saved the world from crisis, the protagonist Kaito Yashio, has since graduated and returns to his hometown of Tanegashima after a long time away.

During his return, he meets a middle-aged man named Itaru Hashida, who has a mutual friend and came to Tanegashima to see the sights. However, he cannot help but find his behavior strange. Although this man is actually a super hacker with world-class skills, Kaito has yet to learn this fact. Before long, events that disrupt everyday life start to repeatedly occur.

That was the sign of a conspiracy that is once again trying to throw the world into chaos.
v21281.description:
信息基础设施日益发达，世界距离缩短的2020年。
让扩增实境更加贴近生活的被称为“便携终端”的触控板设备得到普及，不仅是工业用，民用机器人也变得普遍化的时代。
在这样的背景下，2月发生的机器人叛乱事件虽然因成为决战场的种子岛的高中生们的活跃而平息，但通过网络引发的世界性危机，已充分显示了信息社会的脆弱性。
那之后过了半年。因准备夏日祭典而热闹非凡的种子岛。
高中毕业后，以成为宇航员为目标正在复读中的主人公・八汐海翔，在久违地回到故乡的港口处，通过认识的JAXA职员天王寺绹(天王寺綯)，遇到了一个名叫桥田至(橋田至)的男人。
他自称偶然与海翔搭乘了同一艘船，说是为了观光而来到岛上，但言行举止总觉得有些奇怪。
久违重逢的原机器人部成员兼青梅竹马濑乃宫秋穗(瀬乃宮あき穂)和大德淳和(大徳淳和)。
机器人部的后辈，神代芙拉(神代フラウ)和日高昴。
因2月的事件为契机而认识的少女，行舟爱理(行舟愛理)。
然后，在与天王寺绹、桥田至一起尽情享受夏天的日常中，开始频繁发生让人感到微小违和感的事件。
那是，企图再次将世界陷入混乱的事件的前兆……

v21964.title: 告别回忆-无垢少女-
aliases: メモリーズオフ -イノサンフィーユ-
v21964.originalDescription:
The story begins when protagonist Kasane's wish comes true after he temporarily transfers from his high school in Sapporo to a Shounan sister school to start as a scholarship student in October.

For Kasane, who wished to go somewhere far away, a new step filled with expectations of reunions with close friends after seven years and new places caused a ripple, leading to a complicated love story.
v21964.description:
就学于札幌海陵高校的累，对这一成不变的生活已经厌倦到了极点。
“离开这里，前往未知的远方”，他一直这么盼望着。
在居于神奈川的童年玩伴兼挚友的莉一的建议之下，累下定决心参加了“特优生国内特别交流制度”(简称特交制度)
的审核，得以短期转入神奈川县姐妹高中·湘南海陵高中就读。
“终于迈出了……新的一步！”
湘南海边，冬日即将来临。
累感受着这座观光名城的独特氛围，和陌生的新同学们一起度过校园生活。
不仅如此，与莉一以及他的妹妹柚莉这两位挚友时隔7年再度重逢，让他的内心得到了治愈。
只是，当与柚莉相处之时，累无论如何都难免会想起莉一的另一个妹妹，这令他心如刀绞。
而那一天……
在寒风吹过的单轨电车月台，累再次遇到了自己“初恋的少女”。
他鼓起勇气，踏出了那一小步。
紧接着，日复一日的平常生活，开始崩坏。

aliases: カオスヘッド ノア
v22505.originalDescription:
"If you were God, and your delusions could become reality, what delusions would you wish for? A sensual world? A despotic society? Destructive sanctions? Or..."

Nishijou Takumi, a shut-in gamer and anime otaku, spends his days locked away in a shipping container while occasionally attending classes. In his place of residence, Shibuya, a bizarre string of serial killings is set in motion as he is dragged into the ordeal.

Chaos;Head NoAH is the Director's Cut release of Chaos;Head, adding 6 new routes, changes to the story, new CGs, and a revamped True Ending.
v22505.description:
西条拓巳(西條拓巳)是距离家里蹲只差一步的高中二年级学生。他断言“我对三次元没有兴趣”，在房间里被大量的美少女手办包围着生活。在他居住的涩谷，发生了被称为“New Generation的狂气（通称NewGen）”的连续猎奇杀人事件。该犯人至今仍未被捕，在网络上和电视上引起骚动。

某天他在聊天时，收到了来自名为『将军(将軍)』的谜之存在发来的、仿佛预言下一个NewGen事件般的猎奇图片。第二天，拓巳在放学回家的路上，遭遇了正如预言那般被杀害的、凄惨的事件现场。而在那具遗体前，浑身是血的少女——咲畑梨深正呆呆地站立着。

SINce Memories: Off the Starry Sky
v28683.originalDescription:
The story follows Mizumoto Jun'ya, a college student who works at his family’s general store Mizumoto-dou. The only thing in Jun'ya’s mind is the death of his older brother Takaya who passed away the year prior. He asks himself every day why he was the one that got to live while his brother passed away.
One day, Jun'ya meets a girl who tells him, “You should’ve been the one to die,” before vanishing.

Jun'ya ends up taking on the task of renovating a traditional Japanese manor belonging to the family of Houjou Chihaya, your typical flawless ojou-sama and who happens to be his childhood friend. Since he has no idea how to even start, he’ll need to get help from various people, and he’ll need to get out of his funk to do so. Jun'ya will also have to learn how to deal with all of the emotions and problems along the way. Will he succeed in renovating the old Houjou residence? And who was that girl who told him that he should’ve been the one to die? The fate surrounding the death of his brother will soon begin.
v28683.description:
在“万事屋”展开的，继承的故事
一边上大学一边帮忙打理家业万事屋“水元堂”的主人公“水元隼也(隼也)”。
他的心被对去年离开人世的哥哥“鷹也”的思念所束缚。
“为什么，活下来的是我呢？”
就在这样的一天，他遇到了一位少女。
“要是你死了就好了”
她对水元隼也这样说道，没有表明身份便消失了。
就在这样的他身边，从青梅竹马的“北条千飒(北條ちはや)”那里传来了北條家旧宅的翻新案件。
对水元隼也来说，这是他第一次负责的，大工作。
面对连续不断的新事物而感到迷茫的水元隼也。
要如何去面对这个一个人无法完成的课题呢？
通过工作遇到的各种各样的人们……
被各自的感情引发的诸多问题与纠葛所翻弄的水元隼也。
北條家旧宅的翻新会成功吗？
那个少女是谁？
与哥哥的死相关的因缘，现在，开始转动……。

v33904.originalDescription:
The Quintessential Quintuplets the Movie: Five Memories of My Time with You features a multi-ending story that changes depending on which sister you confess your feelings to. It is every The Quintessential Quintuplets fan’s dream situation: "Uesugi Fuutarou confesses his feelings to each of the five sisters." The player can craft Uesugi Fuutarou’s future with their own hands. There are 15 possible endings. Plus, there is a hidden route that can be unlocked after watching the ending for each of the five sisters, allowing you to enjoy the game many times over.

The game also features an original story set during a graduation trip to Okinawa. The player, Uesugi Fuutarou, goes sightseeing in Okinawa with the five sisters. It even features live-action sightseeing movies, so you can feel as if you are really on a trip to Okinawa with the five sisters. During the trip, Fuutarou strives to kiss the one he confesses to and secure a future for his long-distance relationship. Will he get his kiss? That depends on the player.
v33904.description:
舞台是冲绳！目的是接吻！
与五胞胎一起去的毕业旅行！

在高三最后的学园祭的后夜祭上，风太郎(風太郎)将自己的心意传达给了五胞胎中的一人，确认了彼此的感情。

那之后半年。
在迈向各自前程的春天到来之前，风太郎为了创造共同度过的回忆，向五胞胎们提议进行毕业旅行。

风太郎的心中，还有另一个目的。
优先考虑考试和毕业的风太郎，他的恋情进展至今一直很缓慢。认为这样下去不行的风太郎，决定在旅行中亲吻告白对象，将两人的羁绊变得确凿无疑，以便克服今后将要面临的远距离恋爱。

目的地是冲绳。
究竟，这会是一场怎样的毕业旅行呢？而风太郎的接吻能成功吗？

v38109.originalDescription:
Ajiro Shinpei returns to his hometown of Hitogashima after two years to attend the funeral of his childhood friend Kofune Ushio.

While reuniting with Ushio’s younger sister Mio and his best friend Sou, he learns about Ushio’s mysterious cause of death and the legend of the “shadow disease” passed down through the ages.

The legend of the shadows—it is said that anyone who sees a shadow with their appearance will die. Ushio was said to have seen that shadow.

The shadows of death haunt Shinpei and his friends. Eventually, the day of despair visits Hitogashima.

“How can we save our friends, protect the islanders, and avoid death?…”

Shinpei is forced to constantly think and make decisions in order to avoid despair, but every choice may only open a new door to despair.

But he cannot afford to stop thinking and making decisions. To overcome the three days of despair.

The third series of "Gotoubun Consumer Series" which serves as an alternative story to the plot of original manga series.

v47203.originalDescription:
Kusumegi Itsuki, a second-year student at Fujikawa High School attached to Keiyo University, has a fiancee whose face and name he does not know.
Because of her presence, Itsuki has never been interested in romance.

His 17th birthday, when he would find out who his fiancee was, was approaching in about a month.
One day, in order to hold a meeting to comfort a classmate who had lost her heart, Itsuki goes to Fujikawa's family restaurant "Russac'', but ends up getting into trouble with a part-time female clerk there.

The clerk, Sunomiya Sae, was a third-year senior at the same high school.
Although the way they met was the worst, Itsuki soon began to admire and respect Sae after seeing her mature demeanor.

His childhood friend Amaha Nene sees Itsuki and begins supporting his relationship with Sae with all her might.
The season is autumn. Itsuki's peaceful high school life is about to change little by little.
v47203.description:
「我觅见了生命中的唯一，而后——」

庆阳大学附属藤川高中的二年级学生久寿米木一葵有一位姓名未知、相貌不明的未婚妻。托她的福，一葵从未对恋爱产生过兴趣。
大约一个月后的17岁生日到来之时，一葵将知晓自己未婚妻的真实身份。
某天，一葵去藤川的罗萨克家庭餐厅参加了开导失恋同学的聚会，在店里和做兼职的女服务员发生了争执。那位名叫洲宫纱绘的服务员正好是一葵他们的的高三学姐。
虽然邂逅的过程糟糕透顶，一葵还是被纱绘的成熟举止所吸引，对她既憧憬又尊敬。
一葵的儿时玩伴天羽宁宁看到一葵这样，也开始全力支持他的感情。
——这个秋天，一葵那曾经一成不变的高中生活逐渐发生了变化。

v51838.originalDescription:
“I CAN GIVE YOU A SMILE THAT WILL LAST FOREVER!”

Junior high school student Eisuke Sasaki has been found dead in a chilling fashion, with a smiley-faced paper bag over his head.
This unsettling visage bears a striking resemblance to a recurring clue in a string of unsolved murders from 18 years ago – as well as the urban legend Emio, aka the Smiling Man, a serial killer said to grant his victims “a smile that will last forever”.
Does the Smiling Man really exist…or is a new culprit continuing on his legacy?
As a member of the Utsugi Detective Agency, you’ve been tasked with investigating the events that led to Eisuke Sasaki’s death. Along the way, scrutinise the clues and testimonies you gather for potential connections to the gruesome events of the past.
v51838.description:
“Famicom侦探俱乐部”系列的最新作《Famicom侦探俱乐部 笑脸男》已决定于8月29日（周四）发售。这是继在Famicom Disk System上发售的《消失的继承人》《站在身后的少女》之后，时隔35年的系列完全新作。

围绕成为标题的都市传说“笑脸男”以及与其极其相似的杀人事件，空木侦探事务所将挑战解决案件。

v42.originalDescription:
Day of Love is about Haruki, the main character, that knew about a girl named Maho when he was young, but forgot about her when he was older, which had made her angry when she asked him years later when he's in high school. So to get back at him for not remembering, she dresses up as a guy and lives in the same dorm as him using the alias Mao.

(from Wikipedia)
v42.description: 东条春树（主人公）最近一直睡眠不足，在学校也总是打瞌睡。为什么睡眠不足呢？那是因为一周前，他在宿舍后面的公园午睡时，遇到了一个陌生少女。那个女孩亲昵地搭话说，春树是她憧憬的存在，一直很想见他。然而，春树却想不起她是谁，女孩见状很不高兴，生气地留下一个响亮的耳光便离去了。自那以后，他便日日想着她，辗转难眠。就在某天，春树的班里来了一位转学生。那是个肤色白得透亮、看似柔弱纤细、像女孩子一样的男学生。名字叫柊真生，也很女性化。虽然脑海中不禁浮现出这样的印象，但春树又开始想起前几天遇到的那个少女……

v1280.originalDescription: You are a teenage boy traveling to find the angel that stopped you from aging. You don't remember it very well since it was what, ten years, twenty years ago? Maybe even longer. Other than the clothes on your back, you carry a magical, musical instrument and the feather of the angel you are searching for. One day, you come across a girl. This girl is very different. She can't talk and has different colored eyes. Her left eye is dark blue and her right eye is fire red. This is how the game begins.
v1280.description: 为了寻找失去的“某物”而漫无目的地持续旅行的音乐家克拉维斯(クラビス)，某时来到了“天使之街丰缇尤”，在那里遇到了唱歌的不可思议少女拉斯蒂(ラスティ)。于是，仿佛在呼应她的歌声一般，克拉维斯所持有的一片白色羽毛散发出淡淡的光芒。就这样，被少女所吸引的克拉维斯决定在丰缇尤停留。

v2160.title: 痴漢者トーマスII
v2160.originalDescription: Unable to control his lecherous ways, Touma Sujio was captured and deported back to Japan after committing a series of widely publicized sexual offenses. Set to serve time in prison, he was rescued by the world infamous Thomas: a molester so skilled, no woman could resist him after a mere single encounter. But for what ends, no one - not even Sujio himself - can say for sure.
v2160.description:
《痴汉者托马斯》数年后的世界……美国西部，曾经荒凉的沙漠上，伫立着一个男人。
男人的名字叫斗马筋雄。原本认定牛仔为自己生存之道的筋雄，却因签证失效后的非法滞留被发现，无奈地被○制遣返回日本。
牛仔之路被断绝，每天走投无路地在街头徘徊……某天，在电车上目睹了痴汉的筋雄，想要上前阻止，反而被错当成了痴汉。

就在以为即将被捕的刹那，拯救了筋雄的男人正是初代托马斯。从初代那里听闻了“痴汉道”的筋雄，对那份热切的想法产生了共鸣。他暗下决心，不再作为牛仔去追逐牛群，而是迈向追逐女人们的“痴汉道”。

―――于是，第二代托马斯在此诞生！！―――

v2632.title: 尸体派对：血之复盖 - 无止境的恐惧
v2632.original: コープスパーティー ブラッドカバー
aliases: 尸体派对：血之复盖 - 无止境的恐惧
コープスパーティー ブラッドカバー
v2632.originalDescription:
A group of high school students stayed after school to tell ghost stories. After a good scare one of them revealed that she is going to transfer school, everyone got sad but then another one told them there's a spell to make them always remember each other. Then everyone agreed to do it, each person hold a part of human-shaped paper and to pull it at the same time. One, Two, Three! They pulled it together and about to went home but soon after something like earthquake happened and all blacked out. 

When they woke up they found that some of them are missing but that's not all, the school became a ruin and they couldn't get out. Then they noticed that they are not even in the same school anymore and there is something lurking in the dark school not wanting them to leave...
v2632.description:
在某个下雨的夜晚，为了准备学园祭而留在学校的如月学园2年级学生：持田哲志、中岛直美、岸沼良树三人，在教室里由班长筱崎步美向他们讲述着流传在学校中的校园怪谈。
      怪谈结束的一瞬间，教室突然停电，随后不知何处传来了令人毛骨悚然的声音伴随管风琴的声音。哲志同前来送伞的妹妹由香一同确认风琴声从何而来时，强烈的光芒吞噬了众人，再度恢复意识时已身处陌生的破烂校舍里。哲志等人为了回到原来的世界而展开行动，将会有一系列的奇异现象等待着他们......。

      1996年4月22日祁答院慎（KENIXSOFT名义）通过Dante98为PC98平台制作的初代《尸体派对》，其中大量内容为日后的Team GrisGris制作的同人版、Team GrisGris × 5pb. 的商业版创下了基础。
      但本作的剧情、以及一些设定与系列后续作品并不联通。本作与后续作品的WRONG END设定不同、本作的角色死亡后不会结束游戏，角色的死亡数以及死亡对象会决定本作的结局。

日后的BC / BR、BS、BD、2U均或多或少与本作的理念存在一定的关系。

v3061.title: 木漏れ日の並木道
v3061.originalDescription: You play as Kouichi, who lost his wife years ago. The game places you in a love story involving six girls.
v3061.description:
失去了最爱的妻子的主人公。数年的岁月流逝，但他依然持续思念着亡妻，他的心中始终存在着某种无法填补的空白。

“永恒的爱真的存在吗？”

如果是那样，被留下的人的心意，该怎么办才好呢？
难道必须永远追寻着爱人的幻影吗？
对于这种无形的答案，围绕在主人公身边的人们的“温柔”与“心意”会替他找到。

《树隙阳光的林荫道》就是这样一个温暖人心的纯粹的爱情故事。

v3533.title: 少年達の病棟
v3533.originalDescription:
Ayase Reiji, used to be his high school's soccer champ. However, he made the choice to give up soccer when he went into his sophomore year of university. On the day he finally comes to terms with himself over his reasons for quitting the sport and decides that he should pursue it again, he gets in an accident on his motorbike.

The accident was bad, and Reiji was rushed to an urgent operation, and was fortunate enough to come through the operation all right. However, he will still have to spend a while in the hospital recuperating from his injuries, with the knowledge that now that he had finally decided to return to soccer, his life as a soccer player is now over.

Now Reiji passes his days in recuperation at the hospital, meeting five other boys that are in the same hospital ward, each with their own troubles. Can perhaps Reiji build up a relationship with one of these boys, and begin a new take on life?
v3533.description:
虽是樱花盛开的时节，却下着冰冷的雨
我记得自己留下了非常阴暗的印象

突如其来的摩托车事故……紧急手术……　
考虑到事故的严重程度　
只受了这种程度的伤就了事
只能说是幸运

“术后的恢复也很良好。再过不久就能出院了，不过……”

过日常生活的话没有问题
但是　就在想要再次追逐梦想的当口
作为足球运动员的生命
被完全断送了

外面已是新绿飘香的季节
但就像那场雨留下的印象一样，无法放晴的心……
连医院古旧的墙壁都使郁屈增加

我只是毫无目的地
重复着单调的日子而已

直到与他相遇


在入住八杜総合病院的主人公面前
出现的5名少年们
他们也各自怀抱着不同的思念与烦恼
度过每一天

少年们与主人公交汇的短暂时间
两人培育的关系究竟会变成什么样呢？
你会来帮助我吗？ 
本游戏是指令选择式恋爱冒险游戏。
玩家能采取的行动是一天上午、下午两次，
选择移动到医院内的何处，
以及如何回答在移动目的地发生的事件的选项。
从游戏开始后的两周为一次游玩的时间限制。
到这个时候为止，根据对少年们采取的行动如何，
将决定少年们与您能迎来怎样的结局。
如果对他们的爱不够的话，说不定，
也有可能被其他的什么人夺走……。

The player controls Kiryuu Wataru, a young fourth year university student in the faculty of engineering and architecture who is into mystery novels. To solve this case he will have the help of Nishinosono Moe (a first grader girl in the University Department of Architecture & Engineering) and Saikawa Souhei (University Associate Professor, Faculty of Engineering, Architecture) and other characters.

v5230.description:
20XX年。
少子化问题无法遏制，政府制定并决定施行“少子化对策法案”。
那是一项为了让没有孩子的夫妇能够安心生育抚养孩子的补助制度。
制度使用者会被提供住所及生活费的一部分等，但会产生努力生育孩子的义务。

然后，为了确认这一点，政府决定派遣指导员。
那不是人类，而是特别开发的“机器人”。
这是为了顾及隐私，不让私情感情介入其中。

某几对夫妇，将利用这项制度住进政府准备的公寓里。
然而，到来的“机器人”是 缺陷品。
而且，因为还有并非单纯新婚夫妇的住户，那项“指导”变成了不得了的事……。

v10142.title: めい・king
v10142.originalDescription:
Cain Asbell was an unremarkable guy until one of his stray sheep led him into a cave with a trapped fairy named Elise. In a blink of an eye Cain goes from pauper to Lord when Elise helps him rescue the Princess Charlotte. There's just one hitch. Cain has to make his land the most prosperous in the country within 5 years. Should he fail, he'll lose everything and return to being another lowly shepherd. But if he manages to succeed, Cain will gain the Princess Charlotte's hand in marriage!

Sound easy? Not if everyone in your kingdom is out to take advantage of your young age. Between slavers and bandits it's amazing that Cain is still alive. But being a Lord isn't all bad - he has the right to choose any woman he wants... Tsubaki, who doesn't fully appreciate that her body has a will of its own, Tia, who will do anything for the man that saved her, and Chiffon, whose cold heart has yet to feel real passion...
v10142.description:
法兰贝珠王国的牧羊人·凯恩（主人公／可更改名字），
有一天，在追赶小羊时误入的洞穴里，偶然将100年前
被邪恶的魔法师领主封印的法兰贝珠的守护精灵解放了出来。
“作为谢礼，就让你当这片土地的领主吧——”精灵说道。
凯恩听从她的话，来到了深山里的伐木小屋，
在那里遇到了被山贼俘虏的法兰贝珠公主·夏洛特（シャルロット），
并获得了救出她的荣誉。
然后，机缘巧合之下，作为夏洛特的准新郎，
他被授予了男爵的爵位与领地，
开始与其他准新郎们竞争各自领地的发展……。

v10877.title: 寝取られの学園 ～輪廻るサクリファイス～
v10877.original: 寝取られの学園 ～輪廻るサクリファイス～
aliases: 寝取られの学園 ～輪廻るサクリファイス～
寝取られの学園　～輪廻（まわ）るサクリファイス～
寝取学园～轮回的赎愆祭～
寢取學園～輪迴的贖愆祭～
v10877.originalDescription:
Rokudo is a school city that gathers all the necessary facilities on one island, with Rokudo Academy at its center.
There is no cell phone reception and no internet. Everyone lives in dormitories provided by Rokudo.
While it feels like it's been left behind by modern times, it has a laid-back atmosphere that you won't find in the city. However, it's a slightly unusual island with various rules.

Our protagonist, Hiiragi Seiichi, is a male student who transfers to the school at the invitation of the school principal.
He transfers at the busy time, one week before the cultural festival, the Rokudo Festival.
Classes, clubs, and affiliations are preparing for the festival.
Amidst all this, Seiichi interacts with various girls and deepens his friendship with them.
However, on the day of the festival, a murder occurs.
Seiichi's classmate is killed, and the culprit has yet to be found.
Several "potential suspects," including Seiichi, are gathered. Potential suspects are people who are believed to be involved in the murders for various reasons, such as motive and alibi.
In front of this assembled group of potential suspects, the school principal explains the case.
"If you weren't involved in the murder, please cooperate. But what would happen if you were the 'real suspect'? You don't want to think about it, do you?"

A closed, isolated island, with no way to escape, potential suspects and everyone else.
If their interests align, they can cooperate. But that doesn't necessarily mean they have to be on equal footing.
Testifying to alibis, denying motives. Potential suspects are hungry for "innocence."
So they keep quiet to avoid suspicion. They have no choice but to agree to unfavorable negotiations in order to prove their innocence.
v10877.description:
发生在孤岛的杀人事件。以此为契机制裂的人际关系——

以六道学园为中心，将一座岛上所需设施集中起来的学园都市·六道。\
岛内所有的设施都是六道学园的相关设施，岛屿就这样作为学园都市发挥着机能。\
手机打不通，网络也不能用。生活在这里的人都在六道准备的宿舍里生活。\
那里虽然给人一种被现代抛弃的感觉，却有着都市所没有的悠闲氛围的空间。只是，这是一个存在各种规则、稍微有些奇怪的岛屿。\
\
主人公·柊诚一(柊誠一)是受校长邀请而转学来到这里的男学生。\
他转学过来时，正值距离名为“六道祭”的文化祭还有一周的忙碌时期。\
祭典的准备工作按班级、社团、所属等分别进行。\
在此期间，诚一与各种各样的女孩产生交集，加深了关系。\
**但是，在六道祭当天发生了杀人事件。**\
诚一他们的同学被杀，据说那个○人至今仍未找到。\
包含诚一在内的数名“嫌疑人候补”被聚集起来。嫌疑人候补是因为动机、不在场证明……等各种情况，而被认为是杀人事件○人的人物们。\
在聚集起来的嫌疑人候补们面前，校长陈述了关于事件的事。\
**“如果没有参与杀害，请协助我们。如果被当成‘真正的嫌疑人’，会怎么样……不想去想吧？”**\
\
封闭的孤岛，不可能逃跑的○人，嫌疑人候补以及其他的人们。\
利害一致就能互相合作。但是，那未必需要对等。\
不在场证明的证言，动机的否定。嫌疑人候补们渴望着“清白”。\
所以嫌疑人候补为了不被怀疑而闭口不言。为了证明清白，除了在不利谈判中点头之外别无他法。\
\
**黑暗、昏暗、暗黑……人际关系开始了。**

v11517.title: 见习天使
v11517.originalDescription:
Tentama tells the story of an angel in training that to become a full angel. He has to visit Hayasegawa Shiina and his schoolmates and helps him to be happy, and to do that he has to find a girlfriend in this adventure dating interactive game.

In this game, Kid introduced a very interesting system, where you can see the Tentama world from different characters' perspective and their thoughts/feelings at the moment. The player will see most of the time the world from Hayasegawa Shiina perspective, and the angels just tell him if the girls like him or not.

The main female character of the game is Enoki Rikako, a first year highschool student that goes to the same highschool as Shiina. She hates ghosts.

If the player wins Rikako-chan's heart, he will unlock an omake scenario for Eri-chan that will tell Eri-chan's side of the story.
v11517.description:
见习天使讲述了一名见习天使为了成为正式天使的故事。在这款冒险恋爱互动游戏中，他必须去拜访早瀬川 椎名(Hayasegawa Shiina)和他的同学，帮助他获得幸福，而要做到这一点，他必须找到一个女朋友。

在这款游戏中，Kid引入了一个非常有趣的系统，你可以从不同角色的视角以及他们当下的想法/感受来观察见习天使的世界。玩家大部分时间将从早瀬川 椎名的视角观察这个世界，而天使们只会告诉他女孩们是否喜欢他。

游戏的女主角是榎 理香子(Enoki Rikako)，她是一名和椎名就读同一所高中的高一学生。她讨厌鬼。

如果玩家赢得了理香子酱的心，他将解锁一个关于絵理(Eri)酱的附赠剧本，讲述絵理酱视角的故事。

v15873.title: 催眠母
v15873.originalDescription:
The main character Souichi Chiba used to live with his father in a motherless household but since his father passed away two years ago he's come to live alone. His mother died when he was born and now he's left without any relatives. Because of this he has a powerful longing for someone to call a mother. Even though he has no mother, he's come down with a serious mother complex.

Minami Koube, his doctor and long time confidant, once said to him, "If you want a mom that much, there is an interesting way, you know?". He went along with her suggestion and began working toward getting a mother using the technique of hypnotism...
v15873.description:
■□■故事■□■
主人公千葉草一（ちば・そういち）原本是单亲父子家庭，
两年前父亲去世后便一直独自生活。
母亲在生下主人公时便已去世，如今已是孑然一身。
因为这种境遇，他对母亲这一存在抱有强烈的憧憬，
明明没有母亲，却患有重度恋母情结。
某天，平时作为良好倾诉对象的保健医神户南(神戸 みなみ)对他说，
“既然你这么憧憬母亲，那有个有趣的方法哦？”
他听后便顺从了她的邀请，
决定使用催○术来获取母亲……
■□■登场角色■□■
●八幡 久美子　（CV：白井綾乃）
是主人公就读学园的理事长，也是已故母亲的堂姐妹。
虽是亲戚，也是成为孑然一身的主人公的“监护人”，但她并没有将他接到自己身边抚养，
而是要求他“自己的事情尽量自己做”以培养自立。
从其立场来看，她有着拼命工作的女强人氛围，是让人感觉不太像母亲的女性，
但因为母亲的堂姐妹，主人公认为她是血缘上最亲近的女性，于是决定将她作为目标施展催○术。
●倉敷 智子　（CV：かわしまりの）
班级的班主任女教师，是个非常死板的女人。
对待学生们，总是以严厉的态度进行训斥。
但她并非冷酷的性格，只是非常认真而已，
内心里正为想要拉近与学生们的距离而苦恼。
主人公看着她发牢骚、训斥的样子，觉得那才是“像母亲的态度”，
于是决定将她作为目标。
●神户南　（CV：一色ヒカル）
养护教员的保健老师，是主人公良好的倾诉对象。
是向主人公建议使用催○术来获取母亲的始作俑者。
是个平易近人又讨人喜欢，能像朋友一样对待他的女性。
相比母亲更像是姐姐的感觉，但因为是个在一起很开心的人，
主人公开始觉得，把这个人当作母亲或许是最好的，
于是决定对她本人尝试催○术。
●千葉 草一
本作的主人公。
成绩和长相都极其普通的男学生，但有着重度恋母情结。
顺从保健医神户南的邀请，决定使用催○术来获取理想的母亲。
就这样，他周围的年长女性便成了目标……

v13.title: 无限轮回的时光
aliases: リメンバーイレブン ジ・エイジ・オブ・インフィニティ
v13.originalDescription:
Fuyukawa Kokoro, a third-year sociology major, boards a plane bound for Hokkaido to meet a research subject in the Specified Psychiatric Hospital for Isolation and Aegis, or SPHIA. For unknown reasons, her plane crashes in the mountains in the middle of a snowstorm. Of the 31 passengers, only she, Kusuda Yuni, Yomogi Seiji, and Mayuzumi Lin survive unharmed. Unable to establish communication with the outside world due to the fierce snowstorm, the four decide to take shelter in an empty cabin and wait until the storm passes.

Yuukidou Satoru falls from the SPHIA clock tower. He later awakens with some memory loss and the realization that someone is out to kill him. Unable to leave the SPHIA facility due to a snowstorm, Satoru's only chance at living is to find that person among the three other residents (or perhaps the hidden culprit) of SPHIA.

Shortly after, Kokoro and Satoru realize that they are somehow exchanging bodies and Yuni appears to be at both of their locations...
v13.description:
冬川心是一名社会学专业三年级学生，她登上一架飞往北海道的飞机，去见 Specified Psychiatric Hospital for Isolation and Aegis，即 SPHIA 的一名研究对象。出于未知原因，她的飞机在暴风雪中坠毁于山区。在31名乘客中，只有她、楠田悠尼、黄泉木圣司和黛铃安然无恙地幸存下来。由于猛烈的暴风雪无法与外界建立联系，四人决定在一个空的小屋里避难，等待暴风雪过去。

优希堂悟从 SPHIA 的钟楼上坠落。他后来醒来时失去了部分记忆，并意识到有人想要杀他。由于暴风雪无法离开 SPHIA 设施，悟唯一的生存机会就是在 SPHIA 的其他三名居民（或者可能是隐藏的真凶）中找出那个人。

不久之后，心和悟意识到他们不知为何在互换身体，而悠尼似乎同时出现在他们两人的所在地……

v27.title: 散碎的原色
v27.originalDescription: Released from the hospital after an accident, Junichi struggles to reclaim his lost memories as he returns to school, only to be told that his girlfriend Hikari has gone missing. Now Junichi must piece together his fragmented memories as he faces everything from a forgotten promise with a childhood friend, to a mysterious shadow that seems to target his friends, in order to solve the mystery behind Hikari's disappearance.
v27.description:
Separate Hearts 是原KID公司于2006年2月23日发售的一款悬疑/恋爱文字AVG游戏。本作品也是KID公司有生之年使用代表自身最高品质的品牌SDR Project发售的最后一款游戏。 　　
本作的剧本由业界知名的悬疑剧本家西之宫勇希和SDR Project的若林健协力完成。本作的剧本毫无疑问是亮点多多，无论是宏观的设计还是细微的刻画，都让人找回了KID早期小品型游戏剧本的风格。本作的音乐依然是由KID的王牌音乐人阿保刚负责，阿保刚在这一作的发挥十分的出色，几乎每首曲
子都能震撼人心，使本作的音乐成为重要的加分项目。本作的制作人/制作总监由SDR Project的领导者市川和弘一人担当。主题歌由志仓千代丸打造，由Infinity系列主题歌的演唱者KAORI演唱。声优方面亦有小清水亚美和广桥凉等知名声优出演主角。可以很确定的说，本作的整体表现并没有给SDR Project的金字招牌抹黑。 　　
非常值得一提的是，本作的制作人在游戏中表达了很多深层的、想要传达给KID玩家们的信息。本作剧本中非常明显的表达了对KID三款远古游戏的致敬之情。它们是Memories Off、Never7-the end of infinity-和Close to。这三款游戏的风格、设定甚至部分内容都出现在了本作当中。不但让KID的老玩家重温了三款作品的风格，也与本作的主题一样，暗示了三款游戏背后的制作人已经各奔东西，导致KID灵魂散碎的悲伤之情。而唯一留下的市川和弘在本作设计方面的优秀表现，让人对他的实力刮目相看。

v60.title: 藍より青し
v60.originalDescription:
The game comes with two different story segments, South Island and Winter Lake.

South Island Edition 
During winter vacation, Tina sees a TV program about the balmy southern islands and says that she wants to go to the ocean. Aoi proposes that they go visit her villa in the southern islands.

They immediately board a cruise ship to make the journey to the island as a group. However, on the way the weather turns nasty and the ship capsizes. Miyabi calls for help, but the radio is broken and proves of no use. They are left wondering if a rescue team will come looking for them.

Winter Lake Edition 
During winter vacation, Tina sees a TV program about the warm southern islands and says that she wants to go to the ocean again. Kaoru points out that they just been to the ocean. With perfect timing, Mayu shows up to invite them to her vacation home for the holidays.
v60.description:
本游戏包含两个不同的故事篇章，南之岛与冬日湖畔。

南之岛篇
寒假期间，蒂娜·福斯特看了一个关于温暖南之岛的电视节目，说她想去海边。桜庭 葵提议大家去她在南之岛的别墅玩。

他们立刻登上一艘游轮，一行人前往该岛。然而，途中天气变坏，游轮倾覆了。神楽崎 雅呼叫求救，但无线电坏了，毫无用处。他们只能想着救援队是否会来寻找他们。

冬日湖畔篇
寒假期间，蒂娜·福斯特看了一个关于温暖南之岛的电视节目，说她又想去海边了。花菱 薫指出他们刚去过海边。就在这时，美幸 繭出现并邀请他们去她的度假别墅度假。

Homura Motoki was walking down the street one day with his girlfriend Yuuna  when they were struck by a car. When he woke up in the hospital, he realized something incredible had happened. v247.title: 跳跃的时空 12RIVEN
v247.originalDescription:
May 20th 2012, 11:05. Renmaru Miyabidou receives a mysterious email:
 "Today at noon—a lone girl will leave this world."
 "Killed—at the top floor of Integral..."
 "The girl's name is Myuu... I'm sure you're familiar with that name."
 "Remember the promise—the vow—you made that day... Renmaru."


Public Safety police officer Narumi Mishima receives an email from her friend and coworker:
 "Soon, a girl is going to have her life stolen from her."
 "Narumi-senpai, please. Protect her. Please protect Myuu."
 "To stop their plan—the Second Eclipse Project—her existence is a necessity."


The two of them rush to the abandoned Integral hotel building, and what they encounter is beyond belief: a group of people able to use Ψ, a strange special ability.
v247.description:
2012年5月20日，11:05。雅堂炼丸收到一封神秘邮件：
“今天中午——一个孤独的女孩将离开这个世界。”
“被杀——在Integral的顶层……”
“女孩的名字是Myuu……我相信你对那个名字很熟悉。”
“记住那天你许下的承诺——誓言……Renmaru。”

公安警察三岛鸣海收到来自朋友兼同事的邮件：
“很快，一个女孩的生命将被夺走。”
“Narumi前辈，拜托了。保护她。请保护Myuu。”
“为了阻止他们的计划——Second Eclipse Project——她的存在是必要的。”

两人赶往废弃的Integral酒店大楼，他们遇到的事情令人难以置信：一群能够使用Ψ，一种奇怪的特殊能力的人。

v248.originalDescription: You play as Makoto, a student who never attends the lectures at the school. As a punishment, you have to attend an extra seminar on an island with other classmates. However, when you arrive on the island, strange things start happening. A girl is found dead on April 6th, with a small bell in her hand. Immediately after that, you found yourself in the bed and see the date - April 1st! Was the vision of the girl just a dream, or do you possess a power to predict events? This is what you will have to find out, as a series of strange deaths make your seminar much more suspenseful than you have thought.
v248.description:
本作是2000年发售至今仍然大受好评的「infinity」系列的第一作。

“为永恒的悲伤划下句点──”

主角石原诚从一场噩梦中惊醒。
在梦中，有一名少女在他眼前悲惨的死亡。
为了参加大学的研究会诚来到位于南方的小岛。原本平稳愉快的合宿生活，应该在一片祥和中顺利结束……
然而，命运的齿轮在4月6日开始转动。
那一天，内心的不安化作绝望，预感演变成惨剧。
永远无法迎来第七日的清晨，而悲剧仍不断重演。
诚只能依赖残存的记忆，努力打破僵局，而当他成功避免悲剧时，一切的真相也将随之揭晓。

本作于2000年3月23日在PS上以「infinity」的名称初次登场。
但「infinity」中存在着以『时空转换』为首的未解谜团。
因此，本作从PS版的玩家那里，听取了许多期盼那个神秘破解的意见。
并于2000年11月23日在Neo Geo Pocket Color平台上推出了「INFINITY cure.」，追加增补破解部分的剧本，起到了故事的『完结篇』的作用。（还有，在NGP版上面追加的剧本里面，在高潮部分过后，会安排完全不同的情节。）
2000年12月21日于DC上，本作首次以「Never7 -the end of infinity-」的名称发行了完全版。

v855.title: 水の旋律
v855.originalDescription:
Shiraishi Hina, a second-year schoolgirl, one day finds strange incidents happening to her, from being pushed down the stairs to having wild dogs attack her. At night, a mysterious elderly woman speaks to her in her dreams.
Hina soon finds herself caught in a war between two supernatural human races.
v855.description:
长生不老，青春永驻，是祝福？亦或是诅咒？吃了人鱼肉可以长生不老的传说，相信许多玩家都有听过，本游戏直接引用此传说的起源 －误食人鱼肉而长生达八百年的八百比丘尼故事，描述其后代一谣与九艘因为继承的能力差距过大，引起纷争，长年下来，终于各自演变成两个族群，争斗不休。

　　日本几乎各地都有八百比丘尼传说的故事或遗迹，其中保存最多的，就是本游戏女主角 白石阳菜所出生的地方 －尚和町。阳菜在六岁的夏天因为父亲调职必须搬家离开，小孩子不舍的心性使她嚎啕大哭，她当时的玩伴为了安慰她，咬破两人的手指，彼此相合，笑着说只要有这样，两人不管距离多远，最后都能再次相会，永远在一起。

　　随着时间经过，长大的阳菜对于这个小男孩是谁，外貌名字等等，全部都忘记了。暌违十年，阳菜因为不愿跟着父亲再次调职，而回到尚和町，进入附有宿舍的尚和高中，她会在这里遇上什么样的人事物，又是否能与过去的男孩重逢呢？

v1152.title: 告别回忆
v1152.originalDescription: It's a surprisingly bittersweet tale about a guy named Tomoya Mikami who actually was dating the girl of his dreams, Ayaka Hizuki, for a long time...only to have her die tragically a good while before the game starts. The game even begins with Tomoya having a flashback about Ayaka whilst walking to the train station to get to school. On the train, as usual, is Yue Imasaka - a close friend of Tomoya and Ayaka who pretty much grew up with them. The gist of the story is that Tomoya feels that he's spent enough time grieving over the loss of Ayaka and is ready to try his hand at love again and hopefully find another wonderful girl to make beautiful memories with.
v1152.description:
主人公三上智也是澄空高校的二年级学生。他的父亲在外地工作，母亲也在外地陪伴父亲。虽然他和青梅竹马的今坂唯笑认识已经超过了10年，不过并没有朋友以上的关系。

智也有有着令人心酸的过去。他的另外一个青梅竹马，也是对他来说无法替代的女友桧月彩花因为事故死了。智也没有从她死后到自己恢复正常那段时间的记忆。即使已经过去了3年，只要一想到深爱着彩花的死，智也的意识也会变得模糊。

在智也身边出现了明朗而善于交际的转校生音羽薰(音羽かおる)；在她之前一个月转入的，和他人保持距离的双海诗音；在电车上认识的彩花的表妹，伊吹水面(伊吹みなも)；代替腰痛休息的母亲打理小卖部的雾岛小夜美；还有两个青梅竹马……以期中考试为契机，这些女生中的一个在智也心中的地位逐渐变得重要起来。

v1171.originalDescription:
Inori was looking forward to go to the annual Ashikajima Fireworks Display with Isshu this summer. They had made a promise to always go to the fireworks festival together, since that was the place that they orginally became a couple. But Isshu said he wouldn't able to go because of his part time job. That day would fall on their two year anniversary. Inori went alone to their memorable place, the church... and she began to recall the previous two years.

Fourth game in the Memories Off series (subtitled "Kakeganai Omoi wo Norikoete"). It takes place one year and a half after Omoide ni Kawaru Kimi ~Memories Off~ (Omoide ni Kawaru Kimi ~Memories Off~)
v1171.description: 时间：不仅是每对恋人都期待的“情人节”，而且是高中毕业前最后一次情人节； 地点：不仅是每对恋人都不会忘记的告白的场景，而且提出告白的是女方。浜咲学园三年级的男主角“鹭泽一蹴”，在情人节这一天，怀抱着喜滋滋的心情，来到和女朋友“陵祈”决定交往的海岸边旧教堂，和所有恋爱中的男性一样，他期待着从女朋友手里接过来的巧克力。但是，一切是那么地突然，看似平静无波的海面，忽然掀起了海浪，他的手里，确实收到陵祈给的巧克力，但是他的耳里，却也同时收到陵祈的分手要求，“从一开始我就不喜欢你”。错愕、茫然的一蹴，在不知所以的情况下，呆楞地看着陵祈离去，分手的原因到底是什么？要厚脸皮地挽回？还是就此作罢？矛盾的思绪在心里纠结，一蹴的未来，就交由玩家决定了....

v1173.title: 秋之回忆：从今以后～AGAIN
aliases: 秋之回憶4 ～從今以後～ again
秋之回忆～从今以后 again～
v1173.originalDescription:
This is a sequel to 2004's Memories Off ~Sorekara~. It contains scenarios that focus on the days following the events of the original, featuring the heroines Inori Misasagi, Miyabi Fujiwara and Karin Hanamatsuri.

(Source: GameSpy)
v1173.description:
讲述的是好评如潮的"Memories Off～从今往后～"之后的三篇故事。以「两人的时光」为主题，各个故事完全独自展开。请务必期待这次秋之回忆～从今往后～的续章。 
～After episode - INORI～『Feeling Affection』 
一蹴和陵 祈(陵 いのり)战胜了过去，过着幸福的日子。 
为了升学而努力的同时，两人一起度过的时间也越来越多。 
某天一蹴得知，那个能称为是他们俩的起点的孤儿院即将倒闭。 
～After episode - MIYABI～『所追求的高雅』 
毕业典礼后，两人私奔逃离。 
前往情趣盎然的小镇——初濑，投奔雅的亲戚。 
雅一边在设计作坊里学习，一边和一蹴展开了新生活。 
～After episode - KARIN～『birthday☆splash』 
作为模特，果凛过着忙碌的每一天，但做到了恋爱工作两不误。 
一蹴每天都在苦恼，不知自己能为她做些什么。 
遗憾的是，对于程度非同一般的大小姐果凛来说，一蹴能为她做到的事情很少。 
祈篇故事《Feeling Affecion》 
手牵手，共度备考生活 
      破镜重圆之后，一蹴和祈这对白痴情侣的热恋程度只是有增无减。为了高考进行备考的二人，复习的同时也不忘经常去购物，游泳之类，享受着约会的快乐。某次约会归途中，二人顺便去往曾经收养过一蹴的孤儿院“盛夏的儿童乐园”。一蹴看见孤儿院陈旧的外貌、惨淡的经营现状后，觉得自己该为它做些什么。 
本篇中不曾有过的祈的魅力，绝不背叛祈的粉丝们的期待！ 
      “说起本篇中的祈，在我以前的印象里，片头动画后时不时出现的分手场面和她脸上出现悲伤、难受表情的次数可真多啊。这次则有了一百八十度的转变……她始终带着笑容，与一蹴快乐地恋爱着。而且性格十分积极。老实说，最初我也很困惑，费了老鼻子劲呢。（笑）虽然制作人员叫我演得‘甜蜜’些，可我脑子里总是记得以前的祈，没办法开朗起来呢。原本祈又不是那种咋咋呼呼的性格，感情的起伏也不怎么激烈，所以度的把握让我很头疼。 
      总体来说这是一个温馨的故事，卿卿我我的场面很多，特别希望大家看的是她和一蹴在游泳池闹腾的那一段。因为以前的祈带给人一种不和谐感，所以我觉得那段会让人吓一跳哦。然后，当一蹴面临孤儿院问题时，祈有条不紊地提供帮助的那一段也请一定要看。安慰一蹴，和他一起谈论梦想的祈，应该能让大家感受到暖意。 
      玩过《秋之回忆～从今以后 again～》后心里觉得暖暖的，本篇里所不存在的祈的魅力，这次表现得淋漓尽致。一定不会背叛喜欢祈的玩家的期待的～（笑）敬请期待！！” 
雅篇故事《所追求的高雅》 
在情趣盎然的城市里 度过的充实岁月 
      雅被森严的家庭束缚着。一蹴为救雅，拉着她的手从高中毕业典礼中逃离。二人一直逃至平民区，私奔投靠在雅的叔母门下。雅成为经营着日式服装作坊的叔母的弟子，开始学习一直就想学习的和服设计。一蹴一边在宾馆打工，一边在雅的身旁支持着她。之后，二人过着繁忙但充满了自由与爱的日子，每天都过得很开心…… 
眼下大受欢迎的是羞答答的类型！？ 
陶醉在雅的改变中吧！ 
      “本篇时，雅真的很厉害呢。‘再凶一些，再凶一些，别把一蹴当人看好了……’连这种指示都出现了。（笑）那样的雅这回会做咖喱了，于是我心里觉得暖暖的。与其说是和之前不一样，倒不如说是她原本的温柔被引发出来了，成了一位更加优秀的女性。而且，这次也不仅仅是恋爱，还对雅在伯母的门下学习的故事有所交代，这真是太好了。不只是沉溺在恋爱里，还找到了想做的事，我觉得她的前途有希望。我个人觉得，只是沉溺在恋爱里不行，只是一味地去做想做的事情也不行。我想，同时考虑两方面才是可取的。在这一点上，雅在最后很好地交出了一份我能接受的答案～ 
      如果要我举出配音时印象深刻的台词的话……果然还是 ‘愚蠢的家伙’了（笑）。在亲密的场面最后，一边害羞一边说话很是可爱哟。如果是熟悉以前的雅的人，应该会一下子喘不上气吧？人竟会有如此大的变化，我希望你们能看到雅这种程度上的改变。其他女孩子的故事当然要玩，但因为眼下大受欢迎的是羞答答的类型，那就再来一个吧（笑），也请好好玩一下雅的故事哟” 
果凛篇 《Birthday☆splash》 
想出最棒的礼物吧！ 
      果凛的生日一天天临近，一蹴在礼物的问题上伤透了脑筋。对于能得到任何东西的果凛来说，就算得到了普通的礼物也不会满足…… 抱有这种想法的一蹴，决定慎重地弄清楚她想要的东西。之后，在一次又一次的兜风约会中，一蹴体会到果凛的温柔和体贴，重新被她所深深吸引。比任何人都更喜欢果凛的他，最终选择的礼物究竟是……？ 
成为恋人之后的新鲜故事 
果凛的优雅气质 敬请期待！ 
      “虽然给本篇的果凛配音是很久之前的事了，但我在那部作品中的表现造成了很大反响，她是令我印象深刻的一名角色。这次讲的是果凛和一蹴成为恋人之后的故事，很是新鲜。因为在大部分游戏中，成为恋人时故事也就结束了。讲述成为恋人之后的故事的作品，给人一种独特的安心感，感觉挺奇怪的…… 相互间勤奋地打电话，发短信，就像是刚开始交往的情侣一样，这种剧本让我觉得有一点点害羞呢（笑）。只不过，让人难为情的台词倒是意外地少哟。因为果凛经常直接表示出她喜欢一蹴，所以她的心情丝毫不令我觉得难为情。 
      有印象的场面，就是果凛买了很多很高档衣服。单纯地羡慕她呢……（笑）。然后，就是为了看得清楚，她在一蹴的车上牢牢地贴上初学者的标签。虽然影响了车的美观，但对此毫不介意也正是果凛的风格呢。然后，当她失去重要的东西时，一蹴拼命帮她寻找的场面也是很可爱呢～只不过，这次的精彩之处，不管怎么说都是果凛的日常生活吧。请好好感受一下让一蹴大吃一惊的果凛的优雅气质！”

v1833.title: 6インチまいだーりん
v1833.originalDescription:
You play a high school student living with your parents and younger sister. On your way back from school, you stumble across a mysterious wooden box containing a strange figurine and an old letter. Thus your adventure begins...

Basically, this is a dating game, where you get to chaperone one of three 6-inch tall fairies from another world as they go about exploring your world (and sometimes making quite a mess while they're at it). Depending on how you do, you unlock various scenes/events throughout the game and maybe get a happy ending with the girl of your dreams. 经过这个假期，她变得更为成熟、更为美丽，连我都不由得意识到她女性的一面。在‘邂逅’与‘离别’的季节之中，少年与少女之间摇摆不定的‘恋慕之心’……少年与少女，夹杂着纯真与苦恼的恋爱物语……

This VN tells the story of Kyosuke, a high school student, who lives a normal student's life in a dormitory until one day he receives a strange device from abroad. v5850.title: 梦之翼
v5850.originalDescription:
Your dream is to fly, and you’ve spent years restoring an old plane, hoping that you will be able to fly in the sky just like your father. However, one day, after a test run you find a mysterious girl collapsed near the runway. Who is she? And why is she here? Even though you don’t know anything, you let her stay at your house, and a chain of events have begun to turn…

(taken from Calamitous Intent)
v5850.description:
五年前的一场意外，深山直人眼看着父亲所驾驶的轻型飞机“红蜻蜓”永远地消失在突如其来的暴雨之中。从那之后，为了完成父亲的遗愿，为了能够在梦想的天空下自由翱翔，直人开始了他的奋斗。 时光荏苒，已经年满17岁的他开始为取得“ULP（超轻型飞机）资格认证”做准备。
青梅竹马的表妹、开朗义气的好友、驰骋天空的教练机……日子一天一天平凡而充实地度过。眼看着离愿望实现越来越近的时候，一位名叫芮云静红 的神秘少女突然闯入了他的生活……
“不可以！！”
柔弱的少女，第一次态度坚决地表态，却是为了阻止自己的梦想。
“……没有……办法啊……命运是无法改变的……”
面对直人的询问，静红 喃喃地重复着。然而直人为了实现理想而做出的努力早已动摇了她。
……
命运真的无法改变吗？
“这样太残酷了。”
不断为梦想打拼的直人，无比沉重地叹道。
……
终于，奇迹般的魔法，将产后生命垂危的母马从死亡线上拯救回来，而静红亦因此陷入了深深的矛盾之中……“我没有去喜欢人的资格……就更不要说去爱一个人了……”
然而最终静红终究违抗了命运的安排，不惜令自己永远消逝。那是为了挽救直人的生命。
雨过天晴，一切都过去了，就好像什么也没有发生过一样。只有那份心意、那份信念，永远留在了少年的心中。
静红。
当我能够独自飞行的时候……
你愿意再一次与我共同遨游天际吗？
在梦想的天空下……

恋爱游戏最大的卖点自然就是人设，《梦之翼》起用了近年来人气急速上升的新锐插画家成濑千里（即《美人鱼的季节》中的主力人设），以其女性特有的清新秀逸的纤细笔触描绘出一个略带伤感的纯爱故事。

时值夏季，故事发生在某高原地区坐落在广大草原上的牧场里。在私立晴空高中上学的主人公——神山直人，母亲美佐子在很小时就去世了，将自己一手抚养长大的父亲胜，则在直人小学6年级暑假时，驾轻型飞机前往东京途中失踪，从此音信皆无。内向的他自父亲失踪那天起，就将自己内心的时间停止了。直人的梦想，是驾驶着父亲留下的红蜻蜓在天空中自由翱翔。

为了能驾驶红蜻蜓，直人开始为取得ULP（超轻型飞机）资格认证而努力着。看到这样的直人，青梅竹马的表妹、也是同班同学的神山勇希开始对他刮目相看。暑假前的一天，直人发现了一名昏倒在草原上的少女。便将她抱回了家中。醒来后的少女自称芮云静红，并提出暑假期间寄住在此处的要求。自静红出现后，直人的周围开始发生各种不可思议的事件，同时他也发现自己越来越对静红抱有兴趣。一直对直人有好感的勇希，也开始在意静红的存在…………

游戏中共有4位女主角可以攻略，围绕神秘美少女静红的来历和目的将展开不同的故事。亲情、友情、爱情，现实与梦想，都将在游戏中得到各自的诠释。作为KID近期的原创作品，《梦之翼》在声光效果上达到了一个新的高度，如铅笔画般风格的背景带着少许回忆的苦涩，悠扬空灵的音乐展现着人物复杂多变的内心世界，是跨平台美少女恋爱游戏的又一成功典范。

v5950.title: code_18
aliases: コード エイティーン
v5950.originalDescription: The story starts on September 11th, 2018. Hayato Hino is a high school student at Ryuusei Academy in Tokyo, and is a member of the school's Second Science Club. That day, he goes to the roof of the school to practice his "Dragon Unit", a flight pack. Just as he's about to test it out, he sees a girl falling out of the sky, wearing a similar device. He tries to save her, but fails and falls to his death. However, several seconds later, he finds himself having gone back in time a few seconds ago (though he has no memory of it) with the same incident occurring.
v5950.description:
——时间是，西历2018年9月11日17点30分。
从现在开始，进行计划D第107次实验。

距离现在不远的未来。
隶属于龙成学园第二科学部的高校二年级生飞野逸人，今天也在忙于发明与实验。站在屋顶的他的背上，是其亲手制作的小型飞行工具“龙号Mk-7Va”。
他的目标是，眼前一望无际的天空。

——这次一定要成功。
他暗暗下了决心，去抓住这片蔚蓝。

但是，就在他准备起飞的同时，却发生了不可思议的一幕。

“啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！”

一个陌生的女孩子，正身背着与他所携带的发明一模一样的飞行工具，在飞。
哦，不，正确的说是在下落。
就要掉到地面了。逸人赶紧伸出手，但是似乎已经来不及了……

自从与谜之少女时任有里佳相遇之后，逸人的世界就发生了巨大的变化。
来自未来的寄信人未知的邮件。
渐渐清晰的思念、回忆以及别离。
不断重复的过去的蓄积，必将打开通向未来的大门。

状况，一切OK！准备完毕！

飞野逸人，现在开始再度起飞……


　KID社“infinity”系列最新作「Code18（暂定）」时隔6年后复活，游戏PSP预定于今春发售。
游戏的人物设计是由绘制「机动新世纪ガンダムX～UNDER THE MOONLIGHT～」的漫画家赤津豊氏作为担任。
　　作为“infinity”系列的第四作，「Code18」贯彻了“infinity”系列原有的风格。
“infinity”系列是以不远的未来为舞台，描写时光轮回的作品。
 “infinity”系列的作品包括：2000年的「Never7」，2002年的「Ever17」，2004年的「Remember11」。　
自系列开发商KID社于2007年宣布破产之后，这个品牌就被CyberFront公司买断，此后就再无“infinity”系列后续作的计画，因此次次发表的「Code18」，可说是系列继第三作PS2版「Remember11」之后时隔六年推出的最新作品。

v7010.originalDescription: In this magical love simulation, you get to know six young witches in training as you yourself study at a magic school set in a different world. Your goal in studying is to return to your own world. At the start of every in-game month, you set up your hourly schedule, choosing from six different forms of magic to practice with one of the girls. Between learning, you go out with the girls on dates. Based on your responses in conversation, the girls' feelings towards you change.
v7010.description:
故事在与地球不同的行星上的玛比诺树魔法学院中展开。

在这颗行星上，曾经发展出巨大的产业文明并夸耀着其荣华，但在约300年前发生了被称为“妖精事件之夜”的大灾害，这个文明就此崩溃了。从这场灾害中拯救了人们的，是被称为“特里斯墨吉斯忒斯的魔术师”的人们，他们为这颗行星带来了魔法文明。

玛比诺树魔法学院，是由“特里斯墨吉斯忒斯的魔术师”创始的魔法学校，存在于次元的夹缝中。在玛比诺树魔法学院，人类不会衰老，许多学生们都在进行魔法修行。本游戏中登场的女主角们，也在这所学院进行魔法修行，是学院“吉保斯宿舍”的成员。

在本故事中，主人公与各位女主角之间将加深交流，同时追究这个世界的秘密，以及主人公御神乐圭为何会被召唤到这个世界的谜团。

v24864.originalDescription:
The story follows Rino Rando, who has been on her own since the passing of her mother, Chieri, as she transfers to Miyagami Private Academy with the recommendation of her mysterious pen pal, Mr. Poppit. Shortly after her arrival, Rino surprisingly becomes a member of elite group of girls called the Best Student Council. Rino learns that Kanade Jinguji founded Miyagami Private Academy as a place where students can live free from restrictions and that the Best Student Council was formed to ensure that freedom. Best Student Council Members receive free tuition, room and board.

The story takes place at Miyagami Private Academy, a mysterious all-girl high school, its student council, the Miyagami Academy Maximum Authority Wielding Best Student Council, also known as the Best Student Council (Gokujou Seitokai), having their own Assault, Covert, and vehicle divisions. This council has more authority power than any of the faculty and staff members. The Best Student Council is divided into the four main divisions: Executive, Assault and Covert plus the Vehicle Squad. Each member of the council has their own special ability, such as special fighting techniques, the gathering of information, or weaponry such as cards, a yo-yo, or, in Rino's case, her hand puppet, Pucchan. It is revealed in an early episode that no one really knows how many members are actually in the best Student Council except the President.

v27682.originalDescription: Ayaka, Tomoya's girlfriend who went to heaven, suddenly appeared before Shin. He told him she had lost her "Angel Wings" and had to get them back to go back to heaven but... she doesn't have any clue of how do they look like! The only way to find out is to meet people with "wishes" in their hearts, who happen to be the heroines of the three first games in the Memories Off franchise. Through minigames, they'll be able to solve this conflict, and let Ayaka go back to heaven.
v27682.description:
Memories Off Mix 是一款以Mini Game为主的游戏，包括麻雀∕麻将、15puzzle、拼图、纸牌及问答游戏，会有1st、2nd及想君的人物出现，也收录了不少画师所画的新CG
故事主角是稻穗信。
他在某天遇上了初代女主角之一桧月彩花的「灵体」。现在的她不能回到原本世界，而且只有信才可以看到她。为了帮助彩花回去原本的世界，信需要找寻「天使的羽毛」，时限是入夜前。不过信为了收集情报，竟然要和其他女孩玩游戏 . . . . . .
故事开端就是如此。游戏中会以三作的女主角分为三条不同的故事路线，分别是「唯笑路线」、「萤路线」和「彼方路线」。玩者目的虽然是一样，但是路线对故事的发展就完全不同

v1985.title: スキップ・ビート！
v1985.originalDescription:
Based on the manga of the same name.

Kyoko was in love with Shotaro, her old friend. Shotaro left his hometown to be a TV star after graduating junior high school. Kyoko followed him and worked really hard to take care of him. A while later, Shotaro successfully made his debut as a singer. Kyoko thought she would carry on supporting him, but Shotaro actually thought her as a housemaid.... Kyoko decided to take revenge on Shotaro and had an audition to join the LME Production. She unfortunately failed, but she couldn't give up. After twists and turns, she joined the team Love Me. As she worked as a member of the team, she gradually got interested in performing. One day, Kyoko received a job offer to play a role in a popular drama called "Dark Moon". When her shooting went well, she also received three more job offers at the same time. However, she could choose only one out of three!?
v1985.description: 《Skip Beat!》游戏化登场！原作是白泉社《花与梦》仲村佳树的大人气作品！这次将在游戏中上演最上恭子(キョーコ)全新的娱乐圈挑战！！玩家将成为最上恭子，与《Skip Beat!》中登场的角色们一起完成各种各样的工作。故事完全是游戏原创。从来到最上恭子这里的3个工作进行选择，并根据玩家的行动产生变化。根据各自所选内容的成功与失败，结局也会发生变化。此外，TV动画中未曾登场的“雷诺(レイノ)”与“弥勒(ミロク)”也会登场，这也是游戏版独有的魅力。

v3433.description:
倒在悬崖旁的主人公，在名为“天地”的男性声音中醒来，
接受了照料并恢复了意识。
之后，从在自己倒下的现场遇到的少女“橘步美(橘 あゆみ)”那里，
得知自己是“隶属于空木探偵事務所的侦探助手”，
并且被委托调查『突然死去的资产家·綾城家的当家“绫城菊(綾城 キク)”之死』，
得知被委托调查此事的他，
在回想起自己的名字后，前往位于“明神村”的“綾城家”。
在破败的寒村、明神村首屈一指的资产家綾城家，
世代相传着“死者复苏，杀死与綾城家为仇之人”的奇妙传承。
由于身为当代当家的菊的死，整个村子笼罩在不稳的气息中，
事件最终发展为卷入綾城家相关人员的连续杀人事件，
企图获得菊留下的财产的人们
接二连三地死去……

v6155.originalDescription: Torako and her friends find a room of the group called Yorozuya at school. According to rumor, what Yorozuya do are to look for the thing someone lost, give an advice to someone who has a concern, and do research on someone's affairs. Yes, it's more like detective's work. Torako is attracted to Yorozuya and decides to join it (Of course, her friends are also forced to join it). They soon receive a message from the boss of the group, "I'll test your ability. If you fail, you'll be strictly punished..." Well, will Torako and her friends make it?
v6155.description:
——5月初，上园学园。

虎子她们在杂物间林立的走廊一角，发现了一个同好会，通称“万屋”。据学园内的传闻，万屋的活动内容是寻找失物、学园内学生们的烦恼咨询与身家调查等等……总之就是一个模仿侦探做事的同好会。据说它从很久以前就存在了，历代部员每天都在期盼着委托人的到来。然而不可思议的是，虽然现在有成员在，但似乎几乎处于不活动的状态。

被这样的万屋夺走心智的虎子立刻擅自决定入会（当然，龙姬、雀、步巳也输给了虎子的气势被强制入会）。于是，身份不明的万屋部长留下了一张便条，说是威胁也好，说是开玩笑也好……总之出现了一条可怕的消息。“从现在起将考核虎子她们作为万屋的活动是否优秀，如果达不到及格分数，5月底将受到【万屋的众神】降下的天罚”，这样一个极其无理的枷锁被强加在了虎子她们身上……

虎子她们在期限内究竟能取得多少成果呢！？

After repeated D-mail experiments, Okarin jumps to a world where 3% shift in world line was to be expected. And before he knew it, Kurisu as well as the rest of the members have been gathered and amidst preparations for a banquet. 

In this world, a new gadget had been created but the group is facing some troubles. They can’t afford to pay the electricity bill due to running too many experiments. Let’s see what this new gadget can do for us… 

The concept for this game is a love comedy with some sweet romance scenes and where 99% of the world is science but 1% is composed of … fantasies?!
v6618.description:
在反复进行D-mail实验后，冈部伦太郎跳跃到了一个预计世界线变动率将达到3%的世界。不知不觉间，牧濑红莉栖以及其他成员都已聚集在一起，正忙于准备一场宴会。

在这个世界里，一个新的装置被制造了出来，但众人面临着一些麻烦。由于进行了过多的实验，他们付不起电费。让我们看看这个新装置能为我们做些什么……

这款游戏的概念是一部带有甜蜜恋爱场景的爱情喜剧，其中99%的世界是科学，而1%则是由……幻想构成的？！

v7770.originalDescription:
While maintaining fantasy role-playing game aesthetics, this game puts players in the shoes of a girl named Lilith. She's a novice priestess in the shrine of Dodona. She lives a rather peaceful life with her fairy and remains innocent of the strives that go on in her world until she meets the holy knight Nayuta and the mercenary soldier Kirite. 

Nayuta will do anything for his religion while Kirite swore to protect Lilith from every harm. Besides the two men, there is a whole cast of colorful characters in the dangerous world outside, voiced by famous seiyuu such as Sakurai Takahiro and Kishio Daisuke. 

In her journey, Lilith learns one thing. Love is what saves everything.
v7770.description:
在保持奇幻角色扮演游戏美学的同时，本作让玩家扮演一位名叫莉莉丝的女孩。她是Dodona神殿的一名新手祭司。她和自己的妖精过着相当平静的生活，对世界上发生的纷争一无所知，直到她遇见了圣骑士Nayuta和佣兵基里特。

Nayuta会为了他的信仰做任何事，而基里特发誓要保护莉莉丝免受一切伤害。除了这两名男子之外，在危险的外部世界中还有一众性格各异的角色，由Sakurai Takahiro和Kishio Daisuke等著名声优配音。

在旅途中，莉莉丝明白了一件事。爱能拯救一切。

v9887.title: STEINS;GATE 変移空间的八比特
v9887.original: STEINS;GATE 変移空間のオクテット
aliases: STEINS;GATE 変移空间的八比特
STEINS;GATE 変移空間のオクテット
シュタインズ・ゲート 8bit
v9887.originalDescription: An extension of the True End of the original game. Unlike the modern visual novel format of the original game, this retro game perfectly mimics the style of graphical text adventure games from the 8-bit PC era (e.g. PC-88), with the player typing short commands to interact with and explore the game world. It features all backgrounds and characters drawn in a low-color pixelated style with emulated scanlines, chiptune music played through an emulated FM chip, and no voice acting. The premise of the game features Okabe receiving a D-Mail from himself in 2025 that states that he must save the future by reclaiming an IBN 5100 from a person under of the alias "Neidhardt".
v9887.description:
世界线1,048596，这是冈部伦太郎在经历了那个夏天的事后到达的斯坦因之门的世界线。那件惨剧，第三次世界大战都不会发生的未知的世界线。谁都无法预料明天会发生什么。

但是突然间冈部感到了一阵头晕，没错，这是世界线在发生移动，究竟发生了什么？这时仿佛计算好了的一样冈部的手机收到了新的短信，有不好的预感。打开邮件一看，果不其然，这是从2025年的未来的冈部处发来的短信。

原来，世界线偏移了0.000132%。原因是幻之PC“IBN5100”被疾风迅雷的名为奈特哈特的人物拿走了，并将世界上的所有基础产业全部变成了“萌产业”，因此15年后的世界发生了全球性的恐慌，所有的国家和宗教都在“萌”的面前败下阵来。这已经是超越了暗黑世界，超越了第三次世界大战的悲剧，简直就是“混沌”。

未来的冈部表示需要夺回IBN5100。那么，究竟实验室的成员们能否成功夺回幻之PC，将斯坦因之门世界线恢复原状呢……

v11677.title: 花咲くまにまに
v11677.originalDescription:
Mochizuke Nao is a high school student living in the present day. One day she goes to a nearby shrine for the summer festival… and somehow gets thrown back in time. When she opens her eyes, she finds herself in an unfamiliar land. A peculiar scenery lies before her eyes. It appears that she experienced a time slip back into a period of intense upheaval—the Edo period. The town she landed in is really different from the present day. Nao is incredibly shocked and troubled.

With no idea of how to return to the present Nao is at a loss when she meets a young man named Kurama. He offers to help her, and even though she has doubts, she has no place to go to in Edo. She decides to rely on his kindness, and so he takes her to live at his acquaintance’s place—a brothel called “Manju-ya”.

However, Manju-ya is different from a regular brothel. With time, Nao starts finding out the secrets behind the place. She learns things hidden by the people who work there, at the same time grows closer to them.

They want to touch, but they can’t.

They want to convey, but they can’t.

Irritation towards the unchangeable truth.

 The “truth” and “will” hidden behind the screen.

In an endless cycle called fate, Nao finds a lot of feelings and begins to grow up.
v11677.description:
主人公、七緒是生活在现代的普通高中生。
某天，七緒因为去参加了附近神社举办的夏日祭典为契机，穿越到了过去。

被传送到的目的地是被称为激荡时代的江戸。
睁开眼后是陌生的土地、异样的风景。
面对与现代明显不同的江戸街景，七緒深受动摇，感到困惑。

在不知道如何回到现代而一筹莫展时，遇到了一位名叫倉間的青年并得到了他的帮助。起初虽然感到困惑，但在江戸的街道上无处可去的七緒接受了倉間的好意，寄身于他熟人的店铺“特遊郭「万珠屋」”。

在与传统游郭不同的那间特别的店铺里，七緒渐渐了解了万珠屋的秘密，以及在那里工作的人们的内情，拉近了与他们之间的距离。

想要触碰，却无法触碰
想要传达，却无法传达
对无法改变的事实的焦躁

隐藏在背后的『真实』与『志向』。
在名为命运的巨大轮回中，七緒接触到各种各样的情感并不断成长。

A game based a light novel by Aisora Manta and illustrated by Koin.

The story of Haiyore! Nyaruko-san centers around Nyaruko, a formless Cthulhu-deity of chaos (Nyarlathotep) who can take on the shape of a seemingly ordinary silver-haired girl. Yasaka Mahiro is a normal high school boy who is being chased by a fearsome black alien one night, until Nyaruko saves him. She explains that the creatures from H. P. Lovecraft's works are actually races of aliens, and that she has been sent to Earth to protect him from being kidnapped by an alien trafficker. Eventually, Nyaruko and two other Lovecraft-creatures, Cthugha and Hastur, end up being freeloaders at Mahiro's place.
v12178.description:

v12312.title: DISORDER6
aliases: ディスオーダー シックス
v12312.originalDescription:
One rainy night, a young man wakes up in what appears to be a warehouse. On his right arm is an attached handcuff. The chain is connected to the left hand of a mysterious girl named Shiina. She seems to call him by the name Joe, but she doesn’t remember anything. In fact, neither of them have any recollections of anything prior to their awakening.

“What exactly am I?”

Without a single idea of what’s going on, the two of them search for an exit. Before long, they come across the corpse of a woman wearing a white robe.

“… Who killed her?”

Appalled by the situation, the fire they were using as light began to engulf their surroundings in flames, as the mysterious characters make a run for their lives. Once they make it outdoors they begin to wander around, until they encounter a female detective by the name of Kobayakawa…

As any good detective would, she tries to apprehend the potential witness of the crime. However, without any memories or clue of what’s going on, the two panic and escape from her. The handcuffed pair are now suspects to a crime and are on the run.

A boy and girl who are bound by cuffs. Memory loss. Escape. What truth lies behind their lost memories?
v12312.description:
下雨的夜晚，少年在仓库般的地方醒来。
右手上戴着沉重的手铐。
铁链的另一端连在自称希娜(シーナ)的神秘少女的左手上。
她称呼少年为“乔(ジョー)”，但他自己却没有那段记忆。
不仅如此，至今为止的所有记忆都脱落得一干二净。

自己究竟是谁？

在还没搞清楚状况的情况下寻找出口时，
两人发现了一具穿白衣的女性的尸体。

究竟是谁杀的？

在愕然之中，作为照明点燃的火蔓延到了仓库的货物上，
两人拼死离开了那栋建筑。
走出外面徘徊时，遭遇了一名警察·小早川(コバヤカワ)。
她试图将两人作为杀人案件的重要参考人带走，
没有醒来前记忆的两人
判断被捕会处于不利，便从她面前逃亡了。
于是两人作为嫌疑人被追捕了。
“被铁链相连的男女”、“失忆”、“逃亡”

从失去的记忆中牵引出的真相究竟是……？

The story follows two loners, the pragmatic Hikigaya Hachiman and beautiful Yukinoshita Yukino, who despite their varying personalities and ideals, offer help and advice to others as part of their school's Service Club, assisted by the cheerful and friendly Yuigahama Yui. 以由比滨结衣(Yui)、雪之下雪乃(Yukino)、平冢静(Shizuka)的路线为特色，其他角色的路线作为次要路线。

v12794.originalDescription:
Set two months after the events of Corpse Party: Book of Shadows, Ayumi Shinozaki had paid the price for her use of black magic and been afflicted with a serious illness. However, she managed to somehow survive with the help of Naomi Nakashima. The grim grimoire, known as the Book of Shadows, now has laid waste to the Shinozaki estate and both the estate and tome vanished, leaving only a plot of land where it once stood.

Before she was hospitalized, an acquaintance of Ayumi's older sister, Hinoe Shinozaki, who belongs to the W.I., the Wiccan Institute, an organization that worshiped spirits. Telling Ayumi to get Book of Shadows back, her trail now leads into the residence once belonged to Makina Shinozaki.

The day after being discharged from the hospital, Ayumi went to visit the estate where Makina Shinozaki resided. However, it was run-down and looked to have been closed for a long time; "NO TRESPASSING" tape was strewn up everywhere, blocking entry. She stared intently at the estate with fierce determination. ...She couldn't afford to let Satoshi and the others be involved this time. For Ayumi, it was the responsibility of Shinozaki's bloodline. The lone struggle and legacy of her lineage.
v12794.description:
篠崎芳惠(ヨシヱ)、篠崎幸子(サチコ)的生家、造访篠崎家所引发的悲剧，难道是新的惨剧的预兆吗。
篠崎幸子不在之后，被认为已经崩塌的天神小。
然而，在更强大的支配者之下，其诅咒之力正在扩大。
终于揭晓的，围绕天神小学校的诸多谜团。
能够夺回在天神小被惨杀的伙伴们吗……!?

v13089.title: 解放少女 SIN
v13089.originalDescription:
A sequel to Liberation Maiden, although it sheds the three-dimensional shooting gameplay in favor of a visual novel approach. 

Liberation Maiden SIN follows the exploits of Kiyoto Kaido, childhood friend of and newly-appointed chief aide to President Shoko Ozora, during the events of the Second Liberation War. Kaido has the ability to read other people's minds. Several new female characters also appear as cabinet members in the New Japan government. Both the Liberator Kamui and the Guardian Spirits also feature.
v13089.description:
《解放少女 SIN》是由5pb.于2013年12月5日发售的PlayStation 3专用游戏软件。

本作是2012年5月21日发售的任天堂3DS用合集游戏《GUILD 01》中收录的《解放少女》的续作。前作是射击游戏，但本作的类型变更为冒险游戏。开发也由Grasshopper Manufacture变更为5pb.负责。

据企画本作的5pb.的志仓千代丸表示，《解放少女》连细枝末节的设定都精心制作，有着超越合集框架的“认真制作的感觉”这一魅力，为了更好地发挥那些精心制作的设定，才将其做成了冒险游戏。

v13152.originalDescription: The game follows the life of Jun Sakurada through two separate paths in the visual novel, where he can chose to wind up Shinku, or not. Doing so will allow him to be her master and the game will follow him through the Middle School Route. Choosing not to do so will send players down his college route.
v13152.description:
超人气动画《蔷薇少女》在PlayStation 3、PlayStation Vita上游戏化！将电视动画中大受欢迎的“蔷薇少女”游戏化。不仅能体验动画的故事，还能享受游戏原创的剧本，这是蔷薇少女粉丝无法抗拒的贪心之作！
・长年以来深受喜爱的热门作品《蔷薇少女》！！原作漫画是在《周刊Young Jump》连载的PEACH-PIT原作的人气作品。漫画单行本自2002年起连载，电视动画于2004年、2005年动画化，并在2013年也推出了电视动画，是一部持续受到广大年龄层喜爱的大人气作品。
游玩两个世界的“平行世界” 本作从中学生樱田 纯(ジュン)选择“上发条，还是不上发条”开始。故事在平行世界中推进，玩家可以分别享受选择了不给蔷薇少女的薇上发条的大学生“纯”，以及选择了上发条的中学生“纯”各自的故事！剧本除了原作与动画的故事外，还有游戏原创的展开！内容足以让人尽情领略蔷薇少女的世界观。

v13865.original: IS＜インフィニット・ストラトス＞2 イグニッション・ハーツ
aliases: IS＜インフィニット・ストラトス＞2 イグニッション・ハーツ
v13865.description:
一夏就读的IS学园的学园祭上要上演灰姑娘的话剧。
女主角们全员都成了灰姑娘，围绕一夏展开了激烈的争夺。
在忙于学园祭准备期间，
一夏被学生会长·更识楯无委托，让妹妹簪参加学园祭。
为了让簪参加学园祭，一夏主动搭话，但簪的态度十分冷淡。
到了学园祭当天，一夏试图邀请一直待在整备室里的簪。
就在这时，整备室内出现了爆炸物的反应！
簪和一夏试图拆除爆炸物，但这其实是个陷阱。
在爆炸的瞬间，展开IS的一夏挺身而出，阻止了损害扩大。
因为这起爆炸事件，学园祭被迫中止，一夏也失去了意识——

虽然恢复了意识，但一夏因为爆炸的冲击失去了记忆。

为了帮一夏找回记忆，女主角们费尽心机，却毫无效果。
就在这时，根据楯无的提议，为了恢复一夏的记忆，
大家决定重新举办被中止的学园祭。

女主角们纷纷向失去记忆的一夏自称是他的恋人。
一场名为学园祭的一夏争夺战就此打响。

究竟，哪位女主角能找回一夏的记忆？
谁能俘获一夏的心呢？

v14019.originalDescription:
Collaboration game between La'cryma and 5pb.

Synopsis:

It is not the end (fermata) to this story of battles.

In order to bring upon “justice”, a special force under the direct command of an organization was formed across the border. Its name was the “Seventh Chord”. Having excelled in manipulating magic (rune) in combat using her life force and living in secret from society, Freya was the only girl who has shown excellent results as a knight.

Freya was summoned to the island of eternal summer, where she was born and raised, by Julius, Seventh Chord's commander and her elder brother who she reunited with after being separated for a long time, for her first mission. And that mission, was said to have never been accomplished in history; it was to “defeat a mythical god”. Although it was handed down as a legend before, the "God" that was subdued was revived in this present day and age once again. 

After analyzing the "abilities" of these mythical gods, the organization created the “strategic creation technology weapon” to fight against them. This ultimate scientific weapon, known as “Miracle”, was handed down to Freya, to challenge these mythical existences to a fight.

The enemies have transcended human intelligence, and their immortal existence has the ability to recreate the "powers" of a mythical god. The seven “Mahoutsukai”. 
The seven people who gathered in the name of justice. The "Kisekitsukai" of the “Seventh Chord”.

Ultimate Science (justice) vs. Mythical Magic (another justice)
A fight that no one had expected. Before long, the truth will begin to lead one to a sad fate. 
Mission Rank: SSS-Class. 
The seven knights were gathered to cut open the impossible fate, and set foot into the unexplored stage of humanity that will slowly become a holy war.
v14019.description:
斩开那『命运』。
那是没有“终结”的战斗故事。

在『正义』之名下跨越国境结成的组织直属特殊部队
——其名为，『七圣骑士团』。

擅长运用人类隐藏的生命能量『魔术』进行战斗，作为骑士取得优异成绩的少女·弗蕾亚(フレイア)也是其中之一。
在失散后重逢的哥哥·尤利乌斯(ユリウス)总司令麾下，弗蕾亚为了初次任务，降落在了曾经出生成长的常夏之岛。

那项任务，是成就历史上据说无一人达成过的“超越神话”——讨伐曾经作为传说流传、再次于现代苏醒的“神”。

敌人是超越人智、拥有再现神话的神之“能力”的不死存在，七名『被召唤者』——
相对的，是在正义之名下聚集的，七名『创造轨迹者』『七圣骑士团』。

分析众神的“能力”，为了对抗他们而创造的『战略创造技术兵器』——通称“奇迹”的辉石，弗蕾亚等人手持人造终极科学兵器，向神话上的存在发起挑战。

然而，此时出现了熟练使用“魔法”与“奇迹”二刀流的谜之铠骑士『终结者』的乱入。不属于任何一方阵营、正体不明的第三势力介入，其目的究竟是——

终极科学（正义） VS 神话魔术（另一个正义） VS 融合超科学（隐藏的正义）——谁都无法预想的战斗，终将描绘出一个悲伤的命运真相。

任务难度，SSS级。为了斩开被认为不可能的命运而聚集的七名骑士，如今降临在了人类未踏的圣战舞台上。

v15910.originalDescription:
When the protagonist- Ayazuki Mei from present-day Japan- warped through time, she had arrived in a strange Meiji Era "Tokyo" in which mononoke exist.

There, she met Mori Ougai, Hishida Shunsou, Kawakami Otojirou, Izumi Kyouka, Fujita Gorou and Koizumi Yakumo, who are famous historical figures. As she spent time with them, Mei realised that she possessed the ability known as "Tamayori", which enables her to see mononoke.

The days passed on by, and Mei became attracted to one of the men. She then fell in love...
She was then faced with a conundrum: to stay in the Meiji Era or return to the modern era she had come from. Mei decided to stay in the "Meiji World" to be with her beloved.

And today, again, slightly strange events occur around the "Tamayori"-endowed Mei...
v15910.description:
主人公・绫月芽衣（綾月芽衣※名字可更改）从现代穿越时空所抵达的地方，
是存在着物怪的不可思议的明治时代的“东亰”。
在那里遇见的是森鸥外（森 鴎外）、菱田春草（菱田春草）、川上音二郎（川上音二郎）、泉镜花（泉 鏡花）、藤田五郎（藤田五郎）、小泉八云（小泉 八雲）等历史人物们。
在与他们交流的过程中，主人公意识到自己是能够看到名为“魂依（たまより）”的物怪的
能力者。
然后在度过日常的过程中，主人公被他吸引，坠入了爱河。
在烦恼是留在明治还是回到现代之后，最终决定生活在有最爱的他存在的“明治之世”。

在拥有这种“魂依（たまより）”之力的主人公身边，今天也发生着些许不可思议的事件。

v16921.original: IS＜インフィニット・ストラトス＞2 ラブ アンド パージ
aliases: IS＜インフィニット・ストラトス＞2 ラブ アンド パージ
v16921.originalDescription:
Set several days after the "World Purge" chapter, Infinite Stratos 2 has players developing relationships with the IS heroines as Ichika Orimura. "Braveheart Points" signify Ichika's manhood, and will fluctuate depending on choices made during conversations, with endings changing as a result of the final value.

In addition to chatting it up, Ichika can give the heroines a massage to deepen their bonds and increase Braveheart Points. Techniques involve tapping and rubbing properly, though, so you can mess up and fail, losing points as a result.
v16921.description: 在疑似使用了World Purge的训练中，由于不明程序的影响，发生了女主角们再次处于脑潜状态无法登出的事态。在这种情况下，篠之之束(篠ノ之束)突然出现在织斑一夏、织斑千冬面前。面对起疑的千冬，束表示得知妹妹箒被关在电脑空间，为了救出她而赶来。束讲述了她的见解：被困在虚拟世界的女主角们处于失去了“包含对一夏的心意在内的记忆”的状态，因为与现实世界的联系消失而无法登出。为了拯救女主角们，只能进行“真实之爱的亲吻”，以此煽动一夏……！？

v17099.originalDescription:
In the near future technology is developed that allows ones state of mind and personality traits to be quickly quantified and profiled.

All emotion, desire, and social disease are documented and managed by the government for the public good. The quality of each person's life is measured by a single number. That number, which represents how close the mind and soul are to perfection, is known as the Psycho-Pass. The system also calculates a number that represents criminal capacity, known as the Crime Coefficients. This number is the basis of the justice dispensed by the police force. Officers are divided into two groups: Enforcers, who are tasked with the investigation of crimes and the capture of criminals, and Inspectors, who are charged with managing the Enforcers.  Enforcers with high Crime Coefficients have proven more effective at understanding the criminal mind. This ability is used by the police department to solve complex and difficult cases. Because they have such high Crime Coefficients, however, they must be monitored all time by the Inspectors, to ensure that none of them actually become criminals. Though each member of the Public Safety Bureau carries their own burdens, they must see that justice is served - in a society where everything is quantified, they have to make sure it all adds up.

What's waiting for them out there..?

v19441.title: 可塑性记忆
v19441.original: プラスティック・メモリーズ
aliases: プラスティック・メモリーズ
v19441.originalDescription:
The SAI Corporation has achieved great fame for its human-like androids. Called Giftia, these robots are programmed with a synthetic soul and serve many purposes in society. There’s just one flaw: a Giftia can live only 81,920 hours (about nine years and four months) before their memories and personality fade from existence, and they become potentially violent.

That’s where Mizugaki Tsukasa comes in. After failing his college entrance exams, Tsukasa lands a job at the SAI Corporation’s Terminal Service Department, whose purpose is to reclaim these “expired” Giftia. Surrounded by expired Giftia and assisted by his Giftia work partner, the beautiful, innocent and inexperienced Isla, Tsukasa must come to terms with the short lifespan of these incredibly life-like androids in Plastic Memories.



The game features Tsukasa as protagonist whose choices will affect the storyline. Besides anime's ending, the game also features two original endings and four character endings.
v19441.description:
SAI Corporation因其高度拟人的仿生人而声名远扬。这些被称为Giftia的机器人被植入了合成灵魂，在社会中发挥着多种作用。但只有一个缺陷：Giftia只能存活81,920小时（约九年零四个月），之后它们的记忆和人格就会消失，并可能变得具有暴力倾向。

这就是水柿司(Mizugaki Tsukasa)出场的地方。在大学入学考试落榜后，水柿司在SAI Corporation的终端服务部门找到了一份工作，该部门的目的是回收这些“过期”的Giftia。在过期Giftia的包围下，在他的Giftia工作搭档——美丽、天真且缺乏经验的艾拉(Isla)的协助下，水柿司必须在《可塑性记忆》中接受这些极其逼真的仿生人寿命短暂的事实。

游戏以水柿司为主角，他的选择将影响故事情节。除了动画的结局外，游戏还包含两个原创结局和四个角色结局。

aliases: ニューゲーム ザ チャレンジ ステージ

developers.name: 有限会社コネクト・ウィザード

v19717.originalDescription:
An adaptation based on Tokunou Shoutarou's 4-koma manga.

Having been a strong fan of a particular video game, Suzukaze Aoba, a high school graduate, begins working at the game's developer, Eagle Jump, as a CG artist. As she works on modelling and designing characters for games in development, she becomes acquainted with her fellow co-workers in the character design department, as well as those from across the company.



The Challenge Stage is a training adventure game based on the popular anime. The player is Suzukaze Aoba, who is tasked with creating add-on downloadable content for a hurriedly decided RPG epic.

During Training Parts, your more experienced co-workers teach you and you learn skills. Your training parameters will change depending on which co-workers teach you.

The story will advance during Adventure Parts. You’ll be able to enjoy conversations with your co-workers and friends, and your friendships can change based on your responses. In the second half of the game, you can enjoy the individual episodes of the co-workers you became friends with in the previous parts, as well as trigger character routes.
v19717.description:
改编自 Tokunou Shoutarou 的四格漫画。

作为某款电子游戏的狂热粉丝，高中毕业的涼風 青葉（Suzukaze Aoba）开始在开发该游戏的公司 Eagle Jump 担任 CG 画师。在为开发中的游戏进行角色建模和设计时，她结识了角色设计部门的同事，以及公司其他部门的员工。

The Challenge Stage 是一款基于热门动画改编的育成冒险游戏。玩家扮演涼風 青葉，负责为一款仓促决定的 RPG 史诗巨作制作追加可下载内容。

在育成部分中，经验丰富的同事会指导你，让你学习技能。你的育成参数会根据指导你的同事而发生变化。

故事将在冒险部分中推进。你可以享受与同事和朋友的对话，并且你们的友谊会根据你的回答而改变。在游戏的后半部分，你可以欣赏在之前部分中结交的同事的个人剧情，并触发角色路线。

v19890.originalDescription:
Based on a light novel by Nagatsuki Tappei. It follows an original story that differs from the original light novel series and the anime.

In its original story, the Ruler Election has spun off a beauty contest, giving the winner a treasure that promises the recipient great luck and a powerful advantage to achieving the throne. 
Except, the prize isn't what it seems, and, taking on its "Death Curse", Subaru must use his power to return from the dead to solve the mystery, build the trusts with the girls, receive the "kiss of a beautiful girl" and break the curse to escape death.

Candidates for a relationship with Subaru are Emilia, Rem, Ram, Felt, Beatrice, Crusch, Priscilla and Anastasia.
v19890.description:
改编自长月达平(Nagatsuki Tappei)的轻小说。讲述了一个不同于原版轻小说系列和动画的原创故事。

在这个原创故事中，王选衍生出了一场选美比赛，获胜者将得到一件宝物，据说它能赋予持有者极大的好运，并在争夺王座时提供强大的优势。

然而，奖品并非表面看起来那样，在承受了其“死亡诅咒”后，菜月昴必须使用他从死亡中回归的力量来解开谜团，与女孩们建立信任，获得“美少女之吻”并打破诅咒以逃离死亡。

与菜月昴发展关系的候选人是爱蜜莉雅、雷姆、拉姆、菲鲁特、碧翠丝、库珥修、普莉希拉和安娜塔西娅。

v28730.original: この素晴らしい世界に祝福を！ ～この欲望の衣装に寵愛を！～
