Kono Subarashii Sekai ni Shukufuku o! ~Kono Yokubou no Ishou ni Chouai o!~
KONOSUBA - God's Blessing on this Wonderful World! Love For These Clothes Of Desire!
为美好的世界献上祝福！～为欲望的服装献上宠爱！～
为这美好世界献上祝福！恋爱与欲望之衣！
v28730.originalDescription: The story of Kono Yokubou no Ishou ni Chouai wo features the KonoSuba  party, who during one of their usual quests, find a cursed tablet that lets its user freely generate clothes. The cast all get cursed with  personality-reverse. Darkness turns into a sadistic queen, Megumin turns  into a lolita and starts a Lolita Alliance, and Aqua turns into an actual goddess-like person. The characters will need to make and wear specific clothes with the tablet to break the curse. It’s a game where  you can enjoy typical comedy situations of KonoSuba along with  the cast acting out of character and wearing different costumes. Hence the Japanese subtitle, which can be translated to “Love For the Costumes of Desires".
v28730.description:
**在任务中捡到的黑色石板。**
**那是一个能自由生成衣服的魔法道具。**

**阿库娅(アクア)等人高兴地以为用这个做衣服就能轻松赚钱，**
**却被扣上了从贵族宅邸盗走宝石的罪名，**
**收到了被驱逐出阿克塞尔城的劝告。**

**因莫须有的罪名而遭到驱逐劝告。**
**紧接着，如同雪上加霜一般，能让欲望完全颠倒的石板诅咒向和真(カズマ)等人袭来。**

**为了解开伙伴们身上的诅咒，**
**只能让他们穿上满足欲望的衣服。**

**和真一边寻找把罪名强加给他们的犯人，**
**一边为了解开伙伴身上的诅咒而开始行动。**

v29889.originalDescription:
Based on a manga "Go-toubun no Hanayome" by Haruba Negi.

In the game, the Nakano quintuplets, protagonist Uesugi Fuutarou, and Fuutarou's younger sister Raiha went to the Nakano's private island during the summer break only for three days and two nights. But due a heavy storm, the group is unable to going back and has to spend 2 weeks in the island.
v29889.description:
作为兼职家庭教师，上杉风太郎(上杉風太郎)要将“濒临留级”“讨厌学习”的美少女五胞胎引导至“毕业”。通过林间学校的各种活动，上杉风太郎与五胞胎之间的信任进一步加深了。
结束修学旅行后的暑假，上杉风太郎和妹妹上杉雷华(上杉らいは)受邀来到五胞胎的私人岛屿。
本该与五胞胎度过三天两夜的假期，却因突如其来的暴风雨，导致开往私人岛屿的船只无法航行，被迫过上了两周的无人岛野外求生生活。
上杉风太郎究竟能否顺利引导五胞胎和上杉雷华呢？

v30175.title: B-PROJECT 流星*幻想曲
v30175.original: B-PROJECT 流星＊ファンタジア
aliases: B-PROJECT 流星＊ファンタジア
v30175.originalDescription:
B-Project‘s first console game!

An unknown past and hidden secrets now revealed.

What road will the troubled boys choose as idols, and as people—?

B-Project is a special unit formed of the three male idol groups Kitakore, THRIVE, and MooNs. And last year, the four members of KiLLER KiNG joined as a new addition.

Shining more and more each day, their presence in the industry is more prominent than ever. The 14 members, each wholly unique, are all running toward the same dream, one much more difficult than anyone else could imagine.

And yet even today, all 14 members of B-Project gave their fans the ultimate performance on the country’s largest stage, the Japan Dome. If you close your eyes, you can still hear the voices of the 14 members echo in harmony throughout the venue.

That was step one towards greater success. We were promised a bright future.

—Until that moment, we believed it without a doubt.
v30175.description:
美吉斯在本日（2020年11月21日）举办的现场活动「B-PROJECT THRIVE LIVE2020 -MUSIC DRUGGER-」上，发表了「B-PROJECT」首次家用机游戏化。 
标题为「B-PROJECT 流星＊幻想曲」，将在Nintendo Switch上发售。配合此事，预告网站＆官方Twitter账号已启动，此外还公开了预告影片。 
本作的剧本在浓缩了「B-PROJECT」5年历史的同时，聚焦于14名成员各自的人生，描绘了至今未曾讲述过的他们的真实面貌等。此外除了收录新曲之外，还能享受声优阵带来的全语音。其他详情将陆续公开，敬请期待。

aliases: コープスパーティーⅡ Darkness Distortion
尸体派对2 黑暗扭曲
v46514.originalDescription:
"Ayame Kirishima, Ayame Kirishima, please send them to the hospital."

Hoping to boost her subscriber numbers, streamer Nemu Takahashi convinces her high school classmates Haruka Nanami and Maria Hitsugi to test the urban legend “Ayame’s Mercy” live at an abandoned hospital.

It does not go as planned.

The three friends unwittingly trigger a curse placed on the hospital decades ago and are transported to another, darker realm, home to the vengeful spirit of Ayame Kirishima and countless other horrors. While their classmates back home search for them, Haruka, Maria, and Nemu’s only hope for survival is to evade the malicious spirits haunting Amare Est Vivere Hospital and dispel Ayame’s curse once and for all.
v46514.description:
名为「轮椅上的彩芽小姐」的咒语流传在街头巷尾。
主人公·七海遥与主播·高梨寝夢、精通超自然的棺まりあ
一起踏入了废弃医院，
在直播的同时举行了「轮椅上的彩芽小姐」之咒语。
随之而来的是，在直播中断的同时，遥等人也一并消失了。

而观看直播的同班同学也随之来到医院，
举行了与遥她们所实施的「轮椅上的彩芽小姐」相同的咒语，随后所有人都失去了意识。
恢复意识后，已身陷于另一家跟原医院似是而非、遭到了诅咒的废弃医院。

彷徨的非人之物四处游荡，令人毛骨悚然的疯狂与怨念笼罩在医院之上，
她们能逃出去吗？
而「轮椅上的彩芽小姐」的咒语的真相是——。

v49686.originalDescription: Iwakura Aria is a brand-new original visual novel from MAGES. It is a dramatic suspense title that depicts the love-and-hate pattern of human relationships and the strong bonds between women. It is a suspenseful human drama set in Japan during a period of rapid economic growth. The rich story, which follows the complex and sometimes contradictory emotions of each character, and the turbulent developments brought about by their emotions, invites players back to “that summer” of 1966.
v49686.description:
『岩仓亚里亚』究竟是谁。
越是靠近就越是遥远——越是追寻那位少女，“我”就越了解真正的自己。

本作存在9个结局。
本篇的33年后——1999年的“我”，走过了怎样的人生呢？
根据选择，完全不同的未来将等待着玩家。

v51716.originalDescription:
Become Kinoshita Kazuya, a worthless college student at a Tokyo university, and live the part-time job lifestyle on Enoshima with charming heroines Mizuhara Chizuru, Sarashina Ruka, Sakurasawa Sumi, and Yaemori Mini in this game-original story. By viewing all endings, you can witness Nanami Mami's story.

An Original Story Set in the Summer on the Island of Enoshima.
Experience an original love story that could have occurred during the anime's third season. Kazuya gathered the funds to shoot a movie starring Chizuru via crowdfunding, but it was not enough! To make up for the insufficient funds, Kazuya stays on the island of Enoshima for the summer, working part-time with the four heroines. It will be impossible for something not to happen while under the same roof—Kazuya's delusions are in full effect!
v51716.description:
为了拍摄千鹤主演的独立制作电影而成功众筹的
和也，却被发现资金不足。

为了筹措资金，决定留宿打工。
地点是江之岛的“民宿”和“海之家”。

和也虽然对把千鹤、瑠夏、墨、美野也卷入其中感到抱歉，
但内心依然对与她们在同一屋檐下度过的特别七天充满期待。

v3662.title: 夢幻奇緣2
v3662.original: ファンタスティックフォーチュン2
aliases: ファンタスティックフォーチュン2
v3662.originalDescription: This love simulation title features three female main characters: Marine, Aqua and Aoi. You select one of these girls and play as her through a seven month training period as you work to become the "Star Maiden." During weekdays, you attend classes, building up your character's parameters. When the weekend comes around, you're off on the town, hunting for men. The game features lots of interactive conversation sequences as you choose to fall in love with a guy, make friends with a girl or work towards your stardom.
v3662.description:
本作背景设定在为大海所环绕的神秘之岛“亚罗兰迪雅”，是传说中神最初降临之地。如玩家要从居住在边境的开朗少女、漂流来到此地的冷漠少女以及来自异世界的正气少女之中选择一位，安排她与游戏中众多男性角色上课，学习气质、武术、魔法、魅力等课程。不一样的老师、不一样的能力都会触发不同的事件，导向不同的结局。
《梦幻奇缘 2》和时下大多数恋爱游戏最大的不同点，在于游戏中提供了三位出身背景、个性完全不同的女主角，让玩家可以自由选择。由于个性的差异，与男主角之间的恋情互动自然会有不同，扮演不同的女主角可以看到男主角们不同的一面，也构成吸引玩家一玩再玩的动力。
游戏故事背景架构在剑与魔法的世界，为了将女主角培养成传说中的“星之少女”，玩家必须安排女主角与游戏中的众男性角色上课学习，每位角色可以教授的课程不同，有剑术、魔法、气质、魅力等。与同一个角色上课久了，衍生出感情的机率必然会比其他人高，也更容易触发相关的事件。
不过，世事无绝对，也许同一种课程上久了，女主角对课程产生的兴趣会远远超过授课老师……依据养成的结果与剧情的发展，3 位主角各有15个迥然不同的结局，要成为拯救世人的星之少女，还是与心爱的角色携手共度此生，答案就在玩家的心中。
第2作的基本构架与第1作相似，一开始从三个女主角中选取一个进行游戏，然后在7个月之内（第1作是1年）安排主角每周的行程，提高主角的属性，从而向不同的结局迈进。在具体的某些细节上，第2作比第1作有了很大的改进。

v18405.originalDescription:
Within a sweeping mansion in a picturesque town lives two children, the primary school kid Houjou Katsuki and her teenage butler Nagahara Hitsuji-kun. The master and mistress of the house have disappeared long ago, leaving the two to fend for themselves.

Since the bread winners have gone, Hitsuji has to take care of both the tiny girl and the expenses in the house. When the funds are running low, an idea hit him. He is going to turn the mansion into a lodging house.

Become Hitsuji, take care of the young lady and get to know the charming girls who come to live under the same roof with you. With a flow like a graphic novel, this game is going to bring a flash of warm color this Spring.
v18405.description:
在一座风景如画的小镇上，一座宏伟的宅邸里住着两个孩子：小学生宝条 一姫(Houjou Katsuki)和她的少年管家永原 羊(Nagahara Hitsuji-kun)。宅邸的男女主人很久以前就失踪了，留下他们两人自力更生。

既然家里的经济支柱已经不在，羊不得不照顾这个小女孩，并承担起宅邸的开销。当资金捉襟见肘时，他想到了一个主意。他打算把这座宅邸改造成寄宿屋。

化身为羊，照顾这位大小姐，并结识那些来与你同住一个屋檐下的迷人女孩们吧。凭借如同图像小说般的流程，这款游戏将在今年春天带来一抹温暖的色彩。

v21903.originalDescription:
My new home is my grandmother’s house that also functions as a café. Due to my grandmother’s recent illness and hospitalization, however, she was forced to close the café until further notice. When I heard about my grandmother’s situation from Chisato Komada (a childhood friend who is like an older sister to me), I looked around the desolate café and my heart was filled with a sense of loneliness. It was then I immediately thought:

    “I want to bring the shop back to life again and show it to grandmother…!!!” 

We renovated the inside of the shop and gave it a new name. We prepared a new menu and café uniforms and began the hiring process to find new, part-time staff. Right away two girls, Niwasaka Rira and Shionomiya Rishie, came into the cafe.

    「“Um… would it be ok if we worked here?”」

An unusually strong breeze blew cherry blossom petals inside the shop and they fluttered and danced around the cafe, myself, and the girls around me. This could only be a premonition of the bittersweet tale that would soon follow…

developers.name: ユニゾンシフト：ブロッサム

v193.originalDescription:
Masaharu Tsuwabuki is a normal student, though not very social. One day he meets a new student named Sumomo Akihime, and another girl named Yaeno Nadeshiko, Sumomo's close friend. That same afternoon, he suddenly bumps into Arthur, a servant of Nona Yuki from Figurare who at the time was disguised with a mask. The collision causes Arthur to drop a bag full of magical potions; amid gathering up the scattered cans, one of them is accidentally switched with Masaharu's soda can. Upon drinking it, he transforms into a stuffed animal lamb at night. He must collect seven stardrops, in order to return to normal.

There are two primary worlds within the story of Nanatsuiro Drops: the human world called Retroscena, and a magical world called Figurare from which the Stellar Spinners originate. There are currently two schools that teach magic within Figurare: Pramu Cloris and Saint Asparas. According to Natsume, each year the two schools pick their top Stellar Spinners (the one from Pramu Cloris is called Prima Pramu, and from Saint Asparas is called Prima Asparas) to send to the human world to capture seven stardrops in a goodwill competition to improve relations.
v193.description:
石蕗正晴是一名普通的学生。有一天下课时不小心撞上了园艺部的女孩——秋姬李子(秋姫すもも)。为了赔罪，就帮忙秋姬李子与她的好友八重野抚子，忙完后他去买了一罐饮料，但是一个不注意撞上了一个抱着不明的果汁的人，同时他的饮料与不明的果汁掉到地上，就这样他也没看清楚就捡起来并喝下了那一罐不明的果汁，使其身体变为在日落后便变成山羊布娃娃般的体质。

为了回复原状，如月夏芽(如月ナツメ)老师说需要由凑集七个“星露”而作成的药。但是，能采集星露只有Stellar Spinear（ステラスピニア）而已。所以他坐着说明书（レシピ，Recipe）去寻找Stellar Spinear，而Stellar Spinear就是秋姬李子，并且被秋姬李子取名为小雪(ユキちゃん)。

v630.originalDescription: Riku, who wants to be a professional violinist, is in love with Chisato, the most beautiful girl at school. He has no connection with her, just looking at her every day. One day, they accidentally get to know each other, and their relationship becomes closer and more intimate. Involving Kai, his older brother, and Narumi, Chisato's closest friend, a pure love story starts....
v630.description:
在音乐氛围浓厚的“雪风町”里，有一所一贯制学校“雪风学园”，少年“朝风陆”就在这里上学。他与双胞胎哥哥“海”出生在一个音乐家夫妇的家庭，从小就一直坚持拉小提琴。10月的某一天，他看到学园里偶像般的美少女“北见千里(北見ちさと)”似乎在沉思着什么。从那天起，陆开始莫名地在意起她来，连小提琴的演奏也无法随心所欲了。不久后，陆意识到自己对千里抱有单相思，但终究觉得配不上她而选择了放弃。

几天后，陆平时常听的广播节目《SMILE WAVE》中，读到了一封明信片，上面写着“招募愿意成为音乐伙伴的雪风学园学生”。产生兴趣的陆来到了作为碰面地点的镇上咖啡店“伦特”。来到那里的是陆所憧憬的少女——千里。寻找伙伴的正是千里，而向节目投稿的是她的好朋友，同时也是伦特看板娘的少女“双川成美(双川なるみ)”。听她们说，两人希望参加当年平安夜在镇上的“雪风大厅”举办的有名比赛“白色合奏”，因此想请陆组建一个组合。

陆本想在一瞬间拒绝，因为他觉得凭自己的实力根本不可能参加水平如此之高的白色合奏，而且也没有满足年龄资格，但由于千里太过恳切地请求，他不由得答应了下来。

陆被要求务必请会弹钢琴的双胞胎哥哥“海”也来帮忙，于是他把那天的事情告诉了哥哥。陆本以为性格别扭的哥哥不可能答应，但出乎意料的是，海坦率地表示会参加。就这样，由陆、海、千里、成美4人组成的组合为了参加白色合奏，开始了练习。

v1179.title: Flyable Heart

developers.name: ユニゾンシフト：ブロッサム

v1179.originalDescription:
――It began with a single envelope.

One day, an admission pamphlet to a famous academy arrived, containing an “all-you-can-eat” cafeteria pass. That alone was enough to lure our hero into visiting the super-prestigious Otori Ryouran College Community, home to students who excel in a variety of fields. Offbeat and unique students like a robot seem natural at Otori Ryouran. Organizing this odd student body is the responsibility of two groups ―― the Student Council and the Ryouran Society.

I was so happy to change schools, so why is a fortuneteller saying ominous things the moment I step out the door!

Why did all the fireworks explode on the bridge!!

And why was the only available room in the women’s dorm!!!

“Be wary, boy who carries an exceptional fate. Misfortune awaits you beyond here.”
v1179.description:
——开端是一封信。
某天收到的著名学园的入学许可证上写有『食堂随便吃』的字样。仅被这一点所诱惑，主人公来到了在各领域拥有优秀才能的学生们所属的超名门学校·私立凤缭兰学园！或许有点古怪的超个性化的学生们和在学园中见怪不怪了的谜之机器人。
这些怪人所聚集的两个集团——『学生会』和『缭兰会』。意气洋洋地转校本来是件好事，但欢迎他的却是预言说他离家后很快会遇到不幸的占卜师！设置在桥上的烟花不知为何发生大爆炸!!并且，不知为何只有女生宿舍能作为自己的房间!!!还不如说是自己被卷入了麻烦之中，等待着转校生·晶的是？新的邂逅、以及或许已经开始的和6位女孩子们的恋爱故事究竟会怎样发展？麻烦不断的学园生活、前途多难的每天拉开帷幕！
「拥有着不寻常命运的少年哟，请多加小心。这之后等待着你的将是不幸～」

v3789.originalDescription:
This is an ‘if’ story from UnisonShift’s popular 2009 title Flyable Heart, focusing on Mayuri. 

One day, Shou received a student pass from the famous private school Hootori Ryouran Gakuen and decides to head there, tempted by free food. There, he meets a girl who is looking far into the distance. Her feelings could not be expressed as simply as lonely or sad.
v3789.description:
以双脚站立，用语言表达，通过双眼看到了一切。
不论冰冷，不论温暖，都凭这手感觉到了。
但是，我却还没有出世——无论这个世界的哪里。

假如在那第一天，没有在那座大桥上被卷入烟花的爆炸呢——？

也还是被“食堂费用全免”的字眼给吸引了的主人公来到的，
是一所拥有各领域优秀才能的学生的超级名校“凤缭兰学园”！
在那里，他遇到了一名少女————。

那个人看起来很远。
给人的感觉，不似在寂寞，不似在悲伤。
不是那样的言语可以表达。

v3811.title: Elle:PrieR ～しあわせの欠片をさがして～

aliases: Elle:PrieR ～しあわせの欠片をさがして～
Elle:PrieR -Searching for the Fragments of Happiness- (English Translation)
v3811.originalDescription: Ryou lives in futuristic city of Oozora-shi and his normal life changes with the arrival of a girl named Konomi. She is an android created by his father who doesn’t have any memories. In order to regain her memories, she attends school and he brings her to many places, talks with her a lot and even does ecchi things occasionally. Who is Konomi and why does Ryou want her to regain her memories?
v3811.description:
系统介绍

本作采用的，是稍微有点奇怪的系统——『真心系统』。
通过使用在ADV部分所找寻到的“心点”，将失去了的このみ的“记忆”找回来。
顺利地找回记忆的话，故事就能进行下去，但有时也会找到このみ以外，其他人的记忆哦！？
 
 
故事情节
这里是未来都市——宙市，主人公江戸川菱就是在这里度过自己学园生活的。
然而，他的日常生活却随着父亲所带来的某个少女而完全改变，她就是稚气未脱的『門真このみ』。
而且，科学家的父亲也告诉了菱，那位少女是他以人造人的躯体创造出来的机器人。
欠缺“记忆”的她在父亲的提议下，将以菱的亲戚的身份，和他一起度过学园生活。

为了取回門真このみ的“记忆”，菱不得不到处奔波。
为什么她想要取回自己的“记忆”呢？
而真正的『門真このみ』，又到底是谁呢？
在这近未来、稍稍有点不可思议的城镇里，让人怦然心动的故事即将开始……

v3823.originalDescription: Haruki used to live with his mother, but now moves in with his relatives: 4 sisters born from 4 different mothers, but the same father. Their father was a traveling magician who used magic on them before disappearing. There is only one way to remove the magic: all 5 of them must build a close family bond to each other. However, can Haruki resist temptation being with such cute girls and view them as just family?
v3823.description:
主人公・小倉春喜原本和母亲两人一起生活，但因为某些原因，要在亲戚家生活。
然而那个亲戚，是自称主人公同父异母姐妹的四个女孩子。
她们全员母亲不同，但父亲是同一个人。
——父亲是游走世界各地的旅行魔术师。
但听说他其实能使用并非魔术的真正的“魔法”，并对姐妹们施加了某种“魔法”后消失了。
据她们所说，解开施加在自己身上的魔法的方法只有一个——
包括主人公在内的5个兄弟姐妹，必须用“家族的羁绊”连结在一起。
「几乎都是初次见面，而且这么可爱的女孩子们，怎么可能一下子就当成家人啊！」
主人公究竟能否与女主角们用“家族的羁绊”连结在一起呢？

v5474.title: 籠中的艾莉希絲
v5474.originalDescription:
Long time ago there was a peaceful and prosperous land. The central tree there supplied life to the world. One day, the tree began to wither. The people of the world began fighting, but one girl came up to the tree and began crying in front of it. Her tears were filled with love and they began to rejuvenate the withered tree. With her love, the tree flourished and all was right with the world. She became known as ‘Alicis’ and was locked into a cage. One day, Alicis fell in love with a man. The tree began to wither because Alicis had given all her love to the man instead of the tree. The two decided to escape the cage and go to a different world. Once they entered that world, a bright light shone and the girl died. The man despaired and hated all light from that moment on. His hatred covered the world and brought darkness to a world that never knew anything other than light.

The heroine, Sumeragi Runa, once again sees the tree in her dream. It’s her quiet place where she can just relax, but all the sudden the tree begins to wither. She attempts to save it, but before she actually does anything she wakes up. On the way to school, she hears a voice and is suddenly transported to a different world by M and L, the guardians of that world (Luche).  Before she hounds them for answers, a guy with red hair appears and whisks her away at the guardians request.

While walking, he introduces himself as Harvey and asks that she not tack on a ‘-san’ at the end of his name. He’s happy that she seems like a good kid though she’s kind of tainted with noir. He brings her to a castle called Sefira and introduces her to the rest of the Roacrysto.
v5474.description:
极其普通地长大的女主角皇瑠奈。
某天，被人搭话回过头去后被光芒包围失去了意识。

醒来的地方是被称为“露切”的异世界。

从出生起就佩戴在身上的闪耀光芒的宝石碎片。
据说那是被这个世界选中，成为“露切”的中心存在“艾莉希丝（アリシス）”的证明。

在双胞胎守卫艾姆（エム）与艾尔（エル）的引导下前往的城堡“塞菲拉”里的是
被称为“罗亚克里斯托”的9名护卫。

被大家请求成为这个世界的中心“艾莉希丝”，
但查明作为证明的瑠奈所持有的碎片并没有保持本来的形状。
于是开会讨论是不是错误地把人召唤到了这个世界……

瑠奈怀有这个世界被视为禁忌的“诺瓦尔（负面感情）”，
仅仅因此，就得出了是那种感情扭曲了碎片的结论。

为了成为“艾莉希丝”必须净化“诺瓦尔”，
罗亚克里斯托们决定对瑠奈进行心灵的教育。

但是，为了成为“艾莉希丝”，必须以面向世界的爱作为交换，
舍弃自己各种各样的情感……

v5575.title: Flyable CandyHeart
aliases: フライアブル キャンディハート

developers.name: ユニゾンシフト：ブロッサム

v5575.originalDescription:
Flyable CandyHeart features the full cast of the original game as well as cameos from Nanatsuiro★Drops, Alice♥Parade, Peace@Pieces and Kiminago. 

There are individual spin-off routes for each of the six FH heroines, the new routes for Yui and Suzuno are the final pieces to the multiple route mystery of the original game.

FCH also features three bonus routes; one for everyone's favorite student council secretary Gumi-chan, one in which Shou has the opportunity to become even more intimate friends with Akira, and finally the mega crossover route.
v5575.description:
本作是追加《Flyable Heart》女主角们之后的故事与另一线剧本的衍生作品！
此外，还准备了让Unison Shift的いとうのいぢ作品过往作品角色登场的剧本，
将展开色彩丰富的集大成故事！

■□■各故事■□■

●稻羽结衣(稲羽結衣)story
圣诞派对临近的寒假，结衣和晶在宿舍悠闲度日，
却因为吃了电堂明(マックス)制作的圣诞蛋糕试作品而体重增加，
被天音要求宿舍全体成员一起减肥！

●皇天音story
热爱活动的学生会长提出突发企划，决定举办生存烧烤。
那天本该是约会的日子，但放心不下的天音和晶决定参加。
然而这个企划似乎有会长的什么盘算……？

●雪代铃乃(雪代すずの)story
宛如从一开始就在那里一样，铃乃过着作为凤缭兰学园学生的日子。
半哭着完成了丧尸试胆，尽情享受着校园生活。
某天晶对自己的记忆感到违和感。那是转学来这所学园的那天的事情……。

●水无濑樱子(水無瀬桜子)story
观察期结束，从医院出院的樱子作为学生转入恋人晶等待的凤缭兰学园。
樱子凭借其容貌和气质转眼间便吸引了同学们的目光。
另一方面樱子对于新的学园和与晶的生活，也有各种困惑之处……。

●九条玖琉璃(九条くるり)story
学园理事长皇千羽耶将玖琉璃托付给了晶。
"我觉得你能让玖琉璃变得更像女孩子一些"，
晶说服玖琉璃去买像女孩子一样可爱的衣服，
但平时只穿制服和运动服的玖琉璃完全不知道怎么穿……。

●白鹭茉百合(白鷺茉百合)story
茉百合决定离开白鹭家。那时，小百合作为白鹭家当主的代理来到学园。
晶想起没有交谈一句便离开家的两人，试图将小百合引见给茉百合。

●早河惠(早河恵)story
为了缭兰祭的活动，小惠制作的"丘比特系统"
是一个让电堂明握住手就能显示男女相性度的系统，
在测试中查看晶和小惠的相性度时……电堂明得出的答案是，显示为100％！
"什、什么——！……小、小惠的命运之人，是小晶同学吗————！！！"
对恋爱完全不感兴趣的小惠采取的行动是……？

●电堂晶(電堂あきら)story
"晶！●ふらいあぶるなないろぴぃしぃずぶろっさむすぺしゃるぱれーどハザード
简称"らぶらぶフライアブルハザード"
凤缭兰学园的姐妹校游华综合学园的百濑光(百瀬ヒカル)和秋月奈纪(秋月ナギ)作为机械部被邀请参加缭兰祭，
接受了拆解奈纪制作的机械的委托，
却错误地带来了装有危险病毒的东西。
据说小心处理的话就没问题，但感染病毒后"只会变得有点亲亲热热的状态"……。
与不可思议的毛绒玩具"小雪(ユキちゃん)"和谜之粉色生物"艾姆多利(エムドリ)"一起，
葛木晶能否从袭来的亲亲热热丧尸中逃脱！？

v8174.title: 氷華の舞う空に
v8174.originalDescription: Suou lived in a small town blanketed by snow every winter. One day, his cousin Shiina moved in with him after her parents went overseas. Her transfer into the school so close to the winter vacation was the talk of the school. It had been a long time since he had seen her and their time together is quite different from back then. Then a rumour spread that the school might be closed down…
v8174.description:
遗忘的记忆，与小小的邂逅。
一到冬天就格外寒冷，被白雪覆盖的一座地方城市。
主人公·樱咲周防居住的城镇，也在等待着这样一个冬天的到来。

某一天，表妹冰见川椎奈以父母海外出差为由，搬到了周防他们这里。
在连寒假都已临近的时期，时机错位的转学生。
对于这座小镇的学校来说，这提供了足够多的话题。

久违的重逢，与新的邂逅。
在逐渐被冬日景象包围的城镇里，周防他们度过着与以往略有不同的时光。

曾一度甚至传出过废校传闻的学校——故事便从那里开始。

v10016.originalDescription:
In a mysterious school where day and night are two separate worlds, a mismatched trio works to resolve magic-related incidents.

Michiru is a newly enrolled first-year student at a boarding school with a notably large clock tower, located deep in the mountains. Unfortunately, on his first day of school, he gets caught up in some sudden trouble, and accidentally breaks an expensive-looking statue.

In order to compensate for the broken statue, the principal orders him and the boy who caused the incident to work for the school’s “Bureau for the Investigation of Special Affairs.”

When they arrive at the Bureau’s headquarters, a room situated in the school’s enormous underground library, a girl is waiting for them there with an apathetic look on her face.

The girl informs the confused pair of the situation: Magic exists in this school.

When the clock tower chimes, the “Realm of Night” appears, and merges with the school building. The Bureau’s job is to take care of the supernatural problems that arise. And so, Michiru struggles to protect the school from troublesome magical items known as “Mists”...
v10016.description:
以分为昼与夜两个世界的不可思议学园为舞台，性格迥异的三人组面对与魔术相关的难题的故事。

主人公作为新生来到了深山中耸立着巨大钟塔的全寄宿制学园。然而，在初次登校的那天突然被卷入麻烦，弄坏了学园入口处看似昂贵的雕像。被校长指示代替赔偿工作一段时间的主人公，与成为麻烦原因的一名男学生一起被分配到了“特殊事案调查分室”。

去到位于巨大地下图书馆深处的分室房间一看，那里有一位神情冷淡的少女在等待着。在不明所以的情况下，两人被少女告知。这所学园里，存在着真正的魔术———。伴随着钟塔的钟声，学园会出现“夜之世界”，并与校舍融为一体。

分室的工作，是解决学园中发生的所有魔术问题。就这样，主人公们虽然被各种“遗品（ミスト）”所捉弄，但为了学园而四处奔走——。

One day, they gathered together for an off-kai and he was surprised that most of them were cute little girls! Even though he is good at taking care of others, he doesn’t do so well with girls. 很会照顾人的主人公虽然不擅长应付现实中的女性，但被大家所仰慕，开始一起结伴行动。
当然，结伴去的地方全都是御宅族专用的、非常硬核的店……。

v11093.originalDescription: Michiru and Ushio continue to spend their days solving problems at Tenbinruri Academy as part of the special investigation office, otherwise known as ‘Tokusa’. One day, a foreign girl named Adelheid came to seek their help in looking for her grandmother’s memento. Along the way, will they find out more about the link between the day and night worlds?
v11093.description:
学园隐藏的秘密，黄昏时分交错的两个世界。
……你们没有感到疑问吗？他们从哪里来，又要回到哪里去
夜与昼的界线终有一天——会交汇吗。

位于深山的全寄宿制学园“天秤瑠璃学园”。
矗立着巨大时钟塔的那个地方，并非只是一座普通的学园——。
主人公·满琉作为转校生来到这所学园后，背负起了“特殊事案调查分室”通称“特查”的职责。
满琉与特查的同伴忧绪等人一起，度过着解决这所不可思议的学园中发生的各种麻烦的日常。

就在这样的某一天，学园里出现了一位意料之外的访客。
为了寻找祖母的纪念品，远从异国而来的少女·阿德尔海特。
这位不好对付的客人，被推给了特查的众人。
“是呢。就让我见识一下你们的本事吧”
在围绕阿德尔海特寻找失物的日子里，此前理所当然流逝着的所有时间开始转动。
那就是——学园隐藏的秘密，黄昏时分交错的两个世界。

他们究竟是从哪里来的？又要回到哪里去？
而夜与昼的界线终有一天——会交汇吗？
面对全新的谜团与秘密，主人公们的奔波再次开始！

v11433.originalDescription: After his father’s death, Jin was separated from his 365 imoutos and ended up living overseas. He told them to live ‘strongly’ until he comes back to them. Ten years later, he reunited with his imoutos in Japan… and they are all banchous!? Not only that, but it was said that the strongest imouto will become oniichan’s bride. Could it be that they misunderstood what he said?
v11433.description:
「总有一天我会去接大家。所以，在那之前要坚强地活下去哦」
以父亲的去世为契机家人变得四分五裂，
在与365个妹妹们也离散之后，
主人公决定在海外生活。
那之后经过了十几年的岁月…… 
久违重逢的妹妹们，
不知为何成了“番长”。
而且，
“如果成为日本最强的妹妹，就能成为哥哥的新娘”
似乎成了这样的规定。
因为不得了的误会而引发的哥哥争夺战！
被作为番长生活过来的妹妹们的“常识”所折腾，学园生活充满了大骚动！
主人公究竟能否和这些乱来的妹妹们一起，
找回大家和睦相处的生活的日子呢！？
番长妹妹365人与1个哥哥的，
佛耻义理心跳学园罗武虎灭D 盛大开幕——！！

v12440.title: Yes, Your Highness
aliases: イエス・ユアハイネス
v12440.originalDescription: This is Himawari’s debut title. A war had continued for a long long time in a certain country. With peace and order lost, it was no longer the happiest country in the world and poor people filled the streets. It had become difficult for people to see hope in their futures. At that time, Munakata was called the hero of the country – never having suffered a defeat in any battle. The new post which was bestowed upon him was not in the blood-stained and mud-caked battlefield, but rather in a faintly-fragrant and extravagantly-decorated mansion. His duty was to protect the royal princess Sakurako while she spends her days sheltered away from the outside world.
v12440.description:
只是，为了您我才活下去

那是某个时代、某个国度的故事。

漫长、漫长、漫长地持续着，久到让人忘记了是从何时开始的战争。

曾经被称为世界上最幸福的国度，如今已面目全非，治安混乱，街头满是贫穷的人们……

即便如此战争仍未结束，人们已难以在未来的黑暗中寻得光明。

在这样的时代。

被称为国之英雄，据说凡他所赴战场从未败北的男人。

他被赋予的新驻地，不是沾满鲜血、泥土与尘埃的战场，而是弥漫着淡淡香水香气、被华丽装饰环绕的宅邸。

担任以任性闻名的皇女殿下的护卫。

在与世情隔绝的宅邸中，日复一日优雅度日的她。

那是因为不谙世事，还是看透了一切……。

于是，今天也开始了宁静的一天。

aliases: プレスタ！～Precious☆Star’sフェスティバル～

v12488.originalDescription: Hibikinomori Gakuen is a huge school with a wide variety of specializations, some of them quite different from standard ones. Yoshitaka is in the general education curriculum, but he felt like he had made no precious memories since entering the school. His best friend Suminao jokingly suggested that he be the producer for this year’s Precious☆Star’s Festival (also known as Prestar), the flashy concert which is the focus of the school festival. He was able to get the position with some difficulty, but what surprised him was that all the performers were all-stars: a highly-popular top idol, a world-famous pianist, a pro mangaka/illustrator and a promising Olympian in rhythmic gymnastics. Will he be able to make Prestar a success?
v12488.description:
不仅有普通学科，还设有丰富多彩的专门学科的巨大学园——响之森学园。
在该学园普通科就读的主人公·仓岛芳崇，对于自己从入学至今没有任何值得一提的回忆而产生了危机感。

焦急地觉得必须做点什么的芳崇，被好友推荐参加『Precious☆Star's庆典』。

这是一个“融入了宛如音乐剧与马戏融为一体的华丽娱乐表演，前所未有的全新演唱会”这般鲁莽的计划，但芳崇竟然决定参加『PreciStar』。

然而，比这更让大家惊讶的是，目前人气急升中的准顶级偶像、世界闻名的钢琴家、不仅作品内容连容貌也备受瞩目的漫画家兼插画师、下届奥运会有力候补的女子体操希望之星——

这4位堪称全明星的人物竟然也报名参加了。

芳崇对此满怀期待而心潮澎湃，但这只不过是学园祭前发生的各种突发事件、难以想象的辛苦，以及为人际关系而烦恼的前兆罢了。

芳崇究竟能否顺利迎来学园祭当天，与女主角们一起成功完成企划节目呢——？

v13342.originalDescription:
This is the first title by piriri!, a sister brand of UnisonShift, Hearts and Qoobrand, under the AMUSE CRAFT company. 

It is said that one who graduates from the famous private school Kamishiro Gakuen will definitely become successful in life. The best students at the school are called ‘knights’ and are admired by all. This year, five good childhood friends were selected as the ‘knights’: sourpuss Yukitaka, serious Kei, cheerful Ruruka, timid Asuna and cool Touri. Even though he had some feelings for all of them, he spent his days without pursuing any deeper relationships. That was until he found out about a secret ‘duel game’ which only the knights can participate in.
v13342.description:
传闻只要毕业就必定能获得成功，吸引了全国学生聚集的名门・私立神城学園。
在这里，优秀的学生们被称为“骑士生”，成为了全体学生的憧憬。
那一年，有5个关系要好的青梅竹马被选为了学园的“骑士生”。
唯一的男生，披着朴素角色外皮的别扭主人公・雪隆。
认真且强势，总是吵架的 慧。
开朗且爱照顾人，大家的姐姐角色・瑠々花。
容易害羞，总是躲在大家身后的 明日奈。
头脑聪明，无论何时都我行我素且酷酷的 冬莉。
雪隆与4人虽然互相在意，却度过了无法成为另一种深层关系的日子。
但是，他们却得知了只有学园骑士才能参加的秘密“决斗游戏”的存在。
然后，为了某个目的，雪隆做出了一个决意。
“无论使用什么手段，我都要……！”

v14893.title: 偽骸のアルルーナ
v14893.originalDescription: People enjoy peaceful and rich lives thanks to the protection of the World Tree. However, this peace was shattered by monsters called ghoula which attack and eat humans. Despair filled the world since there was no way to combat this sudden invasion, but they won’t go down without a fight. A self-defence corps was assembled as a last line of defence against the ghoulas. Will joined them not only to protect the townspeople, but to also seek revenge for his family which was taken from him by the ghoulas when he was small.
v14893.description:
这是一个受世界树庇护，承诺了和平与丰裕生活的世界。然而那份平稳，在某一天被打破了。袭击人类、吞噬人类的怪物“古拉”。面对其突然出现，人们束手无策，世界充满了死亡、恐惧与悲伤。

但是，人们也并非只是默默接受这一事件。为了对抗“古拉”，作为保护人们的最后利刃，创立了自警团。

主人公威尔(ウィル)是幼年时期被“古拉”夺走家人的少年。他为了向家人复仇，并且为了保护镇上的人们，立志成为自警团的战士。在训练途中与各种各样的人相遇的交流中，他所抵达的未来是……？

v15147.title: 世界を救うだけの簡単なお仕事
v15147.original: 世界を救うだけの簡単なお仕事
aliases: 世界を救うだけの簡単なお仕事
Sekai o Sukuu Dake no Kantan na Oshigoto
A Simple Task Just to Save the World
只需拯救世界的简单工作
v15147.originalDescription:
Arata is a hot-blooded guy who aims to become a hero and runs about every day helping others along with his osananajimi Akari. One day, he received a mail looking for heroes to save the world. He thought it was just spam, but it was actually a genuine contract mail. His room became a gate to another world Ragnagia and an epic adventure full of laughs and tears awaited them… or so he thought.

It took a mere day for him to defeat the maou and save the world. After hearing the ending theme play, seeing the credits roll by and a short epilogue, the gate to the other world shut and it was the end of this story.

However, when he returned to his room he received the same mail as before and the gates to Ragnagia opened once more. It seemed that the maou would reappear after a set period. When he arrived at the maou’s castle, he discovered that the new maou Ciel was useless. He helped her instead of attacking her and she fell in love with him at first sight.

When he and Akari returned victorious, they found out that they couldn’t return back to their original world. So, they continued their hero duties while looking for a way home. Will they be able to do so? And what is the meaning behind the respawning maou?
v15147.description:
光岛新(光島新)虽然生在现代日本，却以成为英雄为目标每天不断努力，是个有点……不，相当奇怪的热血学生。
和青梅竹马兼知己月见里灯(月見里灯)一起为了帮助他人，今天也在某处东奔西走。
在这样的新等人面前，收到了一封邮件。
“招募勇者 只需拯救世界的简单工作”
那乍看之下只是垃圾邮件，仔细读读也果然只是垃圾邮件。
然而，那封垃圾邮件却是通往异世界的真正的契约邮件。
新房间的门连接到了异世界·拉格纳吉亚(ラグナギア)，作为勇者与魔王战斗！
友情、努力、胜利。然后，有笑有泪的大长篇冒险现在正要拉开帷幕！
本该如此的……
“抱歉，一不小心就把魔王打倒了”
被召唤仅仅一天。新就轻易地打倒了魔王。
传来的片尾曲，流出的制作人员名单，以及开始的尾声。
通往异世界的门关闭了，故事轻易地完结了。
尽管如此，
“招募勇者 只需拯救世界的简单工作”
回到原来世界的新那里，再次收到了那封邮件。
然后再次被召唤到拉格纳吉亚的新等人被告知。这个世界正在定期地产生魔王。
但是，闯入魔王城的新等人面前出现的新生魔王·希尔(シエル)，却是个如画中走出的废柴魔王……
无法对被击退而哭出来的希尔补刀，反而帮助了他的新，以及对这样的勇者大人一见钟情的魔王大人。
就这样，果然离大冒险还很远的，结束了第二次魔王城攻略凯旋的新，得知自己等人已经回不到原来的世界了。
于是两人顺其自然，为了寻找回到原来世界的方法而继续勇者的事业。
新等人能平安回到自己的世界吗？反复诞生的魔王究竟有什么意义？
这是超越了“打倒魔王”这一结局之后的故事。

v15731.title: カミツレ ～7の二乗不思議～
v15731.original: カミツレ ～7の二乗不思議～
aliases: カミツレ ～7の二乗不思議～
洋甘菊 ～7的平方不可思议～
v15731.originalDescription:
Mutsuki is very much a girl. However, she knew ever since she was a child that a ‘boy’ existed inside of her. Sometimes he would appear to help her, sometimes to trouble her. Her parents soon divorced because of this and she was separated from her dear twin little sister Nanami.

The years passed and there was a new transfer student to Mutsuki’s all girls school at the end of the summer vacation of her first year. It was her long-separated twin Nanami. However, her personality had changed from doting to cool. Mutsuki was worried that Nanami would become outcasted in the class, but she was particularly cold to her.

She heard from her roommate about one of the school’s seven mysteries, the large mirror in the concert hall. She went there and asked the mirror what she should do. At that moment, she was swallowed up by an ‘alternate time’, then reappeared in front of the mirror. There was a bright light and she heard a voice say to her: “I will grant your wish”.

When she came to, she was in her own room. Was it a dream or was it real? She was holding a small mirror in her hand. From that moment on, the relationships between Mutsuki and Nanami, as well as with the girls around them, began to change greatly.
v15731.description:
主人公平岡睦月从幼时起就察觉到了存在于自己之中的另一个自己的存在。
存在于身为女孩的自己之中的“男孩子”的自己。
那有时会自动出现在表层，帮助自己或是困扰自己。
然后因为与此相关的麻烦事，睦月的家庭变得生硬不自然，父母离婚了。和关系要好的妹妹・七海也变得分开了。
从那以后大约过了10年。
转学到睦月就读的女校的七海，与睦月所知的她相比，氛围已经大不相同了。
睦月希望能和那样的七海像以前一样亲密地度过。
与此同时，她开始苦恼地想，自己对七海抱有的感情，或许并不是作为姐姐，而是作为存在于心中的“男孩子”的感情。
某天，室友告诉她的校园七大不可思议。据说在音乐堂的镜子对面会展开一个“颠倒的世界”。
半信半疑地前往音乐堂的睦月，在那里遇见了镜子的妖精……
“我来实现你的愿望哦”
获得了作为男孩子的身体。

Mitsuyoshi thought that the cause might have been a fire that happened at the school 20 years ago, and began to investigate this incident in order to reunite with his friend Kotarou who had disappeared as a ‘night school student’. Meanwhile, the school principal who had also vanished secretly planned to bring back the night world from the other side. All of the remaining mysteries of the school will finally be brought to light.
v16212.description: 我一直在寻找你。你，在边界的另一边——每晚出现在学院的“夜之世界”已经崩塌，“夜之学生”也随之消失。主人公们认为20年前学院的一场大火是这一切的根源，为了与那些作为“夜之学生”消失的朋友们重聚，他们开始调查这场大火的真相。与此同时，曾经消失的校长却暗中着手重启“夜之世界”。围绕着学院的所有谜团，最终都将揭晓——

v18335.title: 一如她的撒娇方式。
v18335.original: 甘えかたは彼女なりに。
aliases: 甘えかたは彼女なりに。
A synopsis of girls who don't flatter me.
v18335.originalDescription:
“It’s not like I can’t make friends. I just don’t want to.”

That’s what Hiroto says as he pretends that it was his own choice to be alone, but it would have been rather difficult for others to approach him with his slightly frightening looks and general surliness. His classmates also kept their distance from the strikingly beautiful Tomomi, who would chide anyone who bothered her.

One day, Tomomi came up to Hiroto in the courtyard while he was enjoying lunch by himself. He thought she was going to confess to him, prompting a stern rebuke from her, as she was flabbergasted at his unexpected misunderstanding. Actually, she wanted him to come with her after school to the ‘assistance committee’, which is committee under the control of the student council for helping troubled students. However, he hadn’t heard anyone say goods things about it; in fact, it was dreaded to the extent that it is nicknamed the ‘meddling committee’.
v18335.description:
“不是交不到朋友，而是不交朋友。”
如此自甘沦为“孤僻”的主人公，柴宫浩斗。因为略带凶相的外表和平时冷淡的态度，就算不主动把自己孤立起来也足够让人难以接近，这一点就保密了……

“别管我。”
抱着这样的想法，用毒舌将周围人拒于千里之外的绝世美少女，新仓朋美。总觉得是同类人的两人相遇，故事便由此开始——

“……能陪我吗？”
某天的午休时间。出现在正在中庭独自享受午餐的浩斗面前的朋美，说出了一句出乎意料的台词，让浩斗慌了神。朋美对这意想不到的误会感到无语，冷静地发飙了。总而言之就是“放学后有要带你去的地方”，但被带去的地方是连在学园里都没听过什么好评价的、名为“协助会”的学生会管辖下的委员会。

浩斗也知道它有着“多管闲事会”的异名，被学园学生所畏惧，但是……

v18670.title: 夏色心跳日志
v18670.originalDescription:
One day, Yoshito was challenged by his senpai Kisara to a match in a fighting game. Even though he was confident in his skills, she was a top ranker and beat him handily. As a result, he had to join the cyber-research club that she was the leader of. It was a relatively new club, but it soon became lively with the addition of his osananajimi and student council deputy leader Kuon, his dependable imouto Rin and classmate Kotone.

At the start of summer vacation, Yoshito was asked by the club’s advisor Kanae to help test out a love simulation game that’s in development. However, all the female avatars in the game were played by the girls in the cyber-research club! Once it was revealed that his avatar had an AI which mimicked his personality, they interacted with him in ways that they normally wouldn’t in real life. Traversing the line between reality and imagination, he could see the true feelings of the heroines who are not honest with their feelings. Their summer love story begins now.
v18670.description:
就读于私立芦之宫学园的主人公·臣苗嘉人(おみなお よしと)，
某天突然被前辈名城绮新(なぎ きさら)挑战格斗游戏。

对自己技术有自信的嘉人接受了挑战，但绮新其实是格斗游戏的顶尖玩家“Nagi”。
轻易输掉比赛的嘉人，被迫加入了由她担任部长的电脑研究部。

电脑研究部刚刚成立，部员很少，
嘉人的青梅竹马兼学生会副会长的常磐久远(ときわ くおん)，以调查新设社团为名义加入了进来。
此外，嘉人的妹妹、做事可靠的臣苗铃(おみなえ りん)，
带着同班同学兼朋友的七国都音(ななくに ことね)也加入了社团，一下子变得热闹起来。

暑假开始的某天，嘉人受电脑研究部顾问梅宫香奈惠(うめみや かなえ)的委托，
答应担任正在开发中的恋爱模拟游戏的测试员，
但游戏中登场的女孩虚拟形象的真身，竟然是电脑研究部的女部员们！？

女部员们被告知，作为恋爱对象的男孩虚拟形象的真身是模仿嘉人性格制作的人工智能，因此她们都以平时不会展现的态度来对待他。
嘉人对与现实世界的差异感到困惑，但还是开始了恋爱模拟……

在虚拟与现实的夹缝中若隐若现的，是她们可爱的真心与无法坦白的心声……
与无法坦率的女主角们共度的，一个夏天的恋爱故事现在开始——

v18690.title: 孤僻少女改造计划
v18690.original: ボッチムスメ×プロデュース計画。
aliases: ボッチムスメ×プロデュース計画。
v18690.originalDescription:
Tachibana Ema is a tall, gloomy and unsociable girl with a bad case of resting bitch-face. With all that working against her, she's never really had any friends. At school, everyone's too scared to approach her.

But Ema herself is quite content with that state of affairs. In fact, she was all set to spend the rest of her time until graduation invisible as ever...

That is, until two men turned her life upside down!

"It's you... I've finally found you! You are, without a doubt, MY MUSE!"

Hiraizumi Miki—recently returned to Japan from abroad, he's loved making clothes ever since he was a little kid. He has a strong desire to help make charming, unusual women shine. (He's also a bit of a masochist.)

"Listen up, twerp! You're no good the way you are now. But even you have some potential to shine... I'll just have to polish you up!"

And Shinjou Saito—he frequently finds himself bored because things have always come easy to him. He aspires to accomplish something so big, it'll change the world. (He's also a bit of a sadist.)

These two ambitious and attractive fellows decide to give Tachibana Ema a makeover!

But Ema has other ideas.

"Yeah, well... Who asked you?!”
v18690.description:
严厉的面容、高挑的身材、阴沉且不会察言观色的性格……
这些部分成了负面因素，导致橘花绘磨从小就被孤立。
即使升入新学校这一状况也没有改变，周围的人害怕她，谁都不想靠近她。
然而性格阴郁的绘磨却甘于这种状况，
觉得就这样作为透明人度过到毕业就好。
绘磨这样的人生，将由两名男性来改变。
“终于找到了。你……你才是我的缪斯！”
但是，你也有能闪耀的地方。由我来引导你”
从小就非常喜欢做衣服，
从小就对无所不能的自己感到无聊，
由怀揣野心与美貌的这对搭档发起的橘花绘磨改造计划开始了！
“不……我并没有期望那种事……”

v18759.originalDescription:
Kouryoukan Academy student Naoto keeps a secret even from his closest friends. It is his ability to read and write into the memories of others by merely touching them. While he could have easily abused this power, he considers it too much of a bother and carries on his life as normal.

However, threatening events began to frequently happen around him as Tanabata approached: the discovery of a mangled corpse of a girl, a large terrorist blast with civilian casualties, and the disappearance of his osananajimi Saaya. He was perplexed at the events which unfolded, but when a girl showed up to kill him, he found out that the town had become a stage for a fight to the death between combatants with superpowers.

He managed to flee just as he was about to be killed. Then, it struck midnight and a blinding light enveloped the area. When he came to his senses, he found himself back three days earlier.

Naoto is one of 7 ‘rebellion’ chosen by some mysterious figure. He must kill the other six, otherwise the world will be destroyed in 3 days. The victor would have the power to grant any wish as the new ‘God’.
v18759.description:
「Liber7献给在永劫终末等待着的你」
虽然拥有操纵右手触碰之物的记忆的能力，但为了不引人注目而度过着平稳学园生活的主人公・石动直斗(石動直斗)。
然而在某个夏日，突然收到了一封企图让包括他在内的特殊能力者们互相争斗的邮件！
不由分说地被卷入战斗，迎来了毁灭的直斗。
然而下一瞬间，他回到了3天前的早晨，得知自己觉醒了新的能力……。

v19131.title: にーづま部!! －放課後はえっちな花嫁修業だよ－
v19131.original: にーづま部!! －放課後はえっちな花嫁修業だよ－
aliases: にーづま部!! －放課後はえっちな花嫁修業だよ－
Ni-zumabu!! -Houkago wa ecchi na Hanayome Shuugyou da yo-
新妻部!! －放学后是色色的新娘修行哦－
v19131.description:
时代是近未来。比现在少子化更加严重的世界。
政府鼓励年轻人结婚，决定将年轻妻子可爱地称为“新妻”。
作为“新妻计划”，媒体也展开了“新妻很潮！”等一大宣传活动。
而其效果不仅波及了原本作为对象的年轻人，也波及了老年人。
颇具这个国家的特色，“新妻应当贞淑”“新妻是良妻贤母的象征”等等，
虽然附加了多余的枝叶，但大体上产生了政府所预期的结果。

那样的时代。某所名门女子学园的某个“香道部”。
曾经以良妻贤母教育闻名但如今濒临废部的那个部，多亏了“新妻计划”勉强存续。
并且因为培养出了争夺日本第一新妻的“新妻奥林匹克”金牌得主，让人感受到了复活的气息。

在这样的机运中，学园向身为香道家元的主人公·拓真委托师范。
欣然答应并来到学园的拓真遇到的是，
曾经作为青梅竹马共享了快乐回忆和酸甜回忆的2个女孩。

v19391.originalDescription:
Kusukuni Kyouji has attained an almost legendary status as a freelance prep school teacher, owing to his helping many problem-, and weak-students all pass their college entrance exams (for institutions with a high entrance-examination difficulty).
And such a legend was called upon for a job this summer.
The request was made by the industry's top prep school which holds a girls-only study camp every year on a resort hotel island somewhere in the south of Japan. And they want him to come and teach there.
However, it so happens that his modus operandi when it comes to teaching is: first do lewd tasks together and dramatically increase their potential capabilities and enhance their metabolism.
And thus, in the summer island, education marked with lewdness begins......
v19391.description:
将无数差生和问题儿童全都送入难关学校的传说中的自由预备校讲师・楠国恭司。
这样的他，在这个夏天，收到了一个委托。
来自业界第一的天神原予備校，希望他能来担任每年在度假酒店岛上举行的女子限定预备校合宿的讲师。
然而，他的指导方法就是“通过H的启蒙指导来飞跃性地提高潜在能力和代谢”。
在夏天的南国岛屿上，充满H的指导开始了——

v19530.title: いもーと特区〜妹と結婚できるいい時代になりました〜
v19530.original: いもーと特区〜妹と結婚できるいい時代になりました〜
aliases: いもーと特区〜妹と結婚できるいい時代になりました〜
Imouto Tokku ~Imouto to Kekkon Dekiru Ii Jidai ni Narimashita~
妹妹特区~能与妹妹结婚的好时代来临了
v19530.originalDescription:
The protagonist, Imose Hiroshi, had been overseas for five years because he fell out of favor with the company's slick manager.
When he finally finishes his duty and returns home, he is greeted by his three beloved sisters.
He decides to fully use the month-long vacation he has received from his company for his sisters, who have been waiting for him...

Meeting them after five years, they have grown up to be attractive girls with abundant fruits. What's more, all of them had developed an increased love for their brother that they had harbored since early childhood!

On the day the National Diet passed the "special law allowing you to marry your younger sister," nicknamed "Sister Zone" after great controversy as a special remedy for the declining birthrates with no improvement in sight, the sisters furiously started making advances, literally putting their life on the line! What will Hiroshi do in this situation?
v19530.description:
被公司里能干的部长看上真是倒了八辈子血霉，在海外待了5年之久的

　　主人公·妹背（いもせ）浩。

　　终于结束了那份差事，迎接回国的他的是他最爱的

　　3个妹妹。

　　决定将从公司得到的昔日一个月的休假全部用来陪伴一直等待着自己的妹

　　妹们……。

　　时隔5年，妹妹们已经成长为丰满成熟的魅力女孩。而且

　　她们全体将自幼起便怀揣的对哥哥的爱情

　　升级了！

　　正巧，作为看不到改善迹象的少子化的特效药，在国会大纷斜之后成立的

　　“能和妹妹结婚的特别法”，通称“妹妹特区”

　　正式投入运用的那一天，面对妹妹们激烈的、字面意义上豁出身

　　体的求爱，浩究竟会怎么做呢！！是男人的话，那种事，早就决定好了吧！！

v19886.title: 才没有呼唤神明大人！
v19886.original: 神サマなんて呼んでない！
aliases: 神サマなんて呼んでない！
v19886.originalDescription:
Hiiragi Fuuka (name can be changed) works as a graphic designer at her private office. Her life is busy, she has no boyfriend, she's lonely on her birthday--

Suddenly, gods appear to her?! After hundreds of years, these gods are back living on earth.

And just to make things even more troublesome, Fuuka gets rejuvenated back into a child! The god and exorcist who caused that to happen to her decide to live with Fuuka and keep her safe.

Her destiny with love has never changed much until now, and everything (at least until the day after tomorrow) starts going forward!
v19886.description:
被称为三十岁上下世代的主人公，柊風花。
容貌经常受到夸奖，性格也不算太差，对此颇有自信。
虽然被人说性格强势，但作为经营个人事务所的平面设计师，不这么强势是干不下去的。
因为工作和私生活都很积极，所以也结交了不少男性朋友，在和男性交往时总是被表白的那一方。

难道说，我有什么问题吗……不过首先还是眼前的这份工作……。
就在这样一个没有男友的今年生日。
風花的面前，出现了一柱男人。

“你拥有的神寄之力终于觉醒了。没办法，我来做你的伴侣！”

突然被亲吻，感觉到身体有异变，看向镜子，自己的模样正在不断变年轻……！？
男人说，这是所谓伴侣仪式的一环，正在进行身体的净化。

“……不用担心，接下来就会恢复原状”
“妖孽！只要有我在，就不会让你得逞，放开那个人！”

这时突然，一个年轻男人冲了进来，举起符咒……。

“等等，你以为在现在的状态下使用术法会怎么样！？”
“吵死了，废话少说！”
“等一下，你们，到底在干什么……！？”

轰隆！！

光芒迸裂，那里是大约二十年前模样的風花。
没有恢复成原来的身体……？

“可恶，妖孽！把这个人变回原来的三十岁！”
“吵死了，小鬼！都是因为你捣乱，原本能恢复的也恢复不了了！”
“不不，话说我还没到三十岁呢！”

希望让風花成为伴侣的守护神・碧依。
为了阻止此事而出现的天才祓师・篠田洸太。
两人为了保护变成小孩身体的風花免受邪恶存在的侵害，决定住进她的房间。

在出乎意料的同居生活中，一点点拉近的，心的距离。
神明与祓师。風花究竟会选择哪一方……？

“两边都不要，快把我变回原样啊！”

v20261.original: ナツイロココロログ～Happy Summer～

v20261.originalDescription: This is the fandisc for Natsuiro Kokoro Log, featuring after stories for each of the four heroines, as well as harem routes for both the real and virtual worlds. It takes place one year after the original game as the computer research club members head to a training camp and end up helping out at a traditional Japanese café.
v20261.description:
就读于私立芦之宫学园的主人公“臣苗嘉人”。
他所属的“电脑研究部”在进入暑假后，决定兼作社团集训，和女主角们一起留宿去帮忙“和风咖啡厅”……

在现实世界与电脑世界的夹缝间摇摆不定的恋心。
她们在虚拟现实的世界里向嘉人寻求着什么……

与无法坦率的女孩们的一个夏天的恋爱故事，现在，开始了……

v20315.original: あなたに恋する恋愛ルセット
aliases: あなたに恋する恋愛ルセット
Anata ni Koi Suru Ren'ai Recette
La recette de mon amour pour toi
v20315.originalDescription:
The recently-founded Rokkasei Gakuen doesn’t have a rich history. One of its notable features is that students will select their specialization during the second term of their first year. Haruma decided to pursue the confectionery course that had been added this school year for the simple reason that he loves sweet a lot.

Nonoka, who loves both eating and making sweets

Yuzuki, who looks to be perfect at everything, but is actually quite clumsy

Fuuka, who possess maternal instincts and fortitude behind her quiet demeanour

Miel, who has a discerning palate, despite her lack of motivation and energy

Haruma’s meetings with these unique girls in his class draws him further not only into the charm of sweets, but also sweet sweet love...
v20315.description:
私立六華星学園开设了分为众多课程的专业课程。
主人公・二宮春馬因为喜欢甜点而选择了制菓课程，在那里遇到了许多女孩子。

充满对甜点之爱的女孩、看似完美的千金大小姐、日式点心店的继承人女孩、拥有天生嗅觉的女孩。
理由虽各不相同，但都是被甜点吸引而聚集的女主角们。

无论是甜点还是恋爱，越是了解就越能感受到小小的幸福与深深的魅力……。
就这样，由甜点相连的甜甜恋爱故事，现在拉开帷幕！

面对意志消沉的他，字面意义上豁出身体的色情课程与主动提出协助克服心理创伤的，是姐姐律香和表姐真白。

v21474.originalDescription:
The protagonist miraculously recovers from an incurable disease, however, he still suffers a considerable drop in mental and physical ability. Moreover, his school suddenly announces an exam which, if he can't pass it, will get him expelled immediately.

Through the help of his doctor, he is introduced to several private tutors, but all of them are female college students. Furthermore, he needs to study at their dormitory and university. And so, his dorm life​ filled with private ecchi lessons begins.
v21474.description:
患上不治之症却奇迹般康复的主人公（周防秋良）
因生病的影响，身心机能显著下降。
在此期间，就读的学园发来了复学考试的通告……
如果，结果不合格的话就即刻退学！？
在主治医生的协助下，为了考试合格而被介绍了家庭教师，没想到全都是女大学生！
而且，通过她们所在的宿舍和女子大学的授课，各种色情意外事件
接连发生――！？

与女大学生的H的个人课程＆宿舍生活开始了。

v25964.description:
使用超级工口APP来攻略欧派偏差值最强班级的女孩子们！ 

主人公下城炎寿马（しもじょう かずま）是因为“某种状况”而来到“稍微有点特殊的女校”上学的一介男学生。 

正当接受由于母亲的工作调动而预定转学的“剑艺术学园”的面试考试时， 结果发生了女性面试官因突然发动了炎寿马的特殊能力而全裸着高潮了的事件。 

（似乎是妹妹绘美里所拥有的愿望成真技能在考试会场形成了特异点、才偶然发动了工口技能的样子。） 

“其实我拥有着如此工口的特殊能力吗？小姐！？” 

明明只是对偶尔显露出来的面试官紧身迷你裙中的黑丝大腿燃起了欲望而已！ 

发动了只有女性才能使用的特殊能力的炎寿马，并非是志愿入学的剑艺术学园，而是被强制进入持有通过欧派的大小和技能能力高低而决定的被称为“超能力”的特殊能力、集中了精英爆乳女学生们的“十哑琉女学园”就读！ 

在此之中，与嫉妒着最近正在玩的社交游戏中的老婆角色的妹妹绘美里吵架而弄坏了智能手机。 

为了尽快修理手机，炎寿马进入了昨天看准的手机商店。 

“不会突然出现女孩子什么的从视频里跳出来的场景吧……” 如同飞蛾扑火般钻进商店入口的时候…… 

“欢迎光临……真亏你能找到这家店呢。明明设定好了只有真正的变态才能找得到的……” 

“什么呀那是？那种事情……哦哦！” 

“难道说，主人……？在冒险中总是给我装备有用的道具和工口服装真是非常感谢。” 刚才还在队伍里带着的工口社交游戏的角色-莉莉娅就站在那里。 最初以为是有角色扮演癖好的店员、又或者是什么宣传活动的， 从莉莉娅那里听到了许多只在游戏世界中发生的冒险回忆，炎寿马强行让自己接受了这一状况。 

琐碎的事情先不谈，本想快点转交弄坏的手机，却被莉莉娅推荐了拥有不可思议形状的新手机。

 “好像是稍微有点奇怪的形状的手机呐……” 

“快点跟这种垃圾规格的手机告别，换成这种异世界最新的手机机种吧！主人！” 

垃圾规格真是对不起了呐！呜呜！ 并且，还被定制了实现使用者愿望的APP。 

“看到主人总是用着少量的存储来玩这游戏，就想着要对您报恩的……” 

被拼命推荐更换成莉莉娅所住世界手机机种的炎寿马。

 “能正常使用的吧？不会突然爆炸什么的吧？特别是在轻小说中异世界会出现各种各样的陷阱呐。” 

“嗯、嗯嗯！……主人的话完全没关系哟！不会爆炸的哟！”

 “喂——喂！看着我的眼睛说！还是这种毫无信用的语尾！” 

要是自己家被还原成基本粒子或是被吹飞到异世界就没办法了呐！就现在这里试一下吧。 

感觉，排列着许多看不惯的图标呐……。 

异世界的智能手机吗……半信半疑之时最先看到的APP，炎寿马发动了“突然○制混浴”。 

一点击这个图标，眼前就被一片白光所笼罩了。 

光芒散去后出现了宛如游戏中某一场景的状况…… 

那里是，以青梅竹马的莉音和恋乃香为首的多个女孩子全裸着在学园大浴场里入浴的光景。 

“这，这个是！这就是异世界超工口智能机&超工口APP的力量吗！” 

“只要有这个手机的话一步登天成为学园第一能力者也是有可能的吧……不如说能够征服全员女生也说不定呐。” 

不知为何……如同我心中的盖亚在低语着，我有了使用超工口APP来成就伟大的霸业的这种预感。 

如同被命运所驱使着一般我的下半身如今，开始向着秘密的野心慢慢地抬起了头。

v26791.originalDescription:

v26791.description:

他沉迷于漫画、游戏和动画，嘴里吐出其中的台词并自我陶醉，是个典型的令人尴尬的青年。
明明长相和声音都有着相当高的规格，却有着公认的“遗憾帅哥”的评价。

今天也照常在学园的动画游戏同好会活动室里，和好友“让”（雀野春太）一起，
沉浸在美少女游戏、轻小说、萌系燃系动画和漫画的热烈评论战中。

在这样的情况下，秋人偶然得知了在班级里也极其格格不入的问题儿童“高井户流林檎”（高井戸流林檎）的秘密，

经过这番缘由，秋人被看似对他人毫无兴趣、

v33837.originalDescription:
"Regain the true power by regaining the shattered sign of the Demon King."

The Demon King who once reigned as the King of the Demon World and challenged the battle to the heavens.
He was defeated after a deadly battle with the angels, and the "sign" that was the source of his power was shattered.
The "sign" was divided by the six angels of the heavenly army, and he was managed so that he would never wake up again.
Only one piece of the "sign" disappeared somewhere, and the destination became unknown.

Ryuga Sada is a human being born from the "fragment of the sign" whose destination is unknown.
He once regained his memory of the past and remembers reigning as the Demon King.

And he began his actions to regain the "sign" that was the source of his robbed power in order to challenge the heavens again.
v33837.description:
■故事
『将粉碎的魔王之印记重新收入手中，取回真正的力量吧』
曾经作为魔界之王君临天下，并向天上发起挑战的魔王。
他在与天使们的死斗中最终落败，作为其力量之源的「印记」被粉碎殆尽。
那「印记」被天军势的六位天使分割，为了不让其再次觉醒而被管理起来，但是，
「印记」中的一块碎片却消失在了某处，去向不明。
沙田龙牙，就是从那块去向不明的「印记碎片」中诞生的人类。
他在某个时候找回了过去的记忆，想起了自己曾作为魔王君临天下之事。
然后为了再次向天上发起挑战，他开始行动，试图夺回被夺走的力量之源「印记」。

【灵能少女】
●狮子冢 露西娅（獅子塚 るしあ）　（CV：片仓雏）
从粉碎的魔王之印记中，由「傲慢（路西法）」诞生的人格。
因天使的祝福而拥有截然相反的「谦虚」之美德。
是就读于神学院的年轻修女见习生，从小便拥有灵能力。
拥有想要将自己的力量用于帮助他人的奉献之心，对自己的欲望抱有谨慎态度。
看起来柔弱，但内心坚强的类型。
「那种事……主是不会允许的」

【偶像少女】
●八木明日花　（CV：麻优莉）
因天使的祝福而拥有截然相反的「纯洁」之美德。
是当红的人气偶像，作为「大家的妹妹」深受喜爱的国民级人气角色。
「你好！我是八木明日花！大家都叫我亚吉阿斯！」

【侦探少女】
●熊谷铃（熊谷 すず）　（CV：御苑生萌）
从粉碎的魔王之印记中，由「怠惰（贝尔芬格）」诞生的人格。
因天使的祝福而拥有截然相反的「勤勉」之美德。
是作为天才侦探少女连媒体都有报道的能干侦探，拥有连大人也为之惊叹的头脑。
冷酷且少年般的，用「仆」自称的少女。
短发与理性的双眼是其魅力所在。
「我吗？我是熊谷铃。是个侦探」

【不良少女】
●乌羽守（烏羽 まもる）　（CV：樱井爱丽丝）
从粉碎的魔王之印记中，由「强欲（玛门）」诞生的人格。
因天使的祝福而拥有截然相反的「宽容」之美德。
因为平时斜眼相看的说话方式和锐利的眼光，被周围人害怕是「不良少女」，但实际上是个正义感强、心地善良的老好人少女。
打架很强。
有洁癖且爱干净。基本上不喜欢被别人触碰。
是露西娅的青梅竹马，觉得是因为自己的原因导致露西娅腿脚不便并失去了记忆，对此抱有责任感。
不服输且不轻言放弃。
有着无法坦率面对自己的麻烦性格。
「干嘛啊你，找俺有什么事吗」

【武道少女】
●虎堂惠留　（CV：冈梨衣菜）
从粉碎的魔王之印记中，由「暴食（别西卜）」诞生的人格。
因天使的祝福而拥有截然相反的「节制」之美德。
禁欲，对自己非常严格。
不断以高处为目标。
另一方面对他人却很随和，总是很亲切。
祖父传授的刀术本领相当了得，祖先是据说曾『降伏妖怪』的著名「武士」
「我会消灭恶魔。一定。马上。……做好觉悟吧」

【恶魔娘】
●利维坦（リヴァイアサン）　（CV：奥山步）
从粉碎的魔王之印记中，由「嫉妒」诞生的人格。
只有她没有被给予天使的祝福，将恶德作为恶德保留着。
享乐主义且反复无常，非常嫉妒心重。
是别人拥有的东西马上就会想要得到的性格。
与沙田龙牙不同，是收集『魔王之印记』试图作为魔王复活的『另一个魔王』。
「啊，总觉得火大。把你杀了吧」

【魔王】
●沙田龙牙
本作的主人公。
从粉碎的魔王之印记中，由「愤怒（撒旦）」诞生的人格。
作为普通的高中生过着平凡的人生，但某天回想起了过去的记忆，作为魔王的主人格觉醒了。
为了这次一定要打倒曾经击败过自己的天上势力，他带着周密的计划开始行动以取回力量。
因为也拥有与「愤怒」成对的「忍耐」特性，所以非常能忍耐，不辞为实现野心而付出的辛劳。
「哼……真是顽强啊。杀了你吗」

【引路人】
●玛琪娜（マキナ）　（CV：阿卡由纪）
经常向龙牙搭话的谜之存在。
「好啊，如果是那样的话……玛琪娜小姐，就让你回想起来吧」

v36310.description:
“要不要和我一起去南方的岛屿打工？”

我，大在宗太郎，是靠打工挣学费的穷学生。\
因帮助后辈幸崎羽海而被辞退，陷入走投无路的境地……\

最后，脸颊泛红的幸崎抛出冲击性的一句话：

“请作为我的男朋友，在这里度过吧！”

这下，注定无法逃脱各种意外了。\
打工、恋爱、以及波澜壮阔的度假生活，究竟会走向何方……？

v41944.originalDescription:
Hirose Ayato, the main character who lost his mother several years ago and now lives with his father.
One day, his father decided to go on a long business trip overseas for two months including the summer break. This meant that Ayato would be spending the entire period by himself.

Ayato's father was worried about the situation and consulted with a friend he knew in the neighborhood, a married woman by the name of Ninomiya Rinko. She recommended that he contact a "housekeeping agency" she knew of and he decided to request it for his son. 
However, this wasn't your average housekeeping service - it was a "mama" agency where a registered woman would come as a "mama" and take care of housework and daily life for an agreed-upon period of time. 

Starting with Rinko, who actually works for the company and openly comes as Ayato's "mama". 
She is joined by Kiyoko, a married woman who has known Ayato for a long time and also wants to be Ayato's "mama".
Additionally, Kana—the president of the mama agency service and newly married staff member Tsumugi join the fight as well.

A rich and strange mother-child life begins.

担心此事的父亲向附近的熟人、人妻新宮凛子商量后，被介绍给某家家事代行机构，决定为了彩人委托其服务。
然而，那里并不是普通的家事代行机构，而是在契约期间，注册的女性会作为『妈妈』前来照顾家务和生活的妈妈代行机构。

其实所属该机构，公然作为彩人的『妈妈』前来的凛子自不必说，
同样想成为彩人妈妈的昔日熟人的人妻・清子、妈妈代行服务社长・伽奈、新人工作人员新妻紬貴也加入进来，

v47880.originalDescription:
In the 2040s in Japan, the near-future sport "Jindou" boasts a high popularity as the sport of the people. And the the most famous of all the Jindou performances is the "Daihouen".

Suzakuin Nadeshiko, although currently still a school student, has been fantastically making a name for herself as a pro swordswoman. On the other side, the protagonist Takizawa Kazuma, a washed-up pro swordsman, competes in underground Jindou matches to make ends meet.

One day, these two who were born and lived in completely different worlds had a fateful meeting.

"Kazuma-san, your swordsmanship is the real deal. Fight with us in the Daihouen and let's make it to the top!"

"...yeah. If we could that'd be great"

The pair, captivated by Jindou, are drawn to each other's swordsmanship and seek each other. With Takizawa Komari and Hanabusa Palvi joining Team White Wolf too, they eventually make big waves on the stage of the Daihouen.

If they win, glory awaits. If they lose, they fall from grace. With their beliefs held in their breasts, the swordsmen step out into a battle they can't afford to lose in the intense world of pros.

Swordsmen live in the moment. The "moment" you let slip will never come back-- in which case, set your soul alight.
v47880.description:
204X年的日本。作为近未来运动的刃道作为一项国民运动正享有盛誉。
其中最有名的刃道赛事——那就是“大奉演”。

《朱雀院抚子(朱雀院撫子)》在这个大奉演中，作为现役学园生同时也是职业剑士，取得了辉煌的成果。

另一方面，主人公《泷川一马(滝川一馬)》是在地下竞技场参加刃道比赛赚取日薪的落魄职业剑士。
虽有剑术才华却在武家社会遭到排挤，至今一直走在不见天日的阴影中。

出身与境遇截然不同的两人，某天将实现命运的相遇。

一马先生，你的剑是真材实料。
和我们一起在大奉演中登顶吧！
……啊，是啊。能做到那样的话就太好了

《泷川小鞠(滝川小鞠)》《英·帕尔维(英パルヴイ)》也加入了《白狼队(チーム白狼)》，
不久便将大奉演的舞台大幅推动。

胜则荣光，败则坠落。在严酷的职业世界中，将信念铭记于心，
剑士们迈入不可退让的战斗。
剑士活在刹那。错过的《刻》不会重来。
燃烧灵魂吧。

——这一刹那，值得奉献生命——

v57736.originalDescription:
This is a summer love comedy about two new adolescent lovers who are a little bashful, but have a lot of fun.

It's early summer. With summer vacation just around the corner, the protagonist Makino Yuu and Kunoki Nozomi have officially become lovers. Going to school and back together every day, eating her homemade lunch at lunch breaks, going on after-school dates, and the casual words and little smiles they exchange in their everyday lives slowly but surely connect him and her. And once summer vacation begins, a full course of youthful events awaits!

Him getting excited when he sees her in a swimsuit at the beach, having fun touring the food stalls and watching fireworks at a festival, and getting nervous when they go on a trip and end up sharing a room - summer memories of full-on leisure!

Furthermore, that summer, their friends - a cool beauty who's the tsukkomi of the group, and a troublemaker who is also the mood maker - join them, and their days become lively and bustling. They laugh, they clash, but in the end they end up getting closer to each other.

The newly-formed couple grows closer over the summer. They're still awkward and a little shy, but their relationship certainly grows deeper.

Just one summer. But for the two of them, it was an irreplaceable season.

而当暑假正式到来时，还会有盛大的青春活动等待着他们！

在海水浴场为她的泳装心跳加速，祭典上游遍小摊、仰望升空的烟花欢呼雀跃，旅行时意外同住一室而小鹿乱撞……

不仅如此，这个夏天还有他们的朋友加入——

v362.originalDescription:
Happiness! centers around Kohinata Yuuma, who is a high school student attending Mizuhosaka Academy's regular section of the school, along with his close friends Watarase Jun and Takamizo Hachisuke. The other section, aptly named the magic section, was founded in order to train mages in the art of using magic.

The story begins with Valentine's Day coming up in just a few days and there's a rush for all the girls to get the chocolate they want in order to give it to the boys they like, in accordance with Japanese custom. Kamisaka Haruhi, a mage in training, is out with her friend Hiiragi Anri, also a mage in training, in order to do just this. While walking outside in the park, after buying the chocolate she wanted to give to a boy she met when she was a child, Haruhi meets Yuuma, who stops some younger boys bullying a young girl, and Haruhi thinks that he may be the boy she's been searching for all this time. The next day is Valentine's Day and at school, all the girls are giving their gifts to the boys of their choice. Later that day, Anri challenges Haruhi to a magic battle in order to take the chocolate she has by force for the reason that Haruhi wouldn't tell her who she was going to give it to. Before long, Anri loses control of her magic and it is flown outside, almost falling onto Yuuma and his friends. Ultimately, Haruhi gives him the chocolate she had bought, and in turn Anri does the same, which was her plan - to give her chocolate to the same boy as Haruhi and see who would win his favor more. The next day there is a gas explosion at the magic section of the school and all the mages in training must transfer over to the normal section for the time being. Coincidentally, Haruhi and Anri are placed within Yuuma's class.

Now Haruhi and her friends must adjust to the transfer into the normal section of Mizuhosaka Academy.

v1023.title: Scarlett～スカーレット～
aliases: 日常与非日常的境界线
v1023.originalDescription:
Ohno Akito is a military otaku. Akito dropped out of school a year ago and is now camping on a small island off Okinawa, where he went in the forlorn hope that the American military presence would give him a chance to play with real guns. He's unexpectedly approached by a foreigner girl, Shizuka, who tells him he's in a restricted area. That night, Akito sees a B-2 stealth bomber flying overhead, and realizes something is happening that shouldn't be. The next day, as he's trying to break into Kadena Air Base to get a closer look at the B-2, he runs into Shizuka again...

The story is told from 2 perspectives: Kurou, a super-spy from the prestigious Bettou-Izumi-Scarlett family, and Akito. The former wields knowledge, strength, and great political power, while the latter was just a normal high school guy. But their differing views on the world and how they themselves change is one of the main reasons that the story’s interesting. Scarlett is just a simple little story about 2 people, their different worlds, and the people they love.
v1023.description:
猫猫社的第10部作品。事先已宣告本作之后，猫猫社将停止活动。因此，本作与以往《White 〜セツナサのカケラ〜》《みずいろ》《ラムネ》等作品中可见的“以普通小镇为舞台的普通故事”划清了界限，成为了一部与众不同的作品。

作品的主题是“日常与非日常”。对猫猫社此前一直坚持的“日常”给出了结论。即：“既不是出现剑、魔法或机器人的故事，也不是以普通小镇为舞台的普通故事。目标是打造成熟稳重的娱乐作品。”

故事的舞台是现代社会。聚焦于被称为所谓谍报员或间谍等，为了让自身所属的国家在国际上占据优势，而在黑社会暗中活跃的职业。然而，几乎没有像007系列等作品中那种枪支与暴力起决定性作用的情节，反而是设定了被称为“高级谍报家”的一族，他们认为“杀掉比放任不管要麻烦得多”，并以驱使他们进行阴谋策略为主线。

此外，对于该公司来说比较罕见的是，男性角色也有语音。

另外，本游戏的OP主题曲《Escarlata》是意为斯嘉丽的西班牙语。歌词中完全没有日语或英语的部分，全部用西班牙语演唱。

v1136.title: 朱－Aka－
v1136.originalDescription:
Desert lands in the ancient times. There was a legend about entity called Ruta who bestows various magic-like abilities upon his disciples along with vermillion gems.
Story begins to unfold with the adventure of two people -- Aramis, young girl from the Ruta clan, who can erase people's memories, and Kadan, her guardian.

There are four chapter in the novel, that are connected by the same setting.
v1136.description:
远古之时……千年已是遥远的过去。舞台，只有广袤无垠的沙漠……。

■第一章　阿拉密斯(アラミス)
作为“露塔(ルタ)”的眷属，“阿拉密斯”被赋予的是“消除记忆的力量”。守护着她的“卡丹(カダン)”（主人公）。
即使在眷属中也拥有最强力量的阿拉密斯，被称为“归还者”。
他们为了履行义务而在沙漠中旅行，但通过与各种各样的人相遇，开始对这种行为产生疑问……。

■第二章　塔萨(ターサ)
主人公“塔萨”是为了生存而偷盗的盗贼。与孤儿少女“秋秋(チュチュ)”一同穿越沙漠，在城镇之间旅行。
虽然过着居无定所的生活，但秋秋的开朗带来了些许幸福。
然而，尽管不断旅行，两人却迟迟找不到安居之地……

■第三章　法邬(ファウ)
来自西方的旅人“韦兹(ウェズ)”（主人公）。在旅途中，偶然救下在沙漠中倒下的他的，是住在附近城镇的药师“法邬”。
韦兹为了报答救命之恩而帮忙她的工作，法邬也渐渐接受了他。
在这样平稳的日常中，他注意到了法邬身上佩戴的“朱色宝石”……。

■第四章　露塔
带着一族的使命而旅行的主人公“露塔”，与大富豪的女儿“拉蒂(ラッテ)”的故事……。

v1375.title: 游魂 -It's happy days-
v1375.originalDescription:
Hello there, I'm Yuri. One day, Mashiro wins a lottery and the prize is a three-day trip ticket. It's a big surprise, but bigger accidents happen to me one by one later. For example, Mashiro asks me to marry. Well, it's an extreme choice. 

While I live a busy life, I finally decide which way I should go in the future. I also get a partner whom I'll walk together for the rest of my life. As you can see, the trip ticket is a tiny tiny thing. 

Though summer holiday starts, I still live a busy life and I get tired. Yes, my partner seems to be tired as well. When I think about having a rest, I remember the trip ticket...
v1375.description:
为了能与你再次合而为一，我来到了这个世上。
那是，我——泉户裕理(泉戸裕理)的决心与奋斗解开了各处的误会，奇怪又愉快的日常拉开帷幕后不久的事。
那是迟开的樱花还在惋惜春日残影之时的事情。

“裕理——先生！！！！中奖了——！！！！中——奖——了——！！！！是特等奖，是无欲的胜利——！！！！”

在苇原町商店街举办的抽奖中，泉户真白(泉戸ましろ)抽中了。价值二十万日元，两宿三天的高级温泉旅馆住宿券！
如果是平时，这大概会作为印象深刻的事件留在记忆中吧。但是，在这之后，我的身上接连不断地发生了不得了且非日常的大事件。

比如，真白向我告白——或者说，向我求婚。是让她成为真正的妻子，还是做值得信赖的朋友，这是终极的选择。
对我而言如同亲妹妹一般的由美奈一直怀抱的感情，以及驱使着台风级别神通力的凤凰所引发的大骚动。
还有，与青梅竹马的亚芽里之间一直阴燃的痛苦过去，引来了与绮久罗美守毗売因缘深厚的最强太转依、应龙的决战。
我也知道了背负着无法抗拒之宿命的如月美冬的纠葛。那还是在为了退治真面目不明、神出鬼没的鵺而四处奔走的时候呢。
在那之中，我确定了长久以来一直迷茫的“将来应走的道路”。
并且，也获得了携手走过漫长人生的重要“伴侣”。那是在日后回首时，毫无疑问能称之为人生剧变期的日子。
说实话，特等温泉旅行券之类的事早就被冲刷到遗忘的彼岸，成了微不足道的小事了——。

就这样时光流逝，到了夏天。这是我作为创圣学院学生迎来的，最后一个暑假。
从某种意义上说，我度过了比春天还要忙碌充实的每一天，但正因如此，身心疲劳的积累也是无可奈何的事。
这对支持着我的“伴侣”来说也是一样。
我半是无意识地想着，差不多想要个长假休息一下了呢，或者这个暑假应该是个机会之类的。

突然，我想起来了。那张完全忘记了的温泉旅行券的存在。

这是从“那之后”的夏天开始的故事。又或者是“那个时候，在某个地方”本应发生的小小事件。
相爱的两人的“确切且不可动摇的灵魂羁绊”所交织出的，恩恩爱爱的日常。

Mahiro works at a cafe owned by his mother. Each and every day he meets beautiful girls, family is no exception. In short, life is pretty peachy.

One day, Mahiro's mother declares that he will inherit the cafe, and that whoever he marries will also have their name included.

All is fair in love and war, more specifically, love! Mahiro will have to find a good wife for his future happiness and the good of the cafe!
v1437.description:
――又到了春天。那是相遇与开始的季节。
主人公・朝倉真広，扰乱了不断重复的日常的安宁。
和朋友做些蠢事，帮忙经营母亲经营的咖啡店……
在那样的安定中，终于感到了幸福。
　然而，春天再次造访。
　春假结束后的教室里遇到的是，初恋的对象・春日野恋。
与恋的重逢，改变了真广周围的环境。
　不知晓向着自己倾注的思念的，曾经的青梅竹马　春日野 恋
　比谁都了解真广的思念。现在的青梅竹马　水樹 夏音
　希望能一直守护哥哥建立的日常的妹妹　麻倉 真柚
　希望能成为自己期望的自己的　一条 絢子
春天是相遇，以及开始的季节。
一切都像被温柔地包围着。
　再次，恋爱开始了――
从单相思开始的恋爱故事！
又到了春天。　再次，“恋”开始了――
以主人公母亲经营的咖啡店和学园为舞台展开的恋爱故事！
究竟，单相思能否传达并迎来幸福的结局呢！？

v4521.originalDescription: Shiomizaki Gakuen is a gigantic boarding school with over 1000 students. It prides itself on the learning environment and requires all students to be part of an extracurricular club. Junya transfers to this school to watch over his little sister Kokoa who is starting first year this spring. While walking around the campus to decide on what club to join, they meet the drama club leader Sena. Easily persuaded by Sena’s smooth talk, Kokoa decides to join the club and Junya follows her. However, the drama club doesn’t actually do anything… it’s more like Sena’s private room, complete with a maid Ayuka. One day, Sena suggests that they do a love role play. Is this just acting, or is true love?
v4521.description:
私立汐見崎学園是一所位于沿海中型地方城市、学生人数约1000人的巨型学校。
为了重视学习环境而实行全寄宿制，并不太注重升学，以自由而广泛的教育为宗旨。
课外活动尤为盛行，学生被强制要求必须隶属于某个社团。

羽澄準也在升入二年级的同时，转入了这所汐見崎学園。也就是所谓的转校生。
理由是……陪伴今年春天入读汐見崎学園的妹妹 羽澄心爱(ここあ)……。
羽澄心爱极度怕生，比同龄人更孩子气且不可靠，因此需要準也的支持。

为了立刻决定所属的社团，羽澄心爱和準也在学园内巡视。
在此期间，準也在偶然路过的戏剧部迎来了命运般的（？）相遇。
戏剧部部长・九條瀬那——。
黑色长直发配上端正的容貌。是被那份美丽所迷住了，还是……源于旧时的记忆（？），準也感到内心深处有一丝隐火。
瀬那凭借巧妙的话术和美貌，将羽澄心爱劝诱进了戏剧部。完全提起了兴致的羽澄心爱。
就这样，羽澄心爱和準也成为了戏剧部的成员。

然而，那时看到的是幻影吗？戏剧部只是徒有其名，那里是九條瀬那的城堡。
準也被小恶魔般奔放的瀬那那独裁又自甘堕落的另一面所折腾。
既是部员又是瀬那女仆的柚木沢鮎香，身为学园教师兼顾问却过于娇小的亚沙木由香(亜沙木ゆか)也加入其中，鸡飞狗跳的学园生活。

在此期间，在瀬那的提议下，在度过日常生活的过程中，决定作为戏剧的练习来进行“融入恋爱的角色扮演”。
在完全融入角色进行演绎的过程中，女孩们萌生出的感情。
究竟，这是戏剧？还是现实的恋爱？

Without realizing that he is a boy, she entrusts him with the mission of preserving justice in the world as an an angel substitute, Pastel Nanana!
v6954.description:
光滑细嫩的肌肤，柔顺亮丽的长发……每天承受着来自女生们满怀羡慕的目光，还被要求穿上可爱的衣服，甚至收到男生们认真的情书。
在这样的主人公“七菜川成实(七菜川成実)”面前，竟然掉下来了一位天使“莉莉·林德格伦(リリ・リンドグレン)”。
莉莉没有察觉到成美是个男孩子，就任命他为纠正世界扭曲的天使代行者“粉彩·奈奈奈”！！
因为“天使代行者”只能由恋爱中的女孩子担任，成美只好完全扮成女孩子，为了治愈世界的扭曲而四处奔走！

v12561.title: ココロ＠ファンクション !
v12561.original: ココロ＠ファンクション !
aliases: ココロ＠ファンクション !
v12561.originalDescription:
Halfway through the 21st century, we are surely approaching something called the “network golden age”. The Multi-purpose communication card “Orca” provides a phone network (that goes without saying), an overwhelming number of apps to use allowing one to shop from their home telephone, and even a way to receive school lessons.

Even IDs and the health insurance cards are all incorporated into the Orca card. It wouldn’t be an exaggeration to say that one’s entire life is influenced by this one small card.

I, Hayami Taiyou, lives in a city that supports cutting-edge Orca cards, also a student of Makoto Advanced Academy (something like this city has the best ones).

Blessed with friends, and although i have no large problems occur in my daily life…… A bug occurred in some students’ Orca card after a sudden automatic update was applied. An unusual app called “Cocoro Function” was installed. And it seems I was one of them, and apparently due to this app, my inner thoughts are revealed to the people around me.

“Chairman! Bad News!”
“What’s wrong? (But, I would never get tired of groping your bouncing boobs)”
“Chairman! You pervert!”

You can’t delete the app, but on the other hand you couldn’t live without Orca either. After that, it was impossible to hide my erotic delusions. Furthermore, apparently there are other apps at school that have special features that are also causing problems. The troubles in school are gradually building up.

I had to do something, and with that in mind, I gathered a group of people also bothered by this mysterious app, and started up the Cocoro Function Countermeasure Committee (CFC), in order to try to solve the problem.

Can everyone else and I retain our peaceful school life!?!
v12561.description:
“呐，即使分开。我们也紧紧相连哦”

时至即将迈入21世纪中叶的现在，正是网络全盛期。
只要有多功能通信卡片“Orca”，电话和网络自不必说，
使用数量庞大的应用，不仅能购物、操作家电，还能接受学园的课程。

身份证和保险证等证明文件也都汇总在“Orca”里，
说与生活相关的一切都集于这一张卡上也不为过。

我，速水太阳，在这样由“Orca”支撑的最先进都市里的
“诚进学园”担任学生代表。

我结交了朋友，日子过得波澜不惊，然而……。
某天，“Orca”突然进行了自动更新升级。
接着，因为当时的漏洞，一部分学生的“Orca”里，
被安装了一个奇怪的应用“心灵程序”。

看来我也是其中之一，因为应用的缘故，我获得了“自己的心声能被别人听见”的功能。

“会长！大事不好了！”
“怎么了？“会长！？变态！！”

而且这个应用还删不掉，但要说放弃使用“Orca”更是不可能的事。
此外，似乎除了我拥有的应用之外，还有具备特殊功能的应用，
学园里逐渐增加了各种麻烦——

觉得这样下去不行的我，成立了“心灵程序对策委员会（CFC）”，
开始了让被不可思议的应用所困扰的人们互相帮助、应对问题的活动。
我，以及我们和平的学园生活还能夺回来吗！？

v18907.original: 見上げてごらん、夜空の星を FINE DAYS

見上げてごらん、夜空の星を FINE DAYS
Miagete Goran, Yozora no Hoshi o: Fine Days

v18907.originalDescription: This is the fandisc for "Miagete Goran, Yozora no Hoshi o" with after stories for each of the four heroines. There are also new routes for sub-heroines Honoka and Miharu, and a downloadable route for Hinami in late June.
v18907.description:
【帚星光(箒星ひかり) 后传】

临近毕业的三年级冬天。和光交往已经1年了。
那时，天文界正因彗星的到来而沸腾。

去年计划(プロジェクト)的记忆依然鲜明，世人对再次到来的天体活动也颇为关注。
然而，听到彗星，晓斗他们回想起的是盖森彗星(ガイソン彗星)——世纪大失所望彗星。
回顾着回忆，晓斗说道。

“呐，要不要把‘行星观测笔记’完成呢？”

行星观测笔记的缺失。那是半途而废、记录中断的盖森彗星的记录。
为了兼顾备考和彗星观测，光决定在寒假期间住在晓斗的房间里。

【天之川沙夜(天ノ川沙夜) 后传】

距离星光计划已经过了1个月。
和晓斗成为正式恋人的沙夜，过着“幸福得有时大脑一片空白”的生活。
然而这样的沙夜，有一个小小的烦恼。

那就是——情人节。沙夜对情人节有些心理阴影。
五年级时她曾想送巧克力给晓斗，却没能顺利送出去。
从那以后，虽然曾半开玩笑地送过人情巧克力，但她还是尽量避开情人节度过。
但是，今年就不能那样了。因为已经是恋人了。

察觉到沙夜烦恼的光，对晓斗说。

“你要好好把沙夜当成公主对待啊”

晓斗决定给沙夜送上最棒的情人节约会。

【白鸟织姬(白鳥織姫) 后传】
晓斗和织姬开始交往，眼看就要一年了。
走上新道路的织姬十分忙碌，能见面的时间绝对不多。
利用宝贵的时间，两人不断约会。

在这样的情况下，他们得知了一个活动正在筹划中。
是在海港城(ハーバータウン)举办的天文仪器厂商的产品介绍活动。
为了让当地的天文活动热闹起来，织姬拉着箕星会(むつらぼし)的成员们开始了宣传活动。

这时收到了一封邮件。

“请箕星会的各位也务必协助”

面对突如其来的提议，织姬登上了更大的舞台。

【日下部可乐娜(日下部ころな) 后传】
可乐娜的流星电波观测，从未间断地持续着。
在知识与经验都增加的现在，她开始看清能做与不能做的事。
想要更进一步，现在的环境是不行的。为了进入专门的研究机构，她正在拼命学习。

“真的那样就好吗，我变得不明白了”

可乐娜喃喃自语。面对看不见未来的现状，她快要失去天文的乐趣了。
晓斗建议她重新面对星星。

箕星会筹划的观测会即将临近。
通过准备工作，可乐娜重新确认了对她而言天文究竟是什么。

【吉冈帆乃香(吉岡帆乃香) 路线】
箕星会的会长一职从织姬交接给吉冈，已经过了一年。
通过公关活动等实绩的积累，人们对天体观测的兴趣一点点扩大了。
而各个天文部也感受到了部员增加的征兆。

一边重新确认自己内心对星星的感情，一边继续活动的晓斗。
另一方面，吉冈在不断变化的环境中，抱持着近似寂寞的感情。

吉冈试图通过天体观测来确认自己的心意。
映入她眼帘的，是一直追寻的前会长织姬的背影，以及——

“对我来说宙见君，是怎样的存在呢……”

怀着同样的志向，共同克服困难的，晓斗的身影。

【早乙女美晴(早乙女美晴) 路线】
在打工的便利店“早乙女(さをとめ)”睡醒后去上学，然后在天文部活动的日子。
一边关心着一如既往过着懒散生活的同居人美晴老师，一边度过着依旧平稳的日常。

某天，晓斗在值班时发现了正在打瞌睡的美晴老师。
虽然无奈地想要叫醒她，却在那里听到了她的梦话。

“晓人，对不起……都是因为我……”

与平时不认真的态度不同，真切而悲伤的声音。
听到这句话的晓人的脑海中，曾经见过的恩师的身影复苏了。

v20337.originalDescription:
The Goddesses Descend!

It was a time when people had forgotten their dreams and lost faith. The silhouettes of goddesses revealed themselves to the people who then could only believe in what they saw right in front of them.

The confusion surrounding the countless goddesses appearing in Japan could be explained due to Amaterasu Okami wanting to teach the goddesses about the human world. 

All of this brought about the implementation of the Divine Education Act. A year passed and the numerous goddesses and humans got to learn about each other, got to know one another, and came to a mutual understanding.

The subculture holy land and heart of Divine Idol culture, known as Akihabara, housed the seven lucky goddesses that dominated as idols in L☆SEVEN.

Next Generation Goddess Auditions!
Divine Idol chicks, go on to spread your wings!
A glamorous and splendid contest, what a goddess's dreams are made of, is being held.

Laugh, grow, and even cry with the goddesses who descended from the sky and are aiming to become top level idols.
v20337.description:
「輝けカミサマ！」

大体相同，却又在某处截然不同……
稍微有些不同的日本，稍微有些不可思议的故事。
那时，神明大人与人类，处于相当接近的位置。

神明大人降临现代已经过去了一年。
亚文化的圣地“秋叶原”，如今已成为神明偶像文化的中心地，
七福神作为“L☆SEVEN”君临于偶像们的顶点。

主人公辰巳大和，对世间的流行充耳不闻，过着平稳的日常。
自己就读的学校与“神明教育法”毫无关系，对偶像也毫无兴趣。
老家的吴服店“辰巳屋”是他与神明大人唯一的接触点。

虽然他是这么想的，但从某次看到车站前的街头演出时起，就被深深迷住了。
服装也是附近学校的制服，器材也很简陋的街头演出。
即便如此，拼命歌唱着的她格外闪闪发光。

次世代福神选拔赛！

神明偶像的候补们，将从这里展翅高飞。
华丽而艳丽的神明大人们的梦幻竞演，现在开始！

v20941.title: ピュアソングガーデン！
v20941.original: ピュアソングガーデン！
aliases: ピュアソングガーデン！
v20941.originalDescription:
In 2027, advances in virtual reality technology have allowed for the creation of a ‘mixed reality’, combining both reality and virtual reality. It is not uncommon to see ‘virtual idols’ performing, and the most popular one is Ai, who was created using the newest state-of-the-art VR technology. Kanata is part of the M3 (Music Mediaworks Mate) circle of music lovers, along with his self-proclaimed guardian and cohabitant Kuon, and kouhai Asuka, who is interested only in weird ‘sounds’, among others.

One day, they were able to attend the huge virtual live event “Pure Song Garden” as part-time staff members thanks to the connections of Ritsu, a lady who lives in the same apartment as Kanata, and who used to take care of him when he was a child. Before the event, Ritsu brought them to the stage and did a start-up test for Ai as a special demo for them, but when she appeared, something felt off.

Actually, it was not Ai, but a beautiful girl Iroha who looked just like her. She said that she came from fifty years in the future for a short trip. Her ‘navigator fairy’ Suzu, a girl with fairy-like wings who accompanied her, explained that only Iroha’s consciousness travelled from the future and that she was only temporarily using Ai’s virtual body. At that time, there was a great commotion on the event grounds over Ai’s sudden disappearance. Iroha will have to take over Ai’s role on stage at the live, and Ritsu and the M3 members did their best to support her.

Everything was going smoothly at “Ai”‘s performance when a warning sounded and an unexpected error occurred! The “VR hazard” accident resulted in Iroha unable to return to the future.
v20941.description:
◆你的未来，幸福吗？◆
虚拟偶像之类的事物也正常活跃着，现实与虚拟混合共存，那样的时代。
主人公・山叶奏多（山葉奏多）隶属于通称M3三部这个音乐爱好者聚集的社团。
此外还有自称奏多监护人的从小一起生活的同居人・河和井玖音、
只对奇怪的"音"感兴趣的后辈・下国明日香等，充满了个性丰富的成员。

◆大规模VR庆典"纯歌花园！"◆
某天，奏多等人通过附近的大姐姐・柳泽律（柳澤律）的关系，作为工作人员参加了在这个Diver中举办的
大规模VR庆典。
使用最新技术、大量运用虚拟演出的庆典"纯歌花园！"！
正打算兼做测试体验VR时，出现在眼前的是庆典的招牌虚拟偶像・爱（アイ）。

◆与你一起，寻找未来◆
正这么想着，一个与爱长得一模一样的美少女却说自己是从未来来的星野伊吕波（星野いろは）。
甚至出现了带着妖精般翅膀的女孩・铃（すず）——
庆典的计划因此乱成一团！为了勉强按计划举办，只能让伊吕波当替身！
在场的奏多等人，顺水推舟地开始协助使用未来预测系统的作曲与舞台表演。

◆这个夏天，世界将变成乐园！◆
纯歌花园！终于华丽地开幕了，终于轮到庆典的招牌VR偶像・爱的演唱会开始。
在盛况中即将结束舞台演出时，警报响起，发生了意想不到的错误！
VR偶像们在Diver中到处乃至天空中大量出现，擅自开始表演……
无尽的、热闹的、喧闹的庆典般的每一天开始了！

v24472.title: 恋神 -治愈后宫-
aliases: ラブカミ　ピュアネスハレム
v24472.originalDescription:
"I'll find a solution to the Goddess' problems!"
The more things seem the same, the more they're actually different... 
These are some strange little stories about Goddesses in love. 
They happened in a time when Goddesses and people lived in close proximity, six years after the Goddesses descended to Earth.

Our story takes place in Kamimori City, a community deep in the mountains that is known among some people for one thing; the area is protected by a Tatarigami.

Tatarigami are known for spreading misfortune, but Kamimori City is protected by one.

Akira Manase has inherited a shrine in Kamimori City, and spent his days listening to the Goddess' troubles.

One day, he helped one of the Tatarigami, Yukari, and she fell madly in love with him, almost immediately proposing marriage.
v24472.description:
“解决神明的烦恼！”

故事总体上相同，却有着明显的差异……。
一心一意的日本神明，不一样的恋爱物语。
那时，神明和人类的地位基本相同。

神明降临于现代不知不觉已过6年。
守森市——一个可在乡村深山里随处可见的小村庄，
却被部分人类称为

――灾难之神所守护的土地。

原本是为人类带来不幸的灾难之神所守护的土地——守森市。

真濑彰作为守森市神社的后嗣，
每一天都聆听着神明们的烦恼。

某一天，灾难之神尤嘉莉对给她施予帮助的彰一见钟情，甚至还对他求婚。

“请让我成为你的妻子！”

可是喜欢彰的不只尤嘉莉这个神明，但她对外宣称自己才是他的新娘。
彰在被希望成为其妻子的神明们折腾的同时一边帮她们解决烦恼。
游戏角色
雨津尤嘉莉
因神明教育法而降临的灾难之神。

虽然喜欢与人类接触并积极想要融入其中，可是每当与人接触时就会将不幸带到对方身上。
原本是被供奉在都市的灾难之神，可是因无法接受他人对其感到恐惧的感情，而逃离至守森市之际与彰相遇。

每当造成灾难时都会使对方感到恐怖而对她畏而远之，因此给她心里造成了深深的创伤。

对从相遇以来就从未对其表现出恐惧的彰产生爱慕之情，并认为他就是自己的命运之人，
虽然是一心一意的爱着彰，可惜非常不擅长于情感的控制，经常会露出病娇的一面。
对彰很依赖，经常从彰的角度为他考虑和行动。

虽然对于似乎强硬变成彰的新娘这件事情感到很过意不去，但却很享受能与命运之人一起生活的喜悦。

未园诗音
比尤嘉莉稍早一点来到守森市的贫穷之神。
接受给年老者提供帮忙并获得相应的报酬（蔬菜、点心）等任何委托的工作。
虽然她的身份是贫穷之神，可却深受年老者的喜爱。

基本上是一个乐观向上不会深思熟虑的神明，
可是一旦与金钱有关，即使是一分钱的差额在未凑齐之前可不会罢休。

作为贫穷之神的诗音，比起其他神明更显得寒碜且自卑。

静森枫
因神明教育法而降临的原灾难之神。

虽然曾是守森市的灾难之神，可如今仍作为守森神社的祭神被居民们所尊崇。
在与彰相遇并喜欢上他后，再也没为他人造成灾难，于是逐渐被居民当作守护着守森市的神明。

虽然现在已成为成熟冷静的女性，可叛逆期的灾难之神时代是不可抹灭的黑暗历史。

v24506.title: ココロネ=ペンデュラム！
v24506.original: ココロネ=ペンデュラム！
aliases: ココロネ=ペンデュラム！
v24506.originalDescription:
Around 30 years ago, superpowers known as ‘magia’ started appearing in Japan. Soujirou recently gained the ability to read other people’s minds. Normally these powers would awaken in people over the course of a few days, but for him, it took a full two years. Furthermore, he isn’t able to control his ability well and it gives him headaches from time to time. With the intention of getting rid of it, he decided to enroll in Shizuka-no-Umi Academy in Saema, a leading academic research city where magia users (saucers) gathered.

However, he was caught up in an incident on his first day and saw a fellow magia saucer for the first time. The girl Sumika used her power which can heal even the most serious illnesses, and he was so captivated by her that he wished to become just like her. Thus, he started to learn how to properly use his magia with fellow students Chihaya, Leeruu, Tsumuri and his younger sister Nazuna, the most powerful magia saucer in the school.
v24506.description:
主人公“小町谷总司郎”变得“能读懂人心”了。
这种力量是大约30年前在日本开始发生的被称为“玛吉亚”的力量之一。
是能引起多种多样现象的所谓超能力。
通常这些能力会在少男少女经过数日沉睡后萌发，
而他则是花了两年这样过长的时间才获得的。
而且不仅无法随心所欲地使用，还会引发头痛，是个没用的废柴能力。
他想要消除这种能力，于是决定进入聚集了能力者的最尖端学术研究都市
“静之海学园”就读。

然而在转学第一天就卷入了事故，
他第一次见到了自己以外的玛吉亚。
治愈濒死重伤的奇迹之力，
以及使用这种力量的少女“神代澄香”，
让他移不开目光。

——我也能变得像她那样吗——

进入学园的他与“带刀千早”“绫森莉露”“馆之川螺”，
以及学年变高了的学园最强能力者的妹妹“菜砂”等
少女们一起学习如何使用玛吉亚。

v45481.title: 恋し彩る正義爛漫
v45481.originalDescription:
――When he was a child, he wanted to be a Hero of Justice. To protect everyone's peace and defeat the evil. Kourenji Hayato had always admired such strong and gallant heroes. But after all, it was just a child's daydream...... Before he knew it, as he grew older, that kind of dream had faded away――

Time passes, at the time to enroll at a high school, Hayato moves from the countryside to the city where his relatives run a boarding house. A bustling and brightly sight that is quite different from the countryside, while he is walking in the street in bewilderment―― He runs into a bus being hijacked by a very suspicious​ group wearing masks.

Hayato is trembling and unable to escape. Then, dressed in a pure white outfit, a heroine comes rushing in gallantly.

"The darkness that is spreading in this world, shall be slashed away with white light! 
The Emissary of Justice "Marron Branche", here I come!"

The disguised heroine disperses the masked group with her spectacular moves―― Unconsciously captivated by the scene, Hayato gets caught up in the midst of her fight. At this time, he accidentally sees the identity of the girl, and to his surprise, she is his cousin whom he has known since he was young, Shirakawa Mikuri.

"Everyone has things they wish to keep as a secret for themselves.
So, I wish for this to stay as a secret from everyone."

Hayato makes such an agreement with Mikuri.

The Heroine of Justice, the evil organization, and finding out the secret of his cousin...... Hayato's life at his new school and the boarding house, what is to become of him――
v45481.description:
——小时候，想成为正义的英雄。
守护大家的和平，惩恶扬善。
钢炼寺飒斗(鋼錬寺颯斗)一直憧憬着那样强大而勇敢的英雄。
但终究，那只是孩童的戏言……
不知何时，那样的梦想随着年岁增长而消散了——

时光流逝。
为了升入新的学园，飒斗从乡下搬到了亲戚经营寄宿屋的都市。
在与乡下截然不同的热闹明亮的都市景象中感到困惑，走在街上的途中——

遭遇了可疑的蒙面集团引发的劫持巴士现场。
飒斗双腿发抖，连逃跑都做不到。
这时，一位身穿纯白战衣的女主角飒爽地赶到了。

“用白色的光芒斩除蔓延于这世间的黑暗！
正义的使者‘玛隆布朗什’，在此参见！”

以华丽的舞姿击退蒙面集团的变身女主角——
不知不觉看入迷的飒斗，被卷入了她们的抗争漩涡中。
那时，偶然看到的她的真面目，竟然是从小就熟知的表妹白河美栗(白河美栗)。

“我觉得无论是谁，都有想要保密的事情。
所以，这件事也希望你对谁保密。”

飒斗与美栗立下了这样的约定。
正义的女主角、邪恶组织，以及得知的表妹的秘密……
飒斗的新的学园生活，以及寄宿屋的生活，究竟会变成怎样呢——

Areas ~Sora ni Utsusu Kimi to no Sekai~
Areas～映在天空中的与你的世界～
v1379.originalDescription:
Yuuya and Konoka, his younger sister, live homeless due to various troubles. One day, Yuuya gets an illegal job to get out of homeless life. The job, however, fails and he is captured by the group. He is ready for death, but the boss of the group says, "I like smart boys. I wanna you to be mine." 

Like this, Yuuya and Konoka are sent to an isolated island. "It's warm here! There's no cold wind!" The island is like a paradise under the clear sky and surrounded by beautiful sea. Yuuya and Konoka are ordered to live there and enter school nearby. Yuuya and Konoka's school life on the island now starts...
v1379.description:
公元2082年，日本的海上城市·新海——
主人公御影悠也（みかげ ゆうや）与义妹御影心花（御影このか）两人，被大人们自私的理由和各种困难折腾得连住处都失去了。
就在那时，为了摆脱流浪生活，悠也决定染指地下工作。
然而工作失败了，悠也被指挥军队的女人抓住了。悠也本已做好了赴死的觉悟……女人却不知为何向悠也发出了招募。
“我喜欢聪明的男孩子。所以希望你成为我的人。”
悠也和心花两人被强行带上船，被遣送到了与世界隔绝的远海孤岛“阿利亚斯”。
“哇，好暖和！风一点都不冷哦，悠哥！”
那是一个被清澈无垠的天空与碧蓝闪耀的大海环绕，宛如乐园般的地方——
悠也等人在军队的秘密监视下，作为岛民过着普通的生活，并被吩咐去岛上唯一的学园上学。
就这样，御影悠也与御影心花从流浪生活一转，在远海孤岛“阿利亚斯”过上了普通的学园生活。

v1590.originalDescription:
Susumu and Mirai - friends since childhood. They spent  time together while their parents were busy with work and business trips. All is good, but Mirai fell into a coma.

Susumu visited Mirai in the hospital, and in spite of what was already a year, nothing had changed. One morning, Susumu discovers that he can not leave the house because all the doors and windows are locked. He decided to go to bed, because nothing could be done, Susumu falls asleep on the couch. In the morning he wakes to a strangely familiar voice, 

"So, how long will you sleep?"

Mirai is standing next to the bed.

"How did you get here?" 

"Please, don't ask anything. It does not matter. I'll tell you after... now, let's make a date?"
v1590.description:

v1593.originalDescription:
"Stuck between imouto and osananajimi..."

For our protagonist Souichi it is a daily routine to get raised by his Imouto Hazuki, and then go to school with her and his osananajimi Kotone.

Someday, his parents suddenly had to go on a business trip for half a year.
While Hazuki was made to go shopping, his parents told him that she is in fact not his real imouto -- that they don't have any connection by blood.

Hazuki was secretly peeking at this scene.

After she learned that there is no blood-connection between them, she approached her beloved brother.

Kotone noticed that, and in order to keep Souichi's desire away from his little sister, she had sex with him...

And thus his H-days began -- stuck between his proactive-perverted imouto, and his osananajimi, who tried to keep them from doing "it".
v1593.description: “Moviendo”带来的短篇系列作品第一弹，是一部明快、色情又带点感伤的AVG。主人公与突然出现的本该住院的青梅竹马展开了一场不可思议的约会。度过在现实中不可能存在的不可思议又快乐的时光，两人的约会结局将会如何？

Areas ~Koi Suru Otome no San Eichi~
v3817.originalDescription: This is the after spin-off from Areas and is a love story about maidens, for maidens. Konoka and Ryiz both love Yuuya very much and one day confessed to him at the same time. As rivals in love, they were always around him, joining the same clubs as him, and making bentou for him. Suddenly appeared a quiet and refined girl, and he began to take an interest in her.
v3817.description:
乙女的、由乙女创作的、为了乙女的恋爱物语
莉兹·弗兰内尔(リィズ・フランネル)，正在恋爱。
御影心花(御影このか)知道了隐藏在自己心中的这份感情就是恋爱。
两人恋爱的对象的名字是，御影悠也…。两人同时喜欢上了同一个人。
成为学园三年级生后不久的某一天，悠也同时被心花和莉兹两人告白。
面对因突然的告白而不知所措的悠也，两人成为了恋爱的竞争对手，在对决的同时进行各种诱惑。
上学时两人一起围住悠也，悠也当上图书委员的话两人也当图书委员，中午交给他亲手做的便当，放学后则围绕与悠也度过的时间而争吵。
在这样的日子流逝之中，悠也偶然看到了某个少女。
那个少女静静地，带着凛然的表情独自一人，伫立在教室之中。
在喧闹的日子中偶然相遇的少女……悠也，开始渐渐在意起那个少女的事情了。
究竟，悠也和她们的恋爱去向会变得怎样呢…。
楚楚可怜的少女们的恋爱物语现在，拉开帷幕―――。
