v25707.originalDescription:
Arisa is normal student with a dream of becoming famous actor in the future and has been attending famous acting school for years. After passing the exam to have a chance of going out to real performance for the first time as sub, she has to face a problem with money according to the rule set for non-main actors.

In despair, she reaches out for compensated dating where she meets protagonist - a salary man with only interest in high school girl compensated dating. Little did they know this fateful encounter will change their life forever.
v25707.description:
隶属于知名剧团的“雨宫亚梨纱(雨宮亜梨紗)”，为了实现自己的梦想一直在脚踏实地不断努力着。
某天，她被选为定期公演舞台的替补演员。

梦寐以求的初次登台，然而给替补演员规定“门票配额”是那个剧团的传统。
门票金额总共10万日元……。这对现在的她来说，是一笔太大的巨款。

强烈反对她加入剧团的父母和亲戚那里是靠不上的。
虽说如此，如果去做普通的兼职，就没有时间排练了。

四处奔走的结果，是什么成果也没得到而被逼入绝境的雨宫亚梨纱。

“爸爸，妈妈，对不起”

一边对父母抱有罪恶感一边使用化名，在SNS上发帖。

“因为急需用钱，在东京都内卖初夜。除了酒店费之外请从10万日元起”

对她来说这条信息的意义，是摧毁最后的堡垒——

然后以“如果能让我确认处女膜的话”为条件，雨宫亚梨纱将与主人公相遇。

v19644.originalDescription:
As the scorching sun blazed down on Nanami Shun, a searing memory of his sister's tragic drowning seared into his mind, a wound that would never fully heal. Vowing to live in her place, to make up for the life she never got to experience, he resolved to carry her memory with him always.

Years passed, and Shun found himself caught up in the mundanity of everyday life, attending school and going through the motions. But as summer once again descended upon him, the familiar heat brought with it the ghost of his sister's memory.

Just then, he hears a piano's melody far off in the distance, the same tune that his sister had always cherished. Drawn to the sound like a moth to a flame, he followed it until it led him to a stunning sight.

"Please take care of me from now on, Onii-chan."

The thought of his younger sister, who had been taken away by fate years ago, resurfaced as he saw an android that looked just like her, "TRINO."
v19644.description:
妹妹死了。
在酷暑的盛夏，溺死的。

这件事将使我终生难忘，永远铭记在心。
我决定要好好活下去，把她的那份也一起活下去。
决定把所有一切都当作美好的回忆，接受过去，走向未来。

当时的我确有这种想法。

就这样我度过了痛苦的幼年时期，每天一成不变地去学校上学。
又到了酷暑时节，这个让我回忆起“她”的时候。
从远处传来的是妹妹曾喜欢的曲子，是钢琴声。
走近后出现在我眼前的是，妹妹。

「今后也请多多关照」
「哥哥」

妹妹已经死了。

伴随着这个确凿无误的记忆出现在我眼前的是，和妹妹一模一样的智能机器人，
“トリノ”——

――――――――――――――――――――

トリノ制作完成了。
又可以开始和过去一样的生活了。

拥有人工智能的人形机器人——智能机器人技术突飞猛进，已经慢慢渗透到了现代社会的各个领域。

在智能研究领域作出杰出贡献的紬木沙羅，制作完成了新型智能机器人 “トリノ”。

就外表和行动来看，和人类没有区别。
声音和体温也和普通人一模一样。
此外，这个智能机器人还有一个与众不同的地方——

那就是拥有“七波舜”的亡故妹妹，“七波白音”的记忆。

「早上好，トリノ」
「你要——我要改变世界的时候到来了」

v21295.description:
从正篇《特里诺兰》的后日谈，到“故事虽然变成了那样，但如果这样的话呢……？”这种“如果”的故事，包含了各种内容的《特里诺兰:创世纪》。

::七波白音(七波シロネ):每一天，都是重要的日子。::
某天，白音找舜商量，说想办一次班里成为话题的“生日会”。
为了设法实现她的愿望而四处奔走的舜，却发现白音根本没有生日——

既没有进食功能也没有生日的白音的生日会，究竟会变成什么样！？
::宫风夕梨:两人与，羁绊。::
在快乐同居生活中的某天，一只迷路的猫闯了进来——

虽然经历了种种但幸福生活着的两人与一只猫，突然发生的意外是什么？而这又会给他们带来什么！？
::花子·F·布里斯托尔(ハナコ・Ｆ・ブリストル):虚假的她与，恋心。::
和夕梨的关系闹僵了的花子。看不下去的舜决定代替夕梨帮忙做风纪委员的工作。
在一起度过的过程中，舜得知花子是个相当的大小姐，并且正在被安排相亲。
为了帮助这样的她，舜决定假装花子的恋人，但是——

扮演大家都十分憧憬的【假恋人】的两人，等待着他们的是什么！？
在正篇中给人奔放但有坚强核心印象的花子。::日比野绫花:秘密的，我。::
母亲的问题（参见正篇）总算解决了，作为普通女孩生活着的绫花。
这样的她抱有一个烦恼……那就是因为被舜看到了那个，她总担心有一天会被周围的人发现秘密。
过着不安稳日子的绫花，终于向舜坦白了那个烦恼，但是——

绫花作为自卑感所抱有的那件事，其实是魅力点啊！
让身为凡人的舜君突然去传达这件事，未免太强人所难了。但是想要做些什么的两人所采取的行动是！？
::紬木沙罗:追寻着，两人的日子。::
沙罗回到岛上的日子。
没能遵守离别前交换的“找到丢失的鸟笼的【钥匙】”这个约定的舜，在没有被告知为何她突然决定回来的情况下，去迎接了她。
然后，两人出门进行了对他们来说第一次的【像约会一样的约会】，但是——

在正篇里总是那种感觉，一起吃饭（正经的）、一起出门等快乐场景不多的她，这次出其不意的约会目的地是！？
::姬野永远(姫野 永遠)（客串）:永远的，暑假。::
学校生活最后的暑假。
永远和终(宫坂终)计划去稍微远一点的地方旅行。
在夏日的空气中，两人换乘电车，终于到达了目的地，但是——

在正篇中变得要好的永远和终，两人之后怎么样了？以及在旅行地等待着他们的是什么！？

没玩过《其之先的前奏诗》的人，也可以先试着玩一下Yorino的体验版。Nihii！

即便如此，我也。

v23458.originalDescription:
Ritsuki, his younger sister Runa and childhood friend Mayu attend a school that is popular for its drama activities, with many of its graduates going on to become famous actors and scenario writers. Shortly after the entrance ceremony, they were invited by their classmate Inori to join the drama club. Ritsuki was eager to aim for the school’s primaries for the national competition, but first year students were forbidden from participating in the contest. They wouldn’t accept the fact that they were excluded just because they didn’t have much experience. If only they were given the opportunity to demonstrate their acting abilities…

Rumour has it that there is a ghost that haunts the theater. It is said that it will grant any wish so long as it is related to drama.
v23458.description:
校园里，流传着一个传闻。\

**友濑 律希(友瀬 律希)**与妹妹**友濑瑠奈(友瀬 瑠奈)**、青梅竹马**池贝舞雪(池貝 舞雪)**等人就读的，是一所不仅女演员、男演员辈出，\
还培养出著名编剧等，戏剧相关活动十分繁盛的学校。\

入学后，从小就接触戏剧的律希与瑠奈两人，邀请了总是容易在周围显得格格不入的\
同班同学**深浜 祈莉**，再加上仰慕律希的舞雪也一同加入，进入了戏剧部。\

面向通往全国大赛阶梯的校内预选赛，干劲十足的律希等人。\

然而，据说一年级学生连参加预选赛的资格都没有。\

尽管经验尚浅，但对连参加都不被允许一事无法信服的他们，\
好歹设法争取到了一次在舞台上展示他们演技的约定……。\

附身在舞台上的幽灵的传闻。\\

「听说那个幽灵啊，只要是关于戏剧的愿望 “ 什么都能 ” 实现哦——」

v548.originalDescription:
May 1, 1945 ― Germany. On the eve of Berlin's collapse, a group of men and women carried out a certain ritual. To them, suffering defeat in the war meant nothing. If anything, the countless lives lost in the battle served as a catalyst to their sacrificial ceremony. Whether or not their attempt bore fruit ― not a soul knows. Following the war, they faded from sight, mind, and eventually into the realm of myth.


61 years later ― Japan, 2006.
Ren Fujii, a young man attending high school in Suwahara City, finds his friendship with his old buddy Shirou Yusa shatter to pieces following a certain incident, ending in a vicious fight that sees Ren hospitalized for two months.
The season shifts from autumn to winter ― to the dawning weeks of December, with Christmas on the horizon. Having lost his best friend, Ren leaves the hospital with the intention to rebuild his new life without Shirou.
But even that plan soon falls apart. Irrationality that defies the realm of common sense begins to assault and devour the city. Abnormalities soon seek to destroy everything Ren holds dear before his eyes with overwhelming violence.
He must change, even if it means crossing the boundary between the ordinary and the extraordinary. His desires are hardly anything grand. All he wants is to return to those days of old. Back to those days filled with simple, everyday joy.
The battle with the Longinus Dreizehn Orden. A continuation of that war full of madness, carnage, and maledictions. What future awaits Ren at the end of his road...?



A thoroughly rewritten and expanded remake of Dies irae Also sprach Zarathustra. Henceforth, the two should be treated as different games.
v548.description:
怒火之日迎来了其未知的结局……

2007年12月发售的传奇战斗冒险游戏『Dies irae Also sprach Zarathstra』，以现代日本为舞台，描绘主人公・莲与圣枪十三骑士团之间的战斗的本作终于以完全新作的姿态登场！
作为完全新制剧本收录了主剧本写手・正田崇写作的「萤」「玲爱」路线。与此相应追加新制语音、原画家・G-Yusuke的完全新制图像！此外、在广播剧CD『Die Morgendammerung』中登场的“川岛里乃(かわしまりの)”饰演的新角色「贝阿特丽切·瓦尔图特·冯·基尔希艾森(ベアトリス・ヴァルトルート・フォン・キルヒアイゼン)」等，至今为止没有登场的角色们也会于故事中登场，『Dies irae』的世界将会更加激烈！
此外本作还预定使用因演唱前作主题歌而为玩家熟识的榊原由依(榊原ゆい)演唱的新制主题歌！作词由榊原由依本人、作曲由与犹启至(与猶啓至)负责！另外配合新制剧情也预定追加新制背景音乐！
敬请期待light「Dies」团队奉上的「学园传奇战斗歌剧」！
 
故事情节
1945年、5月1日……德国。在陷落的柏林，一些人正在进行某个仪式。
对他们来说在战争中败北不过是鸡毛蒜皮的小事，甚至还将在战争中产生的大量牺牲者作为仪式的触媒献为祭品。
他们的尝试成功了还是失败了，没有人知道。
他们在战后隐藏了行踪，不知是生是死，甚至让人无法确定他们是否真实存在过，无人知道真相，只有传言传播。
圣枪十三骑士团——纳粹德国的黑暗中诞生的超人们。
他们终将回归。其时世界将破灭。故，决不可允许他们的再来——这样一个传言。
然后61年的时光流逝。知道他们的存在的人，大部分已经死亡，众人忘记了他们。
然而——
 
2006年……日本。就读诹访原市的学园的藤井莲(藤井蓮)，在某事件之后与好友・游佐司狼(遊佐司狼)决裂，仿佛厮杀般干架的结果是两个月的被迫入院生活。
季节由秋转冬——圣诞临近的12月。
怀着仿佛半身被夺的丧失感，退院的莲想着要重新构筑没有司狼的崭新日常生活。
往者不可追。那么，至少要珍惜如今手中之物……
但是，连这个愿望也分崩离析。
每晚梦见的断头台的噩梦。狩猎人头的杀人犯。追杀他的黑衣“骑士”们。超越常识的不条理覆盖城市，逐渐侵蚀。
这份异常完全不是两个月前能相比的，暴力到粉碎至今为止积累而成的全部事物的非日常。
不改变的话，没法活下去。不活下去的话，没法回去。
在以加速度疯狂下去的世界中心，莲独自跨过日常与非日常的界线。
并没有期望什么了不得的事。也不是想高举正义与大义的旗帜。
只是，想回去而已。回到没趣、无聊然而平凡、温暖的那段时光。
胸怀悲壮的决意，司狼的声音回响。
只要还在这个城市，无论是谁迟早都要疯掉——他如是说。

与圣枪十三骑士团的战斗。充满狂气与杀戮与诅咒的战争的连续。
在那尽头，莲究竟将会看到什么呢。

v6291.title: 妹之形
v6291.originalDescription: Yukito doesn’t have a single relative after a great flood which claimed the lives of his parents when he was small. That was also when his younger sister went missing. One day, he happened to hear in the news that the past records pertaining to the disaster would be available to the public for the 15th anniversary of the event. He decided to return to his hometown of Kugumi village, holding on to the belief that if he checked those records he might be able to reunite with his long lost younger sister that he only faintly remembers.
v6291.description:
故事发生在距今不远的未来世界。

美馬雪人 （みま ゆきと）是一个孤身一人漂泊异乡勤工俭学的青年。幼年时因为灾害失去了双亲，隐约有印象的妹妹也下落不明。

被设施收养后，一边打工赚取学费一边上学。

就在某一天，偶然在新闻里看到了故乡城市。

虽然城市在导致双亲双亡的实验都市灾害中承受了毁灭性的打击，但之后在居民们的齐心协力下得以重建。

重建后十五年之际，过去的记录得以广泛公开。

灾害发生时，很多孩子都失去了双亲、兄妹，自身也身处难以预计的悲惨境地之中。

作为受害者之一的雪人坚信，如果调查被公开的过去的记录就可能和下落不明的妹妹再会。

于是雪人为了寻找隐约留有印象的妹妹，决定前往故乡城市·鵠見市（くぐみし） 白鸟环境特区——

v6438.title: D.C.III ～ダ・カーポIII～
aliases: D.C. III R ~Da Capo III R~ X-rated -
v6438.originalDescription:
The sakura that bloomed year-round are now a thing of the past and Hatsune Island is now known as an island that shows that beauty of each season. 

Kiyotaka is a second-year student at Kazami Academy who is part of the news club along with the school idol Rikka, his younger sister-like childhood friend Himeno, his mixed-race cousin Charles, hard-working junior who skipped a grade and is in his class Sara, and energetic in spirit but weak in body Aoi. 

Unlike in the past, there are no more mysterious things happening on the island. That was until one winter day when the sakura began to bloom. All the news club members got a message on their cell phones telling them to do something at a promised place when the sakura begins to bloom. They couldn’t make out the rest of the message, but are surprised that it was dated 1951. Rikka was extremely curious about the message and the sudden blooming of the sakura, so she called on everyone to solve the mystery with her.
v6438.description:
初音岛篇 故事
一整年樱花盛开乱舞的景象如今已成往事。
初音岛作为一座展现出四季各异表情、自然丰饶的岛屿而广为人知。
位于初音岛的风见学园。
在那里上学的附属二年级学生芳乃清隆，与学姐兼被称为学园偶像的森园立夏、像妹妹一样的青梅竹马葛木姬乃(葛木姫乃)、混血儿表妹芳乃夏露露(芳乃シャルル)等5名女孩子一起作为新闻部开展活动。
话虽如此，在如今不再像过去那样充满不可思议之事的初音岛上，也没有发生什么值得写成报道的事件，每天都是在部室里慵懒度日。

——那样的某个冬日。
明明是冬天，初音岛的樱花却一齐开始绽放了。
此外，惊讶的新闻部成员们的手机同时收到了邮件。发件人不明。其内容是，
“樱花绽放时，在约定的那个地方——”
后半部分变成了乱码无法阅读。但是，总觉得有些意味深长的文章。而且，发送时间竟然是1951年。
“这是从过去发来的邮件哦！你不觉得这正是在暗示现在的状况吗？约定的那个地方究竟在哪里？那里会发生什么？说起来，为什么樱花会突然绽放？我们新闻部要解开这个谜团！”
新闻部部长森园立夏充满力量地如此宣言道。

推进谜团调查的清隆等人。仿佛受到邀请般造访的，那棵永不枯萎的樱花树。
在那旁边，伫立着一位女性。明明应该是初次见面，却感到非常非常怀念。
“那么，就请让我为您讲述吧”
谜之女性讲述的往事。那是发生在100多年前的伦敦，她与清隆等人相遇与离别的故事。
“宛如达·卡波般循环往复，如梦似梦的，起始的故事”

风见鸡篇 故事
以及谜之女性讲述的，另一个故事——

作为日本屈指可数的魔法师家系葛木家的长子清隆，与妹妹姬乃一起，为了前往英国伦敦的皇家伦敦魔法学园、通称“风见鸡”留学而漂洋过海。
在异国他乡等待着清隆与姬乃的，是被深雾笼罩的伦敦街景，以及在其地下蔓延的巨大学园都市。
在地下湖中，宛如新月般排列漂浮的，由3座岛屿组成的学园都市。
为了在最好的环境中学习魔法，来自世界各地的魔法师苗子们聚集于此。
在那里与许多伙伴相遇，清隆虽然对新的环境感到困惑，但也度过了愉快的学园生活。
那宛如达·卡波般循环往复的，平凡的，又如梦似梦的日子……。

某日，清隆与莉卡(リッカ)一起走在伦敦的街上。
在巨大的钟楼下，两人遇到了一位少女。手中拿着小樱花枝的这位少女，失去了大部分记忆。
并且检查结果显示她拥有魔力，少女便暂时由风见鸡来照看。

——清隆有着父亲托付的愿望。
为了实现它，必须成为风见鸡的学生会干部。为此清隆参加了学生会选举。
就在这时，女王的委托传来了。
有人使用魔法之力伤害人们——
为了防患于未然，清隆等人在雾气深重的伦敦街头四处奔走。

失忆的谜之少女，与一年到头不放晴的雾。以及她手中那枝魔法樱花。
清隆等人的命运齿轮开始转动。
那宛如达·卡波般循环往复的，相遇与离别的故事。

v10793.title: 仓野家的双胞胎故事
v10793.original: 倉野くんちのふたご事情
aliases: 倉野くんちのふたご事情
The twins situation of the Kurano family
v10793.originalDescription:
The 8-person Kurano household that runs the cafe Apple Pie has three sets of twins. The oldest pair is the reliable Izumi and the sporty Mikoto, followed by Kazuya and his tsukkomi-type twin Tomoka. The youngest twins are the Yamato Nadeshiko-like Yae who’s great at housework, and the ‘so cute you can’t help but hug her’ Ema. They get along well even if their parents fight constantly. However, one summer day, their parents’ arguments had escalated to divorce! His mother gained custody of Kazuya and only one of the 5 daughters. Thus begins the struggle among his sisters to be with the brother that they all love so very much. 



After storming out of the house their mother allows Kazuya one month to decide which sister will come with him. To make the situation worse the morning after their father leaves for a month on a journey of self discovery. The twins must all work together to keep their parents pastry shop running and Kazuya gets to live alone with all of his sisters!
v10793.description:
经营咖啡厅“苹果派”的仓野家，是一个有着3对双胞胎、总共8人的大家庭。
最上面的双胞胎是，仓野泉(いずみ)和仓野美琴(みこと)。踏实能干的优等生长女，和虽然学习不行但擅长运动的次女。
第二对双胞胎是，仓野智花(智花)和仓野和哉(和哉)。负责吐槽的常识人三女，和被家人比父亲还要依赖的长男（主人公）。
第三对双胞胎是，仓野弥惠(弥恵)和仓野绘麻(絵麻)。擅长家务的大和抚子四女，和被娇惯着长大的像小猫一样的五女。
父母虽然经常吵架，但一直以“苹果派”为中心，每天和睦地生活着。
然而——就在暑假前夕的某一天。
一如既往吵架的父母这次白热化了，终于发展到了谈离婚的地步！能跟着被决定交给母亲一方抚养的和哉一起走的，在五姐妹中只有一个人。
和弟弟哥哥一起生活的是，我！！
赌上和最喜欢的长男一起生活的未来，仓野家五姐妹的“主人公争夺战”，现在开始——！！

v11301.title: 爱丽娅的明日盛典！
v11301.description:
佐久茂地区作为赏樱胜地而闻名。近年来，作为区域重建的一环，引入了实验性的教育系统，在新建的作生台学院由学生自主管理，以期提升学生生活。有能力且致力于改善学习环境的学生，将获得各种好处。此外，据说成绩优秀者会被赋予特别特权。

时隔许久回到佐久茂区的莲(レン)转了学，与胆小的妹妹花梨(かりん)以及青梅竹马椎名(しいな)重逢。开学第一天，他遭遇了一些麻烦，并救下了一个女孩。少女阿兹哈(アズハ)请求他加入自己的社团，以ALIA为目标，改变学校。面对突如其来的邀请他虽然感到困惑，但想到新的学校生活一定会充满刺激而感到高兴。
v11301.originalDescription:
The Sakumo ward is well known for its cherry blossoms. In recent years, as part of the redevelopment of the ward, an experimental education system was introduced where the students would govern themselves in the newly constructed Sakumodai Gakuin to improve the student life. Those students who are capable and work hard to improve the learning environment would receive various benefits. Also, it seemed that the one with the top results would get a special privilege.

Ren returned to Sakumo ward after a long time away and transferred into the school, reuniting with his timid little sister Karin and childhood friend Shiina, who had grown up to be very beautiful. On his first day at school, he was caught up in some trouble and ended up saving a girl. The girl Asuha asked him to join her club, aim for ALIA and change the school. He was puzzled over her sudden invitation, but was excited that his new school life will be surely be an exciting one.

v11487.original: 狙われた女神天使エンゼルティアー ～守った人間達に裏切られて～
aliases: 圣天之泪：惨遭背刺的天使
狙われた女神天使エンゼルティアー ～守った人間達に裏切られて～
Nerawareta Megami Tenshi Angeltear ~Mamotta Ningen-tachi ni Uragirarete~
v11487.originalDescription:
After a certain incident, Yuuri was guided by Suzune, the goddess angel Holy Rouge to become "Angeltear", and fight against the demons. Yuuri keeps fighting bravely to protect the peace of the human world, her friends and her loved ones. However, the demons saw through her personality, and prepared a special trap for her. After seeing how Angeltear uses up all her energy, they purposely start to contaminate males. The demons threaten her by saying that the only way to save these men is by sexually satisfying them.

But that's not the only problem, there are more people apart from the demons aiming for Angeltear: men that she rescued from the demon's hands, men that go after her with lust when she uses up her energy, men that lie about being attacked by demons to get some sexual services and people that threaten her with revealing her secret identity unless she services them. Not only do they go for her when she's transformed, but these people that she saved also go after her body when she isn't transformed...
v11487.description: 优理以某起事件为契机，在身为女神天使圣红的凉音引导下变身为“天使泪”，与魔族展开战斗。她为了保护朋友、重要的人以及人间的和平而坚强战斗。魔族看穿其性格并设下狡猾的陷阱，会在她耗尽能量后采取行动；被她从魔族手中救出的人们中，也有人威胁她并以其真实身份为把柄逼她听话。

v11686.originalDescription: Strange other-worldly beings known as youkai have existed in Japan since ancient times. Not too far in the future, humans lived together with youkai harmoniously and studied their mysterious abilities. Kazuto lived in the research city of Byakuya-jima and had grown up with youkai by his side. Following his motto of enjoying every moment of life, he enrolled in Shiramine Gakuen with his osananajimi Shizune. However, on the day of the entrance ceremony, he reunited with a girl who he used to play with and who had saved his life: the oni girl Miyabi. That spelled the end of his normal days as many other youkai and humans flocked to his side.
v11686.description:
早上醒来时，房间里有个病娇君。
看来病娇君是擅自闯入了房间！
虽然被纠缠着感到很困扰，但不知为何主人公君无法将他推开……
主人公君今天也被病娇君玩弄于股掌之间！！？
整体上脑子和下半身都很松的病娇BL游戏。
来疼爱脑子不好的病娇男子吧！！

v12292.title: せんすいぶ！
v12292.originalDescription: In this country where it’s slightly warmer due to global warming, the hottest thing is a new female-only water sport called "sensui", where girls ride torpedo-like high-performance mini-subs called ‘MAV’s and try to knock down their opponents by shooting special water attacks at them. The sensui team at Aosaki Academy doesn’t have enough members nor do they perform well in competitions. However, the club leader Maasa is determined to turn around the fortunes of the school by enlisting a sensui ace Mito to the team. The four girls (Mito, Alice, Maasa, Rikoko) are managed by a male coach, Riku, whose dream of becoming a sensui player was dashed due to the gender restriction. Together, they aim to compete and win the national competition, the Wassergrahl.
v12292.description:
舞台是西日本某座沿海城市，青崎市。

在这个全球变暖比现在稍微严重一些的国家里，被称为【战水】的事物正成为热议的话题。
如今正稳步扩大着国内支持度的【禁止男性】的新兴水上运动。

私立青崎学园（通常简称：青学）的战水部，空有社团之名，因部员不足与成绩匮乏，连存续都岌岌可危，是一支弱小队伍。
虽然是这样的队伍，但今年唯一的部员即部长下定决心。
从将战水俱乐部青年组的前王牌选手带到青学的那一刻起，万年弱小校青学的反击必定就已经开始了。

因为替人着想且温柔，而在临门一脚处陷入瓶颈的，我们青学的一年级王牌，蓬生美都(蓬生みと)。
攻击性且暴力的态度是自卑感的反面。其他方面不行但论速度则是全国水平的速度之星，阿莉榭·藤叶(アリーシェ・藤葉)。
积累的练习量绝不会对她撒谎。青学战水部部长兼气氛制造者兼努力之人，桥姬真麻。
无论何时都毫不动摇的钢铁精神与扑克脸，在背后支撑队伍的幕后功臣，梅枝莉子子。

而指挥这样一支队伍的司令塔就是我，长谷见陆。
曾经被【禁止男性】这堵高墙阻挡、作为战水选手的梦想破灭的我，这次竟然能作为教练再次站上战水的舞台……
对于给予我这个机会的她们，真的只有感谢的话语。
正因如此，我们必定要这5个人一起冲向。
所有战水选手的目标与憧憬，一切的顶点——全国大赛决赛＜瓦瑟·格拉尔＞。

v13694.title: 恋する気持ちの花言葉
v13694.original: 恋する気持ちの花言葉
aliases: 恋する気持ちの花言葉
v13694.originalDescription: This is the first title by HexenHaus. Takumi was entrusted with managing the student dormitory that had previously been taken care of by his grandmother. He went to the dormitory with his osananajimi Kana and greeted new residents Nanakusa and Sara. After the busy spring break, he started the new school term with Kana, Sara, and his friend since last year Tsubaki. Due to bad grades, Kana and Tsubaki also ended up living at the dormitory as well. Thus began the awkward house life with his osananajimi, friend, kouhai and senpai, as a new dorm manager.
v13694.description:
将这份思念融入花束中　哪朵花最适合你？
春假。 宗方拓海 被托付了祖母至今为止作为舍母悉心管理的学生宿舍的管理工作。
受热心照顾人的祖母影响而不懂拒绝别人请求的拓海欣然答应。
与青梅竹马的風祭花奈 一起前往宿舍，那里新生白根七草 和 高年级生姫柳沙羅 已经入住，作为新任舍母，以及就读同一所学院的学生，他们互相打了招呼。
在忙碌度过的春假结束后，拓海在新学年的分班中与花奈、从去年起就是朋友的八重樫椿、以及因出勤日数不足而留级的沙羅分在了同一个班级。
然后在学年初的实力测试中，花奈、椿、沙羅的成绩不佳，之后经过一番波折，花奈和椿也住进了宿舍。
就这样，新手舍母与青梅竹马、朋友、前辈、后辈聚集在同一屋檐下，奇妙的共同生活开始了。

v14270.title: Endless Dungeon
aliases: エンドレスダンジョン
v14270.originalDescription: This is a sequel to the Tiny Dungeon series, featuring new heroines. Trinity is a school which trains future heroes. A half year after the past heroes successfully passed the trials, a group of new youths pass through the gate, brimming with confidence. One of them was Hime’s imouto, Miko, who came to support her brother. In addition, there was a second blond-haired dragon girl and two girls who came from 20 years in the future and are of a fifth race which was a mixture of all the special traits of the demons, gods, dragons and humans. What future lies ahead for our hero who had opened the gate?
v14270.description:
Trinity。那是为了培育未来的勇者而创造的学园。
过去的勇者们带来的试炼顺利落下帷幕已过半年，那里迎来了新的年轻人们。
对自己的力量抱有不小自信的人们。每个人都梦想着成为勇者的自己，穿过那扇门。
而在其中，有一名人类族的少女。
作为曾经掀起过巨大战争的种族，被忌讳嫌恶的种族的少女。
白鹭皇女（しらさぎ みこ）。
两年前，她哥哥不顾周围人的反对，以成为未来的勇者为目标前往了这所学园。为了成为他的力量，她现在穿过了Trinity的门。
从周围倾注而来的，蔑视与嘲笑的视线。
向高声报上姓名表示绝不认输的少女投来的，学园生们的话语。
“呀啊啊——！你是白鹭学长的妹妹吗！？骗人的吧，下次一定要介绍给我！！”
“哥哥……你到底做了什么！？”
展现出确切变化的Trinity。在那里开始聚集的未来的碎片们。
被选中的勇者的妹妹。本不该存在的、拥有金发的第二名龙族。以及自称第五种族的谜之少女们。
现在，为了回应众多的期待，《TinyDungeon》之后的舞台拉开帷幕。
打开了勇者之门的少年，在那未来会成就什么呢。

v14534.title: 爽海バッカニアーズ!
v14534.originalDescription:
Rian Lawrence is a 16-year-old girl whose mother passed away when she was a child and now her father has gone missing. She dreams of becoming a seafaring adventurer, having been influenced by watching church plays, hearing epic heroic tales and learning that her missing father was also an adventurer who crossed the ocean. To fulfill this desire, she leaves the town where she has comfortably lived, and ventures to the port, King’s Bridge.

Shortly after her arrival, she gets caught up in a tussle and ends up acting in unison with pirates. From then on, she grew interested in them. Two methods of being able to go to sea appear before her- one being “pirates”, and the other, the “navy”.

Will she choose to live her life as a pirate aboard their ship; joining the elusive and whimsical crew lead by its chivalrous yet self-centred ore-sama captain and the always calm, cool and collected deputy captain with a scary smile? Or will she join the ranks of the navy; answering to a young-looking naval commanding officer who’s proud of his nobility and the older, taciturn deputy commanding officer who exudes an aura of depth?

Which will the protagonist choose? What kind of adventurer will she become? Who will become the closest partner at her side?
v14534.description:
自幼丧母，父亲也下落不明的16岁少女。
受到教会戏剧和英雄传说中讲述的故事影响，加上听说下落不明的父亲也曾是如此，她一直梦想着成为渡海的冒险家，于是离开熟悉的城镇，来到了港口城市金斯布里奇。

刚一抵达城市，她便卷入骚乱并与海盗们共同行动，以此为契机，她开始对“海盗”这一存在产生了兴趣。

在她面前，作为出海的方式，开启了“海盗”与“海军”这两条立场不同的道路。

是乘坐海盗船作为海盗活下去，与有男子气概但以自我为中心的唯我独尊型船长、总是冷静沉着且笑容可怕的副船长、神出鬼没且反复无常的船员们为伍；还是成为海军，与外表稚嫩却怀有贵族骄傲的海军队长、寡言少语且似乎有着深层背景的大一轮的海军副队长们一起共事。

主人公会选择哪一条路，出海后会成为怎样的冒险家呢。
还有，那时待在主人公身旁的搭档又会是谁呢……。

v15393.title: 恋爱中的她的笨拙舞台
v15393.original: 恋する彼女の不器用な舞台
aliases: 恋爱中的她的笨拙舞台
恋する彼女の不器用な舞台
Koi Suru Kanojo no Bukiyou na Butai
All the world's a stage, and all the men and women merely players.
The Awkward Performance of a Girl in Love
v15393.originalDescription:
The students at Hayakubo Academy are all excited about the upcoming culture festival. However, the clubs with not many members have a problem on their hands: if they don’t complete the task that the student council assigned them for the festival, then their club will be disbanded.

For the literary club which Ichigo was part of, they must prove that they deserve a club room and funds by selling 100 copies of their latest work. His childhood friend Mayuu, who used to be a famous actress, was worried about losing a place to call her own, while his underclassmen and writer Sena had no desire to join another club. However, they had only sold 35 copies at the last festival and they couldn’t see how they could meet their goal with only the three of them in the club.

The leader of the 2-member drama club, Momoka, came to them and offered them with a solution. Their club would be disbanded if they didn’t put on a great play at the culture festival, so she asked them to write a script for them and also to take part in the play. She also wanted Mayuu to return to the stage. Will the literature club and drama club successfully complete their tasks?
v15393.description:
私立早久保学园正为了学生们的主要活动——秋季文化祭而热闹非凡。
——然而，部员人数少的通称“弱小社团”的大家都在抱头苦恼。
那是因为他们被强加了“如果在文化祭上无法完成学生会给出的课题就废部”这样麻烦的条件。
接着，主人公宫国一悟所属的文艺部也收到了通知。
那就是“文艺部的社刊如果卖不出100本就废部”。
学生会说：“如果有文艺杂志的需求，提供社团活动室和社团经费才有意义。”
原本是著名女演员，现在是同属文艺部部员的青梅竹马十川真优感到困扰地说“我的容身之所要没了”，
现役作家学妹七濑千奈则困惑地说“除了文艺部以外没有我想参加的社团活动”。
但是，只有3人的文艺部部员们却找不到解决的办法。
这时来到他们身边的，是演剧部部长千代田百花。
“没有演出实绩的演剧部不能称为演剧部。如果在这次文化祭上无法上演戏剧的话，就废部。”
学生会虽然发出了这样的通知，但演剧部的部员人数只有区区2人。舞台演出之类根本是不可能的事。所以——
“想让文艺部来写剧本，并且也希望能来演出！
　还有，希望真优能再次作为女演员站上舞台！！”百花这样说道。

文艺部和演剧部究竟能否顺利完成学生会的课题呢？
真优会再次站上舞台吗？然后，一悟和女孩们的恋情又将何去何从？
尽管抱有各种各样的问题，文化祭的举办日还是一刻一刻地逼近了——

ネコぱら Vol.1 ソレイユ開店しました!
v15538.description:
水无月嘉祥离开了老家——一家传统老字号的日式点心店，
以西式糕点师的身份开了一家名为『La Soleil』的蛋糕店。

然而，从老家寄来的行李中，混进了两只在老家养过的人型猫咪——巧克力和香草。
准备送猫娘回去的嘉祥经不住她们的一再哀求，
决定带着两只猫娘开始Soleil的经营。

为了最喜欢的主人，
两只猫娘经历无数挫折仍在拼命努力的
暖心人猫喜剧，正式上演！
v15538.originalDescription:
What's NEKOPARA? Why, it's a cat paradise! 

Minazuki Kashou, the son of a long line of Japanese confection makers moved out to open his own shop "La Soleil" as a patisserie. 

But upon moving out, hidden amongst his things were two of the catgirls ("neko"), Chocola and Vanilla, that the family had been raising. When he tried to send them back, they begged and pleaded until he gave in and now they've opened La Soleil together. 

With two nekos who really, REALLY love their master trying their very best and occasionally failing -- a heartful comedy opens for business! 

See the Sayori NEKO WORKs’ mascots Chocola and Vanilla like never before, moving, and in full voice on screen. And now with the E-mote System, the characters smoothly move on screen changing expression and poses in countless ways.

aliases: 爱丽娅的明日盛典！Flowering Sky
愛麗婭的明日盛典！Flowering Sky
ALIA's CARNIVAL！ フラワリングスカイ
愛麗婭的明日盛典! Flowering Sky
v16483.originalDescription:
This is the sequel to Alia's Carnival!. Spring turned to summer at Sakumodai Gakuen, which is home to the future science curriculum and self-governed by students who possess ‘arcane’ abilities. As usual, Ren is giving it his all in his quest for ALIA, enjoying his school life with his group of friends.

One day, a strange girl Inori appeared, proclaiming that she is a messenger from the student council. After that, his surroundings began to gradually change. What kind of story awaits him?
v16483.description:
位于都市近郊，作为赏樱胜地而闻名的樱云区。那里存在着以学生自治为理念的樱云台学院。
在学院里学习名为未来科学的课程，被赋予名为“阿肯”的能力，学生们自我磨炼并相互竞争。
并且根据其成果，设立了能够享受学习环境的改善及各种恩惠的“ALIA's CARNIVAL！”这一制度。
季节流转，初夏——
隶属于“明天吹拂未来之风研究会（通称·明日研）”的主人公·才城莲，为了目标ALIA今天也致力于社团活动。
每天开朗交谈的同班同学们。一如既往地严厉的风纪监察委员会的各位。
与结识的许多伙伴们，度过忙碌又快乐的学院生活。
在这样的莲身边，某天出现了一位不可思议的少女。名字是朔日祈(朔日いのり)。她说自己是来自学生会的使者。
然后，前往度假胜地·碧岛的交换留学。学院后山隐藏的秘密财宝之谜究竟是什么？新编织的与恋川志穗的幸福故事究竟会——
围绕他的环境，如同遍及四方的苍空一般接连变迁。
那里，究竟有怎样的故事在等待着他呢……。

v16651.originalDescription:
Our heroine, Kousaka Amane, was living a simple yet happy life in the countryside until one day she was suddenly taken away to live in the empire, summoned by her brother Amazaki Soushi -- the current ruler. Though she was unaware of the underlying circumstances, she finds herself brought to this lively and palpable central city.

Living in the immaculate royal palace, our heroine comes to learn that the empire might not be as joyful as it seems. 
Her brother is no longer the gentle man she once knew...
A corrupt organization secretly runs things behind the scenes...
The heroine’s fate guides her down the path of love.
v16651.description:
在乡下过着朴素却幸福生活的主人公・香坂天音，
突然被召唤回统治帝国的哥哥・天崎奏嗣身边。
在不明就里中被带到的中央都市，
展开着华丽而令人心潮澎湃的光景。

在豪华绚烂的王宫生活中，
主人公将了解到中央都市的光与影。
曾经温柔的哥哥的蜕变、暗中活跃的地下组织……。
降临在少女身上的宿命，以及那场恋爱的去向。

v16802.title: 末世孤雄 Vol. 1
v16802.original: ゾンビのあふれた世界で俺だけが襲われない
aliases: ゾンビのあふれた世界で俺だけが襲われない
Zombie no Afureta Sekai de Ore Dake ga Osowarenai
I am the only one who is not attacked in the world filled with zombies
In a World Full of Zombies I'm the Only One Who Doesn't Get Attacked

developers.name: 株式会社フォーナイン

v16802.description:
雄介(ユウスケ)是个讨厌与人交往的上班族，喜欢一个人默默地工作。他所在的公司突然倒闭，让他失去了工作，随之他所有的动力也消失殆尽，彻底变成了蛰居族。在狂欢着打了一周电子游戏之后，在一个他难得决定走出公寓的日子里，一个神秘男人袭击了他，咬了他的手臂。雄介勉强回到了房间，但他发烧倒下，卧床不起好几天。

当雄介醒来并恢复过来时，他试图回到正常的生活，但他很快发现，在他沉睡的短暂时间里，世界已经完全变了。僵尸同时出现在世界的每一个角落，极少数的人类幸存者现在都躲藏了起来。然而……“为什么只有我不会被僵尸攻击？”

雄介将如何利用这种新情况，又会发现什么呢？
v16802.originalDescription:
Yuusuke is an office worker with a dislike for people, preferring to do his job alone and in silence. When the company he works for suddenly goes bankrupt, he loses his job, and with that, all his motivation disappears, and he becomes a complete shut-in. On one of the rare days he decides to leave his apartment after a week-long video game binge, a mysterious man attacks him and bites his arm. Though Yuusuke manages to escape back to his room, he comes down with a fever and becomes bedridden for several days.

When Yuusuke wakes up, recovered, he goes to resume his normal life, but he soon finds that in the short time he was asleep the world has completely changed. Zombies have emerged in every corner of the world simultaneously, and the few human survivors are now in hiding. However... “Why am I the only one the zombies don’t attack?” 

How will Yuusuke take advantage of his new situation, and what will he discover?



Based on the popular web novel of the same title. The story covers the first two volumes of the web novel.

v17790.title: 新娘太好找了我很方！
v17790.original: 嫁探しが捗りすぎてヤバい。

选择妻子的进展似乎顺利过头。

选择妻子的进展似乎顺利过头
v17790.originalDescription:
Daiki lives in an isolated village far from the city where the only other person around his age is his imouto Kirino. There is blood of the gods in his lineage and thus, he possesses a mysterious divine power. It is the family law that no one must know about this immense power.

One day using this power, he saw a dream where he was having the most passionate sex with his beloved. He remembered that he promised that he will make her his wife. It felt so real and he wished to meet the girl and make the dream come true. However, he must not use his ability outside; if someone found out, they would immediately have their memories erased.

Accepting the conditions, Daiki set out to find the girl, but… there were three girls who resembled her!? Moreover, he saw another dream where he was having sex with a different girl. Could his future be changing? Will he be able to meet the ‘promised girl’?
v17790.description:
生活在远离都市的过疏村落的主人公・苇原大辉(葦原大輝)。年纪相近的年轻人，只有妹妹苇原希里乃(希里乃)。
他的家系是拥有被称为“神通力”的不可思议的能力的、继承众神之血的一族。
过于强大的那股力量绝不能被任何人知晓——这就是一族的规矩。
然后他想起了曾与那个女孩“约定”要让她成为“妻子”。
现实感强烈的关乎未来的梦会变成现实——
被如此告知的大辉，强烈地希望能见到那个孩子。
“在街上禁止使用能力。如果被谁发现就消除那个人的记忆并立刻返回”
接受了下到人间的条件，独自一人来到街上的大辉。
但在那里，带有她的面影与气味的少女竟然有3人！？
难道说，未来的轴心发生了偏移？
走向不确定的未来，一旦暴露就出局的极限生活的结局会是？
然后大辉能够与“约定的女孩”相遇吗！？

v18303.originalDescription: The game has 3 sections Memoria, Norn 9 Quest and Cantabile. In Memoria, all characters shuffle their groups and there's three scenarios for each boy. In Norn 9 Quest, the characters are reimagined in a fantasy setting. In Cantabile, the girls are turned into small fairies and the player must play minigames to make them return to normal size.
v18303.description:
【Memoria】
未曾描绘的幕间故事
许多回忆交织重叠。
这是未曾描绘的，
连接过去与未来的可能性故事。

巡游时间与记忆，与他的日子苏醒过来。

【Legend Of NORN】
在剑与魔法的世界中展开的平行故事
为了拯救被龙掳走的空汰，
受国王的委托，12名年轻人踏上了旅途。
途中等待着各种危险，
他们与空汰的命运究竟会如何——。

【Cantabile】
以喜剧风格描绘的，旅途中某日的一幕
某天，女主角们的身体突然变小了。
在不明原因的情况下在梦的世界里寻找解决办法，
这次却又误入了童话的世界。
似乎只要通过“试炼”就能恢复原样，但是……。

v18681.title: 聖鍵遣いの命題
aliases: 聖鍵遣いのプロポジション
Proposition to the Holy Key Contractant
v18681.originalDescription:
This is the debut work for UnicoЯn. 

There exists a legend about a king who obtained a relic from a lost civilization and used its power to grant any wish to unite the world. This relic, ‘Sora no Ison’ (Legacy of the Sky), was sealed afterwards by the ‘holy keys’ somewhere in the world. Countless persons have attempted to find it, but none of them could even find a trace of its location.

Haruto is a hopeless guy who was forced by the headmaster Spiano to attend the Academy, but ended up skipping all classes. When she made him work part-time, an unfortunate incident caused him to carry a huge debt to her. To pay off the debt, he was unwillingly tasked to explore to the depths of a sealed ruins as part of a supplementary test. His fellow test-taker Akina mentioned that it was rumoured that the elusive relic was sealed deep in the ruins. Vowing to become rich and to show Spiano up, he faced the challenge with heightened vigor.
v18681.description:
统一联邦有着自帝政期以前流传下来的建国神话。
边境国利兹的国王哈罗德，得到了旧文明米斯特利亚留下的究极遗产——
能够实现任何愿望的“宙之遗产”，将世界统一为一个国家。
而宙之遗产据说被“圣键”封印在了某处至今。
因此数不清的人寻找过宙之遗产的下落，却连线索都没找到，岁月就这样流逝而去……。
从那以后过了大约400年的某一天。
管理局的搜查官斯皮亚诺·格兰塞尔(スピアーノ・グランセル)，在某处遗迹保护了自称是恶名昭彰的幻兽神“诺托里乌斯·维阿兰”的可怜少年·哈尔特(ハルト)。
然而他是个毫无生活能力到令人绝望的“废柴家里蹲”。
他被斯皮亚诺强制成为学院的学生，却不好好去上课，
在不情不愿决定去打工的地方，又因为把钻进冰箱的照片传到网上而引发炎上，
回过神来，已经背负了向斯皮亚诺借的巨额债务。
为了还清债务，哈尔特勉为其难地决定参加补考，
却从一起参加补考的秋奈·秋月(アキナ・アキツキ)那里，听到了在学院里传得煞有介事的传闻。
——据说能实现任何愿望的“宙之遗产”，就在举行补考的封闭遗迹里——
“我要成为有钱人，让斯皮亚诺刮目相看！”气势汹汹的哈尔特，与秋奈一起挑战了补考。

v19142.originalDescription:
The evil organization Marc Gene is plotting world conquest. But the twin "Primaveil" magical girls Selene and Plage are standing in their way. The story begins with Prince Folkhart's ignominious defeat at the hands of the Primaveil duo. The task of defeating them is handed over to his younger brother, Prince Lambert, who quickly meets the same fate.

Yet Lambert develops a mysterious power after his narrow brush with death: resistance to Selene's moon energy attacks. He confronts the Primaveil duo once more and uses his newfound power to defeat and capture Selene. For this unprecedented achievement, Lambert is promoted to operational commander of Marc Gene's forces. Become Lambert and command your own band of power rangers, develop Mystery Men and advanced items, confront Primaveil, corrupt them into faithful servants of Evil through sexual training sessions, and ultimately conquer the world.
v19142.description: マルクジェネ是企图征服世界的邪恶秘密结社，曾在与正义女主角普莉玛贝璐的激战后被认为野心破灭，后又再度复活。继承皇帝血脉的主人公普林斯与兄长福尔克哈特为率领新生组织而日夜精进；兄长部队惨败并被降职后，普林斯亦向普莉玛贝璐挑战，重伤苏醒后获得能无效化其力量的能力，并捕获了其中一人塞蕾涅。组织遂发起旨在统一世界的「Ω（欧米茄）作战」，另一位普莉玛贝璐普拉吉仍独自留下。

This story is a heartwarming cat comedy about their ambitions and the bonds between family members... with a little ecchi on the side, too.

v19769.originalDescription:
“If you don't tie the knot with the person of your dreams within the next year, you'll be in big trouble.”

So forewarns Urara, the self-proclaimed Goddess of Matchmaking, when she appears before our hero Hajime Kanbayashi. Hajime's your average youth, except that he's been a little bit too into love spells and love charms in his goal to get more popular with the ladies. And this time, according to Urara, it's this particular hobby of his that's the cause for his current predicament—just like eating too much of a good food can make you sick, each spell, however trivial and cute, can prove disastrous if overused. To make matters worse, it seems that some of the spells Hajime tried were the real deal! Thanks to this, the law of cause and effect has been thrown out of whack and his future is looking bleak...

“Well, to put it simply, you're going to be alone for the rest of your life.”

“I want a girlfriend! I don't want to be alone forever! It's just... it seems like a lot of work.”

Just as Hajime begins to despair, Urara teaches him about three candidates potentially written into his destiny along with their respective “destiny counts,” which represent the distance he'll have to overcome to win their hearts and the goal is to reduce the number to zero. To further complicate things, each girl also comes with her own unique quirks.

Nanami Nagumo, the prime minister's daughter: 870,000,000
Suzuna Akagi, an idol: 15
Yukari Suo, Japan's no. 1 detective: 65,535

And so begins Hajime's race against time to defeat his karma and reverse Urara's prophecy...
v19769.description:
“如果你在一年之内不和命中注定的对象结合，就会发生不得了的事情”

主人公神林始被突然出现的自称结缘之神的丽如此告知。

他是个随处可见的普通少年。
只是，他具备着出于一心想受欢迎而尝试古今中外各种咒语等调皮的积极性。

据丽所说，原因似乎就是那些咒语。
就像好吃的食物吃多了也会吃坏肚子一样，一个个微不足道又可爱的咒语，做过头了也会变成毒药。

更糟糕的是，始试过的咒语里，似乎混进了几个真的。
多亏如此，因果律彻底错乱，未来变得非常不稳定。

“简单来说，就是你一辈子都会保持童贞的意思”

想要女朋友！不想一辈子当童贞！但是，又不想做过度的努力……

面对迷茫的始，丽告诉了他作为命运对象候选的3人，以及表示与她们之间缘分距离的“缘计数”。

“首相的女儿”　南云七海
　缘计数：870,000,000（8亿7千万）

“现役偶像”　赤城铃奈
　缘计数：15

“日本第一侦探”　周防由香里
　缘计数：65535

她们是各自都有些古怪脾气的少女们。
与原本毫无瓜葛的她们之间，计算缘分的相遇开始了。

Ten years ago, there was an accident during the transport of chemicals in the port city of Mizuho, as well as a series of murders, but it is now just a part of history. v20227.description:
靠近海、港口旁的城镇・瑞穗。
10年前发生了化学药品搬运事故，之后又发生了杀人事件等，
如今已经成为了过去。

生活在瑞穗的少女・相马伊座奈(相馬いざな)。
她在10年前与大亲友突然分离，度过了无法释怀的时光。

然而这个夏天。
那位亲友，就像消失时一样毫无预兆地回到了城镇。

为重逢而喜悦的伊座奈。
然而那位亲友，却向她传达了极其荒谬的事实——

v21161.title: 冬天的谎言 -Snow World End-
v21161.originalDescription:
This is the fourth game in Campus’ Uso series, focusing on Setsuka. It follows the scenario of what happens at Mahoshi Gakuen if the magic contract didn’t end up in Satsuki’s hands, Souichirou had protected Aoi from being taken over by the succubus, and Eris didn’t find what she was looking for with Shizuku.

Everyone lies, whether it be to protect, to deny, to misrepresent, or to keep things unchanged.

In spring, Souichirou met Satsuki for the first time and she shortly thereafter was welcomed as a new club member.
In summer, he was busy preparing for the Mahoshi festival with Aoi and the student council.
In autumn, he was caught up in some trouble involving his longtime friend Eris.
Then came today, the first day of snow. He didn’t know the reason, but he could tell that it was a lie.

Even though he always found it hard to deal with her…
Even though he thought that their paths would never cross…
Even though it seemed that he must not reach for her…
— he could not betray his true feelings.

“I love you, Teidou-senpai. Please go out with me.”

It was the beginning of a story about the snow world end.
v21161.description:
Campus Uso系列的第4部游戏，以雪华为主题。接下来的场景是，如果魔法契约最终没有落入佐木手中，宗一郎保护了葵免受魔女的伤害，而艾莉丝和雫一起寻找的东西没有找到的话，魔星学园会发生什么。

每个人都在撒谎。为了保护、否定、歪曲事实，也为了维持现状。

春天，宗一郎第一次见到了皐月，不久她作为社团的新成员受到了欢迎。\
夏天，和葵以及学生会一起忙于魔星祭的准备。\
秋天，他遭遇了与旧友艾莉丝有关的麻烦。\
今天是下雪的第一天。他不知道原因，但他知道那是谎言。

他一直觉得和她相处很难……\
他以为他们的道路绝不会交汇……\
他似乎无法伸出手去抓住她……\
——他无法出卖自己真实的感情。

“我爱你，帝堂前辈。请和我一起离开吧”

这是关于雪之世界终结的故事的开始。

v21534.originalDescription:
There was something missing.
It was memories of his childhood.
It was the key to locked memories.

She just wished for wings to fly into the sky.
She just wanted to take a step out of the cage that she had been locked in.

Because surely this key would open the door to something wonderful.
Because surely the first love which only comes once is something irreplaceable.

It can’t end like this. It can’t remain unrequited like this. We can’t be happy like this.
Even if it’s only one thing, I want to know the truth.

This is a normal story, a normal love story, that happens everywhere.
A story between a young lady and her butler.
v21534.description: 发现受伤的狗的贫穷少年佐佐木静也(佐々木静也)。处理后，他前往项圈上写的地址，来到了一座前所未见的豪宅。在那里遇到的宅邸大小姐・千鳥雛乃邀请他成为自己的管家。静也虽然烦恼，但她的脸和声音隐约留在记忆中。为了想起在忘却彼方消失的记忆与约定，静也决定作为千鳥家的佣人工作……。

v21676.title: LOVE³ -爱立方-
v21676.originalDescription:
Things are looking grim for down-on-his-luck hentai manga artist, Ichinari Tsuzurigi. He's struggling to even afford his meager rent, and is seriously considering giving up on his dream, until... His editor, Akira Higashibojo, who's always looking out for him, offers him a position as an assistant to one of the top dogs in the adult comics industry!

Thinking of it as a last hurrah, Ichinari accepts. Lo and behold, said top dog turns out to be none other than Ichinari's childhood friend, Iori Shitaka, with whom he made a childhood promise to become manga artists together.

Also working as an assistant is doujinshi artist of the moment Nadoka Amabane. Ichinari was her Senpai in manga club during high school and taught her how to draw.

Shocked but elated at this unexpected reunion, Ichinari discovers that a certain god has taken an interest in their wishes and blessed them with interconnecting "Fates" that will forever change the course of his life. And so Ichinari finds himself working on sexy manga while living with a group of women whose burgeoning feelings can't be ignored...
v21676.description:
连房租都交不起，正打算放弃漫画家之路时，
一直照顾他、娇惯他的责任编辑姐姐
东坊城 圣(東坊城 聖)，
壱成心想这是最后的挑战便答应了下来，
那位大师竟是壱成的青梅竹马，也是曾与他一起
约定实现漫画家梦想的志鹰 伊织(志鷹 伊織)。
而在那里作为助手加入的超人气同人作家，
则是壱成高中时代漫研的后辈，曾教过她画漫画的天羽 和花(天羽 和花)。
壱成虽然对突然的重逢感到惊讶但也十分高兴，
但听取了壱成与她们各自愿望的神明将“缘”连结在一起的结果，
他与再也无法压抑自己心意的她们，

v21787.originalDescription:
In the near future...

Summer break was around the corner. Hiyori Sena, a sophomore in high school, was living a peaceful life. One day, as she was walking home with her childhood friend, a masked figure appeared before them. The two were abducted and taken to a strange world with two moons.

When they awoke, they met nine others in the same predicament. In their confusion, the mysterious figure began to speak.

"Welcome to Arcadia!"
"In this world, if you perform for us, your wildest dreams can come true!"

In order to find their way home, the group was forced to work together and act in an assortment of scenes from a drama.

They were also made aware that a traitor walked among them... What could be the motive of this traitor? And why are they all being forced to act?

Unable to fully trust anyone, whose hand will she take in the end?
v21787.description:
在不久的将来……

暑假即将来临。濑名日和是一名高二学生，过着平静的生活。有一天，当她正和青梅竹马一起走路回家时，一个戴面具的人出现在他们面前。两人被绑架，带到了一个有两轮月亮的奇异世界。

当他们醒来时，遇到了另外九个处于同样困境的人。在他们感到困惑时，那个神秘人物开始说话了。

“欢迎来到Arcadia！”
“在这个世界里，如果你为我们表演，你最狂野的梦想就能成真！”

为了找到回家的路，这群人被迫合作，并在各种戏剧场景中表演。

他们还被告知，他们之中潜伏着一个叛徒……这个叛徒的动机是什么？为什么他们都被迫表演？

在无法完全信任任何人的情况下，她最终会牵起谁的手？

v22302.title: 勇者と魔王と、魔女のカフェ
v22302.original: 勇者と魔王と、魔女のカフェ
aliases: 勇者と魔王と、魔女のカフェ
Yuusha to Maou to, Majo no Café
The brave and the devil and the witch's cafe
v22302.originalDescription:
Filiaswald is governed by the goddess of light Aria and the goddess of darkness Anri. There was once a long war between light and darkness, which culminated in a single battle between the hero Fiona and the demon king Astaroth. However, no one knew how it ended as both vanished without a trace.

Ten years later, a young man with no recollection of his past wandered through the forest. He arrived at a small coffee shop and inn, Café Sorcière, where three witches-in-training (earnest but gullible Rufuna, small yet motherly Candy, and taciturn and lazy Eliya) happily worked for the polite yet super innocent owner Assam. They gave him the name ‘Tarou’ and got him to work at the café while he regained his memories.

Every day was full of interesting events: incidents ending up in compromising positions, helping people in need, going on adventures… event fighting with monsters!? He would befriend Apple, a girl from a nearby town who would later be a regular customer, as well as the miniature forest faerie Pecoe. He no longer worried about his forgotten past when the present is so full of happiness.

However, Tarou started to see recurring dreams of fighting with the demon king and the hero attacking the demon king’s castle. When he woke up, he would have not recollection of the dreams. As he gradually began to show signs of change, the girls around him are caught in the large whirlpool of fate…
v22302.description:
由光之女神亚莉亚与暗之女神安莉所统治的世界“菲利阿斯世界”。

曾经，那里发生过光与暗的战争。

在漫长战争的尽头，光之眷属的代表勇者菲奥娜与魔王阿斯塔罗斯最终决定以单挑一决胜负。

然而，那场战斗的结局无人知晓。勇者与魔王双双消失，此后经过了10年的岁月。

…………

……

“嗯，失忆了吗……嘛，总会有办法的吧”

那名青年失去了记忆，一直在森林中徘徊。

不久，青年抵达的小店是“Cafe Soreciere”。
那是一家有着三名魔女见习生女服务员与店长开朗快乐地生活着的旅馆兼咖啡厅。

“露芙娜(ルフナ)”是个一本正经，却十分好骗又可爱的女孩。

“坎迪(キャンディ)”虽然娇小，却是个总是很靠得住、母性满满的女孩。

“艾莉亚(エリア)”沉默寡言、无精打采又面无表情。是个什么事都交给魔像处理的让人有点头疼的女孩。

“阿萨姆(アッサム)”是个礼貌又可靠，但其实超级纯情的店长。

青年从四人那里得到了“太郎(タロウ)”这个暂用名，决定在咖啡厅工作直到恢复记忆，并逐渐被卷入各种事件之中。

此外还会帮助困扰的人们、去冒险、与怪物战斗！？与街上的女孩、手掌大小的妖精、开朗的朋友们一起，每天都充满笑容。

在这样的生活中，太郎渐渐变得不再在意失忆的事了，然而……

从某个时候起，他好几次做梦。

——“奔赴与魔王战斗的梦”

——“勇者攻打魔王城的梦”

梦境在醒来之后，立刻就会从记忆中消失。

太郎身上开始逐渐出现变化，女孩们也被卷入了巨大的命运漩涡之中……

Kimi to Hajimeru Dasanteki na Love Come
Kimi to Hajimeru Dasanteki na Rabukome
v22583.originalDescription:
Kazuma has lived a tough life of poverty thanks to the debts accumulated by his carefree parents. After their deaths, he transferred to Mahoshi Gakuen in the middle of the year, determined and armed with a plan to become rich. He would use his pretty looks to target Shirayuki, the daughter of one of the richest families in Japan. However, she had absolutely no interest in him, having heard the same pick-up lines from many others before and wary of anyone outside of her family.

There was also one other person that Shirayuki trusted: her personal servant Nono, who also happened to be Shirayuki’s childhood friend. Nono offered to help him with his plan. Why did she offer her assistance and will he be able to achieve his goal?
v22583.description:
“从现在开始，我的玫瑰色人生——！”
主人公・矢上一真怀揣着一个野心，作为不合时节的转校生降临了麻保志学園。
在乐观且自甘堕落的父母身边，被讨债人追赶，连吃的东西都要辛苦筹措的极度贫困生活。
但是，那样的生活要在这里终结。
以从父母那里继承的甜美面容为武器，日本屈指可数的名门千金——
看上了帝堂白雪的一真，为了入赘豪门立刻接近她，然而……
“坦白说太陈腐了。全是听腻了的搭讪词，耳朵都要长茧了。”
对从小就在算计的世界里生存的白雪来说根本不可能行得通，被一刀两断地拒绝了。但是，向这样的一真伸出救援之手的，是意想不到的人物。
“我说了要协助你。那个计划”
那个人物，是白雪的专属从者，也是青梅竹马的佐仓希乃(佐倉希乃)。在某种意义上是白雪最信任的人物。
究竟，一真的野心会实现吗！？

v22703.originalDescription:
'Jail,' an impregnable asylum referred to as "a living prison."

Birthed several decades ago, it was controlled by "Marchens," monsters led by insane beings known as "Nightmares."

Tsuu and Little Mermaid, members of the "Dawn" organization with the goal of escaping the prison, rescue Alice and her partner Jack after being captured.

In the midst of an expedition to the city, Alice was dyed in madness and ran amok slashing through anything and anyone at sight.

In an attempt to protect Tsuu from one of Alice's attacks, Little Mermaid and Jack fell off a cliff with her.

After regaining consciousness, Little Mermaid's first sight was a dying Jack.

The bloodstained story of Tsuu, Little Mermaid and Nightmare Jack trying to escape the tower and their fate begins.
v22703.description:
监狱——那是被称为“有生命的监狱”的难攻不落的人类收容所。数十年前突然诞生的这座监狱，由被称为“童话”的怪物以及统率它们的疯狂存在“梦魇”所管理。

隶属于为了从那座监狱越狱而成立的组织“黎明”的鹤(つう)和人鱼公主(人魚姫)，成功救出了被囚禁的新同伴爱丽丝(アリス)以及和她在一起的少年杰克(ジャック)。

鹤等人本打算与两人一同前往城镇，但在途中爱丽丝突然染上疯狂，开始无差别地挥舞起刀刃。爱丽丝的凶刃袭击了鹤以及试图保护她的杰克和人鱼公主，三人坠落到了悬崖之下。

在悬崖下醒来的鹤和人鱼公主眼前出现的，是眼看就要丧命的杰克的身影——。

鹤、人鱼公主，以及杰克——这是为了企图从命运中越狱，而编织心血的少女们与化身为梦魇的少年的故事。

v23244.originalDescription:
Akito came to Mahoshi Gakuen as a transfer student and got lost as he walked around the unfamiliar vast campus. A girl with gentle eyes, Yuki, called out to him. She showed him around the school, ending at a flower garden where the flowers were still budding.

“Let’s meet here again when the flowers bloom”
v23244.description:
——大波斯菊的花，还没有绽放。

新学期。以转学的形式来到麻保志学園的少年——匂坂秋人。
在不熟悉的校舍中走着时，迷了路的他被人搭话了。

“那么，我带你到正门去吧。看，我也正要回去呢。好吗？”
用温柔的眼眸笑着的少女——永瀬優希。
跟着带他参观学园的她来到的地方，
是一片布满花蕾的花田。

“对不起呢，还是花蕾的样子”
“等那花绽放了，两人再一起……”
優希浮现出苦笑说道。
在没有绽放的花田里定下下一次的约定，以及新学园生活的开始。

——这是祈愿着想要变成花的，魔法使的恋爱。

v24275.title: 我的未来是恋爱与氪金
v24275.original: 僕の未来は、恋と課金と。～Charge To The Future～
aliases: 我的未来是恋爱与氪金
僕の未来は、恋と課金と。～Charge To The Future～
Boku no Mirai wa, Koi to Kakin to. ~Charge To The Future~
我的未来是恋爱与氪金 ～Charge To The Future～
v24275.originalDescription:
Bill yesterday, bill today. charge today, Bill for tomorrow.

Our Protagonist Kyoya Arima is currently struggling to save up with his part-time job at a convenience store.
Finally however he saves up enough to afford the smartphone he always wanted.

He immediately tries installing various game apps at once from the App Store, 
but nearly all the game apps he wanted included in-app purchases, 
despite being marked for "Free"

I tried my best to play them these mobile games. But soon enough I realized, 
I couldn't experience these mobile games to there for full extent, 
or even advance sometimes without paying for micro-transactions

Kyoya, now has no money left from his part-time job after spending it all on his new smartphone.
"Screw it! I'm not paying for any app purchases, and i'll do what ever it takes! 
I promise I'll never going pay for any app, I'm going to keep on searching!"
Kyoya say's to himself with a burning spirit.

Kyoya then searches for what it seems like day's and finally finds a social gaming app, 
one with no in-app purchases.


--"CUFFS Story"


"CUFFS Story" is a real world RPG game that uses AR technology.
And is currently rapidly gaining popularity.

Kyoya immediately gets absorbed into "CUFFS Story"
Kyoya is drawn to how fun the game is without in-app purchases 
After playing for a amount of time Kyoya joins a guild,
And they all eventually decide to host an offline meeting.
At this meeting Kyoya discovers that all his guild members
are from the same school as him.

Connections in-game, turn into real-life connections.
Kyouya's school life is about to change forever---
v24275.description:
昨天的氪金是今天的氪金。今天的氪金是通往明天的氪金。
主人公・有馬恭也在便利店的兼职中努力奋斗，终于如愿以偿地得到了智能手机。

他立刻试着装了各种应用，但无论哪个都满眼是“【免费】※App内含氪金”的字样。
虽然试着玩了一下，但无论哪个全都是以氪金为前提的，能正经玩下去的很少。

把兼职赚来的钱都花在买智能手机上、身无分文的恭也，
痛下决心“无论如何都要贯彻零氪金！”，燃起斗志探索着应用。

然后终于，他找到了一款社交游戏。

――「CUFFS Story's」

这是一款运用AR技术、以现实世界为舞台的RPG，人气正在急速上升中。
恭也沉迷进了不氪金也能充分享受的「CUFFS Story's」中，不久在与游戏内组建的公会成员们的线下聚会中，发现大家全都是同一所学校的人。

社交游戏上的联系，变成了现实中的联系，
与以往不同的、崭新的学园生活就此拉开帷幕——

v24553.originalDescription: Every day Reiji was caught up in unfortunate incidents due to a curse unbeknown to him that dates back to his childhood. Eventually he was taken away by the guards and after a full-body examination, he found out about the unique curse. He was left in the hands of Samantha, a famous magician and researcher, who brought him in a cage to her mansion. There he met her apprentices: Alisa, who for some reason is interested him and aggressively pursues him; Yuel, who has chuunibyou-like aspirations of world domination and plans to make him her servant; and Liliana, who wants him to help with her magic experiments. Trapped together with them, he decides to remain at the mansion in order to find out how to break the curse that had been cast upon him.
v24553.description:
年幼时，主人公因为一点微小的契机而在身上背负了“诅咒”，
在毫不知情的情况下度过了每天被卷入麻烦的日子。

最终他变成了引发麻烦的一方，被街上的警备队逮捕并带走。
身体检查的结果表明，他是一个在世界上都极为罕见的身中“诅咒”的人类，
于是决定将主人公托付给身为著名魔法师、且作为研究者以收购和管理魔道具等为生的萨曼莎(サマンサ)。

主人公被关在笼子里，运送到了萨曼莎的宅邸。
他暂时信任了一眼看穿他身怀诅咒的萨曼莎，迈步走进了宅邸。
在自称萨曼莎弟子的亚里莎(アリサ)带他参观宅邸的过程中，他遇到了同样是弟子的尤埃尔(ユエル)和莉莉安娜(リリアナ)。

不知为何对主人公抱有好感，并积极展开攻势的亚里莎。
有着中二病般的想法企图征服世界，图谋让主人公成为自己干部（仆从）的尤埃尔。
为了得知主人公魔法成功的原因，而请求他协助实验的莉莉安娜。

在被她们包围的环境下，为了进一步查明原因并得知解咒的方法，主人公决定在宅邸中留宿。

v25126.original: 恋音 セ・ピアーチェ

v25126.originalDescription: Shin'ya heard the sound of someone playing the guitar poorly while returning home and followed them to Hana, who was happily giving an amateurish performance in the park. After initially mistaking that he was hitting on her, she told him that she started playing the guitar because she attended his band’s show. She implored him to teach her how to play the guitar, but actually he was the drummer in the band. So their musical drama begins on the wrong note.
v25126.description:
——某天听到的音色，是生疏的吉他声。

“哼哼哼～♪”

循着声音找去，发现的是一个正愉快演奏的女孩。
试着搭话却被误认为是搭讪，
结果反而被她以“我们在哪儿见过吗”为由反过来搭讪了。

“我不是在搭讪啦！？”

与初次见面的少女展开的装傻与吐槽。
然后，女主角胡桃花(胡桃はな)回想了起来。

在促使她开始弹吉他的那场现场演出中，
主人公中埜真也曾登台演出。

“请——教我弹吉他吧”

就这样，由音乐相连的两人的故事，现在开始了。

（……我本职其实是打鼓的啊）

在一抹不安之中，开始了……！

v25144.description:
和仓茧子(和倉繭子)结婚后不久，丈夫便被杀人狂杀害了。
失去生存动力、陷入自暴自弃的茧子企图自杀，但一名少年救了她。
他就是加贺伊佐武(加賀伊佐武)。
那名少年也和茧子一样，因杀人狂而失去了双亲。
感受到彼此相通之处的茧子，决定从孤儿院收养伊佐武，与他共同生活。

十年过去了，伊佐武长大成人。
茧子借助丈夫的弟弟、精神科医生和仓隆文(和倉隆文)的帮助，总算重新振作了起来，但与恢复相反，她却因与亡夫的记忆日渐淡薄而苦恼。

某天，伊佐武在神社的祠堂前遇到了一位美丽的少女。
伊佐武对那名少女说出的话感到震惊。
“茧子马上就会死了。”
当内心化为虚无之时，精神的死亡便会降临——
那名少女知道拯救茧子的方法，并表示愿意借力相助。
然而，那个方法，竟是接受少女的性启蒙，内容令人震惊。
v25144.originalDescription:
Wakura Mayuko, a newlywed, loses her husband to a ruthless killer and attempts suicide in her despair. Kaga Isamu, a young boy who also lost his parents to a murderer, saves her. Feeling a bond of shared sorrow, Mayuko adopts Isamu and begins a new life together.

A decade later, Isamu has grown into a young man. Mayuko, with the help of her psychiatrist brother-in-law Wakura Takafumi, slowly heals from her trauma. However, as she recovers, her memories of her late husband become increasingly distant.

One day, Isamu encounters a mysterious girl at a shrine who warns him that Mayuko will soon die a "psychological death" when her heart becomes void. The girl claims to have a solution to prevent this tragedy. However, it is as shocking as the prophecy itself: Isamu must undergo sexual lessons under her guidance to save Mayuko.

v25809.title: アマアネ -My Sweet Sister-
aliases: 姐姐回来当你的新娘了哦
v25809.originalDescription:
Yuuta was at the airport waiting to welcome his older sister Alice. He had only met her for a few days when his mother remarried overseas three years ago and haven’t had the chance to see her again since then, but they still got along rather well since they frequently chatted on the phone and e-mailed each other.

“I’m here to be your bride♪”

He had been expecting an enjoyable life with his cute sister, but was overwhelmed by the sudden marriage proclamation and pampering beyond his imagination.

“I’ll clean your ears, so rest on my lap~”
“Dinner’s ready. Here, open up~♪”
“Finished your studies? Hehe, have some headpats as a reward”

The sweet days have begun with an older sister who wants to be a bride.
v25809.description:
机场响起了广播。

来到这里是为了迎接从海外来的姐姐。

3年前，母亲在海外再婚时短暂相处过的姐姐。

因为住在海外，所以很难见上一面。

尽管如此，我们还是通过电话和邮件保持联系，姐弟俩相当融洽。

她来到日本的第一句话是。

“姐姐回来当你的新娘了哦♪”

“……啊？”

憧憬着与可爱的姐姐一起生活的主人公，沉陷于突然的嫁人宣言和甜蜜攻势之中。

“我给你掏耳朵，请睡在我的大腿上吧”

“晚饭做好了。来，啊\~♪”

“作业写完了吗？呵呵，那就摸摸头作为奖励吧”

——与满心期待成为新娘的姐姐的甜蜜日常就此开始。

v25838.original: 姫と穢欲のサクリファイス
aliases: 姫と穢欲のサクリファイス
HimeYoku: A Sacrifice of Lust and Grace
v25838.originalDescription:
Seeking vengeance, a young man named Caldo single-handedly storms the Kingdom of Solide, whose ruling dynasty has long prospered from the horrors of war.
Consumed by hatred, he forges a series of “unholy pacts” with unseen forces to ensure victory, but on seizing the castle, he seems uninterested in Solide’s people and politics, instead turning his demonic arts to the lovely Princess Fiana…
v25838.description:
索利德国——
在国家间战争中获胜并发展起来的大国，
被一个男人袭击。

对国王怀有强烈的怨恨，
为了复仇而采取行动的主人公卡尔多(カルド)
借助所驱使的“恶魔”的力量掌握了城堡。

对国政和国民不感兴趣，
作为对国王的复仇，
使用恶魔们的能力开始了对王女菲亚娜(フィアナ)的调教。

v25884.title: 同じクラスのアイドルさん。Around me is full by a celebrity.
v25884.original: 同じクラスのアイドルさん。Around me is full by a celebrity.
aliases: 同じクラスのアイドルさん。Around me is full by a celebrity.
Onaji Class no Idol-san. Around me is full by a celebrity.
同班的偶像小姐。Around me is full by a celebrity.
v25884.originalDescription:
Kentarou’s childhood friend Akari transferred schools a few years ago and they haven’t much contact since. One day, it was decided that he’ll live with his grandfather due to his father’s job transfer. When he arrived at the house, he saw Akari for the first time in a few years. She had enrolled in the celebrity course at Itsuko Gakuen and was living at his grandfather and the board chairman’s house, which had recently been converted to a student dormitory.

Then he was surprised once more when he was told that he would be part of this new curriculum starting the next day. They were lacking students since many had quit due to the rigours of the program, so he reluctantly agreed to participate for a year. He was unfamiliar with the specialized classes, but managed to get by with help from Akari, aspiring singer Ei and his other childhood friend Wako, who decided to join to stay by his side.

It’s a lot of hard work preparing the stage for the trio. What does the future hold for them?
v25884.description:
超人气偶像——三岛朱莉(三嶋 アカリ)

也是司马健太郎青梅竹马的
三岛朱莉在几年前转学了，
如今已是身处另一个世界的人。

然而有一天，父亲决定调职，于是他要和爷爷一起生活。
去拜访家里时，那里出现了朱莉的身影，两人时隔数年再次重逢。

她转入了五子学园新设立的艺人培养课程，
据说现在住在身为理事长的爷爷家改建而成的学生宿舍里。

健太郎暂且掌握了情况，
这时爷爷却说出了令人惊讶的话。

“你小子，明天起去演艺科上学吧”

刚成立的演艺科还在摸索阶段。因为学生人数
不足，他只好不情愿地约定只转科一年。

对特殊学科的课程感到困惑的健太郎，不久后
遇到了正在出道的歌手——小鸟游咏(小鳥遊 詠)，
而另一位青梅竹马——悠木和心(悠木 和心)也
转入了演艺科。

他们一边互相合作与冲突，一边解决问题、
完成课题，有时三人还会组成组合，
在舞台上公开亮相，忙得不可开交。

与她们共同度过时光的健太郎，究竟会有怎样的
未来在等待着他——？

v26344.title: 贽之匣庭
aliases: Nie No Hakoniwa - Dollhouse of Offerings
v26344.originalDescription:
The first title by NEKO WORKs's sister brand, Chatte Noire.
A visual novel epic filled with madness and a complex mix of love and hate.

 Let's celebrate—the birth of this nightmare.

In a time long past, the oppressed sparked a rebellion with the aid of a "box" introduced by a stranger.

With time, these once subjugated individuals thrived as the prestigious Seven Noble Families. Yet, the Shiki, at the helm of this lineage, faced a dilemma due to the absence of male successors. This led them to welcome a young man from beyond their borders to continue their legacy.

This young man was named Yasaka Kurou.

His encounter with Kyouko, the Shiki's eldest daughter, started a unique connection. Despite their vastly different lives, a mutual attraction soon blossomed between them.

And on their wedding day—a nightmare was born.
v26344.description:
NEKO WORKs的姐妹品牌Chatte Noire的首部作品。
充满疯狂、爱与憎恨的复杂交织的视觉小说叙事诗。

来庆祝这个噩梦的诞生吧。

很久以前，被压迫的人们借助陌生人介绍的“箱”的帮助发起了叛乱。

随着时间的推移，这些曾经被征服的人们繁荣成了名门七贵族。然而，掌握这一血统实权的志贵面临着没有男性继承人的困境。于是，决定从海外迎接一位青年来继承遗产。

青年的名字是羽坂九郎。

从与志贵的长女·杏子的相遇开始，诞生了独特的羁绊。尽管他们的生活大相径庭，但他们很快就互相吸引。

婚礼之日，噩梦诞生了。

v26639.title: 献给神明般的你
aliases: Kami-sama no You na Kimi e
Hacking the Moon to Find My Goddess

developers.name: 株式会社エンターグラム

v26639.originalDescription:
Our time together, now,
Continues onward, towards tomorrow.

Shiromae Kaito, a young man gifted with a talent for hacking.

Despite being merely a student, Kaito broke through the most advanced security system and gained administrative privileges to the C-AI (Central AI) that governs countless AI. In this day and age, the majority of the infrastructure essential to humanity's daily living has been optimized with AI. Kaito, who now had the power to do anything, issued his command:

“I want to meet a girl who loves me, Shimae Kaito! She has to have large, cute eyes, be kind and will spoil me, oh, and have big boobs!”

However, the reply came back, "No qualified persons found. Displaying results: 0 out of 0."

Kaito was dejected when his search got no hits, but the AI activated a late-night robot factory and built a robot according to his specifications.

Some days later, a girl who looked exactly as he described showed up at his door - Tsukuyomi. She had superhuman physical abilities and loved Kaito immensely. However, being an AI, she lacked all common sense. Having determined that she still fell short of being his ideal, she decided that she had to express her "love" for him in the most perfect way possible.

-You, who are like a God-

What future waits for Kaito and his ideal (albeit robot) girl?

 and
v26639.description:
擅长黑客技术的青年——城前 塊斗。
塊斗尽管还是学生，却通过黑客技术突破了最高级别的防护，获得了向统括无数AI的C-AI（セントラル・エーアイ）下达指令的权限。

人类生存所需的大部分基础设施，都由AI进行优化的现代。
变得无所不能的塊斗下达了命令。

‘请让我见见一个最喜欢我这个城前塊斗的女孩子！
　然而回答是……‘无符合条件者。搜索结果为0件’

塊斗虽然感到沮丧，但AI启动了深夜的机器人工厂，制造出了塊斗所订购的那种外貌的机器人。

然后几天后，与塊斗想象中一样的少女——月咏(ツクヨミ)出现了。
月咏拥有非人类的身体能力，对塊斗抱有绝大的好感。
但是，因为是AI，所以没有常识。

判断自己还未达到塊斗理想的月咏，决心完美地表达出“最喜欢”。

——如神明般的你。
与理想的女孩子（但是是机器人）相遇的塊斗，究竟会有怎样的未来在等待着他？

v26785.title: シルヴァリオ ラグナロク
v26785.original: シルヴァリオ ラグナロク
aliases: シルヴァリオ ラグナロク
银色逆袭 诸神黄昏
v26785.originalDescription:
"Silverio Ragnarok" is the third and final installment of the "Silverio Saga" series.
The fierce battles between cool superhumans and beautiful battles between fascinating characters have captured the hearts of many fans to date.
This is a story of fate, demise, and hope as the "Godslayer Ragna" and his partner "Hikari" fight to the death to overthrow the gods who rule the people with their overwhelming power.
v26785.description:
在无谬的千年王国中，统御众生的神明存在于此。

现人神不老、不朽、且不死。

伴随永劫不衰的神威，将森罗之理敷设于天地。

因此，众生无救赎……因为神明不会拯救人类。

一切生命皆平等，皆为献给神明天地创生的供物。

正因如此，终焉吼龙绝不宽恕。

命运、终焉，将以希望燃烧殆尽。

命运所约定的“神祖灭杀”就此拉开帷幕。

新历1036年──坎特伯雷圣教皇国。
那里不外乎是超越人类智慧的超越者、四柱神祖所司掌的巨大实验场。
和平的宗教国家之类的宣传语，全都是欺瞒。是充满谎言的虚饰。
神祖的真相，是挺过旧历崩溃的大和之民。因此他们宣扬崇拜日本的教义。
为了将黎民百姓作为添入自己理想的薪柴，使其成为盲目的羊群。

没错，在这个国家生杀大权全凭神明的一念之间。
人类根本没有任何生杀予夺的权利。
就像把养肥的家畜屠宰一样，将喜悦与幸福一个不剩地解体，连碎片都不留地收割殆尽。然后葬于黑暗之中。
结果，一次、一次又一次、无数次无尽地……
不断重复着毫无慈悲的残酷神明行径。遵循被蹂躏的世界法则，一无所知的无辜黎民化作结晶。
一边灿烂闪耀一边吞噬鲜血、吞噬血肉，不分婴儿与老人，贪婪地吞噬无数惨叫后，星之树海就此降生。

在既妖邪又庄严、既骇人又奇幻的景象中，既无报应也无责罚降临。
因为期盼这一切的神明们已经建立起千年王国。
因为他们为黎民带来的和平，已是散去生命的数亿倍之多。
支配体制确立至今，已过千年。以多数人的幸福这一道理铸就的大盾，持续封杀着一切悲叹……

在其尽头不断凝聚的诅咒与愤怒——即祸津。
背负着怎么也消除不尽的尸山血河之业，为向神明降下报应，赫怒的化身向天咆哮。

开什么玩笑。能认同吗。那种胜利去吃屎吧，他如此说道。

面对毁灭的故乡，两道影子觉醒。轰响着灾厄之星，祈愿神祖的毁灭，拉格纳·尼德霍格(ラグナ・ニーズホッグ)化身为邪龙。
贯穿绝望吧，咬碎它吧。仿佛在回应狂暴的宣誓，美咲·九条(ミサキ・クジョウ)也用染血的月光照亮她深爱的男人。

因此，神谕降临。伴随银色闪耀的巨狼之冬。

“你必须成为‘命运’”

“你必须成为‘终焉’”

“你必须成为‘希望’”

所以来吧，终焉吼龙当如此。为了在跨越地狱的前方，让笑容之花绽放。
坠落吧，神明的千年王国。葬想月华如今，在此转动命运的车轮。

“汝，希望的殉教者啊——
向我的心脏露出獠牙，完成‘弑神’吧”

v28093.title: QUALIA ～约定的轨迹～
v28093.originalDescription:
The AI-equipped android “Machina” was the world’s first to pass the Turing test.
She was an extremely sophisticated android that could be mistaken for an actual human, however it seemed that she still had immature areas that could be developed further.

The protagonist and developer Hiro, along with the co-developer Karen, prototype robot Proto, and Machina—who started working as Hiro’s maid—lived their daily lives which intermingle with one another. 
As Machina matured day by day, Hiro began to grow special feelings for her…

An android heroine and a brilliant but lonely protagonist—
the two mutually struggle to grow, defy fate, and attain happiness.
This is a story of pure love and heartfelt bonds.
v28093.description:
搭载了AI的最新型仿生人“玛琪娜(マキナ)”，在世界上首次通过了图灵测试。
玛琪娜因其与人难辨真伪的品质而备受瞩目，但仍有无法完全应用的部分，似乎还有成长的空间。

作为开发者的主人公希罗，将与共同开发者卡莲、初期型机器人普罗托(プロト)，以及在希罗身边开始作为女仆工作的玛琪娜共同生活，并产生交集。
在与日益成长的玛琪娜接触的过程中，希罗心中萌生出了特别的感情——

仿生人女主角，与身为天才却孤独的主人公。
描绘了这样的两人共同成长、跨越命运、最终抓住幸福的故事。
心意相通的纯爱故事。

v28533.title: 神獄塔 斷罪瑪麗 Finale
v28533.original: 神獄塔 メアリスケルターFinale
aliases: 神獄塔 斷罪瑪麗 Finale
神獄塔 メアリスケルターFinale

developers.name: アイディアファクトリー株式会社
株式会社コンパイルハート

v28533.originalDescription:
The Jail—a living prison that feeds on the humans trapped within its confines.

The Jail appeared a number of years ago with the caving of the city around it. Now twisted creatures known as Marchens and treacherous Nightmares roam its halls.

The Blood Maidens, reincarnations of old stories and folk tales led by Jack, successfully escaped the Jail and managed to make it from the underground prison to the surface…

Although they had hope for the surface, the scene Jack and company first saw when they emerged… was thousands of dead bodies submerged in a sea of blood, and the maniacal laughter of “Genocide Pink” (executioner girls).

Scattered by the overwhelming slaughter and mayhem of Genocide Pink, their only ray of hope was seemingly destroyed.

Scorched Pillar, a member of Genocide Pink born to kill humans; Jack, a Blood Youth who would give even a drop of a blood to save a friend; Mary, a match girl who plays the light of the meaning of life; Zyu, a mysterious boy who calls himself “Tower Base”; Red Riding Hood, a Blood Maiden distressed about her father; and Clara, a regular old nobody.

Everything leads to the “Foul Feeding Overseer Tower” that floats high in the sky… This is the finale of the prison break drama of the girls who follow the lights of hatred and friendship in attempt to escape the tiny earth star.
v28533.description:
监狱——那是被称为“有生命的监狱”的难攻不落的人类收容所。

几十年前突然诞生的这座监狱，由被称为“童话”的怪物以及统率它们的疯狂存在“噩梦”所管理。

作为童话转生体的杰克(ジャック)率领的血式少女们，
成功实现了“逃离命运的越狱”，出色地从地下监狱升上了地面……

怀揣着对地面的希望，杰克等人最初看到的景色……
那是浸泡在血海中的数千具尸骸，
以及“处刑台少女”疯狂的笑脸。

在处刑台少女压倒性的杀戮与暴力面前四散的同伴们，
那仿佛是在将一丝希望处刑一般。

为杀人而生的处刑台少女“火刑柱”
为同伴连一滴血都肯奉献的血式少年“杰克”
奏响存在意义之灯火的卖火柴少女“玛丽”
自称“监狱塔”的谜之少年“十”
为对父亲的感情而苦恼挣扎的血式少女“小红帽(赤ずきん)”
谁也不是的普通少女“克拉拉(くらら)”

一切都向着高空浮游的“恶食之监队塔”引导而去……
这是为了从渺小的地球越狱，
沿着憎恶与友爱之灯火前行的少女们的终焉越狱剧。

v28871.title: 响野家的工口游戏店
v28871.original: 響野さん家はエロゲ屋さん！
aliases: 響野さん家はエロゲ屋さん！
响野家开的工口游戏店
v28871.originalDescription:
In the residential district Kamiitsukomachi's old shopping district lies Hibikino Shop. This general store closed down after the grandfather owning it finally retired.
His three granddaughters, attached to it, and unwilling to let it disappear, decided to renovate it.
Hibikino Shop, loved by its community since 50 years, under the pressure of Yukari, the good for nothing of an eldest sister, became... an eroge store!

Hibikino Shop finally reopened.
A store of this size being too much for only three sisters to handle, and with only Yukari to know about this peculiar kind of products, they asked the second daughter's childhood friend Kurama Ren, our hero, to help them, as a part-time worker.

This is a story about the eroge industry from the perspective of a salesclerk.
v28871.description:
这里是距离五子站不远的
宁静住宅区“上五子町”。

位于萧条商店街一角的怀旧杂货店“响野商店”
因店主祖父宣布退休，即将歇业。

出于想让充满回忆的商店存续下去的想法
同住的孙女三姐妹商量之后，
决定改装成别的店铺，让响野商店继续经营下去。

“难得可以自由发挥，我想开自己喜欢的店！”

由于平时毫无干劲、生活散漫的长女的强硬主张，
某天突然，有着50年历史、深受当地喜爱的“响野商店”
摇身一变，重生为工口游戏专卖店“HIBIKINO SHOP”！

──最喜欢工口游戏的长女“响野由香里(響野ゆかり)”
──踏实可靠的次女“响野纺(響野紡)”
──对性方面有洁癖的三女“响野结衣(響野結衣)”

除长女外毫无相关知识。虽然重新开业了，
但光靠三姐妹显然无法维持店铺，于是次女的同班同学兼
青梅竹马的主人公“藏马莲(蔵馬蓮)”决定作为店员来打工。

以店员视角展现工口游戏业界的ADV。
卖工口游戏，光靠喜欢工口游戏可不行！

v29187.title: 心之形心之色心之声
v29187.original: ココロのカタチとイロとオト
aliases: ココロのカタチとイロとオト
Kokoro no Katachi to Iro to Oto
The shapes and colors and sounds of the heart.
v29187.originalDescription: Shiki Tsukimori was born with a mysterious power that allowed him to see and hear the minds of others. It could be a direct voice, a mood, or a color, but in any case, Shiki was able to see things that should have been invisible, and as a result, he has had a rough childhood. One day, he meets Harune Hoshina, whose heart he can't read. Shiki becomes interested in Harune, and the two eventually become lovers. This is the first time Shiki has been able to feel truly happy. Shiki wants to know more about Harune's heart but he's also afraid to know more and it ends up affecting his relationship with Harune. Will Shiki and Harune be able to overcome this ordeal and be truly happy?
v29187.description:
游戏主人公月森志季天生就具有不可思议的力量——能够“看”到或“听”到他人的内心情感。

他窥探内心得到的是直接的『声音』，『气氛』，或者『颜色』等各种形式。

总之，志季本来应该看不见的东西他能看见，因为这个力量他从年幼的时候每天过着痛苦的生活。

志季并不想知道别人的内心。有一天，他初次遇到了“无法看穿内心”的少女——星名晴音。

至今为止在志季的人生中，从来没有遇到过这样的存在。

志季因此对晴音产生了兴趣，不久两人就成为了恋人。对志季来说，这是第一次与宁静平和的日常相遇，他从心底感到很幸福。

……但是不久志季发现了自己心中的矛盾。“想更多地了解晴音的心。

”“但是，我害怕再次知道他人的内心了。”——两种相反的想法。

本应是幸福的志季心中起了涟漪，同时也影响了他与晴音的关系……

这是一个属于他们——志季和晴音的故事——克服重重挑战，两人在真正意义上变得幸福的故事。

v29666.title: 海与雪的青蓝色
v29666.original: 海と雪のシアンブルー
aliases: 海と雪のシアンブルー
Umi to Yuki no Cyan Blue
Cyan Blue of Sea and Snow
v29666.originalDescription:
At the end of autumn, I got a younger sister. She is someone who has never seen the ocean.
I didn't know what to say, so I took my sister to the beach.
And so our daily lives began.


The protagonist Aono Shion lives in the countryside where the city is snowy. 
He will soon leave the school which he used to attend. 

―― "Graduation"

After graduation, he will move to Tokyo for higher education.

The younger sister who will no longer lives with him―Aono Nana,
The classmates who will no longer be with him―Sumiki Kotoha, Hagino Yume, and Chigira Shuuto,
The underclassman who will no longer with him―Nabatake Inaba, and
The homeroom teacher who will no longer with him―Matsuki Ira. 

Farewells are bound to come, be it to shallow, or to deep relationships.

As he prepares to graduate and move to Tokyo, Shion takes his goodbyes to the place he grew up at and everyone he grew up with. While he's at it, he also recalled the bonds he had forged, the feelings he realized for the first time, and the signs he was finally able to notice. He spends his remaining days with the feeling of loneliness on leaving his hometown, mixed with the feeling of excitement of new world he's about to go, eventually, the day comes.

This is the story about Shion and his friends about what "graduation" means.
v29666.description:
特

主人公青野汐恩（青野汐恩）住在积雪的乡下。马上离开一直就读的学校的毕业

毕业后，去东京升学。

不再一楮住的妹妹·青野奈奈（青野奈々）。不再一猪不在的同级生们——小羽寸美纪（小羽寸みき）、萩野梦千绮罗（萩野夢ちきら）、修藤同学

不再一艘不在的下级生——程叶尚武（程葉尚武）、不再一猪不在的班主任老师——伊雁松木（伊雁松木）。

离别，无论是浅薄的关系还是深厚的关系都必定会到来。

毕业，正在准备移居东京的汐恩，向自己长大的地方和一起长大的所有人告别。他在那里期间，回想起他建立起的羁绊，第一次切实感受到的心情，怎么气绝的兆候他怀着离开故乡的孤独感度过剩下的日子。对崭新世界的期待感与沮丧，终于那一天到来

这是汐恩和他的朋友们讲述“毕业”的意义的故事。

v30812.originalDescription:
"I really want to continue my grandfather's café," you think to yourself. Unfortunately, you're completely in the dark about how to make it happen. Then a certain school comes forward and offers, "How about we provide this lovely café with some of our trainees?". You gratefully accept the offer, but the assigned trainees turn out to be four carnivorous cats?!

You've heard that it's not uncommon to use cat people as employees lately, but...

Here's where your story about running a cafe together with the four cats begins!
v30812.description:
【故事简介】
你继承了已故爷爷的咖啡店和房子。虽然心想“无论如何都想把最喜欢的爷爷的咖啡店继续经营下去”
却不知道该怎么做而一筹莫展时，某所学校向你提议

“要不要让有相关知识的住店研修生来这家可爱的店里工作呢？”

你带着抓住救命稻草般的心情爽快地答应了，然而出现在你面前的，
并不是人类研修生，而是4只肉食系猫咪？！

确实最近听说人型猫店员也不算罕见了……
你和4只猫咪一起经营咖啡店的故事现在开始了！

v31740.title: 我们是不能延期了
v31740.original: ウチはもう、延期できない。
aliases: ウチはもう、延期できない。
Ready or Not: The Deadline is Coming!
v31740.originalDescription:
Spring break. Miyamura Miku, a hobby writer of light novels, is approached by her older sister Miyamura Karin, who reveals to her that she's working as a voice actress for erotic games.

"The company I am working for right now needs someone to assist with writing the sex scenes!" Karin asks for Miku's assistance. 

"Wait, I'm still a virgin, you know? I have no clue how to write such a thing!"

At the same time the protagonist, Shiiba Masashi, is getting a sudden call from his big sister.

"Jeez, we can't! We're delaying. Can't. Impossible. We delay."

The one who keeps repeating these phrases like a broken record, is the protagonist's older sister, Shiiba Sayaka - CEO as well as scenario writer of the popular upstart eroge brand "Hades Soft".

"If we delay now, then we're done for. The sponsors will be chasing us for the rest of our life in order to reclaim the cash. We have to find a solution or I'll be to the neck in debt! I'll come haunt you if this kills me, okay?!"

And so, Masashi ends up being roped into helping them with their eroge development?!

This game is centering around eccentric heroines like the artist Suzumoto Chisa (pen name: Suzuse Akiko) and the reclusive colorist Sakakibara Ai. Here comes an ADV about creating eroge that's a little on the weirder side.

IF YOU LOVE EROGE, DON'T JOIN AN EROGE COMPANY!
v31740.description:
某年春假发生的事。
“求你了！另一方面，同样在享受春假的主人公，椎马雅史也突然被姐姐叫了出去。

“真是的，不行。要延期。不行，不行。延期”

像坏掉的录音机一样重复着同样的话的，是ハーデスソフト的代表，也就是他的亲姐姐椎马沙耶香(椎馬さやか)。

“这个要是延期了，就完了。会被流通渠道追到地狱尽头，被死缠烂打要求退钱的”

结果就半被威胁似的不得不帮姐姐工作！？

以在业界逐渐小有名气的ハーデスソフト为中心展开的，

v32310.title: マガツバライ
v32310.originalDescription:
“Spiritshine” is a mysterious power that has long-existed in humanity and nature. Hayato Isurugi—the apprentice of a “Spiritualist,” whose livelihood is to master the use of that power and exorcise demons—was enjoying his peaceful young life at Shinwa Academy.

Working part-time making charms to earn money; enjoying silly, lighthearted conversation with good friends; and secretly planning out a gift for his older sister as thanks for all that she does for him… But his ordinary, albeit pleasant routine is shattered by the arrival of an unforeseen assailant.

While the Academy falls into pandemonium, Hayato is deathly injured trying to protect his friends. But just as he is about to die, he encounters a young woman named “Magatsu,” the incarnation of an evil spirit sealed by his ancestors. It was 1,000 years ago, during the Heian era, that the city was shaken by the 13 Demon Generals. Taking the appearance of a beautiful young woman, the Calamity Shion smiled.

“Well, now… do you want to live, fool?”

“Here is the deal. Free me thyself.”

“And I will give thee strength.”

And thus the story began. The glistening days of youth.

“Even a little rock can make something happen if it starts moving!”

Like a clear sky, Magatsu Barai.
v32310.description:
自古以来存在于人与自然之中的不可思议的力量“灵煌”。
修习其运用之法、以祓魔为生的“灵奏士”见习少年，
石动隼人(石動隼人)在神和学园里讴歌着平稳的青春。

为了赚点零花钱打工制作御符……
和脾气相投的朋友们享受着闲扯的谈笑……
为了向姐姐表达平日的感谢，偷偷计划着送礼物……
这虽然平凡却很幸福的日常，却因意料之外的袭击者的到来而被击碎。

在学园陷入大混乱之际，隼人为了保护同伴而身负濒死的重伤。
在生命走到尽头的这一刻，他与祖先封印的怨念化身“祸”的少女完成了邂逅。
那是千年前，在平安之世震撼都城的十三魔将。
——以容貌美丽的少女之姿，灾祸鵼·祀怨(災禍鵼・祀怨)微笑了。

“来得正好——那边的蠢货，想活命吗？”
“这是契约。用你的手将妾身解放吧”
“赐予你力量吧”

于是，故事开始了。
闪耀般的青春岁月。

“哪怕是微不足道的小石子，一旦动起来也一定能引发些什么！”

宛如晴空万里的祸祓 X-rated就此拉开帷幕。

v32946.originalDescription:
Having recognized Minazuki Kashou’s talents in running his patissiere, Beignet felt her role was over. So she closed La Soleil in France and entrusted Fraise, the catgirl she raised, to him.

Fraise feels a fondness towards Kashou but becomes bewildered in the face of his 6 catpanions. She turns to Shigure for advice but she too harbors a hidden love for him. Fraise feels that the relationship between siblings is the most important while Shigure feels the happiness of her catgirls is what is most important.

Motivated by their desire to make sure the other is able to fulfill their love for Kashou first, the battle between catgirl and girl begins!
v32946.description:
### 关于本作

剧情
认可了水无月嘉祥作为糕点师的本领，并感到自己已尽到职责的贝涅(ベニエ)，
关闭了“La Soleil”法国店，将饲养的猫草莓(フレーズ)托付给了嘉祥。
草莓对嘉祥抱有好感，却对6只恋爱猫前辈感到不知所措，不久后便与同样怀有隐秘爱意的水无月时雨(時雨)逐渐亲近。
主张应当优先考虑兄妹关系的草莓，与将猫的幸福看得比什么都重要的时雨。
想要优先实现彼此的恋心，一猫与一人的攻防战就此开始！

v33175.original: ジュエリー・ハーツ・アカデミア -We will wing wonder world-
aliases: ジュエリー・ハーツ・アカデミア -We will wing wonder world-
Jewelry Hearts Academia -We will wing wonder world-
寶石心學院物語 -We will wing wonder world-
霞流宝石心 壮志凌云振寰宇
v33175.description:
“闪耀吧，我们的意志──”

弗里吉亚皇家宝石学院──

那里是研究被称为“意志”的不可思议宝石的学园。
主人公索玛·杰斯(ソーマ・ジェイス)为了探寻沉睡于学院中的“贤者之石”，
作为特工尝试潜入“钻石班”。
然而……他被分配到的是谜之新设班级“飞马班”。

──隐藏身份的外国间谍·索玛。
──只对剑感兴趣的女孩·贝尔卡(ベルカ)。
──不与任何人结伴的孤高不良·维奥(ヴェオ)。
──身为兽人且稀世才女·梅娅(メア)。
──成绩和态度都最差的王子·马库斯(マークス)。
──唯一正经的班级良心·阿丽亚娜(アリアンナ)。

齐聚飞马班的是目的与国籍各不相同的6名少年少女。
他们虽然时常相互排斥，但终将直面威胁世界的危机。

“食石”──

那是企图将诺瓦大陆全土石化的谜之灾厄。
位于最前线的他们，被卷入了与元凶组织《美杜莎》的斗争之中……？

“上吧大家──让我们把全力，狠狠地撞上去吧！”

索玛究竟能否达成任务。
又能否战胜吞噬大陆的石化威胁呢。

展翅飞向世界的意志与羁绊的冒险谭──在此闪耀。
v33175.originalDescription:
“Shine, Our Will—“

Phrygia Royal Jewelry Academia

This is an academy that researches mysterious gems known as “Will (Gems).” The protagonist, Soma Jace, infiltrates “Class Diamond” as an agent in order to investigate the “Philosopher’s Stone” said to lie dormant within the academy.

However… the class he ends up assigned to is a mysterious, newly-formed class: “Class Pegasus.”

— Soma, a foreign spy concealing his true identity.
— Belka, a girl interested in nothing but swords.
— Veo, a solitary delinquent who runs with no one.
— Mea, a beastkin and rare genius.
— Marcus, a prince with the worst grades and worst attitude.
— Arianna, the class’s one true voice of reason.

Class Pegasus brings together six boys and girls with wildly different goals and nationalities. Though they often clash with one another, they will eventually find themselves facing a crisis that threatens the entire world.

“The Stone Eaters”

A mysterious calamity bearing down to turn the entire continent of Nova to stone. Standing on its front line, they’re swept into a struggle against the organization behind it all: Medusa…?

“Come on, everyone — let’s throw everything we’ve got into this, with all our might!”

Will Soma be able to complete his mission? And can they overcome the threat of petrification devouring the continent?

A tale of adventure — of will and bonds soaring across the world — shines here.

v33494.title: ネコと女子寮せよ！
aliases: What Happens if I Who Can Use Magic Live in a Girls' Dormitory?!
ネコと女子寮（ワカイ）せよ！
女仆咖啡厅与魔法女子寮
v33494.originalDescription:
--Minato Dormitory, a women's dormitory.

Located in the neighborhood of the historic Shiraki Private Academy, the dormitory is managed by the cousin of the protagonist Yasaka Yuuki. It is an uncommon dormitory with a café where students working as waitresses are dress up as maids. Yuuki has been helping with the dormitory work since he was a child, and had seen the lives of many girls who lived there.

--One day, with a full-blown summer approaching.

Yuuki instinctively used his "magic" ability to save Tachibana Seika, a girl who was about to be run over by a car.

The Yasaka family can use a little bit of magic. Sometimes shooting small ice bullets, moving light objects, or to understand the will of animals. But this was an absolute secret. Yuuki hurriedly tried to deceive her, but Seika, who is originally a curious person, was skeptical. Eventually, she became interest in Yuuki, and suddenly moved into the dormitory.

A twin who always sticks to Yuuki, Yasaka Kanon;

A kouhai who enjoys working at the café, Momiji Akira;

A girl who likes to spoil Yuuki, Hiba Mitsuki.

In the place where these girls gather, the summer of Minato Dormitory is about to begin!
v33494.description:
——女子宿舍·凑寮

建在历史悠久的私立白城学园附近，
主人公八坂 勇气的表姐担任管理员，
并附设了由学生们担任女仆的咖啡厅
这样一座罕见的女子宿舍。

勇气从小就帮忙做宿舍的工作，
见识过各种女孩子的生活。

——盛夏逼近的某一天

勇气瞬间释放了自己拥有的能力“魔法”，
救下了差点被车撞到的少女橘 晴华。

八坂家的人，能使用一点小小的魔法。
有时能打出小小的冰弹，或是移动轻巧的物体，
或是能领会动物的意志……

但那是绝对保密的事情。

虽然勇气慌忙掩饰，
但原本就好奇心旺盛的晴华起了疑心，
不久她开始对勇气产生兴趣，
甚至突然住进了凑寮。

总是形影不离的双胞胎“八坂 花音(八坂 かのん)”，
在咖啡厅工作中努力的后辈“红叶 明(紅葉 あきら)”，
一味娇惯着勇气的“桧叶 美月”。

这些女孩子聚集的女子宿舍·凑寮——

对处于青春期的勇气来说，令人苦恼（？）的女子宿舍生活的夏天开始了。

v34121.title: 提早绽放的黑百合
v34121.originalDescription:
It may have been the curse of the black lilies that bloomed early in the winter--.
It has been 18 years since the new and threatening virus "CLII," which killed more than 50% of minors, was completely contained.
People have completely regained their normal lives, but it has left a huge mark and problem in the society....

A girl who has yet to realize its impact, Sasamori Hana, is a third-year student at Naeshiro High School in Sapporo.
She is a quiet girl, but inside she always feels anxious.
With only a few days left until graduation, Hana finds herself repeating the same day over and over again.

"Ah... that's right. I like Itsuki-chan..."

Hana strongly wishes for the happiness of "Itsuki-chan" who saved her in the past.
She's not even exaggerating it, she would do anything to make it happen.
But she thought the second time, "no, my feelings won't make her happy..."
She thought it was something she shouldn't admit, and it would just ended as "a whim of puberty."
However, that realization led to a deep, deep "curse"....

This is a story of love that weaves between two people in order to persist through such "love" and "curse."

v35899.title: 夏日终焉
v35899.originalDescription:
Summer in the countryside, rich in nature. The end of the world for two people.

After graduating from college, Yuuji found a job, but had to retire after less than a year due to physical problems he got from his workplace.

After much consideration, he decided to move to his grandparents' house in the countryside, which was vacant.

During his recuperation, he spent his days making videos of his rural life and uploading them on video websites.

The videos he uploaded gained a lot of attention, and when he was finally able to make a living from the income he earned from his videos, a global pandemic broke out.

People all over the world were dying. Fortunately, Yuuji was not infected.

One by one, people in his village fell ill, and after he saw the last person in his village off; 

"I wonder if I will die someday, too."

Yuuji thought to himself, and lived in apathy.

Then he meets a girl named Mio, who casually comes to his village, and he remembers the joy of living once again.
v35899.description:
自然丰富的乡村之夏。只有两人的末日世界 

大学毕业后虽然一度就业，但由于职场太黑心，不到半年就搞坏了身体而辞职的主人公「夕路(ユウジ)」
烦恼到最后，决定搬到乡下成为空房的祖父母家居住。

疗养期间，将乡村生活的种种拍成视频，
过着每天向视频网站投稿的日子。

投稿的视频幸运地走红，
终于到了能靠视频收入维持生计的程度时，却发生了世界性的传染病。

在世界的人们接连死去之中，不知为何没有感染的夕路。
送走住在同一个村的最后一位村民后，只是想着“总有一天自己也会死吧”，毫无生气地活着。

在这样的情况下，与偶然造访的女主角「澪(ミオ)」相遇，再次回想起生存的喜悦。
