v21186.originalDescription: The protagonist Seiji comes back to his hometown, where he becomes a witness of the mystery behind the series of unsolved murder cases. One by one, every single one of Seiji's old friends, with whom he just met, disappears. The mystery under the moon's light reveals a truth little by little, thus starts the story about the disappearance of the world, the moon, and the girl...
v21186.description:
契机，是母亲离奇的死。

大和国广濑郡 散吉乡——
名字与《竹取物语》多少有些渊源的沖名诚司，时隔数年回到了故乡的村子。

因为与父亲不和而寄宿在青梅竹马家的诚司，多亏了她广阔的交友关系，
得以遇见能令人感到舒心的、可称为“伙伴”的朋友。

然而，与他们一同度过的平稳日子，并未持续太久。
以调查母亲死亡的真相为契机，诚司他们被卷入了惨剧之中。

接连发生的、宛如仿照传承一般的连续怪死杀人事件。
本该信任的伙伴们，一个接一个地消失。

被月光照亮的惨剧，最终映出了令人不愿相信的犯人身影。

v800.title: 仏蘭西少女～Une fille blanche～
v800.originalDescription:
Masashige lives a well-off but vacant life. One day, he receives an invitation letter from his friend Harumichi. Masashige visits his house with his sister, Kasumi, and his friend, Kounosuke, who are also invited by Harumichi. However what they face there is the sudden death of Harumichi...
After the funeral, Masashige is informed by Caliban, the only butler in Harumichi estate, that he will receive a part of Harumichi's inheritance. There is a beautiful girl in a pure white dress in the basement of Harumichi's house. When Masashige whispers to her, she opens her green eyes and says "My master..."
The butler tells him "You can do whatever you want to her..."
v800.description:
大正十二年，西元1923年，5月6日，周日。自法兰西归来的友人所遗留下的东西是，沉睡在地下室的纯洁少女......
欧洲大战终结后，一度疯狂般的经济繁荣衰退下来，面对必然袭来的萧条局面，世态骚动不安，这是一个即将爆发革命的时代。
主人公矢旗泽政重，过着自由自在，也缺少刺激的无所事事的生活。
这时，从闭门不出的友人，织田桐治道伯爵那里，突然接到了到宅邸做客的邀请函。主人公与同样接到邀请的义妹矢旗泽香純
以及旧友真山皐之介一同赶赴织田桐宅邸，然而他们见到的是，治道伯爵的暴死。
事后，政重从织田桐宅邸的可疑的管家那里，接受了治道伯爵留给他的遗产，那是被安置在宅邸地下室的不可思议的美少女。
政重试着在少女的耳边低声细语，少女睁开了青色的眼睛，绽放出如花般的笑颜，说道："主人......"
然后，管家告诉政重："主人，可以对少女做任何事情"。

令人怀念的老家……但那里已经变成了只有女性的合租屋……
享受着独居与大学生活的主人公，因为公寓发生火灾，不得不回到继母居住的老家。
然而，时隔许久回到的老家，在主人公不知情的情况下，已经变成了只有女性居住的合租屋。
如今已变成女性乐园的这个家，似乎没有主人公的容身之处……
主人公正一筹莫展，但出乎意料的是，她们允许他一起住下来。
不过，这似乎有些隐情……
不管怎样，在这个满是女性的家里，主人公的新生活开始了。

v1241.originalDescription: The game revolves around Tōru and his girlfriend Mari, who are suddenly drawn into a horrible murder mystery while on vacation at a skiing lodge. The first part of the games develops as a crime-solving adventure. Additional murders occur if the player is unable to find clues, and the story culminates into a horror movie-esque ending.
v1241.description:
《镰鼬之夜×3》是自1994年在超级任天堂上发售的《镰鼬之夜》起延续至今的人气音效小说系列完结篇。2006年在PlayStation 2（PS2）上发售，本次为首次移植。
　　舞台设定在《镰鼬之夜2》的1年后，从第1作起就登场的透、真理等人卷入了新的惨剧。系列首次采用多主角制，从各种视角逼近事件的真相。
　　《镰鼬之夜×3》同时收录了第1作《镰鼬之夜》、第2作《镰鼬之夜2》的主线故事。即使没有玩过过去的作品，也能从本作开始享受乐趣。

v1462.title: North Wind
v1462.originalDescription:
The story takes place in a small town surrounded by the mountains where, every winter, a "Love Letter Festival" takes place. According to the legend, if you write a love letter to the one you love, and post it at the local shrine on the 26th of December, you will get to meet that person.

The protagonist, Makoto Akizuki, was born in that town and has been living in Tokyo for the last 3 years. He pays a yearly visit to his relatives, this time accompanied with his a junior at school, Hakana Fuyutsuta.
v1462.description:
时代为现代，舞台是被东北群山环绕的小镇——七藏町。

这座小镇上的七藏神社流传着一个小小的传说。

将信件投入神社里那个陈旧的邮筒，寄给想见面并传达心意的人，那封信就会

在每年12月26日举行的“恋文祭”当天被焚烧，那份心意化为灰烬，由北风送达给心上人。

然后，总有一天能与心上人相见吧……

许多相信这个传说的人，都造访了七藏神社。

在这座小镇出生、后来搬到东京的主人公秋月诚，

从3年前开始，在恋文祭临近之时，每年都会回到这座生养他的小镇。

今年学妹冬苕儚将会同行。

温暖迎接诚回乡的青梅竹马绫川佳暖与小牧水澄。

管理七藏神社的君冢一族的独生女，君冢深姬。

还有……诚在造访七藏神社的归途上遇到的失忆少女，柳雪华。

阔别一年再次造访的故乡小镇也诞生了新的邂逅。以这座积雪深厚的深山小镇为舞台

诚与5名女孩交织的恋爱故事就此开始。

v2089.originalDescription:
Yamada Hana is just an average student. One day, when she reads a book about the Romance of Three Kingdoms, she is suddenly surrounded by a flash of light and she loses consciousness...

When she wakes up, she finds herself in a forest. A man appears in front of her, and she is at a loss of what to do. The man's name is Koumei and she meets another person called Gentoku, but she is mistaken for a disciple of Koumei's and ordered to command an army and take part in a battle...

She doesn't know what to do, but somehow she wins the battle...
v2089.description:
女高中生主人公在阅读三国志书籍时，突然被白光包围。
等她回过神来，那里竟是一个与三国志一模一样的世界！
主人公听从自称“诸葛孔明(孔明)”的人的话，寄身于玄德军，
不知为何被当成了“诸葛孔明的弟子”，作为临时军师开始工作！
面对陌生的世界感到迷茫，在战场的严酷中呆立不动的她，
鼓励并引导她的，是如璀璨群星般的英杰们。
不久，淡淡的情愫萌生，并逐渐膨胀……
但是，在战场上可靠的他们，在恋爱方面却有些笨拙！？

v2756.originalDescription: Taisho era. Main character comes from a Chinese family. With his mother dead and father travel around the world. protagonist spends most of his time together with the girl Yui picked up and adopted to the family at a young age. One day siblings find a chest at the mansion and open it, but there is nothing inside. The same night after incredible light splash Yui's eyes turn red and hair blonde. Protagonist loses consciousness because of blood being sucked from his neck. But he wakes up from the tremendous pleasures body receives.
v2756.description:
时代是大正。

主人公和泉時雄（いずみときお）是暴发户华族的继承人。与小时候捡来、当作妹妹抚养长大的結衣（ゆい）一起，在宅邸中生活。母亲早逝，父亲在世界各地飞来飞去不回家。在这样的环境中，时雄和结衣加深了胜过亲生兄妹的家族羁绊。

然而有一天，在隐藏的宅邸地下室里发现了一口妖异的棺材。时雄不听结衣的劝阻，出于好奇心打开了盖子。——果然，里面什么都没有。失望的时雄，和松了一口气的结衣。可是，事件其实已经从这个时候开始了……

那天夜里，在露台看到结衣身影的时雄，目睹了难以置信的光景。转向时雄这边的结衣的眼睛红红的，闪烁着红光。下一个瞬间，结衣的头发变成了美丽的金发，嘴角露出了尖锐的犬齿。吸血鬼艾尔(エル)——这样自称的少女妖异地微笑着，开始吸食时雄的血。伴随着被吸血的慵懒感，同时感受着至今未曾体验过的快乐，时雄的意识渐渐远去了……

He decides to save Misa, and looks for his company, and meets Mikoto. She was also attacked by Kimaira and lost her family. At this very moment, Byakko appears and attacks Mikoto. Mikoto transforms herself into "Soul Eater" and has a battle against it. But Mikoto loses and is raped. Ryusuke is depressed to see what is happening in front of him, but Mikoto already decides to take a revenge....
v2866.description:
被由谜之兽人组成的犯罪组织“奇美拉”囚禁的主人公、
藤原龙介在千钧一发之际被姐姐美沙救出。
然而，美沙将奇美拉开发的新兵器“毁灭武装”的芯片托付给他，
为了让龙介逃脱而成为了奇美拉的俘虏。
发誓要救出美沙，
一边躲避奇美拉的追击一边寻找强者的龙介，
遇到了名叫圆城命的少女。
她因奇美拉而失去了家人，
自惯用手被废以来便封闭了心灵。
那时，奇美拉的追击者“白虎”现身，将命卷入了战斗。
然而，拯救了这一绝境的却是命。
她亲手拿起了毁灭武装的芯片。
命一直在暗中等待向奇美拉复仇的机会。
孤注一掷，龙介与命两人启动了毁灭武装。
随后命变身为人类兵器毁灭武装之一“噬魂者”
。成为噬魂者的命凭借其能力与白虎苦战。
但是，身经百战的白虎并没有大方到把胜利让给身为战斗外行的少女，
被拿出真本事的白虎逆转的命，
在龙介的注视下凄惨地失去了贞操。
龙介对眼前凄惨的景象感到绝望。
但命即使在被凌辱的同时，
她的眼中却将复仇的火焰燃烧得更加猛烈……。

v2998.originalDescription:
A mysterious tale of romance unfolds in Kowloon -- a walled city where there is no "sky".

Originally planned as the first part of a five-part series.
v2998.description:
九龙——这里是没有《天空》的城市。
被耸立的城墙包围、每边不到1km的土地。朝着天空层层重叠、复杂连结、多种多样的建筑物。交错铺设其间、细长狭窄仿佛迷宫一般的小道。在这样的场所熙熙攘攘、约30万混杂的人种。
对于这个城市的人们来说，《天空》是无限遥远之物。

——因此。
飞翔于《天空》的“鸟”，令人们产生畏惧之念，作为不吉利的象征被人们恐惧着。

——故而。
这个城市有一个自古留传的传说。
鸟代表了死亡，因鸟而死者，将因鸟而受到报复。
——有着这样的一个传说。

普通的女高中生佳苗酱为了发泄平日的压力，

v3659.originalDescription: Yuuta has started living alone in spite of opposition from his parents. But, he sinks into poverty soon.... One day, his older brother, Shuuhei, is transferred to his town and starts living together with him. From poor life to rich life, thanks to Shuuhei. v3659.description:
藍川祐太不顾因调职而搬家的父母的反对，开始在东京独自生活。然而，生活费被断绝，过上了只有打工的极度贫困生活……

某天，最喜欢的哥哥周平突然来访，说他调职到了东京。从极度贫困的生活一转，变成了包办三餐的优雅生活！但是祐太忘记了。哥哥是个极其过度保护且过度干涉的人！

v3660.title: 神学校-Noli me tangere-
v3660.originalDescription:
Michael and Gabriel Levi are twins who are enrolled in a seminary. On the eve of their Christmas holidays, the twins return home eager to see their family after the absence, only to find them dead and their home in flames. As if things couldn't get any more strange, there's a bizarre mark on the wall painted in their father's blood, of an inverted cross with a snake wrapped around it. It's the mark of a secret society in their very own school - a secret society which worships the devil.

Furious that God could let something so callous occur on a holy day, Michael turns his back on the figure he so dearly worshiped beforehand and vows to get his revenge while investigating the cult that had something to do with the destruction of his family.
v3660.description:
时代是不知第几次的世界大战后。战争留下的伤痕渐渐开始愈合时的英国。在某个地方的郊外，存在着一所古色古香的神学校。
学生们以带有时代印记的修道院为校舍，度过着祈祷与学习的日子。其中尤为优秀且虔诚的学生，麦克尔·列维(マイケル・レヴィ)。
出生在牧师家庭，把教会当成游乐场长大，自己也毫不怀疑要像父亲一样作为神的仆人活下去的少年。
然而，在圣诞夜，悲剧袭击了他。气喘吁吁赶回故乡的他眼前，父亲、母亲和妹妹已经化作了焦黑的尸骸。
并且，家人被烧死这一残酷的事实，将至今为止比呼吸还要自然的对神的赞美变成了诅咒，让他蜕变为了燃烧着复仇之火的愤怒之块。
圣诞夜，夺走他家人的究竟是谁。还有，在即将烧塌的墙壁上麦克尔·列维看到的，那个可憎的刻印是……。
不久若隐若现的，崇拜恶魔的秘密结社。拥有天使之名的少年，踏入了名为真实的禁忌之中——。

v4871.originalDescription:
Nana-chan is your childhood friend and classmate.
One day you went to play at her house.
Nana's family is not home and you and Nana are alone.
This is a story of that one day.

■"Playing House"
I will be playing house.

■"Food, Bath or Me"
Which one do you choose?

■"Playing Doctor"
You must be a doctor and see Nana-chan.
Palpations, tongue diagnosis (?), And injections.
Play with Nana-chan as you wish.

■"Taking a Walk"
We both go out to the neighborhood park.
Nana-chan is running around and does not wear any clothes.
Please look at the unprotected Nana-chan as much as you want.
v4871.description:
奈奈酱(ななちゃん)是你的青梅竹马，也是同班同学。
有一天，你去她家玩了。
奈奈酱的家人都外出了，只有你和奈奈酱两个人。
这是这1天的故事。

「过家家」
利用整个家来玩过家家。
「饭」「澡」还有「睡」
你会选择哪个？
　
「医生游戏」
你来当医生，给奈奈酱看诊。
听诊、触诊、舌诊(?)，还有打针。

v4880.originalDescription:
Uchihama Academy has seen an increase in enrollment in recent years and as a result, a new school building will be constructed. The story takes place during the final school festival in the old school. All the club leaders decide to give it their all to make this the best school festival. Sou is a member of the notorious astronomy club, which basically solves the various issues in the student council's place.

On one day, he stays in the school late at evening because he got slightly injured by the judo club and is healing his wounds in the infirmary. Suddenly, the building shakes. Shocked, he runs up the stairs to where the shaking seems to have centered, and there he encounters a mysterious naked girl, who at first appears to know him. On the next day this girl, Yui, seeks out the astronomy club, expressing her desire to join.
v4880.description:
这座校舍举办的文化祭，将是最后一次。

21世纪初，秋季的内滨地区。内滨学园公园宣告了前一年的高潮。

各文化团体的最大展示会场，由一般社团、执行部举办。这将是与新校舍的建设，以及决定废校的旧校舍的工程同时举办的最后的狂欢节。

当然，各文化协会的会长动员学生们，为了引导这最后一次文化祭走向成功而竭尽全力。

获得无数奖项的美术部的展示、实现了植物遗传因子转换的风乐团、生物学会的一般成员的大型演唱会。

每当强有力的社团宣布参战，士气就不断高涨。

此外，这种高昂的士气，也与大家对主人公秋山奏(秋山)所属的“天文学会”所寄予的期望有关。

活动内容不明、研究未发表，但他们的话语一定会做些什么，引发些什么。

基于这些充满希望的观察，赋予这个社团的使命只有一个。“镇压由各种社团过剩的能量引起的狂欢节暴动，不仅排除阻碍活动进行的障碍，还要解决入夏前开始的难以想象的事件。”

社团的成员，是学校里为数不多的名人之一。

学校暴动的背后，一定有合气道师傅、・的大臣支仓爱理(支倉 愛理)这个人的名字。在第33届新娘投票大赛中，被在第二年二年级部分获得第一名的佐佐木佳织(佐々木 佳織)拉开了巨大差距。学期中途转学到其他学校的转学生，古川结(古川 ゆい)。毒舌教师的破坏工作员・神宫渚。此外，天文学会还有来自美国的交换留学生・长船·KENNY·英太郎(長船・KENNY・英太郎)。

背负着全校的期望，向着最后一次文化祭行动了。

　本该如此。

　赶赴现场的蕾米莉亚看到的究竟是什么！？

v18353.originalDescription:
The life of an ordinary salary-man. Early mornings, occasional overtime, eat, sleep, repeat. A normal life without any inconveniences or surprises. But one day, you feel compelled to take the casual words of your superior to heart: 

"Change is good, even if it's just a little."

Some change would be good-- just challenge yourself a little. Broaden your horizons, meet new people here and there. 

However, to your surprise. Immediately that night, you spontaneously find yourself in bed with a woman. A situation that the old you could have never even imagined happening.

And just like that, your mundane days of a salary-man would begin to change with each encounter...
v18353.description:
职员・男鹿樹 （おが いつき）是一个普通的成熟的上班族。

早上起来上班工作，时而加班，回家后吃饭入浴睡觉，然后又是起床工作去……

纵然每天都是工作，却并没有什么拿得出手的实绩。

这一定是大多数社会人循环往复的、度过的每一天。

对此，他的上司对他发表了一番建议。

“改变就好。改变现在的你自己，就算是一点点也是好的。”

如此的话，也许就能看到与至今为止都不同的日子。

明白不懂之事，邂逅不识之人——

随着想要改变如今的每一天的想法，樹也为此开始展开了行动……但，

换做以往，那是绝不可能发生的事。

工作狂每天伴随着众多的邂逅，潜移默化地发生着变化——

v19133.originalDescription:
Seiryou Gakuen is a popular high-ranked school in the seaside city of Minato which prides itself on the latest facilities and student independence. Since a year ago, it has been managed concurrently by the student council and the new entrants council.

Soutarou is a second year student who is part of the ‘twilight club’ (tasogare-bu) that was formed under special circumstances and is governed by the student council. It helps with minor things like searching for lost objects and resolving troubles and worries. Even though every day is busy, they are carefree and he gets to walk to school with the student council president who he looks up to and talk with the beautiful club leader.

One day, he received a letter with no name on it:

“Will you be able to solve the repeated problems that will happen from now on?”

At the same time, a helicopter descended upon the school. The club was then beseiged by various troubles: negotations with the two school councils, a place with snow cherry blossoms, a mysterious clock tower, and a mysterious ability that could be used only by a few select people. There are many secrets called ‘alicegram’ which lie buried in the town. Will Soutarou be able to solve them all?
v19133.description:
青噮学园是海边城市港区的人气高中，以最新设备和学生的自主性为傲。从1年前开始，由学生会和新生会双方共同管理。

宗太郎(ソウタロウ)是二年级学生，也是“黄昏部”的一员。该社团在特殊情况下成立，由学生会运营。他们帮忙寻找失物、解决烦恼和担忧等小事。尽管每天都很忙碌，他们却很悠闲，他能和尊敬的学生会长一起步行去学校，还能和美丽的社团部长交谈。

有一天，他收到了一封无名信件。

他能解决今后反复出现的问题吗？

与此同时，一架直升机降落在了学校。此后，社团卷入了各种麻烦之中：与两个学校评议会的谈判、有雪樱的地方、神秘的钟楼、只有少数人能使用的不可思议的能力等。城镇里埋藏着许多被称为“爱丽丝地图”的秘密。宗太郎能解决所有问题吗？

v30969.originalDescription:
Tokyo Bay Area, somewhere in the Minato Ward.

Today is the last day of the second semester, the end of the year approaching. Godai Tomori, a member of the Twilight Club, the anything-goes club at Seiryou Academy, sighed even louder than usual.

Kanade, the club president, skillfully works and simultaneously converse with him. While emphasizing her big boobs.
Then, the former student council president Kotona interrupts them with a handful of sweets. And also shaking her big boobs.
Meanwhile, his underclassmate Yui would tangle and tease him whenever she has the chances. Not to forget pushing against him with her obviously—again—big boobs.
In this situation, the maid secretary, Sumire, made him a cup of tea with a smile. The glimpsing views of her deep cleavage is very soothing, and that indicates a presence of yet another pair of big boobs.

The Twilight Club... is not actually that kind of booby club. Surrounded by pretty girls, Tomori is happily working away despite the hustle and bustle. It's an end-of-the-year tradition, an annual cleaning in gratitude for the year. As they are all noisily cleans up the club room, Tomori find an ''old box'' that he doesn't recognize. When he opens it, he find a small key and a letter from an unknown sender inside.

"I am the Black Traveler."
"The Celestial Sphere of Time has been destroyed, and the world's balance has been disturbed."
——is the nonsense that is written on the letter.

This is the last mystery (Alicegram) left behind in the Twilight Club.

What is the meaning of this letter? And how will this change his relationship with the girls? What kind of future will they choose?

The mysterious and exciting erotic story of the protagonist, Godai Tomori, is about to begin.
v30969.description:
这里是东京都内，位于湾岸地带的凑十区（みなとく）———。

今天是年末逼近，第二学期的最后一天。
隶属于成棱学园的万事屋、黄昏部的後代灯（ごだいともり），叹了一口少有的大气。

作为部长存在的‘‘奏’’，花言巧语地翻弄着我。这时原学生会长的‘‘星泉琴奈(コトナ)’’，拿着零食来妨碍作业。至于后辈的‘‘小樱结(結)’’，一有空隙就挽住手臂来捉弄我。在这样的状况下，负责女仆的花之香澄玲(澄玲)笑着为我泡了茶。不对。
在被可爱的女孩子包围的黄昏部里，我虽然忙碌但也愉快地开始了作业。
这就是年末惯例，带着对一年感谢的大扫除。

大家吵吵闹闹地收拾着部室时，在那里发现了一个没有印象的‘‘破旧小箱子’’。
试着打开一看，里面装的是一把小钥匙和一封寄件人不明的信。

『——我是黑之旅人』
『时之天球被破坏，世界的均衡被打破』

信上只是缀写着令人费解的话语。
那正是遗留在黄昏部的最后的谜题（アリスグラム）。

这封信意味着什么？然后与女孩子们加深的关系又将如何？
究竟，他们选择的未来到底……？

v2341.description:
本作是描绘主人公健太郎(けんたろう)（玩家角色，名字可任意更改）与以女主角结城瑞穗(結城瑞穂)为首的众女主角之间恋爱的作品，在汲取了与《同級生》同种的基本剧本和地图移动型冒险系统的同时，将游戏内时间贯穿一整年，试图描绘逐渐加深的爱情。此外，废除通过图标光标移动进行观察和对话的系统，也是与《同級生》及《同級生2》的巨大差异。

但是，本作中也存在随季节变化的事件等，为了看到这些事件，设定了需要在规定期间内保持一定好感度等条件。如果急于提升好感度，有时会无法看到途中的事件，因此道具的使用时机很难把握。相反，也可以通过道具或事件降低好感度，但根据女主角的不同，一句不经意的话也可能招致彻底的破裂。

虽然标题名为《下级生》，但登场的女主角中下级生很少，与主人公同龄或年长的女主角登场更多。

Eito and his friends search for the prince, along with the eccentric Register Grimm, whose personality changes frequently, and Shirayuki, an optimistic girl who is easily get carried away, yet they can't find him at all.

Then, at Grimm's suggestion, Eito begins to run around the stories in the place of the missing prince.

v30726.originalDescription:
The Seventh Republic—the city despised by the sun.

Sunlight hasn't reached here since the last great war, and the shadows teem with vicious criminals.
With evil threatening on every side, the National Police Agency is a stronghold of justice.

Detective Ruka Hiryu belongs to the 13th Division, nicknamed the Sideliners, and treated like shit by the rest of the force.
With no major incidents to keep him distracted, Ruka has been investigating the sealed Cult Massacre case in secret.
Things change when the 13th picks up two new members.

The agency is shaken with unreliable rumors about the semi-mythical Shining Union, and as suspicions and conjecture fly like bullets, will Ruka, the 13th, and the NPA be unscathed?

警察内部传来的可疑传闻，存在本身被视为谜团的“光辉同盟”。
在各种企图暗中行动之中，卢卡的、第十三课的、警察组织的最终去向是……

v7771.title: 白色相簿2
v7771.originalDescription:
A song drifted in, carried by the cold wind’s embrace—

It matched the guitar I played in the music room steeped in twilight.
It echoed the piano someone played in the room next door.

And then, from the rooftop, a voice rang out.
High and clear, like the chiming of bells, weaving the three scattered melodies into one.

It all began in late autumn.
When someone fell in love.

We were all giving our everything.
We were all pressing forward, driven by feelings we couldn't hold back.
We were all earnest, unwavering, and honest.
In that fleeting moment, our hearts were bound, and we created memories that could never be replaced.

But because of that, someone fell in love.
A love that came too late. 
A love that should never have been.

Then came winter—covering all sins beneath the endless snow.
Then came spring—laying judgment bare as the snow melted away.

v1455.title: Folklore Jam
v1455.originalDescription: The story places the player in the shoes of one Momose Yuuichi. Our protagonist is an ordinary member of the Shotou Academy's student council that is forced to join the school's new up-and-coming Occult Study Group (Occult Kenkyuukai, or OkaKen) after he loses a bet with his childhood friend, Yaotome Itsuki. Though he is a realist, Yuuichi is easily scared when faced with the eerie and unexplained, but chooses to remain with the OkaKen in order to carry out his terms of the bet. As such, the game introduces the player to Kannagi City, its denizens, and the misadventures of the OkaKen as they face mysteries and challenges from the living and those beyond the mortal coil.
v1455.description:
被强制加入名为灵异研究会的男主角。
在成员个性鲜明的“灵研”里，崭新的校园生活就此开始……
过着平凡校园生活的男主角，突然迎来了动荡的日子……
这一切始于男主角最不擅长的对象，青梅竹马的八乙女维月（やおとめ いつき）的邂逅。
几乎被维月绑架般带去的地方，是她担任部长的“灵异研究会”，通称“灵研”。
这个研究会，除了男主角之外全是女孩子，乍看之下是小型后宫状态……本该如此，但聚集的成员却是古武术宗家的幺女和旧华族的后裔等个个脾气古怪的女孩子。
此外，将企图让研究会升格为社团的维月视为眼中钉的，学园首屈一指的才女，且其毫不留情到连教师都会避而远之的执行委员会会长也牵扯其中，“灵研”周围的局势呈现出剑拔弩张的态势。
在这种情况下，执行委员会提出的升格条件是，至少四名部员、一名顾问，以及能让委员会信服的活动报告―――
被强行拉来凑部员人数的男主角，等待着他的命运究竟如何？！
他能否平安生还，找回以前平凡的日常呢？

v1456.title: ままらぶ
v1456.originalDescription:
The player takes the role of Sakuragi Kouji. Our protagonist is a senior in high school that at one point was the ace of his school's baseball team. An injury forced him into early retirement, crushing his dreams of becoming a professional baseball player. For the last five years Kouji and his dad have been living in an apartment building where, as time passed, the tenants of his floor became something like a surrogate family. Kouji and his dad, wedding dress designer Ryouko and her daughter Koyuki, and university student/ero-literature author Kaori.

Much to Kouji's dismay, his dad has a bit of a reputation as a womanizer, and most expect him to be a chip off the old block. Proving them wrong, Kouji is more serious than his dad, and already has his heart set on someone. Of course, the person Kouji is set on is (true to the game's title) Ryouko, surrogate mother of the tenants on the fifth floor, and Koyuki's mom.

While the plot focuses on the affair between Ryouko and Kouji (and all the trouble our couple goes through to keep it a secret from others), the game has a total of five heroines for us to get to know in this strange romantic comedy.
v1456.description:
主人公・桜木浩二是住在公寓502号室的极其普通的少年。
这样的他意中的人，是隔壁503号室的未亡人・藤枝涼子。
令人难以相信她有一个比主人公小一岁的女儿，可爱的女性。
他梦寐以求的微小将来，就是与那位涼子拥有平凡的家庭。
“想两个人独处，过不被任何人打扰尽情撒娇的生活啊！”
怀揣着这样略显妈控，却令人莞尔的小市民式愿望的应考生。

然而，他这样的将来规划，
因为身为出了名的花花公子的父亲的血统而深入骨髓的，
隐藏的花花公子气质化为了仇敌。
涼子的独生女，同时也是同班同学的，藤枝小雪。
嚣张倔强又啰嗦，对浩二来说是像老婆一样的存在。
但是，继承了母亲基因的美少女，在校内被当作公认情侣对待的对象。
她也是，暗中恋慕着主人公的女孩子们之一。

瞒着小雪开始交往的主人公和涼子，还停留在接吻阶段。
围绕着为了设法达到那一步而奋斗的两人，
充满个性的女主角们。
突然从美国到来的主人公的未婚妻・克里斯汀娜·霍斯特托勒(クリス)，是个乐天派，
猛烈地向主人公发起攻势的，胸部很大的女孩子。
外表清纯，表面是顺从可怜的萌妹，菊永瑠璃。
然而，背地里，是把主人公欺负了个够的漆黑女王大人。

然后，501号室的秋月香里(秋月かおり)，是稍微年长的大学生。
但是，穿着裸体衬衫晃来晃去，或许是写色情小说的因果，
满口色情词汇的让人头疼的人。
主人公穿梭于那样充满色气的诱惑之中，
能平安地和真命天女涼子H吗？
还是会输给她们的诱惑，选择新的恋情呢。

v90.originalDescription: To Heart 2 - Another Days places the player in the shoes of Kouno Takaaki, a second year high school student living life one day at a time. The story officially takes place sometime after the events of To Heart 2 and assumes Takaaki is on friendly terms with all ten original heroines, but has not gotten romantically involved with any of them. Taking this idea a little further, Takaaki now has a new burden to deal with on top of the usual stuff: he has earned a bad reputation as a gigolo and casanova in school (the girls openly refer to him as such, the boys sigh in envy and even some of the teachers partake in the ribbing).
v90.description: 在『To Heart 2 - Another Days』中，玩家将以高中2年级学生河野贵明（河野貴明）的立场度过每一天。这个故事正式设定在『To Heart 2』的事件之后的某个时间点进行，假设贵明与全部10名原创女主角都保持着友好的关系，但并没有与她们中的任何人发展出浪漫关系。将这个想法进一步推进的话，贵明除了日常事务之外，还必须应对新的重担。他在学校里获得了小白脸和卡萨诺瓦的坏名声（女生们公开地这样称呼他，男生们则发出叹息），被人投以羡慕的目光，甚至有老师也参与到欺负他的行列中。

v169.title: Pia♥キャロットへようこそ!! ～We've been waiting for you～
v169.original: Pia♥キャロットへようこそ!! ～We've been waiting for you～
aliases: Pia♥キャロットへようこそ!! ～We've been waiting for you～
Pia♥Carrot e Youkoso!! ~We've Been Waiting for You~
v169.originalDescription:
You play as Yusuke, a young 18-year-old just finished with High School. You plan on spending your last summer with your best friend Daisuke. However, previously you made a bet with your father, concerning your grades. Your test marks are not desirable, and you lose the bet, therefore you must live up to your promise and work at daddy's restaurant, the Pia Carrot. What seems like what's going to be a lame summer of slave labor, becomes the greatest and most memorable summer of your life. What makes things interesting are all the cute girls who work at the Pia Carrot, and those who dine there.

You already know Shouko, a childhood friend of yours and Satomi, a classmate and the girl you have a crush on already, will be working with you. Yet, as the summer goes by the interaction with other girls is intense and you must choose who you want. There are a total of nine girls Satomi, Shouko, Reika, Yukiko, Saori, Airi, Shiho, Kiyomi, and Yukari, to court after.

Some will be easy to win over, others will require much sacrifices, patience, gentleness, perseverance, and chivalry. Your goal is to have one of the ladies "fall head over heels" for you and have her meet you in the park August 28th after you call her.
v169.description:
木之下 祐介(木ノ下祐介)（主人公）与父亲木之下 泰夫(木ノ下 泰夫)打了一个赌。
赌约的内容是，如果期末考试没有不及格，父亲就会全额负担暑假和损友江口大介一起去搭讪旅行的费用，否则就要在父亲经营的家庭餐厅“Pia Carrot”里整个暑假一直打工。
结果，祐介考了不及格，旅行化为泡影，人生中最宝贵的时间全都泡在了打工里。
祐介虽然被挫败感击垮，但等待着他的，是一场能将这种不幸一扫而空的绝佳邂逅。
那是祐介炎热夏天的开始……。

v446.originalDescription:
A fan disc of sorts for various Leaf games.

Includes:

- Witsarunemitea Senki: Action game featuring characters from Utawarerumono
- Leapon: Ponjan game where you can choose from six opponents: Eruruu, Aruruu, Takase Mizuki, Mikage Subaru, Kurihara Touko, and Kida Emiri
- Guendina no Majo: Real-time strategy game that takes place after Natsumi's route in Magical Antique
- Routes Extra Mission: Two short scenarios that take place after the main story of Routes
- Leaf no Tou (Leaf Battle Characters): 50 stage RPG with real-time elements, with playable characters from Magical Antique, Tasogare, Utawarerumono, and Routes
- And other omake material
v446.description:
Leaf Amusement Software第4作。

收录的游戏等被设定为名为"传颂乐园"的现代游乐园风格设施中的游乐项目。

引导员是《传颂之物》的阿露露(アルルゥ)，哈克奥罗(ハクオロ)、艾露露(エルルゥ)、柚叶(ユズハ)、卡缪(カミュ)也一同进行引导。此外，其他《传颂之物》的角色也作为游乐项目的向导出演。

另外，本作的标题有时会被误写为"和阿露露玩!!"。手册第2页也有同样的笔误。（不过，也有人认为这是故意的）

内容

维茨亚尔内米特亚战记
《传颂之物》的角色登场的动作游戏。在斜向上滚动的场地上打倒敌人前进。角色不仅有原作的己方角色，满足特定条件后也可以使用敌方角色。部分地方散见令人联想到1980年代街机游戏的演出。

りーぽん
与《Comic Party》《传颂之物》《没有天使的12月》的角色对战，以及角色化为牌的麻将。

也可以使用作弊技巧。

可以选择作为对手的角色有以下6人。牌会变成对手出处作品的角色，不同出处作品有各自固有的牌型。

《Comic Party》：高濑瑞希(高瀬瑞希)、御影昴(御影すばる)
《传颂之物》：艾露露、阿露露
《没有天使的12月》：栗原透子、木田惠美梨(木田恵美梨)

古恩迪纳的魔女
以《Magical☆Antique》的牧部夏美(牧部なつみ)为主角的即时模拟RPG。夏美参加古恩迪纳的魔法考试，以成为独当一面的魔法师为目标。召唤各种使魔，打倒敌人。

Leaf之塔
Leaf角色总出演的RPG。目的是收集"Leaf之塔"内据说能实现任何愿望的9枚"叶子"。流程上，在每一层完成"冒险部分"→"战斗部分"后前往下一层，如此反复，因此完全没有探索要素。

战斗部分中每场战斗从以下角色中选择4人。冒险部分中，设定为以下所有角色始终一起行动。

《Magical☆Antique》：宫田健太郎、苏菲(スフィー)、莉安(リアン)
《谁彼》：坂神蝉丸、三井寺月代、桑岛高子
《传颂之物》：哈克奥罗、艾露露、阿露露
《Routes》：那须宗一、汤浅皋月、伏见由香里(伏見ゆかり)

Routes EXTRA MISSION
《Routes》的番外篇剧本。"福原庄藏先生与快乐的伙伴们"和"灵魂之画樱花绽放"两篇构成。

原作是视觉小说，但本作采用了在画面下方显示窗口的一般冒险游戏形式。

Leaf SIDE-B 出张版
昔日Leaf里网站"Leaf SIDE-B"（现已关闭）的出张版。网站招募的"第4回 Leaf CG大赛"的工作人员投票结果发表。

其他
收录了新绘制的壁纸、《雫》的附加语音、工作人员的评论。

v1165.title: 君が呼ぶ、メギドの丘で
v1165.original: 君が呼ぶ、メギドの丘で
aliases: 君が呼ぶ、メギドの丘で
Kimi ga Yobu, Megiddo no Oka de
你在米吉多之丘的呼唤
v1165.originalDescription: Beigel finds a girl lying unconsciously at the desert. Her name is Rinon. According to her, she came from the edge of the world to stop the God's clock...
v1165.description:
**贝格尔·罗科(ベーグル・ロコ)**

主人公。与玛丽亚出身于同一家孤儿院“罗科之家”，但他离开了神学校，现在作为自称的考古学者在各地发掘遗迹（实质上是盗掘）。在拜访玛丽亚的边境之地索尔特贝尔，（字面意义上地）捡到了莉农(リノン)，被强行塞了原版圣经后，被捧为救世主，陷入了不得不拯救世界的境地。

没有骨气，给周围人留下不可靠的印象，但对女性很温柔（包含私心）。此外，无法对陷入困境或危机的他人坐视不管，有时甚至拥有牺牲自己也要保护他人的愚直。

起初，由于性格方面并不合适的自己被选中，加上对世界灭亡半信半疑，他缺乏作为救世主的自觉。但是，通过与各种各样的人相遇和经历事件，他逐渐觉醒了作为救世主的使命。

在故事即将进入尾声时，他的本名是“贝格尔·雷斯塔蒂奥”，是约兰·雷斯塔蒂奥(斯温)与查德·罗科的亲生儿子这一事实浮出水面。

持有的武器是圣经。

**莉农(リノン)**

恶魔三柱之一。司掌大地之键。指定阿达曼的子孙贝格尔为救世主。特征是酷似牛角包的金发纵向卷发，常被当作标记。带着一只名叫迪波的独眼、类似蝙蝠的生物。

其实她一直在远处观察贝格尔，选择他作为救世主的理由是“因为恋爱了”。

持有的武器是一把大钥匙，但在普通攻击时是迪波在用身体撞击。

**雅哈(ヤハ)**

恶魔三柱之一。司掌天空之矛。名字的原型是耶和华（雅威）。

在故事初期，她看不起软弱的贝格尔，一有机会就想从背后将他砍倒，但逐渐察觉到贝格尔内心的坚强而被他吸引。

自称“保护莉农之人”，但在最终BOSS战前真相大白。

持有的武器是三叉戟状的矛。

**玛丽亚·罗科(マリア・ロコ)**

与贝格尔出身于同一家孤儿院的修女。因为对所属的圣典教团提出意见，被流放到边境之地索尔特贝尔。她追赶着卷入拯救世界骚动的贝格尔。玛丽亚的名字里隐藏着秘密，尾声中有暗示的描写。从这些描写来看，她被认为是真正的女主角。因为和贝格尔同姓罗科，被塞西莉亚误认为是贝格尔的妻子。

本应是作为优秀治疗师而为人所知的虔诚修女，但自从卷入贝格尔的战斗后，就在破戒的道路上一路狂奔。

持有的武器是左轮手枪双枪。枪法相当了得。也会使用片头动画中出现的加特林机枪。

**纳塔斯(ナタス)**

恶魔三柱之一。司掌时间。让阿达曼的搭档伊法（相当于创世记中的夏娃）堕落的罪魁祸首。作为凶事预言者而令人恐惧的存在。在冷冻睡眠状态下被贝格尔等人（字面意义上地）敲打唤醒。对被称为阿达曼翻版的贝格尔怀有热烈的情感。

持有的武器是锡杖。

**巴迪(バディ)**

本不该存在的第四个恶魔。缺乏感情，沉默寡言。相对于雅哈的白衣，她身披黑衣，可以说是对立的存在。绝对服从斯温的命令，如果是他的命令连平民也会屠杀，但被贝格尔说服，逐渐向他敞开心扉。

其实是由斯温以他和查德的细胞为基础制造出来的女儿，在遗传学上相当于贝格尔的妹妹。

持有的武器是镰刀（大镰刀）。

**塞西莉亚·库贝蕾(セシリア・キュベレー)**

隶属于圣典教团的圣骑军年轻女性指挥官。是被圣典教团歧视的异教徒之女，因其身世而成为被信仰心束缚在教团上的悲哀存在。被贝格尔拯救了心灵，决定脱离教团。但被教团抓住，被耶利米亚交给了“阿达曼的裁断机”后失去自我，企图杀害贝格尔，但裁断机被破坏后恢复了理智。

持有的武器是有两根巨大剑尖的枪。

**耶利米亚·欧里斯米亚(エレミア・エウリスミア)**

被称为圣典教团所属圣女的存在，但其实是个贪财的守财奴。对被捧为救世主的贝格尔怀恨在心，在故事即将进入尾声前会作为强大的敌人与他对抗。

本名是“克拉拉·埃科”，曾和玛丽亚、贝格尔在同一家孤儿院生活过。

持有的武器是耶利米亚自己开发的人工圣经“伪典”。

**查德·罗科(チャド・ロコ)**

在各地（特别是针对圣典教团）行窃的，飘忽不定难以捉摸的女性。自称“义贼”。与纳塔斯是老朋友。

其真实身份是曾经与救世主一起挑战世界时钟的人之一，是贝格尔的亲生母亲。

持有的武器是类似日本刀的剑。

**斯温(スウェン)**

v2547.title: DOKIDOKIバケーション ～きらめく季節の中で～
v2547.original: DOKIDOKIバケーション ～きらめく季節の中で～
aliases: DOKIDOKIバケーション ～きらめく季節の中で～
Doki Doki Vacation ~Kirameku Kisetsu no Naka de~
Dokidoki Vacation ~Kirameku Kisetsu no Naka de~
v2547.originalDescription: Dokidoki Vacation tells the story of a Japanese teenager called Junichi. High school is over, the summer vacation has begun. But due to the young man's uneasy relationship with his family and other circumstances, he cannot afford the vacation he was hoping for. So Junichi decides to find a job. He starts working in a book store, and soon realizes that feelings develop between him and Megumi, a girl who works in the same place. But what about the classmate Junichi was in love with before?..
v2547.description:
跨越14年的时光，那部《DokiDoki假期》回来了！
为了100%发挥原作的优点，原画保持不变，以全彩重新绘制！
睦、彩香、塔尼亚(タニア)等人将以鲜艳的色彩重新焕发生机。
语音为全新录制的全语音规格！游戏系统也刷新为最新规格！
这就是既怀旧又崭新的完整重制版！！

★故事
期盼已久的暑假！今年一定要邀请同班同学小睦去约会……
但因为没勇气，一直说不出口。
就在这时，损友彻提出了旅行的计划。
小睦和那家伙的女朋友关系很好，这简直是千载难逢的大好机会！
作为交换，费用全部被推到了我身上，但顾不了那么多了。
为了攒钱还得去打工，看来今年能过一个充实的暑假。
备考？我们学校是直升制的，所以完全没问题。
总之现在对我来说，和小睦急速拉近关系比什么都重要。
情敌似乎相当多，得在这里一口气拉开差距才行！

★登场角色
●高阶睦
润一的同班同学，人气第一的偶像般存在。
性格文静清纯、温婉端庄，但有一点点爱吃醋。
和优莉是好朋友。她将和润一一起参加优莉（和彻）邀请的旅行。
在各种场合会表现出似乎对润一抱有好感的态度，
但每次都会被打扰，迟迟无法更进一步。
非常不擅长鬼怪、幽灵等灵异相关的事物。

●雪谷绫香
是润一和惠抽中的抽奖特等奖品——职业摔跤比赛场馆里遇到的女子职业摔跤手。
她是明星摔跤手，非常强大，而且一旦发怒就会失去理智，
拥有连巨型摔跤手都能轻松摔飞的怪力，
但平时完全看不出这些，是个有些容易动心的普通大姐姐。
从高中开始练职业摔跤，现在似乎已经成为与她密不可分的重要事物。

●谷川惠
是润一为了筹措旅行资金而开始的书店打工伙伴中的女孩。是个非常开朗的女孩，
尽管薪水微薄，仍然坚强地努力着书店的打工。
是个相当硬核的推理小说迷，一聊起这个话题就停不下来。
和润一一起寻找书店店长的纸袋时，尽管是盛夏，却以福尔摩斯风格的装扮出现。
经常被当成年纪小，但其实和润一是同一所学校的同年级学生。
尽管如此，在书店的相遇是他们的第一次见面。

●加贺优莉
润一的朋友彻的女朋友。是个开朗又有些好胜的女孩，彻肯定是被她管得服服帖帖的。
和性格完全相反的睦关系非常好，也有热心撮合润一和睦的一面。
兼具活泼、聪慧和敏锐的直觉，这样的她为什么会是彻的女朋友，润一无法理解。

●九段美奈穗
旅行目的地十钱滨的住宿地"白波庄"的女儿。
实际上经营着白波庄，拥有与润一那宛如妖怪般的祖父母截然不同的宣传能力与美貌。
不知为何会积极接近润一，搅乱他和睦的关系，也有些使坏的一面。
相比年轻的外表，她对十钱滨和过去的事情非常了解，是个充满谜团的女性。

●塔尼亚
本名是"亚历山德拉·科米克罗什·内蒂贝尔克松·塔尼亚·亚历山德拉"。
是润一担任外交官的父亲命令他陪伴一天的女孩。
是曼加尼亚王国这个北欧小国的公主，似乎对世间事务不太了解。
来到日本是为了观光和增长见闻。
天然呆，迷迷糊糊的，但对本国的未来却相当认真地思考着。
好奇心旺盛，对任何事物都表现出兴趣，并勇于尝试。

v7719.title: Tears to Tiara II 覇王の末裔
v7719.original: Tears to Tiara II 覇王の末裔
aliases: Tears to Tiara II 覇王の末裔
Tears to Tiara II: Haou no Matsuei
Tears to Tiara II: Heir of the Overlord
ティアーズ・トゥ・ティアラII 覇王の末裔
ティアーズ・トゥ・ティアラ2 覇王の末裔
v7719.originalDescription:
Hamilcal, nicknamed Hamil, is the successor of the Hispania’s throne, but his country was conquered by the ever growing Holy Empire. He and his people are treated as slaves and Hamil has to pretend to be a fool (acting almost like a retard) just to discourage his people from doing a counter attack that would surely fail.

On a fateful night, he meets a strange girl who claims to be the main goddess of his religion, the Goddess of War, Ashtart (Tart). She treated Hamil’s wounds and sang a lullaby to help him sleep. This was certainly the happiest day of Hamil's life, but everything crumbled when messages from the empire interrupted their sacred festival to officially announce the slavery of the Hispania’s people, and as a symbolic act, they decided to sacrifice Tart for heresy against their supreme god Watos.

This made Hamil go into a rampage, summoning the forces of the God of Conquest, Melqart and releasing all the magic he had been building up for 7 years to assassinate a whole army by himself. However, Hamil failed to notice that Tart was set on fire by one of the empire’s guards, and he desperately jumped into the flames to rescue her. Deeply moved by Hamil’s bravery, every Hispanian in the festival started to root for him and their savior goddess, their restored faith revitalizing Tart’s power, saving her from the flames. Rejoining with Hamil while still inside the flames, they performed the sacred ritual of marriage between a goddess and a mortal to use the power from their magical resonance to summon an army of giant elephants and machines from the Heavens and, with it, they smashed many other Imperial troops. Taking advantage of the situation, Hamil ordered every Hispanian troop to attack. This was how he came to be known as the Conqueror King and how he retrieved his whole country in a single night.
v7719.description:
哈米尔卡尔，昵称哈米尔，是 Hispania 王位的继承者，但他的国家被不断扩张的神圣帝国征服了。他和他的子民被当作奴隶对待，哈米尔不得不装疯卖傻（表现得几乎像个白痴），只是为了阻止他的人民发起注定失败的反击。

在一个命运之夜，他遇到了一个自称是他所信仰宗教的主神——战争女神阿斯塔特（Tart）的神秘女孩。她为哈米尔处理了伤口，并唱起摇篮曲哄他入睡。这无疑是哈米尔一生中最幸福的一天，但当帝国传来的消息打断了他们的神圣祭典，正式宣布 Hispania 人民沦为奴隶，并作为象征性行为，决定以亵渎其至高神 Watos 的异端罪名将 Tart 献祭时，一切都崩塌了。

这让哈米尔陷入狂暴，召唤出征服神 Melqart 的力量，释放了他积蓄了 7 年的全部魔力，独自一人暗杀了一整支军队。然而，哈米尔没有注意到 Tart 被帝国的一名守卫放火烧身，他绝望地冲入火海去救她。被哈米尔的勇气深深打动，祭典上的每一个 Hispania 人都开始为他与他们的救世女神呐喊助威，他们恢复的信仰重新唤醒了阿斯塔特的力量，将她从烈火中拯救出来。阿斯塔特在火海中与哈米尔重聚，他们举行了女神与凡人之间的神圣婚礼仪式，利用他们魔法共鸣产生的力量从天界召唤出一支由巨象和机械组成的军队，并以此粉碎了许多其他帝国军队。利用这一局势，哈米尔命令所有 Hispania 军队发起攻击。这就是他被称为征服王，以及他如何在一夜之间收复了整个国家的故事。

v8897.originalDescription:
The game is based on the manga "Half Moon ni Kawaru" made by Ryo Ramiya. It contains four separate stories, which can also be defined as mini-games due to their short length. Each story contained is dedicated to a different heroine:

1. Suzuka and her boyfriend escape from ninjas; they are ambushed by amazon warriors and get separated. Suzuka finds herself in a weird mansion overrun by monsters, and must fight her way with a sword.

2. Eve is a saleswoman in a large company that sells items for skin care and make-up. She has to explore the neighborhood and to convince customers to buy their products.

3. The protagonist in this story is the "hero" of the entire game (default name Tatsuya); he offers his services to Selena, the queen of the medieval Rabbi-Rabbi kingdom. Evil bunnies are disturbing the peace in the country side, and the hero, aided by the lovely girl Nina, has to get rid of them and bring back the carrots.

4. The shortest game tells the story of Titis, a lovely mermaid who dreams of marrying a human prince. In search for the love of her life, Titis gets to know the world of humans through a series of sexual encounters.
v8897.description:
很有趣。看下面的CG就能明白，是4个故事的短篇集形式。4个故事系统本身都不同，可以享受不同的乐趣。基本上是温馨的感觉，也交织着笑声。

铃鹿剧本是试图和恋人一起成为逃忍，却被传送到异次元的故事。是地下城RPG风格，也会和敌人战斗。

伊布剧本是销售皮肤的游戏。虽说是如此，但也是从地图上选择要去的地方来推进的普通AVG。只有这个是多结局的。

兔女郎剧本是打地鼠游戏。兔女郎的国度出现了人妖兔女郎和大哥兔女郎。成为了勇者来守护国家。就是这么个设定。

踢踢死(ティティス)剧本真的是单线。没有任何选项的普通AVG。是人鱼踢踢死寻找王子的故事。是以同名漫画为原作的作品。

兰宫凉担任原画的游戏还有很多其他的。推荐。

v26075.originalDescription:
When he came to his senses he was in the darkness, too lost to know which way was up and which was down.

How long had he been there? How long would he remain?

As his voice grew hoarse, his screams going unheeded, and his last sparks of consciousness threatened to fade—it was then that a ray of light shone through the darkness.

He heard someone calling…

Driven by that voice, he desperately reached out to the light, only to see an unknown starry sky before him.

And in his arms was a girl with red eyes, and two horns pointing up at those strange heavens.

The girl was bleeding. The blood wasn't stopping. Teetering between life and death, she addressed him.

“A black mask…? You’re… my….”

Their rebellion began in that moment. The struggle of a princess bound by blood, and a man who lost his name.
v26075.description:
故事

回过神来，自己已身处
不知上下的一片黑暗之中。
究竟是从何时起就在这里的，
又究竟会在这里待到何时。
声音传不到任何地方，就连残存的意识
都仿佛要消融在黑暗中时，
一条光芒射入。
听见有人在呼唤的声音……。
被这样的念头驱使，拼命向光芒伸出手的前方
是一片陌生的奇妙星空。
而那双臂之中抱着的
是长着指向天空的双角与赤红双瞳的少女。
流血不止、徘徊在生死边缘的少女问他。
“黑色假面……？你是……我的……”
被血所束缚的一族之公主与
失去名字的男人对命运的叛逆开始了。

v181.title: 鎖
v181.originalDescription:
"If only we hadn't rescued him..."

There is a high-speed experimental ship, "Vasilisk." The protagonist, Kouzuki Kyousuke, and his friends happened to be on its trial voyage. It was summer at that time. Because the trial voyage's supervisor was also the mother of the protagonist's childhood friend, Kyousuke and his friends were spending their time as if they were on a cruise.

One day, the ship came across an ocean investigation ship adrift on the high seas. There was only one person on its board: Ishida Youichi, who claimed to be an oceanographer. He was a well-mannered young man, so there were no particular issues with him. However, as soon as they took him abroad, the ship's navigation instruments began to fail one by one.

And when the sun was hidden under the veil of darkness, an incident occurred—there was a sudden blackout. Once the electricity was restored, a cruel scene appeared before the eyes of Kyousuke and his friends. There was a woman tied to a chandelier. She was in terrible shape, as if she had been tormented mercilessly.

That woman was the supervisor, Orihara Shino...
v181.description:
本作是在船内与犯人展开直接战斗与心理战的悬疑冒险游戏。

在这款游戏中，一旦选择失败或漏掉道具，就会立即导致游戏结束。本作的游戏结束非常多，这也是其特征之一（注：由于游戏结束不会播放片尾曲及制作人员名单，因此不包含在右侧表格的结局数量中）。有许多场景只能默默隔着屏幕看着女主角们遇害。此外，令人印象深刻的坏结局和游戏结束也很多，还描写了禁忌之恋等。

故事物语的舞台是高速实验船“巴吉里斯克”的船内。主人公（香月恭介）等人搭便船参加了朋友母亲主持的该船试航。然而，自从救起在公海上漂流的男子岸田洋一后，事件便开始发生……

Included within the set are Azusa (the female lead who hates Koji for his perversion), Ryoko (the manager who's sweet on Koji by working him very hard), Aoi (the token alcoholic), Jun (the secret-hiding waitor), and Mina (Azusa's cute little sister).
v2396.description:
前田耕治（主人公）受好友矢野真士之邀，去家庭餐厅「Pia Carrot」二号店打工，两人约好在车站前碰头。
而且他还嘲笑了女孩戴着的项链坠子，导致两人明明是初次见面，却吵起嘴来。
他带着最糟糕的心情前往面试地点「Pia Carrot」，却在那里与吵过嘴的女孩重逢，甚至还要和她一起工作……。

v4558.title: きゃんきゃんバニー
v4558.originalDescription:
The story of this game is simple. The protagonist is a lonely guy who constantly dreams about having a girlfriend but doesn't do anything to actually get one. One night, a fairy with bunny ears named Ariko appears in front of him and says she will fulfill one wish for him. Afterwards she simply guesses what the guy needs most badly: a girlfriend. So she gives him a magic book, which will give him information about five beautiful girls living somewhere in the city. With this book the hero's chances are increased. The quest for love begins!

The game plays like a standard Japanese adventure (still shots of locations, menu-based interface), with some additions. The hero can buy items and give them to girls as presents to impress them. The conversations with the girls involve going through several topics to find out what the girl likes. Once a girl seems to be "ready", it's possible to directly use commands such as "kiss the girl", "touch the girl" (with body parts specified), and even "***** the girl", which speaks for itself.
v4558.description: 导航员是亚理子。与后来的作品不同，此时亚理子的外观是兔女郎风格的。攻略对象是与主人公有某种关联的5人。这也是目前唯一进行过重制的作品。

v6307.title: 猪名川でいこう!!
v6307.originalDescription: An amusement CD collection with characters and stuff from Comic Party and White Album. The game Night Writer is also included with this CD. Night Writer is mainly a typing game featuring Corin. You battle demons from Dr^2 Night Janki by typing words for your attacks.
v6307.description:
Leaf amusement soft第3作。

主要的推进者是《漫展派对》的猪名川由宇(猪名川由宇)，但该作品的其他角色们也会进行对话或负责各环节的推进。

由2张CD-ROM组成，其中1张仅收录了「Filsnown」。

内容
Leaf悬疑剧场 流浪同人作家旅情篇③
《漫展派对》的番外篇剧本。
三大御宅族 漫展派对最大决战
《漫展派对》的角色登场的问答游戏。像双六一样掷骰子在地图上前进，停在格子上会出与Leaf作品相关的问答题，答对题目并达成定额后就能继续前进。
Night Writer
《DR2夜雀鬼》的角色登场的打字游戏。原创角色驱魔师“城户芳晴”（名字可自由更改）和天使“科林”，封印雀鬼们的故事。经常被弄错，是Night Writer而不是Night Rider。
Filsnown
作为PC-98系列对应发售的该作品的Windows移植版。追加了结局等。
Memories of White
《WHITE ALBUM》的电子书。
收录了小说、漫画、工作人员评论。
「まじかる☆アンティーク」体验版
本作发售当时的下一部作品「まじかる☆アンティーク」的介绍。
樱井朝日(桜井あさひ)的DJ播放器
以《漫展派对》的樱井朝日为原型的CD播放器。
Leaf桌面
以《漫展派对》和Leaf的标志等为原型的桌面主题。
此外，收录了工作人员评论、漫展派对角色的人气投票结果

v30616.originalDescription:
In this game, you play as Fujita Hiroyuki, a high-school student who seems to have more interest in romance than in his studies. In his school there are several pretty girls, and his goal is to be nice to one of them, to make the right decisions when talking to her, and ultimately to win her heart.



Remake of the original PC version featuring a completely revised script, with some of the heroines having completely different stories as a result, full voice acting for all characters except the protagonist, new art, and mini-games.
v30616.description:

与青梅竹马的『神岸明(神岸あかり)』『佐藤雅史』、初中以来的朋友『長岡志保』等人，度过着热闹的高中生活。

接着到来的3月、4月。伴随着清爽的春风，主人公的恋爱故事即将开始。

v40027.title: 義賊探偵ノスリ
v40027.originalDescription:
It was a trivial matter that started it.

Haku is living a busy life in the imperial capital of the great nation Yamato. Peaceful times seemed like they would last forever.

However…

Among the reliable friends that surrounded him, one sensed something strange.

With clear wisdom and a discerning eye, and bold and delicate reasoning and judgment, a “good woman” who possesses the qualities of a “great” detective speaks.

If someone in the east is suffering, she will be there to lend a hand. If someone in the west is troubled, she will save them. A chivalrous thief is sensitive to the signs of those in need.

—It is from here that the curtains rise on the great Nosuri theater. It is she who will bring to light the true identity of the great evil that undermines the imperial capital.

Haku: “What, I gotta get involved in all that?!””
v40027.description:
──起因，不过是件微不足道的小事。

大国大和的帝都之中，过着忙碌日子的「白」。
以为和平的时光会永远持续下去。
但是……
聚集到他身边的可靠伙伴之中，有人嗅到了异变。

清冽的睿智与慧眼，大胆又细腻的推理与判断。
正是具备“名”侦探资质的“好女人”说道。

东边有人受苦便施以援手，西边有人烦恼便予以帮助。
义贼对困扰之人的气息可是十分敏感的。

——华丽的鵟剧场，就此开幕！
侵蚀帝都的巨恶的真面目，就由我来揭开！！

白“诶，这得由我来吐槽吗！？”

v26.title: 聖なるかな -The Spirit of Eternity Sword2-
v26.original: 聖なるかな -The Spirit of Eternity Sword2-
aliases: 聖なるかな -The Spirit of Eternity Sword2-
圣哉 -The Spirit of Eternity Sword2-
v26.originalDescription:
A journey across infinite worlds.

The Time Tree. Countless branches extending through space, each a world of its own. In one such world, a boy holds within him the soul of an ancient god yearning to break free. He tries to live a normal life, but must constantly struggle against the destructive urges threatening to overwhelm him.

Little does he know that his closest friends also carry the burdens of an age long forgotten. With this destiny comes power; Eternity Swords with incredible might and Guardian Spirits manifested from their very souls. The gods are reborn, friend turns on friend, and an ancient war erupts once more.

Thrown into a world not his own, Nozomu must fight to bring his friends home. He must also discover the true nature of the being within him before it consumes him utterly. Thus begins a journey that will shake the very foundation of the universe.
v26.description:
■故事
作为破坏神转世而降生的世刻望（主人公）。
随着成长，他逐渐觉醒了从内心涌出的强烈破坏冲动，
以及超越人类认知的力量。
随后，邂逅了「永恒神剑」与「神兽」的望，觉醒了奥利哈康之名，
真切感受到曾经平稳的日子正在轰然崩塌……
在支撑分支世界的「时间树」中，望被卷入了众神的战争。
在这之中，逐渐觉醒神之记忆的少年少女们。
这场战斗的真正理由是什么？
战斗尽头等待着的是什么？
各自将心意深藏胸中，寻求答案的他们的旅程就此开始——

■系统
本作的游戏部分大致分为三个部分。
通过角色之间的对话使故事发生变化的「冒险部分」。
进行部队编制和单位的培养、完成各种任务的「模拟部分」。
以及，攻击、防御、支援，三个角色各自承担不同的职责，
通过连携配合与敌方单位战斗的「战斗部分」。
是让心仪的角色大显身手，还是一丝不苟地追求胜利，
一切皆由玩家随心而定!!

■角色
【世刻望】　（CV：岛崎比吕）
永恒神剑：第五位「黎明」
守护神兽：天使・蕾梅(レーメ)
拥有破坏神前世的故事主人公。
与作为破坏神的意识抗争着，
苦恼于必须在身为人类的意识消失之前解决问题。
性格深思熟虑且认真。
善于从多角度判断问题，对自己所处的状况感到恐惧。

【斑鸠沙月】　（CV：白井绫乃）
永恒神剑：第六位「光辉」
守护神兽：半人马・凯隆
望所就读学院的学生会长。
自身也是持有永恒神剑的转生体，因此关心着身为破坏神转生体的望。
为人善良、爱管闲事、喜欢照顾人，有些爱面子。
被希美单方面视为竞争对手是目前最大的烦恼。
喜欢打扫和洗衣服，但料理是弱项。

【永峰希美】　（CV：青山由香里）
永恒神剑：第六位「清净」
守护神兽：次元鲸・莫诺贝(ものべー)
一心想着望的青梅竹马，与望同日出生的邻居。
因斑鸠沙月这位学院女神般的前辈出现，
总想与之较劲，却得不到望的注意。
有些怕生，但基本上性格开朗温柔。
兴趣是料理和写日记。

【卡蒂玛＝艾吉亚斯(カティマ＝アイギアス)】　（CV：樱川美红）
永恒神剑：第六位「心神」
守护神兽：恐惧元素・艾吉亚斯
在「剑之世界」中作为叛军先锋战斗的亡国公主。
正义感极强，绝不容忍邪恶。
不喜欢卑鄙行径，有过于重视骑士精神的倾向。
在与望等人的生活中处于大姐姐般的立场。
平时性格温厚，但不知不觉间也会卷入围绕望的纷争中。

【露普托娜(ルプトナ)】　（CV：大野麻里奈）
永恒神剑：第六位「摇篮」
守护神兽：利维坦・海神
在「精灵之世界」中站在与人类敌对的精灵一方的少女。
重视本能行动，直觉敏锐。
热血直率的性格。因一直不与人类来往生活，
除了信任的人之外很难亲近。
一旦打开心扉，就会从心底信任对方。

【娜雅＝托特卡·纳纳菲(ナーヤ＝トトカ・ナナフィ)】　（CV：本山美奈）
永恒神剑：第六位「无垢」
守护神兽：魔法机械・克劳兰斯
「魔法之世界」的总统，选择与望等人共同战斗。
高等级的技术人员，信息战的专家。
旅团中年纪最小，但有大人的成熟一面，有时会向望说教王道。
本来的性格乐天且豪放不羁，会做出超出大家预料的出格举动。
露普托娜总是被娜雅训斥。贪吃且早熟，但完全没有经验。

【萨雷斯＝库沃克斯(サレス＝クウォークス)】　（CV：皇帝）
永恒神剑：第五位「慧眼」
守护神兽：树人・贤明之巨人
统领望等人的「旅团」的领袖。
以消灭「带来光明者」为目的，
优先拯救危险的时间分支而行动。
用仿佛能看穿一切的目光，从不展露真心，除指示外几乎不说话。
为了达成目的，不惜利用同伴。

【塔利亚(タリア)】　（CV：韮井叶）
永恒神剑：第六位「疾风」
守护神兽：巨水母・漂浮之泡
在最前线战斗的「旅团」一员。
有着爱花般温柔的性格，但很少在人前展露，
通常对他人采取严厉的态度。
对望等新人没有太好的感情。
与索尔拉斯卡水火不容。有洁癖倾向。

【索尔拉斯卡(ソルラスカ)】　（CV：木岛宇太）
永恒神剑：第六位「荒神」
守护神兽：狼・黑之牙
对望抱有竞争意识，但很快便意气相投的「旅团」成员。
既然生为男儿，便想夺取天下。
粗鲁粗暴，但容易落泪且重情重义，性格直率。
天然、大胃王、味痴、哪里都能睡。
有一个小五岁的妹妹。

【昴＝塞拉夫卡(スバル＝セラフカ)】　（CV：滑川菊太郎）
永恒神剑：第六位「苍穹」
守护神兽：狮鹫・斯帕斯
认真且举止温和的青年。
「旅团」中可靠的大哥般的存在。
主动承担调解和统合的角色，也经常倾听望、沙月和希美的烦恼。
虽然讨厌争斗，但为了保护同伴会率先行动。
是富民层的儿子，但有反抗父亲而出走的过去。

【雅茨塔(ヤツィータ)】　（CV：金田真昼）
永恒神剑：第六位「愈合」
守护神兽：红龙・巴拉斯塔达
带着某种悠然的气质，但喜欢捉弄人的「旅团」二号人物。
医学知识丰富，掌握了各种医疗技术。
对同伴非常温柔且奉献。
实际上自己的过去已经消亡，不知道自己是什么人。
因此，非常害怕失去现在的同伴。

【尤菲莉亚(ユーフォリア)】　（CV：安玖深音）
永恒神剑：第三位「悠久」
守护神兽：双子龙・青之存在、光之追求
《永远的阿塞莉亚》的主人公高岭悠人与阿塞莉亚(アセリア)的女儿。
在第一次任务中被派独自旅行。
能吃、能笑、能睡。
天真烂漫，有着与年龄相符的坦率性格，
但继承了母亲的固执，一旦决定就不会退让。
忘记了来到这个世界的原因。

【晓天之绝】　（CV：中田纯）
永恒神剑：第五位「晓天」
守护神兽：堕天使・无名(ナナシ)
既不属于「旅团」也不属于「带来光明者」的孤狼。
曾经是望等人的同班同学，也是挚友。
为了濒临毁灭的故乡「枯竭之世界」的存亡，背负着人们的愤怒与悲伤，
挡在望等人的面前。
讨厌成群结队，不太信任他人。
以对其他分支世界的愤怒为食粮，独自在分支世界中旅行。

【达拉巴＝乌扎(ダラバ＝ウーザ)】　（CV：井原启介）
永恒神剑：第六位「夜烛」
守护神兽：元素・雷斯托亚斯
统率「剑之世界」军事国家格伦·德拉斯的将军。
是艾吉亚王国军事起义的幕后主谋，被周边国家畏惧为恶鬼的化身。
对自己的信念抱有绝对自信，为此不惜杀戮。
毫不留情地攻灭与艾吉亚相关的城镇和国家，似乎有着某种因缘。

【艾沃莉亚(エヴォリア)】　（CV：鸠野比奈）
永恒神剑：第六位「雷火」
守护神兽：魔像・吉姆斯
位于企图破坏分支世界的集团「带来光明者」核心的女性。
策划断绝弱小分支世界以完全释放玛娜，供应给自己的世界。
此外，通过觉醒有益的人物，暗中活动将其纳为自己的部下。

【贝尔巴尔扎德(ベルバルザード)】　（CV：户冢和也）
永恒神剑：第六位「重压」
守护神兽：红龙・加里奥帕尔萨
「带来光明者」的一员。
沉默寡言，情感难以揣测，但对组织展现出坚定的忠诚心，
为了目的毫不犹豫地挥舞强大的力量。
兼具坚强意志与隐藏的凶暴性，
接受「带来光明者」核心艾沃莉亚的命令，挡在望等人的面前。

【肖＝埃皮尔马(ショウ＝エピルマ)】　（CV：taka）
永恒神剑：第六位「疑冰」
守护神兽：蝙蝠・血之渴
出身于「未来之世界」的青年。
与昴是朋友关系。
出身贫民层，但与富裕层出身的昴一起行动。
贫民窟是故乡，不太与其他人亲近，
但对于认定为挚友的人会全力守护。

【森信助】　（CV：波多野和俊）
望的多年好友兼同班同学。
随和的类型，重视班级和睦，
学园骑在莫诺贝的背上穿越时空之后，
也率先致力于解决问题。
顺便一提是归家部，没有交往的女朋友。

【阿川美里】　（CV：莲香）
望和希美的同班同学，隶属于摄影部。
来到异世界后，能够拍摄平时拍不到的
珍奇事物，每天都过得很充实。
充满活力的女孩。

【蕾切蕾(レチェレ)】　（CV：文月加奈）
在「精灵之世界」经营酒馆「巴斯蒂尔亭」的善良少女。
父母已经去世，代替身体不适的叔叔打理店铺。
擅长想出新的料理菜单。
此外，巴斯蒂尔在「精灵之世界」中指的是「橡子」。

【菲洛梅拉(フィロメーラ)】　（CV：彩世优）
从娜雅的饮食照料到消遣的玩伴，负责日常照料全面事务的女仆。
在已建立完善供给系统的「魔法之世界」中，没有魔法工学技术的普通人，
像菲洛梅拉这样在技术人员手下效力的情况很常见。

v637.title: つくとり
v637.originalDescription: Kaoru meets Kudou on his way to work. Kudou is on her way to the scene of the murder to investigate. By following her request, Kaoru starts to investigate the murder case with her, and they find another dead body hanged from a tree soon after. According to people living nearby, a hanged dead body is found every year around the annual festival. They treat it with care as a sacrifice to Tsukutori, the local deity. Kaoru and Kudou don't believe it, but they face a series of mysterious accidents...
v637.description:
主人公“桥上郁”为了工作正前往武藏野府。途中，他遇到了正前往调查月鸟町发生的杀人事件的刑警“久十生宁”。
接受久十生的请求，郁决定协助调查这起杀人事件。
被害者是在研究所工作的名叫“福雷斯特”的身份不明的外国人。他的尸体被吊在研究所庭院的树上。
将尸体吊在树上的行为让郁等人感受到了犯人的异常性，但在月鸟町，据说每年临近祭典季节时都一定会发现“吊在树上的尸体”。
镇上的人们将吊在树上的尸体作为“筑鸟大人的祭品”郑重对待。
郁主张筑鸟根本不存在，但在推进调查的过程中，却接连遭遇了人力无法引发的离奇事件……

v1335.title: スズノネセブン！
v1335.originalDescription:
Suzunone Magic Academy is a prestigious educational and research establishment where magic meets science. Established shortly after magic has been first discovered, it has departments dedicated both to the study of magic itself, and to the engineering of devices that use magic.

Kido Yukimura is a student in the Academy's engineering division. He cannot use magic, and his unorthodox engineering approach has landed him in Suzunone Trial, a special training camp where the worst seven students from the academy are chosen every year. Each of those students is given a special personal assignment they have to pass in order to avoid getting expelled, and the assignment Yukimura gets is to "fulfill someone's wish using magic", which, given his inability to use magic, is challenging to say the least. How will he get out this predicament? And whose wish will he choose to fulfill?

v2031.title: クレナイノツキ
v2031.originalDescription:
Kouya, a rookie detective, is walking deep inside the forest. It was two weeks ago, a hand of an unidentified creature washed up on the shore of a river. Hard and thick skin, bristle like an animal, thick fingers and sharp nails, it was not a human's hand. Also, there was a jewel ring on the ring finger. 

This mysterious story was featured in a magazine and caught people's attention. Days later, the police found that it was a woman's hand, who had been missing for a month. She went missing when she played golf with her friends nearby. The police confirmed she was attacked by a stray dog, but couldn't explain why the hand looked so differently. They tried to close the case, but her husband wasn't convinced. He didn't want to believe his wife was a monster. He decided to ask a detective to investigate the case, that's why Kouya is now roaming around deep inside the forest.

It is getting dark, but he doesn't know where he is now. Just when he feels dizzy, he hears someone's voice. Is that auditory hallucination? He hears a girl's voice this time. "I've been saved!" But he accidentally falls down a waterfall. When he regains his consciousness, he finds himself lying in the bed. He looks around and finds three girls. "Are you alright?" "Well, did you save me?" "Yes, I and my older sister carried you all the way here." Their mother says to him, "I'm relieved to see you getting well. But you must marry either of my daughters, Sunao or Hiori."

He doesn't know what she means. A mysterious hand bitten off by someone, a small village deep inside the forest, marriage to a miko, Kouya's fate is led to unexpected direction after he meets these two girls...

v2375.title: 電激ストライカー
v2375.originalDescription:
Yamato has a great sense of justice and aspires to be a hero. He always tried to protect his childhood friend Haruna when she’s being bullied, but he always got beat down instead. One day, Haruna was going to move away and wanted to say goodbye to him. However, he despaired that he was never able to protect her once in the end.

He met an old man called the ‘Memory Collector’, who could grant any wish in exchange for one’s memories. Yamato wished to become a Stryker, the hero from a manga he loved. Several years later, some people with superpowers called the Balbora Empire appeared in the city Haruna was living in. The police and army were powerless in stopping them, but one warrior showed up and beat them with one kick. He was the hero of the manga Dengeki Stryker.

Koichi and his stepsisters help each other and build a relationship that is even stronger than if they had been real brother and sisters.

Now, their summer vacation turns into a sexual training camp. Who is threatening them? What does the person want? What will happen to this family?

v6016.title: RUN
v6016.originalDescription:
The story begins with Kouichi, the only son from a wealthy family. His mother died when was very little, and within that lapse of time, his father married a second time, and the stepmother brought her own daughter over, Serino, who would later become Kouichi’s little sister. His father used to ride a bike in his youth, on which he went on many trips to many places, meeting up with new people, and having different experiences. Kouichi liked to listen attentively to his father stories, no matter how plain, or simple they sounded. Both his admiration and love for his father grew with the pass of time, mostly due to these stories, and seeing how other people relied so much on his father. But after a couple of years, his father passed away. It’s normal, life comes to an end, he thought.

By then he was already a college student, and would soon inherit and administrate his father’s company. Reality kicks in, a reality far away from those stories he used to hear. He had to embrace it, until he stumbled upon that old bike once again. It was non-functional, rusty, long forgotten by time. That beaten up bike, left abandoned at the corner of the garage brought him to tears the moment he laid eyes on it, and decided to do a total restoration of it to go on a journey, just like his father did. Easier said than done, though. There’s school, responsibilities, and pretty soon, work. Somehow, he got permission, both from his father’s company and school to be absent for a while. And his stepmother helped him with the cost of the bike’s restoration. Okay, everything is moving smoothly. But he hasn’t done anything on his own, he is just the family’s pampered child. They answer to his whims. But that’s precisely why he wanted to go out to the world; to grow as a person, to gain experience in life, to stop being the family’s child, and become like his father, his life-long role model. To obtain that “something” his father had, but he actually hasn’t.

v7260.title: 恋骑士 Purely☆Kiss
v7260.originalDescription:
Meet Fujimori Kaname, a boy whose life was once saved by a knight amidst red flames and debris. That day changed him - his illusion of being all-powerful crumbled, but it wasn't despair that stayed with him. Instead, the image of the knight who rescued him inspired a vow: to become a knight who protects more people than anyone else.

Today, Kaname steps into Shiromiya Academy, a knight breeding ground. His first challenge? Joining the Shiromiya Squire Knights "Esquire", a test order for new student knights.

Kaname's journey is not just about training. It's about the companions he'll share it with: Elcia Harvence, with her striking golden hair and skillful swordplay; Kazama Akari, the spirited and impulsive girl from a modest background; Shidou Mana, the homely, marriage-ready daughter of a corporate giant; and his prodigious sister, Fujimori Yuu, who's a grade-skipping genius. Leading them all is Kuninaka Kaori, the calm and caring senior.

But there's a twist - Kaname realizes he's the only guy in the group. Amidst the confusion and a bit of worry, Kaname embarks on his knightly journey, stepping into a world of uncertainties and adventures.

v7633.title: 元素勇者学园 Material Brave
aliases: 元素勇者学园 Material Brave
v7633.originalDescription:
Kamioki-jima is an island close to Japan which was recently formed due to volcanic activity and is home to one of the rarest minerals, enigmatite. Living beings which fuse with enigmatite gain great powers. Such humans are known as "unleashed", while animals and plants are known as "neoplasm" (NP). To research the hidden powers behind enigmatite, the island was designated a special area with a school to train the unleashed, called the "Unleashed Nursery".

Ayumu is a rare male unleashed who has a special ability, ‘engage’, which boosts the powers of his female partner. However, to activate his power, there must be an exchange of bodily fluids. The school president pairs him up with the most powerful student, Kanae, who always maintained her distance from him. One day, the island was attacked by NPs and in order to defeat them, they activated his "engage" ability with a kiss.

In the middle of this century the politicians of this country, worried for the declining birth rates, propose a certain law. The "Law against Sexual Misconduct". The content of this law says that "All the sex acts that haven't as purpose the reproduction are forbidden".
It was a law that prohibited the enjoyment, through the contact or the possession, of that sort of things like the pornography and the sex industry.

He has been the first chief executive of this country and, after his retirement, has founded the "Seiren Gakuen", a facility made to isolate those young persons that have violated the law against SM, and he's spending his remaining years of life as its chairman.

A girl that has violated that law is going to be sent to the Seiren Gakuen.

Then there are "Nishina Eri", a boyish girl that she meets in the Gakuen's dormitory, and "Kuryuu Hazuki", the previous president of the students' council.
Every single day they, without being able to rest, are victims of cruel sex abuses of the men and so, adapting themselves to those sex preferences, they decide to kneel in front of the door that brings to an abnormal awakening.

v15226.title: PENDULUM
v15226.originalDescription:
PENDULUM takes place after the events of KAI’s debut title Walpurgis. It had been four years since the abominable ‘Circle of Doom’ incident and true peace still had not fully returned to the world. Various areas were still infested with grotesque angels (circulars) and it was up to a group of girls with magical powers, Magus Order, to rid them once and for all.

It appeared that their efforts had lowered the numbers of the circulars. However, people started questioning the existence of the Magus Order when their powers rivaled that of even the military. This caused a rift among the members of the Magus Order itself, resulting in a split of the group.

But even in the midst of the confusion, the fact remained that circulars are threatening the world. They cruelly murder humans and revel in hearing their screams and suffering. The Lightning Lancers division of the Magus Order descended from the assault dropshop Orthros into this hell which no one wishes to see, to fight against these ‘angels’ before disaster envelops the world once more.

v17872.title: 罪之光Rendezvous
v17872.originalDescription:
In front of the lone tunnel leading out from the small village of Tamasato, Yuuto draws a picture of a mermaid living in the deep ocean where light does not reach. One day, he looked up from his drawing and there was a girl in front of him who looked just like the one on his canvas. She called herself a ‘sinner’ who came to this town to repent for her sins. Yuuto and the townspeople welcomed the girl, Ai, to their town.

Come spring, the entrance ceremony was underway. The new students took pictures and videos in front of the school with their parents to commemorate this special day. However, it was a depressing event for Yuuto, who lives alone after the death of his father and the abandonment by his mother and older sister. While he had gotten used to it, this time he suddenly felt very lonely due to the recent passing of grandmother, the sole close relative he had left.

Upon finding out about Yuuto’s loneliness, Ai confided that she was abandoned by her parents. She searched for a reason for living, whereas he ran away from reality through his imaginative drawings. Even though they were polar opposites, their backgrounds also made them quite similar. Gradually, they became closer to each other, while harbouring secrets of their own.

50 years after the Great War the Cold War is still pending with occasional skirmishes happening.

This story takes place in the oldest preparatory school that has a big number of excellent graduates, but even bigger number of war idiots, so students of this school are often called "war fools"...

v3415.title: Viper-V16
v3415.originalDescription:
The final game in the V series and arguably the most recognizable. VIPER-V16 breaks with tradition and provides only two stories, instead of three, but both are longer, more complicated, and contain many more options than the prior V series stories, resembling games more than visual novels for the first time. The widely popular Rise story describes the kidnapping and escape attempt of three waitresses, while the lesser known Imagine tells the story of a young technical college student's attempts to attract the interests of three girls.
The Rise series prompted two sequels: VIPER-GTB and VIPER-GT1.

v9086.originalDescription:
In the year 1999, the Guild of Magicians was about to open a portal to the mysterious dimension of Nemesis, intending to rejuvenate Earth's polluted atmosphere. However, one of the magicians betrayed the Guild and used the portal for his own gain, releasing hostile creatures known as Lucifer Hawk onto Earth. Twenty-four years later, a special all-female unit known as Attacked Mystification Police was formed to combat the enemy.

Case: Titanic is based on the manga and anime Silent Möbius. It presents an original episode that involves the sighting of a strange ship in the clouds above Tokyo. Closer inspection reveals that the ship appears to be identical to the famous RMS Titanic that sank in the Atlantic Ocean in 1912. The game's nameless male protagonist boards the ship along with Rally, Kiddy, Nami and other heroines from the manga in order to investigate this seemingly inexplicable phenomenon.

v184.title: 痕
v184.originalDescription:
The protagonist, Kashiwagi Kouichi, and his father had lived apart. 
One month has already passed since his father's sudden death in an accident. Kouichi cancelled a long-awaited trip with his friends and decided to visit his old house in the countryside to revere father's memory - at least during a long summer break at university and until the forty-ninth day after his father's death. 

His cousins, having lost their parents at a very young age and having been raised by his father, stopped passing their days in sorrow and began to slowly return their smiles. The girls joyfully welcomed the protagonist but still had deep scars in their hearts. Yet one case mercilessly ripped the hearts of the girls...

v204.title: Routes
v204.originalDescription:
The story takes place in 21st Century Japan (approximately at the end of April 2010). The main character Nasu Souichi is a perfectly ordinary high school student, who tries to do as little as possible every day, and sleeps though most of his classes, only ever to be woken up by his friend Yuasa Satsuki. They believe they are living in a peaceful time, where no large wars are occurring.

However, these peaceful days are destroyed, when a number of large ships disappear at sea, almost instantly, and with no explanation as to why. A strange woman named Lisa＝Vixen suddenly appears and attacks Souichi... however Souichi also has his share of secrets.

v235.title: 雫
v235.originalDescription:
A door of madness is opening creakily...

The last few days have flown by as if I were floating in a bizarre, viscous sands of time. I had a peculiar delusion that every day the same time was repeating with the same pictures. It has been a string of tedious days with no signs of change for the better. Before long, I realized that all of the sounds and colors were leaving my dull world. I had given up on my uninteresting reality and was gradually stepping towards the world of madness...

And when one day, a girl in my class went insane. She sprang up straight from her seat, as if she were a machine, and abruptly began shouting obscenities. At the time when the teacher held her mouth, her face had become covered in blood from fresh wounds. It was the girl's own nails that were digging into her skin. While the rest of the class gasped at the scene, I just stared at the fresh blood, feeling that the real world was regaining its color...

After classes, one of the teachers in the school, my uncle, asked me to investigate this matter. So now I am starting the investigation with the assistance of one of the girls who has a connection to the case.

Little do I know, to which horrors it will lead...

v237.title: 誰彼~たそがれ~
v237.originalDescription:
You are part of a special program in the Imperial Army of Japan. During WW2 you were a clone that were subject of tests and special mutations. Liquid were injected into you that helped you develop special powers, like better healing and vision. The most important of all, immortality. You will die eventually if you are exposed to limb/body damage beyond the rate of repair, but anyway you will stay young forever.

Among your hibernation grounds there were also 3 others. One whom you once called friend. For some reason your hibernation was interrupted when your friend tried to kill you. Being almost immortal your brawl was interrupted when 2 girls entered the  domain and caused your "friend" to divert attention to the uninvited visitors. Soon you found yourself on the ground and were carried to safety by the 2 girls.

After a few word of exchange you were discharged from the hospital and went home with one of the girls that you saved. Meeting your clone you discovered that you have been dormant for almost 50 some years!

v2337.title: 同級生2
v2337.originalDescription:
As graduation looms on the horizon during the final winter break of his college life, Ryuunosuke finds himself immersed in creating precious memories with a special girl, even as the uncertainty of his future path weighs on his mind. It's as if, losing himself in these moments, he can glimpse what lies ahead... This story is brimming with the bittersweet essence of youth - pure desire intertwined with listless passion. As if shrouded in a feverish haze, the dreamlike days are drawing to a close...

Ryuunosuke spends his time grappling with indecision, trying to figure out what he wants, should do, and is capable of doing. Despite the confusion, the inevitable "end" that signifies a new chapter is fast approaching. Who will he choose to walk beside in the days to come? Where will his path lead? The only way to discover is to enter the city and embrace the world! The "answer" he seeks must be out there, waiting to be discovered...

v8325.title: Viper-V10
v8325.originalDescription:
The third Viper has the same structure as the two previous entries: three unrelated stories with little interaction, but many animated sex scenes.

The stories this time are:

1. "Northern Lights" describes a competition between two young apprentices of kendo. The protagonist, a young boy, is challenging the girl Asuka, who claims to be better than him. He needs to practice in order to win, especially because Asuka promised him she will do whatever he wants if he defeats her...

2. "Children's Play" tells the story of a teenage girl named Yuki, who is in love with an older school mate. One morning she goes to school, only to discover that someone has made pictures of her masturbating to the boy's photo...

3. "Rear Under" follows the adventures of a team of three female soldiers who have to infiltrate the base of an evil robot simply known as "Boss". One of them is captured, and the other two have to save her at all costs.

v10121.title: Viper-GTB ~Rise After~
v10121.originalDescription: The long awaited sequel to the VIPER-V16 story, VIPER-GTB's "Rise After" chapter takes place almost four years after "Rise". Her family abducted, Saki returns to Anne Mitter's to enlist Akira's help in a daring rescue. In the course of saving them from the domineering aquatic queen Irear, Akira herself is captured. Offering to rescue her are a small band of extra-terrestrials, led by the mysterious Tarma whose true intentions are not revealed until its too late. Trading Karin, Saki, and Seed to Irear in exchange for the strongest woman on Earth, Tarma claims Akira as his newest slave. Fellow champion martial artist Makoto, arriving at Anne Mitter's to avenge a recent defeat at the hands of Akira, becomes embroiled in the plot, soon following Tarma's companion Narsha to the spaceship, where she and the warriors of the underground race lay siege to the craft. The fate of other strong women across the galaxy now rests with Akira and Makoto.

v117.title: Brave Soul
v117.originalDescription:
It is a world very different from ours, a world in which magic exists, a world where peasants labor under the burden of heavy taxes imposed upon them by the unfair rulers of the land. Although the commoners have a difficult lot, there are those among them with the strength to use his sword and make a name for himself -- an adventurer. To be an adventurer is the dream of every peasant.

The story details the journey of a young man who was raised in the countryside of Souvania, on the continent of Valencia. Disowned by his own father and forced to make his way in life, he chooses to become a Hunter, a mercenary who accepts jobs for a variety of adventures. Heading into town to officially join the Hunter’s Guild with his dragon Shell at his side, he happens across a mysterious girl who looks strikingly like the Moon Goddess.

The Moon Goddess... Ever since he was young, a beautiful girl appears before him on nights of a full moon. Because of the mysterious manner of her appearance, he gave her a unique name. With the mysterious girl Alicia and dragon Shell at his side, as well as new characters he will join with later, our hero embarks on many bold adventures. But will he ever be able to solve the bizarre mystery of the beautiful Moon Goddess standing in the lake...?

v130.title: Yin-Yang! X Change Alternative
v130.originalDescription:
Kaoru Sakurazuka is a normal young man, besides his unusually feminine features. Even his name, Kaoru, is a common name for both girls and boys. His friends don't care, and he enjoys living in a cheap apartment with his buddies Touya and Renji.

One day he feeling strangely ill, so Kaoru visits the school doctor, who is more like a crackpot chemist that enjoying creating new concoctions in the name of science. Upon his visit, Kaoru accidentally drinks a vial marked 'experimental medicine' – and the next day Kaoru, the boy, has become Kaoru, the girl! While he desperately tries to find a way to return to normal, he's forced to spend his days in his new female body.

Kaoru is surprised at the changes in his environment now that he's a girl. Everywhere he goes he's the center of attention, and it seems that everyone takes an interest in him. What strange adventures are in store for Kaoru, now that he has this new body to test-out?

v299.title: 大番長 -Big Bang Age-
v299.originalDescription:
In the year 200X, a giant hole erupted in the middle of Japan. Called the Hell Hole, its appearance caused the sea to split and the lands to bend. The entirety of Japan was twisted out of shape, and dark B-crystals appeared everywhere, bestowing special powers to some people, mostly the younger generation. Special Students, as those people were soon called, became the object of fear. Japan became ruled by violence and terror and was cut off from the rest of the world.

A year after the appearance of the Demonic Hole, a Special Student with extraordinary strength and will managed to unite the Special Students throughout Japan. He formed the Student Union (S.U.) to bring order back to Japan, and Japan entered a peaceful time, but it was not meant to last.

Now, the land is more split than ever between the military of the PGG, the horrifying vampires of the Nightmare Eyes, the disciplined ninjas of the NPI, the fanatical Holy Flame knights, and the violent Skull Serpents sky pirates, with no end to the hostilities in sight. However, one man appearing in the Tokyo school may just change Japan forever...

v913.title: 水月 -すいげつ-
v913.originalDescription:
On a summer afternoon, I woke up in a hospital bed without any recollection of the past. I was suffering from severe amnesia, and the ones who saved me as I trembled with doubt and fear through the night were my friends and my maid, Yuki. Through their kindness, my life began once again. A new life filled with joy and happiness. 

However, the nightmare that haunted me ever since I woke up that day continued to torment me. In my dreams was a woman with pure white skin and black hair so lustrous it seemed to fade into the dark night. And within a few weeks, on the night of the Star Festival, I would meet this beautiful girl.

Makino Nanami...

The girl whom I killed with my arrow each and every night ...

v1069.title: 群青の空を越えて
v1069.originalDescription:
You start off as Yashiro, one of the two first rank students in a flight combat school maintained by the army. Japan is split into two factions and the situation is tense, with small battles being held here and there.
His father was the one who caused the entire splitting up and tense situation, with the proposal of some yen economic plan.
Life isn’t exactly as easy as normal school life over there, with it’s hardcore training. Still, he still manages to talk with friends and just act like a somewhat normal guy of his age should act.
But things never go right. Rumors have that a war is starting. That means he’ll have to go out to the frontlines as a pilot killing people. Can he save what his father has caused or can he even survive till the end of the war?

Takuya Takahashi, who is a professional investigator, a "Runner," is asked to investigate the case, and he starts investigating this dangerous disease, without even knowing much about it?

v2709.title: EVE ZERO
v2709.originalDescription:
"Eve Zero" is a prequel to the famous detective/mystery adventure Eve Burst Error.
You control once again the two main heroes of the series: the witty and womanizing private investigator Kojiroh Amagi, and the beautiful red-haired secret agent Marina Hojo. The events of the game take place shortly before those of "Eve Burst Error". Kojiroh is working at Katsuragi Detective Office together with his girlfriend Yayoi. Dr. Nishina, the head of a genetic research facility, hires Kojiroh to investigate the disappearance of his son Shin. v13843.title: 海空のフラグメンツ
v13843.originalDescription:
When he was small, Shin made a promise with a girl who only visited the island for the summer. They promised to attend the same school when they grew up, so that they could always be together. This childhood memory and innocent promise faded as the months and years passed by. However, everything changed when he saw a photo of a student council president in one of the school brochures which he was leafing through. He decided to enrol in that school, the promised school.

Shin attended the entrance ceremony with expectations of a new school life, but it was suddenly announced that the school would be closing in a few months. He was obviously disappointed by the news, but he was determined to bring the "rose-coloured school life" which he had dreamt of into reality. The first step was joining the student council which was full of beauties. It would be the quickest way to attain his dream.

v15655.originalDescription:
This is the sequel to Magical Canan. One year after the Dark Materia incident, contact was lost with the unit monitoring the human world. Natsuki once again headed to the human world on the orders of Tsuyuha, the Queen of the magic world Evergreen. He immediately went to meet up with Chihaya, but he was attacked by a black magic warrior named Crimson. However, he can’t fight by himself; he only had the power to bestow magical powers to his partner, transforming her into a magic warrior.

He ran around looking for Chihaya and bumped into Misaki, kissing her on the lips and turning her into Magical Warrior Machalite. They were able to fight off Crimson, but Natsuki was perplexed at how he was able to give his powers to someone other than Chihaya. After he found Chihaya, he discovered that she could no longer turn into Magic Warrior Carmein. Will he be able to overcome the dangers and bring back peace to the human world?

v12702.originalDescription:
A dating sim game based on the anime Date A Live.

Thirty years ago a strange phenomena called a "spacequake" devastated the center of Eurasia, claiming the lives of at least 150 million people. Since then, smaller spacequakes plague the world on an irregular basis. Itsuka Shido, a seemingly ordinary high schooler comes across a mysterious girl at the ground zero of a spacequake and learns from his sister Kotori she is one of the "Spirits" who are the real cause of the spacequakes that occur when they manifest themselves in the world. He also learns that Kotori is the captain of the airship Fraxinus, crewed by the organization Ratatoskr, and is recruited to make use of his mysterious ability to seal the Spirits' powers thus stopping them from being a threat to mankind. However, there is a catch: to seal a Spirit, he must make her fall in love with him and kiss her.

(Summary of the plot from Wikipedia)

This game introduces a new heroine named Sonogami Rinne. The only gameplay system is choosing which girl you want to talk to, and the game itself is centered on dating the heroines. Features animated CGs.

v15771.title: 黑蝶幻境
v15771.originalDescription:
As she fell deeper and deeper into the darkness, she could hear the sound of rainfall.
Also, she heard an animalistic cry.

When she woke up, the young girl found herself in a Western-style mansion.
An unknown, terrible monster rushes to attack the confused girl.
As the young girl ran away from the monster, she thought:

"Where is this place?"
"Who am I, anyway?"

Having lost pretty much all of her memories, she eventually met and joined up with some men in the same circumstances as her.
They all held weapons that were strange handguns.
From there on out, with their lives at stake, they must participate in the "Black Butterfly Hunt", and collect "Kaleidoscope Shards" possessed by those monsters.

Inside the Western-style mansion in which despair and betrayal swirls, will they be able to find hope in their futures?

v16842.originalDescription:
That day, Shidou felt something strange with the duplicate key he found in his house. The thing that he should have handed it to someone for sure. However, he doesn't remember to whom he should have handed it to. At that moment, a small noise appeared above his head, and takes the consciousness of Shidou.
Upon being awakened, Shidou found himself in a world where Arusu Maria exist, who does not have a physical body in reality. And then, a certain girl appeared before Shido.
Sonogami Rinne ― At one time, a girl that Shidou had failed to save.
Shidou, who regained the memories of when he had known, becomes possible to investigate the cause of the resurgence of Eden .
In the midst of it, who appeared before Shido was, a young girl whose appearance resembles that of  ― Rio.
"It's no good if you don't find the most important thing to you."
What does Rio means by "the most important thing"? Is she an existence related to Eden ?
In this closed world, the action should Shido take in order to regain the everyday life is only one―
By dating and make them fall in love!?
v16842.description:
2014年12月COMPILE HEART宣布新制作，之后在2015年2月游戏官方网站上宣布本作为由《约会大作战 凛祢乌托邦》与《约会大作战 或守装置》合辑移植PS Vita并追加新剧情的版本。
原作者橘公司与原画家つなこ继续担任监修以及人物设定。本作在原作基础上增加原创角色园神凛绪（園神 凜緒（そのがみ りお），声：佐仓绫音）以及全新章节“转世凛绪”，5月20日完整游戏PV公开。
时间线介于游戏《或守装置》以及小说第八卷《搜寻七罪》之间。
本作发售有限定版、通常版以及下载版三个版本。与前作相同，限定版附送收录原画师未收录插图，以及由原作者执笔的短篇小说“团聚凛绪（暂译）（凜緒リユニオン）”以及相关人物介绍的特典小册子以及广播剧CD。

v6341.originalDescription:
This is the modern era where magic exists alongside science. Ayako Orihara is a student and a member of the Occult Research Club at Keisei Academy.
Despite the flourishing of magic alongside science, the popularity of the occult is significantly low, and thus Ayako is not only the head of the club but is also its only member.

Ayako is told that the Occult Research Club will be closed down if more members don’t join so she does whatever she can to attract interest in order to save her club. To do so, she attempts to explore the legendary “Seven Wonders of the Academy.” However, each wonder she seeks out only results in failure. Finally, she tries the only thing that’s left, the Seventh Wonder: “Get kicked by a horse and die,” which turns out to be more than outrageous–
She accidentally digs her own grave out of curiosity, and finds something strange.
These are the strange, fun, and— precious seven days of Ayako and her friends.

“Seven days with the Ghost“ is a serious yuri visual novel that’s fake-occult at a fake magical academy created by members of the 2-chan community.

One day in the yard at his home, Yotsuba finds a Phillips-head screwdriver. He traces its origin to a nearby abandoned manor, and enters. Inside, he finds something…

v22020.originalDescription:
After being taken in by Kashou and his little sister, Shigure, the young kittens, Chocola and Vanilla find it difficult to fit in. Despite the warm welcome the other Minaduki catgirls give to them, they act with trepidation as they adjust to the pace of the family.

As they slowly interact with their fellow sister catgirls, Chocola and Vanilla begin to open up more and it's here we see Kashou's kindness towards them that builds up their feelings towards him.

v24889.originalDescription:
The sequel to the novel game "The Fox is Waiting for Me'', is finally here!

The story revolves around Shua, a slightly naughty fox girl who lives in a fox mansion deep in the forest, and Kaito, a boy with amnesia, and Mimir, a mountain god with a small body but big attitude who lives in a nearby lake.

One day, Lyufa and Renfa were dispatched by the Shua clan to test her power. Starting with the encounter between Shua and Ryufa, Kaito and his friends become entangled in the plans of the Shinigami and the Fox Clan.

Will Kaito, who got lost with Ryufa in a space-time that closed due to a certain trigger, be able to escape safely? And what is the aim of Karin's "senior'' who is working behind the scenes?

The bond between Kaito, Shua, Mimir, and Karin will be tested!
